jobs.title: Full Time Senior Full-Stack Developer
jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are hiring a Senior Full-stack Developer.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are hiring a Senior Full-stack Developer. You will build and ship new products across a portfolio of companies. You work from the backlog alongside your team, and you manage your own day-to-day work. You also help our digital marketing agency with technical needs from time to time. The work happens in TypeScript and JavaScript stacks, with AWS and mobile app releases as part of the work.

About Us

New products here start on Lovable and similar platforms so we can test them fast. The ones that work get taken over with time, which means moving the code, the infrastructure, and the app store accounts into our own hands. As our first hire, you are how that handoff begins, and you set the technical foundation the rest of the team builds on.

What You Will Do

  1. Build and Ship Production Code. You write and own full-stack code in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, and you take products from AI-generated prototypes into production.
  2. Make Sure Stakeholders Never Find a Bug. You test your work before it reaches a stakeholder. That means writing automated tests, testing on web and on real iOS and Android devices, and releasing only when it holds up.
  3. Rapid AI Prototyping and Development. You use our AI-assisted workflows (Lovable, Cursor, and emerging AI agents) to spin up and validate feature prototypes quickly. Then you carry them into full engineering production, including the call on when a product has outgrown its starter platform and needs to move to our own codebase and AWS setup.
  4. Hands-on Architecture and Code Review. You review code, diagnose build bottlenecks, and directly program code overrides or refinements when AI generation tools hit their limits. You set the technical standards so the output stays clean, type-safe, and scalable.
  5. Work From Specs and Sharpen Them. You build from the specs and acceptance criteria written by our product manager and stakeholders. When you spot a gap, you raise it early and propose a solution.
  6. Ship Mobile Releases. You manage App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and release schedules for our mobile apps.
  7. Support the Agency. You help with the agency's technical needs as they come up, including AWS accounts, hosting, access, software costs, and the technical side of client projects.

Tech Stack

  • React, TypeScript, and Node.js, front end and back end
  • Supabase and PostgreSQL for application back ends and databases
  • AWS for hosting and infrastructure
  • Data warehouse storage for reporting and analytics
  • AI-assisted development with Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, and emerging AI agents, where most new products begin
  • WordPress for marketing sites, hosted on Cloudways
  • iOS and Android app releases through the App Store and Google Play

Requirements

  • Deep Coding Expertise: 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience (React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL). You have the technical authority to audit other developers' work and enforce structural code quality.
  • Self-Directed Work: You manage your own time and priorities, take direction once, and carry it through without needing a manager to check on you.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow Competency: Active, practical experience using AI code creation or agentic tools (Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, or similar platforms) to speed up application prototyping and delivery workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Strong UI/UX awareness, product intuition, and the ability to think like a tech founder. You spot product gaps and propose solutions proactively, without needing detailed design direction.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, written and verbal, with a proven ability to coordinate effectively with international startup teams and founders.
  • A Tester's Eye: You find bugs other people miss, and you write down how to reproduce them so a developer can fix them fast.
  • Cross-Platform Mobile: React Native, Capacitor, or another way to ship one codebase to both app stores.
  • AI Builder Handoffs: Experience moving a product from an AI app builder into a production codebase.
  • Platform Familiarity: Experience with AWS and with getting a mobile app through App Store and Google Play review.
  • Industry Experience: Experience working on SaaS or marketing technology products.
  • Marketing Technology: Familiarity with analytics, tag management, and CRM integrations.

Nice to Have

  • Engineering Leadership: 3+ years of experience managing remote software engineering teams, running agile sprint cycles, and driving hiring strategies or organization building.
  • Mentoring: Experience training developers and leading code reviews for a team.
  • Startup Technical Leadership: Experience as a fractional CTO, agency tech lead, or startup technical founder.
  • Marketing and Sales: A deep background in marketing and sales.

Hours and Language

Fluent English, spoken and written, is required. You will work a combination of US and overseas hours so you overlap with our US stakeholders and with developers in other time zones.

How We Work

  • You carry out direction without needing a manager to check on you, so your team does not have to micro-manage you.
  • You learn from the first mistake and do not need to be told the same thing twice.
  • If a deadline will slip, you tell the team before the deadline date.
  • You give and receive constructive feedback with emotional intelligence.
  • You talk to people directly instead of about them, and you act with honesty and integrity.
  • You are accountable. You own your results and your commitments from start to finish.
  • You are coachable. You ask for feedback, take it in, and change how you work because of it.

How the Role Grows

You start as the first developer, owning the build and quality of our newest products, plus occasional technical help for the agency. As products mature and move off their starter platforms, you take on more of the architecture. As we hire, you can grow into technical leadership by mentoring developers, leading code reviews, and helping shape the team.

jobs.excerpt: Responsibilities100% Remote Emergency Radiologist (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME) Evening and Overnight Shifts, Full and Part Time options, Huge salary upside Dartmouth Health’s Department of Radiology is seeking fully Remote Evening and Overnight Emergency Teleradiologists (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME).
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

100% Remote Emergency Radiologist (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME)

Evening and Overnight Shifts, Full and Part Time options, Huge salary upside

Dartmouth Health’s Department of Radiology is seeking fully Remote Evening and Overnight Emergency Teleradiologists (FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, ME). This is a high-paying job with plenty of time off to travel and live life, offering a vibrant and fulfilling career, and being part of a thriving department. Fully remote Evening and Overnight Emergency Radiologists have no on-site responsibilities, though they are valued members of our department helping us cover multiple Dartmouth Health facilities located throughout New Hampshire and Vermont. Dartmouth Radiology is a leading, nationally known radiology enterprise covering all modalities and all radiology subspecialties.

Position Summary

Dartmouth Health is seeking a remote evening and nighttime radiologist to join our Emergency Radiology imaging division. Evening and overnight work consists of a standard emergency radiology case mix, comprised mostly of straight -forward x-rays, CTs, and Ultrasounds. We have limited overnight and evening MRs acquired as well. Our evening and overnight coverage is a team model, so candidates with specific strengths or weakness can often be accommodated.

We cover the Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center, which is a level I Trauma Center and has a Comprehensive Stroke Center, as well as imaging from other surrounding facilities. The Emergency radiology schedule is a 7-day-on, 14-days-off schedule with staggered, overlapping shifts covering the evening and overnight hours.

The Department values patient-centered care and a highly collaborative, respectful, caring, and engaging work environment. There is a strong working relationship with other Departments.

We are able to employ radiologists from Florida, Missouri, Washington state, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Vermont, and Maine.

Though Dartmouth radiology is home to outstanding training programs, remote radiologists do not have direct educational responsibilities. We do welcome candidates who are interested in occasionally lecturing or other engagements with our educational mission, though participation in entirely voluntary without any core expectations built into the role. Remote radiologists do not routinely read out radiology residents, though limited resident interaction is possible. Our remote radiology team is also not expected to participate in research or other scholarly activities, though again, we welcome candidates who may have targeted interested and we aim to be supportive of candidate’s professional goals.

All remote radiologists will be full members of the Department as well as valued W-2 employees of Dartmouth Health. Remote readers are provided a Dartmouth owned reading station with a full suite of our standard PACS software.

Compensation

Remote radiologists are W-2 benefited employees who are compensated via our productivity-based Radiology Compensation plan. The plan offers a competitive guaranteed starting salary with opportunity for productivity incentives in addition to base.

All remote radiologists receive employer-provided retirement contributions, including a generous matching program, which are in addition to one’s salary. Medical malpractice is provided. There is a generous health insurance option specifically for remote employees.

Our faculty are encouraged to participate in continuing education, national societies, and professional development organizations, depending on the faculty’s interest and needs. We support these efforts with institutional funds allocated to each faculty member.

Schedule

The Emergency radiology schedule is a 7-day-on, 14-days-off schedule with staggered, overlapping shifts covering the evening and overnight hours. We have opportunities to do additional hours or add-on shifts (analogous to internal moonlighting) for those seeking additional income. A full-time position involves completing 4 weeks of work every 12 weeks (one week out of every three), and we have options for individuals to do part time roles (including completing 3 or 2 weeks of work every 12 weeks).

Clinical Excellence

The Department prides itself on high-quality, efficient, modern imaging and very much prizes our clinical service and the care provided to our patients. Remote readers will have an essential role in contributing to our core clinical mission. We value the engagement of all radiologists on our team, including remote radiologist, in our robust peer learning program and all quality systems. We value input on the imaging provided and clinical services rendered.

The Department values patient-centered care and a highly collaborative, respectful, caring, and engaging work environment. We value remote radiologists’ contributions to our positive and caring culture. There is a strong working relationship with other Departments, and all referrers.

Benefits:

  • Market leading, highly competitive salaries.
  • Remote readers are eligible for our generous retirement programs with institutional-contributions and a matching program.
  • Remote radiologist roles are fully benefited positions that include malpractice insurance, life insurance, disability insurance, as well as an affordable medical plan.
  • CME funds
  • Incredible department culture which is respectful, transparent, communicative, supportive, optimistic, constructive, and engaged; this culture permeates the department including our on-site and remote workforce. We value our sense of community and our connection to each other.

To learn more, please visit:

www.DHproviders.org

Cover Letters should be addressed to:

David M. Naeger, MD FACR FAAR

Chair, Department of Radiology

CV and cover letter to be sent to:

Caitlin Vecchio, MBA, CPRP-DEI

The Department and Dartmouth Health

The selected candidates will join Dartmouth Health’s 70 radiologists. We are an internationally-known Department with a deep history in the field, beginning with acquiring the first clinical x-ray in the United States in 1896. Since then, we have continued an upward trajectory growing in breadth and depth and expanding our services across New England.

While Dartmouth Health includes many hospitals and clinic sites, our central hub is the tertiary-care Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center, which is the system’s one and only Academic Medical Center. DHMC is the state’s only Level 1 trauma center, a certified Comprehensive Stroke Center, and home to an NCI-designated Comprehensive Cancer Center. Dartmouth runs a fleet of helicopter and ground-based medical transport services connecting facilities and patients throughout New England.

Dartmouth Health maintains a total of 802 beds, with 458 located at DHMC. Our extensive network handles over 3 million outpatient visits annually, supported by a dedicated team of 15,000 employees and more than 2,300 employed providers. Our commitment to the community is reflected in our contributions, with over $345 million in community benefits and $16 million in charity care. These numbers underscore our role as a leading healthcare provider, committed to both clinical excellence and community support.

Required Licensure/Certifications

  • Diagnostic Radiology Board Certified or Board Eligible
  • Must obtain and maintain a medical license in New Hampshire, Vermont, and the candidate’s state of residence.
  • Currently, we are able to employ remote readers who live in, and will read from, FL, MO, WA, CT, MA, NH, VT, and/or ME. We require a fixed address (or addresses), from which readers will provide services. More than 1 address is acceptable as long as all addresses are within the 7 states listed above and the radiologist’s current location is provided at all times.

Job Title: Sr Director & Head of Sales, IQVIA Language Solutions

Job Location: Reading, Berkshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Head of Sales


Europe-based | Sales Leadership | Life Sciences & Healthcare


The opportunity


IQVIA Language Solutions is building the multilingual operating layer for global life sciences—bringing together healthcare intelligence, AI-enabled workflows, specialist human expertise and the reach of IQVIA. We are moving beyond traditional translation to help customers manage critical content safely and efficiently across clinical, regulatory, safety, patient and commercial workflows.

Join a growing, entrepreneurial commercial organization and shape how IQVIA takes this next generation of language solutions to market. As Head of Sales, you will set the sales strategy, own the team quota and build a disciplined, high-performing sales organization capable of winning complex enterprise business. You will lead from the front on strategic pursuits, develop exceptional sales talent and connect IQVIA Language Solutions more deeply into the broader IQVIA portfolio and customer base.

This is a visible leadership role for a modern commercial leader who combines localization expertise, life sciences credibility and rigorous sales execution. You will have the platform to deliver meaningful growth today while building the team, operating model and executive relationships required for the future.


What you will do


  • Develop and execute the sales strategy across priority markets, customer segments, solutions and accounts, translating business goals into clear territory plans, quotas and seller-level objectives.
  • Own and exceed the team’s annual bookings, revenue and gross-margin targets, with direct accountability for new-logo acquisition, strategic account growth and predictable commercial performance.
  • Recruit, lead, coach and retain a high-performing team of enterprise sales and business development professionals; establish a culture of ambition, accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Drive sales excellence through clear performance expectations, regular coaching, opportunity reviews, pipeline governance, forecasting and decisive performance management.
  • Build a healthy, qualified pipeline with the coverage and velocity required to deliver the plan; ensure CRM quality, stage integrity and reliable, evidence-based forecasts.
  • Lead pursuit strategy for the most important, complex and competitive opportunities—from executive sponsorship and value proposition through proposal, negotiation, contracting and handover.
  • Build trusted executive relationships across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO and healthcare organizations, positioning IQVIA Language Solutions as a strategic multilingual content and workflow partner.
  • Partner across IQVIA to create integrated opportunities that combine Language Solutions with broader data, technology, clinical and commercial capabilities, and mobilize IQVIA account leaders around shared customer priorities.
  • Work closely with Account Management, Presales, Delivery, Technology, Quality, Marketing, Finance, Pricing and Legal to ensure that solutions are differentiated, commercially sound, operationally viable and implemented successfully.
  • Bring customer, market and competitive insight into go-to-market priorities, offering development, investment decisions and the evolution of IQVIA’s AI-enabled, human-assured language portfolio.
  • Represent IQVIA Language Solutions in executive customer engagements, industry forums and selected thought-leadership opportunities.

What success looks like


  • The sales team consistently achieves quota and delivers sustainable bookings, revenue and gross-margin growth.
  • A strong, well-qualified pipeline converts into new logos, new buying centers and larger strategic opportunities.
  • Forecasts are reliable, CRM and opportunity management are disciplined, and commercial risks are surfaced early.
  • Sellers perform at a higher level through clear expectations, active coaching, strong deal leadership and a visible talent pipeline.
  • Executive relationships deepen and integrated IQVIA pursuits create measurable customer value beyond translation fulfillment.

What you bring


  • 10+ years of progressive commercial experience, including significant leadership of enterprise sales teams across countries, regions or complex markets.
  • A proven record of building teams and consistently achieving ambitious revenue targets in language services, localization, multilingual content, life sciences technology, professional services or a closely related field.
  • Deep knowledge of the localization ecosystem and a strong understanding of pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO or healthcare customer needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to create and execute sales strategy, set quotas, improve seller productivity and turn pipeline discipline into predictable growth.
  • A coaching-led leadership style: you set a high bar, develop people thoughtfully, recognize performance and address gaps directly.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise pursuits and influencing C-suite and senior functional leaders.
  • Strong commercial judgment across value-based selling, pricing, margin, proposals, negotiation, contracting and competitive positioning.
  • The ability to lead effectively in a global, matrixed organization and align diverse teams around a clear commercial outcome.
  • Curiosity about AI, localization technology and evolving content workflows, with the judgment to balance automation, human expertise, quality, security and compliance.
  • Executive presence, resilience and the communication skills to inspire a team, earn customer trust and represent a growing business internally and externally.

Why join IQVIA Language Solutions?


You will join at a pivotal point: the team is scaling its commercial organization, broadening into new life sciences workflows and building a more connected, technology-enabled portfolio. This role offers the mandate to shape the sales organization, develop outstanding commercial talent and win meaningful business with the backing of IQVIA’s global reach, healthcare expertise and customer relationships.

If you are energized by building high-performing teams, challenging the traditional localization model and creating a more strategic role for multilingual content in healthcare, this is an opportunity to make a visible and lasting impact.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.

The Director, HEDIS & Quality Performance, is accountable for developing and executing the enterprise strategy to drive HEDIS performance across all lines of business, with emphasis on HEDIS measures contributing to the Medicare Advantage Stars program. This leader will serve as the organization's enterprise subject matter expert and strategic architect for HEDIS performance, including HEDIS measures contributing to Medicare Advantage Stars ratings, translating CMS and NCQA requirements, performance data, market intelligence, and industry best practices into actionable strategies that improve clinical quality, member outcomes, provider performance, operational effectiveness, and HEDIS results. This role requires deep expertise across HEDIS measurement, quality improvement, data acquisition and completeness, provider performance, intervention design and audit readiness and the transition to digital quality measurement. The Director will lead through influence across a highly matrixed organization, building shared accountability for HEDIS outcomes and visibility to an enterprise plan. The Director will own and orchestrate cross-functional HEDIS plans, establish clear performance expectations, and drive follow-through across participating functions. The Director will oversee a sizeable team of direct/indirect reports, with additional matrixed oversight and influential collaboration with a multitude of related stakeholders. This leader will also build the organization’s internal HEDIS capability by developing talent, strengthening measure expertise, and creating sustainable processes that reduce reliance on individual employees, manual workarounds and fragmented institutional knowledge

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkhedenVoor een afgebakende analyseopdracht zoeken we een ICT Business Analyst die een onafhankelijk advies uitwerkt over de toekomst van een bestaand digitaal platform.
jobs.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een afgebakende analyseopdracht zoeken we een ICT Business Analyst die een onafhankelijk advies uitwerkt over de toekomst van een bestaand digitaal platform. Het gaat om een eenmalige opdracht ter beslissingsondersteuning. Structureel applicatiebeheer, productbeheer en ALM blijven buiten de opdracht en behoren tot de interne verantwoordelijkheden.

De opdracht resulteert in een beknopt en onderbouwd adviesrapport, aangevuld met een korte toelichting aan de opdrachtgever. Binnen een beperkt analysevolume formuleer je een onafhankelijke technische en financiële evaluatie als basis voor de keuze tussen drie toekomstscenario's.

Doel en deliverables

  • Een technische en financiële analyse van de huidige situatie.
  • Een inschatting van kosten en risico's per scenario.
  • Een gemotiveerde aanbeveling, rekening houdend met doelstellingen en budgettaire haalbaarheid.

In scope

1. Technische analyse

  • Je brengt de voornaamste technische knelpunten, technische schuld en structurele oorzaken van terugkerende incidenten en hoge onderhouds- of supportkosten in kaart, inclusief relevante API's en koppelingen.
  • Je beoordeelt de afhankelijkheid van een gedeelde back-end en de impact daarvan op mogelijke toekomstscenario's.
  • Je maakt een high-level evaluatie van de stabiliteit, onderhoudbaarheid en risico's van het huidige platformmodel.
  • Je signaleert UX- en rolgerelateerde drempels die een duidelijke impact hebben op kosten, adoptie of scenariohaalbaarheid, op basis van beschikbare data en gesprekken met stakeholders.

2. Samenwerkingen en externe afhankelijkheden

  • Je analyseert de technische werking van bestaande doorstromen en koppelingen, inclusief knelpunten en de financiële of operationele afweging tegenover de doelstellingen.
  • Je beoordeelt geplande of voorbereide integraties op relevantie, risico en kostenimpact voor de verschillende scenario's.
  • Je voert een korte marktverkenning uit naar overlappende instrumenten of platformen die relevant zijn voor een fundamentele heroriëntatie.

3. Financiële analyse

  • Je geeft inzicht in de belangrijkste kostendrijvers.
  • Je maakt een duidelijke afbakening tussen beheer, support, optimalisatie en doorontwikkeling.
  • Je weegt de huidige werking af tegenover de vooropgestelde doelstellingen.
  • Je werkt per scenario een indicatieve kosten- en investeringsrange uit, met aandacht voor risico's en afhankelijkheden.

Scenario's waarover advies verwacht wordt

  • Scenario 1: behouden en optimaliseren van de huidige vorm en functie, met onderbouwde aanpassingen en kosten-bateninschatting.
  • Scenario 2: heroriënteren of grondig aanpassen van functie, doelstellingen, techniek en budget, met onderbouwde aanpassingen en kosten-bateninschatting.
  • Scenario 3: fundamenteel hertekenen, inclusief de afweging of een eigen platform nog de beste optie is of aansluiting bij andere instrumenten meer aangewezen is.

Buiten scope

  • Dagelijkse ticketafhandeling, bugfixing en operationele support.
  • Volledige UX-research of een volledig redesign voor alle doelgroepen.
  • Een volledige maatschappelijke impactanalyse of beleidsanalyse.
  • De implementatie van het gekozen scenario.

Werkwijze

De opdracht omvat documentanalyse, verduidelijking van kostenstructuren, technische interviews met interne ICT, productverantwoordelijken en de huidige technische partner, analyse van beschikbare monitoring-, ticket- en kosteninformatie, afstemming met relevante stakeholders en oplevering van een adviesrapport met toelichting.

Je combineert daarbij inzicht in algemene bedrijfsvoering met toepassing op ICT, ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van bedrijfsprocessen (BPM), projectmanagement en stakeholdermanagement. Er wordt ook verwacht dat je vertrouwd bent met projectmatige aspecten zoals kosten, timing, coördinatie, planning en inschattingen, en dat je technische omgevingen met onder meer Craft, Next.js, AWS, PHP en Drupal voldoende kan beoordelen in functie van productbeheer en optimalisatie. Ervaring binnen de Vlaamse overheid of bredere publieke sector is hierbij relevant.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt een sterke achtergrond in algemene bedrijfsvoering met toepassing op ICT.
  • Je hebt ervaring met ontwikkeling en optimalisatie van bedrijfsprocessen (BPM).
  • Je beschikt over senior ervaring in projectmanagement.
  • Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en kan verschillende partijen zorgvuldig meenemen in een analyse- en adviestraject.
  • Je beheerst verschillende projectmanagementfacetten, zoals kosten, timing, coördinatie, planning en schattingen.
  • Je kan technische landschappen met Craft, Next.js, AWS, PHP en Drupal inhoudelijk evalueren.
  • Je hebt ervaring met productbeheer en optimalisatie.
  • Ervaring binnen de Vlaamse overheid of de publieke sector is een pluspunt.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (10%).

Role Summary

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.
  • Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.
  • Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.
  • Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.
  • Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.
  • Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.
  • Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.
  • Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • 15+ years of progressive legal experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).
  • Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.
  • Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.
  • Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

jobs.title: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)
jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

About the Role

At BukuWarung, we are building the financial backbone for millions of underserved merchants. As an SDE II in Lending Engineering, you will design and scale systems that power our lending products—ensuring a seamless user experience, strong data consistency, and reliable integrations with external financial partners.

Your work will directly impact how merchants access and interact with credit, from application to disbursement and repayment. Beyond building features, you will help lay the foundation for a scalable lending platform that can evolve toward automated underwriting and intelligent decisioning.

The Mission

We are entering a critical phase where scalability, reliability, and data integrity are essential. You will work within a Hexagonal Architecture to ensure our lending platform can scale sustainably while remaining resilient and maintainable.

Our goal is to build a system that not only handles growing transaction volumes but also integrates deeply with partners and internal data sources—ultimately enabling us to develop our own underwriting capabilities and automate credit decisions at scale.

What You'll Do

  • Build Scalable Lending Systems: Design and deliver core features across the lending lifecycle, including loan origination, disbursement, repayment, and reconciliation.

  • Java Mastery: Strong proficiency in Java (11+) and modern Spring Boot.

  • Ensure Data Consistency: Develop systems that maintain strong data integrity across distributed services, especially in financial transactions and state transitions.

  • Partner Integrations: Build and manage robust integrations with external partners such as payment gateways, banks, and credit bureaus.

  • Platform Evolution: Contribute to the foundation for underwriting systems, enabling future automation of credit risk assessment and decisioning.

  • System Reliability: Improve fault tolerance, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to ensure reliable financial operations.

  • Data & Storage: Own schema design and manage database evolution using PostgreSQL and Flyway, ensuring performance and correctness at scale.

  • Event-Driven Systems: Leverage Kafka for asynchronous processing, auditability, and decoupled service communication.

  • Quality & Mentorship: Write clean, testable code and raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 3–6 years of backend engineering, with experience in distributed systems or financial domains preferred.

  • Scalability Mindset: Experience designing systems that prioritize reliability, consistency, and maintainability over time.

  • Reactive & Async Processing: Familiarity with asynchronous or reactive programming (WebFlux, Kafka-driven systems); R2DBC is a plus.

  • Architecture: Solid understanding of Hexagonal/Clean Architecture and event-driven design patterns.

Accountability

As a TikTok Shop Director, your success will be defined by your ability to independently own, build, and scale TikTok Shop as a profitable D2C business line.

Here’s how you’ll make an impact:

TikTok Shop Business Ownership & Strategy

  • Develop and execute the overarching channel growth strategy to scale revenue and contribution margin.

  • Develop advertising budgets, monitor ROAS, and optimize campaign efficiency to protect contribution margins.
  • Allocate media budgets strategically across core SKUs, product launches, and key promotional events.

Promotional Strategy & LIVE Commerce

  • Develop and maintain the promotional calendar, coordinating LIVE shopping events and campaign launches.
  • Align promotional velocity with stock availability and customer conversion objectives.
  • Evaluate promotional performance to uncover repeatable growth levers across Latin American markets.

Affiliate Leadership & Cross-Functional Governance

  • Lead and provide direct strategic direction to the TikTok Affiliate Manager.
  • Establish affiliate program priorities, evaluating commission economics and overall channel contribution.
  • Collaborate across digital, creative, inventory, and executive teams to remove operational bottlenecks.

Colleagues

You will report directly to the Vice President of Digital as your primary functional lead while working closely with broader executive stakeholders, including the Chief Marketing Officer. You will also directly lead the TikTok Affiliate Manager and collaborate cross-functionally across creative, inventory, fulfillment, and digital commerce teams.

At Oceans, you’ll also receive guidance and support from your Operations Manager, who will help you succeed in the role and ensure that you’re continuously growing and developing in your career.

Skills and Qualifications

At Oceans, we believe in T-shaped individuals—those who bring deep expertise in one area, paired with broad curiosity and interests. As a TikTok Shop Director, your vertical strength will be TikTok Shop business ownership, Seller Center operations, and GMV Max strategy, while your horizontal capabilities should span channel P&L management, D2C unit economics, inventory planning, and cross-functional leadership.

To excel in this role, you should have:

  • Experience: Proven track record scaling TikTok Shop revenue for a beauty, hair care, or DTC CPG brand, with direct accountability over channel revenue, paid media, and profitability.
  • Tools/Systems: Expert-level mastery of TikTok Shop Seller Center, TikTok GMV Max, affiliate management platforms, and LIVE commerce tools, alongside P&L reporting and commercial forecasting models.
  • Analytics/Process: Strong fluency in channel P&L management, contribution margin modeling, ROAS analysis, in-stock rate tracking, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Mindset: Highly commercial, analytical, and proactive leader who thrives on taking full ownership of channel P&L targets in a fast-paced environment.

  • GMV Max & Paid Media Strategy: How do you structure paid media budgets and optimize GMV Max campaigns to maximize ROAS?
  • Seller Center & Operational Ownership: How do you manage catalog health, listing troubleshooting, and inventory availability through Seller Center?
  • Affiliate Leadership & Promotional Planning: How do you lead affiliate teams and align campaign calendars with stock availability?

Responsible for ensuring that all charges related to clinical trials are billed appropriately to either insurance(s) or the Clinical Trial Coordinator/Principal Investigator by reviewing multiple computer systems and interpreting clinical treatment plans for each patient within each clinical trial in conjunction with the various services being charged for hospital services.

EEO/AA/Disability/Veteran


Responsibilities

  • Performs detailed analysis of potential clinical trial accounts by identifying charges billable to insurance and separating charges that are part of the clinical trial by creating the appropriate accounts. Uses good planning and problem-solving methods and resourcefulness to resolve issues (including any system problems). Follows up on accounts by contacting both internal and external sources to obtain the clinical information needed to substantiate charges as part of the clinical trial.
    • Utilizes various computer systems to access daily work file to correctly identify accounts with potential clinical trial charges and establishes any necessary accounts to be billed appropriately.
    • Initiates effective follow up by contacting clinical trial coordinators and/or patients to obtain additional information necessary to resolve any issues holding up the bill.
    • Contacts Medical Records, reviews clinical information available on a variety of systems and interprets clinical treatment plans and protocols for the patient to determine the status of the charges.
    • Identifies and resolves edits in the systems which may be holding up the billing process.
    • Ensures subsequent follow up activity is established and adheres to a timely schedule to follow up on accounts.
    • Documents all follow up activity on the account in the system in a clear concise manner, in order to aid in the resolution of the account and for future reviews.

Determines which accounts should be billed to clinical trials or to health insurance, written off, re-billed or appealed to health insurance and refer to the appropriate parties. Looks for ways to continually to improve the process resulting in charges being billed to either clinical trials or health insurance appropriately.
    • Demonstrates a thorough knowledge and understanding of each phase of the process and a familiarity with all systems involved. This includes a complete understanding of clinical trial procedures and third party billing requirements in order to effectively carry out assigned duties.
    • Determines appropriate reimbursement methodology and applies to clinical trial accounts according to established protocol/trial.
    • Verifies the accuracy of proration and makes adjustments to accounts as necessary and with respect to developed fee schedule.
    • When identifying changes billable to third parties, ensures that the necessary edits are addressed and correct modifiers are added to charges on the account.

  • Maintains and updates clinical trial billing procedures in accordance with Clinical Trial Protocols, managed care companies, third party insurers, state and federal billing regulations and guidelines.
    • Updates procedures as required to insure that charges are accurately applied to the appropriate accounts and billed according the regulations.
    • Acts as a resource for access and billing staff throughout the department on matters of clinical trial billing.
    • Reviews protocols to ensure that all documents are in concert with the YNHH procedures and financial interests. Collaborates with university clerical staff with regard to data entry and account accuracy.

jobs.excerpt: ¿Qué es? Es un profesional especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV) y alto voltaje (HV) en aplicaciones industriales, especialmente en la industria automotriz.
jobs.description:
¿Qué es?

Es un profesional especializado en el diseño, desarrollo y liberación de arneses eléctricos (conjuntos de cables, conectores y componentes) para sistemas de bajo voltaje (LV) y alto voltaje (HV) en aplicaciones industriales, especialmente en la industria automotriz. Su trabajo garantiza que los sistemas eléctricos sean seguros, eficientes y compatibles con los requisitos de manufactura y calidad.

¿Cómo lo hace?

Utiliza herramientas como Siemens Capital Essentials y CATIA para crear dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes.

Colabora con proveedores, fabricantes de contratos (CM) y equipos multifuncionales para asegurar que los diseños cumplan con estándares como IPC/WHMA-A-620, ISO 26262 y USCAR-21/USCAR-2.

Resuelve problemas técnicos durante la instalación, debugging y validación de arneses, asegurando que los sistemas funcionen correctamente en entornos reales.

Participa en procesos de APQP, PPAP y gestión de ECRs para garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de los diseños.

¿Por qué es importante?

El trabajo del Ingeniero de Arneses Eléctricos es crítico para la electrificación de vehículos y sistemas industriales, ya que:

Asegura la integración técnica entre componentes eléctricos y mecánicos.

Minimiza riesgos de fallos eléctricos en producción masiva.

Optimiza la manufacturabilidad y reduce costos en proyectos de alta complejidad.

Es clave en industrias como automotriz, aeroespacial, energía y robótica, donde la confiabilidad de los sistemas eléctricos es esencial.

Requirements

Experiencia: Mínimo 5 años en diseño de arneses eléctricos (LV/HV), creación de dibujos de manufactura 2D, listas de cables, definiciones de conectores y librerías de componentes en Siemens Capital Essentials.

Herramientas: Dominio de CATIA V5/V6 (rutado 3D) y Siemens Capital Essentials (dibujos 2D, librerías de componentes, símbolos).

Conocimientos técnicos:

Interpretación de esquemas eléctricos lógicos y físicos.

Protocolos de comunicación CAN, LIN, SAE J1939.

Restricciones físicas: protección térmica, durabilidad a vibración, selección de materiales (plásticos, calibres de cobre).

Rutado de cables en interfaces dinámicas (cadenas portacables, radios de curvatura, alivio de tensión, separación LV/HV).

Procesos de calidad: APQP, PPAP, ECRs.

Gestión: Seguimiento de BOM, manejo de proveedores y experiencia en industrialización.

jobs.description:
Looking for Philippines-based candidates

Job Role: Senior AI Developer

Compensation range: $4,000 AUD - $5,000 AUD / Monthly

Engagement type:Independent Contractor Agreement

Work Schedule: This role is expected to align with Brisbane business hours (approx. 9 AM - 5 PM, Monday to Friday) for collaboration, but as a contractor, you’ll have flexibility in how you manage your time.

Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be engaged directly by the client as an independent contractor. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote so you'll be able to work from home.

Who The Client Is: A training organisation delivering nationally recognised hospitality training across Brisbane and the Gold Coast. The business is focused on improving student outcomes and modernizing its internal processes through AI, with a growing focus on streamlining compliance documentation, assessment mapping, policies, and training strategies.

Role Overview: You will be our first dedicated AI developer and the technical owner of a five-tool suite in addition to other tools as they evolve to streamline and support the management of the training organisation. Each tool takes national training package data, combines it with our own context and materials, and produces audit-ready drafts that our team reviews and finalizes.

This is a hands-on build role with real ownership. You will shape the architecture, choose the right models and services, write the code, test accuracy against human experts, and deliver polished tools our non-technical staff use every day

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical design, build, testing and release of all five tools
  • Engineer prompts, retrieval pipelines and structured outputs that keep every claim grounded in source documents
  • Build evaluation sets with our compliance team, and measure accuracy against human reviewers
  • Create high-quality document exports using proper Word styles, templates and branding
  • Manage hosting, security, data handling and costs, with clear reporting on usage and spend
  • Translate VET and compliance requirements into practical features, asking sharp questions along the way
  • Document everything clearly so the suite stays maintainable and fully owned by 1 Education
  • Spot new automation opportunities across the business and bring ideas to the table

What You Will Build

Tool 1

Assessment Tool Mapper (TOP PRIORITY)

Validates an assessment tool against every requirement of the units in a cluster, with evidence and reasoning for each decision.

  • Ingest assessment tools (Word, PDF) and pull unit requirements from training.gov.au, recording the release version used
  • Rate every performance criterion, performance evidence, knowledge evidence, foundation skill and assessment condition as Fully, Partially or Not Covered
  • Cite the exact evidence location (document, section, question, page) with a short quote, plus a rationale and suggested fix for each gap
  • Track required volumes such as "on at least 3 occasions" and route context-dependent items to a human reviewer
  • Produce a colour-coded validation report (Word, PDF, optional Excel matrix) with executive summary, gap list, cross-unit matrix and reviewer sign-off
  • Target 85%+ agreement with experienced human validators, with every rating linked to real document text

Tool 2

Assessment Tool Generator

Generates a complete, compliant assessment pack for one or more units, ready for a qualified assessor to review.

  • Knowledge questions across multiple formats, each with a model answer, acceptable response range and satisfactory benchmark
  • Observation checklists linked to performance criteria and evidence, with assessor instructions, resources and S / NYS outcomes
  • Full pack structure: cover sheet, student and assessor instructions, reasonable adjustment guidance, marking guide, results summary and appeals note
  • Context settings for industry, job role, workplace type and learner level, with single-question regeneration and version history
  • Mapping matrix showing 100% coverage, with output that passes the Tool 1 validator with every item covered

Tool 3

Training and Assessment Strategy (TAS) Generator

Turns a guided questionnaire into a detailed, audit-ready TAS written to the Standards for RTOs 2025.

  • Pull qualification packaging rules, core and elective units, AQF level and nominal hours, and check elective choices against packaging rules
  • Design a branching, save-as-you-go questionnaire with help text and examples that an RTO representative completes unaided
  • Generate a tailored TAS with delivery schedule, amount of training rationale, assessment strategy, RPL, learner support and validation
  • Map content to the 2025 Outcome Standards, holding the Standards as editable reference data with a recorded version
  • Export a clean Word document with styles, clickable contents, well-behaved tables and versioned headers and footers

Tool 4

Learner Guide Generator

Creates contextualized learning resources in print, slide and online formats, aligned to the matching assessment tool.

  • Cover every element, performance criterion, knowledge evidence item and foundation skill, tailored to industry and job role
  • Read the assessment tool and produce an alignment matrix linking unit requirement, learning content and assessment item
  • Output a print-ready and screen-friendly Word Learning Guide, a PowerPoint deck per unit with speaker notes, and SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packages
  • Interactive knowledge checks and completion tracking in SCORM, accessible to WCAG 2.1 AA and tested on a live platform
  • Cite legislation and codes of practice for reviewer verification, with section-level regeneration and version history

Tool 5

Procedure and Policy Generator

Produces a consistent suite of RTO policies, procedures and forms mapped to every clause of the 2025 Standards and Queensland SAS requirements.

  • Capture the RTO profile and real operating practice through guided questions, so documents reflect how the business actually runs
  • Generate policies, step-by-step procedures (roles, timeframes, decision points, records) and every linked form and template
  • Apply one master template for identical styles, numbering, version control and terminology across the suite
  • Build a master compliance matrix by clause and by document, with gap flagging, plus an Excel document register
  • Flow edits through related documents, forms and the matrix, with change logs and approval sign-off

Shared Platform Foundations
All five tools share a common core. Building this well once is where your senior judgement makes the biggest difference.

  • Training package data. Reliable retrieval from training.gov.au web services and data feeds, with release-version tracking and manual unit upload as an override.
  • Reference data. The 2025 Standards and SAS requirements held as versioned, editable data, so updates flow through without a rebuild.
  • Accuracy and hallucination control. Evidence-linked outputs, structured generation, evaluation sets and repeatable results, so the same inputs give consistent outputs.
  • Human in the loop. Every output treated as a draft, with clear flags for items needing human input and easy reviewer edits before finalizing.
  • Document generation. Professionally styled Word, Excel, PDF, PowerPoint and SCORM outputs with RTO branding.
  • Privacy and security. Australian hosting where possible, transparent data handling and model providers configured so RTO content stays out of model training.
  • Ease of use. A clean, simple web interface built for non-technical trainers and compliance staff.
  • Ownership and handover. Full documentation, with 1 Education owning all code, prompts, templates and accounts.


Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience, including 2+ years building production applications on large language models
  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript, with experience building full-stack web applications
  • Hands-on work with LLM APIs (Claude, OpenAI or similar), retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs and document parsing
  • A proven approach to accuracy and hallucination control, including evaluation and regression testing
  • Experience generating well-formatted Word, Excel and PDF files programmatically (e.g. python-docx, docx, openpyxl)
  • Cloud deployment experience (AWS, Azure or GCP), with sound security and data privacy practices
  • A portfolio of AI document-analysis, document-generation or compliance tools you have built and shipped
  • Excellent written and spoken English, and confidence explaining technical choices to a non-technical owner

Highly Regarded

  • Experience in Australian VET, education or another regulated, compliance-heavy sector
  • Working knowledge of training.gov.au, units of competency or the Standards for RTOs
  • SCORM 1.2 / 2004 packaging and LMS testing experience
  • PowerPoint generation (e.g. python-pptx) and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility
  • UX design skills for guided questionnaires and wizard-style interfaces
  • Agentic AI workflows and tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or similar AI-assisted development


How We Will Measure Success

  • Tool 1 ratings agree with an experienced human validator on 85%+ of items, with every rating citing real document text
  • Generated assessment packs map 100% of unit requirements and pass the Tool 1 validator in full
  • TAS, learner guides and policy suites are judged audit-ready by a compliance consultant with only light editing

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.

We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.

What You’ll Do:

  • Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.
  • Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.
  • Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.
  • Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.
  • Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.
  • Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

  • A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
  • A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
  • Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
  • The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
  • Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
  • The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
  • An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Lithuania Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-90,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

jobs.description:
Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor

Job Description

Join Conduent and help strengthen Medicaid drug rebate operations. We are seeking an experienced Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor to lead a team of rebate professionals, deliver accurate and timely results, and support high-quality service for our state Medicaid clients. This role is ideal for a collaborative leader who combines deep MDRP knowledge with a commitment to operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Position Summary

The Medicaid Drug Rebate Supervisor oversees day-to-day Medicaid Drug Rebate Program (MDRP) operations across Conduent Medicaid accounts. The role is accountable for accurate and timely rebate invoicing, payment processing, reconciliation, dispute resolution, and accounts receivable activities while ensuring compliance with CMS requirements, state contractual obligations, audit standards, and performance commitments.

The Supervisor leads a team of rebate analysts and specialists, serves as a subject matter expert, supports client relationships, and drives process improvements that strengthen quality, service, and financial outcomes.

Work Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required during quarterly invoicing cycles or other critical business periods.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Supervise and coordinate the daily activities of Medicaid Drug Rebate Analysts and Specialists.

  • Manage workload distribution and resource planning to ensure timely completion of quarterly and ongoing rebate activities.

  • Monitor team productivity, quality, and adherence to established procedures and deliver on client service-level agreements.

  • Provide coaching, mentoring, and professional development to team members.

  • Conduct performance evaluations and support employee growth initiatives.

Rebate Invoicing and Payment Administration

  • Oversee quarterly Medicaid drug rebate invoicing processes.

  • Ensure accurate calculation, validation, freezing, and generation of rebate invoices.

  • Review utilization, NDC, labeler, and rebate data to ensure invoice accuracy.

  • Monitor manufacturer payment receipt, allocation, and reconciliation activities.

  • Ensure accurate application of principal and interest payments at the NDC level.

  • Oversee accounts receivable tracking and collection activities.

Compliance and Audit Management

  • Ensure compliance with CMS Medicaid Drug Rebate Program requirements and state contractual obligations.

  • Develop and maintain analyst standard operating procedures and update project-specific operational guides at least annually.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and support federal, state, and internal audits.

  • Review quality assurance reports, exception reports, and reconciliation findings.

  • Implement corrective actions for identified compliance or operational issues.

  • Monitor evolving CMS regulations and communicate impacts to staff and leadership.

Dispute Resolution

  • Oversee manufacturer dispute management and resolution activities.

  • Review supporting documentation for disputed utilization, unit adjustments, and rebate calculations.

  • Coordinate with manufacturers, states, and internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies.

  • Monitor dispute aging and ensure timely resolution.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Develop and review operational, financial, and performance reports.

  • Track rebate collections, outstanding receivables, invoice accuracy, and team productivity metrics.

  • Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for process improvements.

  • Present operational updates and performance metrics to management and clients.

Client and Stakeholder Support

  • Serve as a primary operational contact for Account Managers, state agencies, and internal leadership.

  • Participate in client meetings and support contract deliverables.

  • Assist with implementation of new programs, enhancements, and regulatory changes.

  • Collaborate with pharmacy, finance, compliance, and technology teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Accounting, Pharmacy, or related field.

  • 5+ years of Medicaid Drug Rebate Operations experience.

  • 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, or team lead experience.

  • Pharmacy Technician certification or equivalent pharmacy operations experience preferred.

  • Knowledge of Medicaid Drug Rebate Program regulations and CMS requirements.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.

  • Experience with accounts receivable, reconciliations, and financial reporting.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams and manage multiple priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Medicaid rebate administration systems, MMIS platforms, or rebate processing solutions.

  • Knowledge of pharmacy claims processing, NDCs, URAs, AMP, and rebate calculations.

  • Experience supporting state Medicaid agencies.

  • Lean, Six Sigma, or another operational excellence certification.

Flexible Work

At Conduent, we value flexibility and the individual contributions of our associates. This position is designed for remote work, enabling you to deliver results from a home-based work environment while maintaining effective collaboration with colleagues and clients.

Working for You

  • Health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your family, with eligibility beginning on your first day.

  • Retirement savings programs to help you plan for your financial future.

  • Employee discounts on merchandise, services, travel, and more.

  • Career Growth Opportunities: We help you thrive, so together, we can grow. We provide opportunities to advance your career with a vast portfolio of businesses and a global footprint.

  • Paid Training: Earn while you learn and continue to grow with access to award-winning learning platforms throughout your Conduent career.

  • Paid time off: We provide attractive paid time off packages designed for you to enjoy your life away from work.

  • Great Work Environment: We are proud of our award-winning culture and the recognition we’ve received for our diversity efforts.

Join Us at Conduent, we are one team, one mission. We understand that our success is directly related to the success of our associates. We strive to create a culture where you can: Bring your authentic self to work Grow and thrive, both personally and professionally Make a difference with our clients, in our communities, and with the millions of people we support When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best.
