jobs.excerpt: Position Title: Consultant, Microsoft Modern Work Solution Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous US Job Summary:As a Consultant within our Digital Workplace practice, you will deliver Microsoft Modern Work solutions for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), tenant consolidations, and divestitures.
jobs.description:
Position Title: Consultant, Microsoft Modern Work Solution

Position Location: Remote in the Contiguous US

Job Summary:

As a Consultant within our Digital Workplace practice, you will deliver Microsoft Modern Work solutions for mergers and acquisitions (M&A), tenant consolidations, and divestitures. This hands-on role covers assessment through post-migration support across identity, Microsoft 365, and Intune-managed endpoints, with a focus on secure access, business continuity, and a smooth user experience.

Essential Functions:

  • Assess Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and endpoint environments to document business requirements, migration scope, dependencies, and readiness gaps.
  • Work with solution architects and technical leads to translate client requirements into Modern Work recommendations and tenant-to-tenant migration, consolidation, and divestiture plans, addressing workload sequencing, identity alignment, coexistence, cross-workload dependencies, and user impact.
  • Configure Microsoft 365 services and execute migrations across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams using approved migration tools and documented procedures.
  • Support identity transitions, including directory synchronization, domain and UPN changes, and access policies, in coordination with security and endpoint specialists.
  • Implement Microsoft Intune endpoint solutions, including Windows Autopilot provisioning, device join and enrollment, configuration and compliance policies, application deployment, endpoint security, and Windows updates; support cross-tenant device transitions during M&A migrations.
  • Execute pilots, migration waves, and cutover activities; validate data, permissions, mail flow, and user access; troubleshoot issues and support rollback readiness and post-migration stabilization.
  • Maintain migration runbooks, configuration records, and support handoff documentation; communicate status, risks, and dependencies; and assist project managers with milestones, user communications, and delivery coordination.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Sound judgment, critical thinking, and responsible handling of client data and privileged access.
  • Strong client-facing communication and customer service skills; ability to explain technical issues and user impacts, work independently, and collaborate with architects, project managers, security teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Strong organization and attention to detail in migration inventories, identity mappings, permissions, and validation; ability to manage competing priorities and meet project deadlines and cutover windows.
  • Understanding of M&A migration dependencies, including tenant coexistence, identity and domain transitions, workload sequencing, and business continuity.
  • Working knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, hybrid identity, multifactor authentication, and Conditional Access.
  • Hands-on experience delivering the Intune and Windows Autopilot solutions described above, including application packaging and troubleshooting enrollment and policy deployment issues.
  • Hands-on proficiency administering Microsoft 365 workloads, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Microsoft Teams, with deeper expertise in one or more areas.
  • Required hands-on proficiency with Quest and AvePoint as the primary migration tools, plus PowerShell for Microsoft 365 administration, reporting, and migration automation. Familiarity with Microsoft Graph; preferred familiarity with ForensIT, BitTitan, ShareGate, and PowerSync Pro as secondary tool options used as project and client needs dictate.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across identity, mail flow, permissions, collaboration access, and endpoint sign-in, with the ability to document findings and escalate risks promptly.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in Microsoft 365 consulting, Modern Work implementation, or enterprise migration delivery, including hands-on participation in tenant-to-tenant or M&A migration projects.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications aligned to Microsoft 365 administration, identity, endpoint management, or collaboration.

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

Healthcare Privacy Analyst

Remote

$85,000-$95,000 DOE

Position Summary

The Healthcare Privacy Analyst supports the organization's Privacy and Compliance programs by coordinating privacy-related activities, managing regulatory documentation, assisting with investigations, supporting audits, maintaining policies and procedures, and serving as a liaison among Compliance, Legal, Human Resources, and operational stakeholders. This role focuses on healthcare privacy, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation activities. While incumbents may possess legal education or attorney licensure, the position does not engage in the practice of law, provide legal advice, establish attorney-client relationships, or represent the organization in legal proceedings.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Privacy Program Administration

  • Support day-to-day administration of the organization's privacy compliance program.
  • Maintain privacy policies, procedures, forms, and guidance documents.
  • Monitor regulatory updates related to HIPAA, state privacy laws, and healthcare compliance requirements.
  • Assist in implementing privacy program initiatives and corrective action plans.

Privacy Incident Management

  • Coordinate intake, tracking, and documentation of privacy incidents and potential breaches.
  • Assist in gathering facts, documentation, and evidence for privacy investigations.
  • Maintain investigation files and case management records.
  • Support preparation of breach notification documentation and regulatory submissions as directed.

Compliance Monitoring and Auditing

  • Assist with privacy audits, monitoring activities, and compliance reviews.
  • Compile data, perform documentation reviews, and prepare audit reports.
  • Track findings, recommendations, and remediation activities.
  • Maintain audit schedules and supporting records.

Regulatory and Documentation Support

  • Prepare and maintain compliance logs, reports, and records.
  • Coordinate retention of privacy and compliance documentation.
  • Support responses to regulatory requests and internal inquiries.
  • Assist with contract reviews involving privacy-related provisions under established guidelines.

Training and Communication

  • Coordinate privacy and compliance training activities.
  • Maintain training records and completion metrics.
  • Develop educational materials, job aids, and awareness communications.
  • Support department communications regarding privacy obligations and compliance requirements.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a resource to business partners regarding privacy processes and documentation requirements.
  • Coordinate with Legal, Human Resources, Information Security, Clinical Operations, and other stakeholders on compliance initiatives.
  • Participate in compliance committees, meetings, and projects as assigned.

Reporting and Analytics

  • Prepare recurring compliance and privacy metrics.
  • Analyze trends related to incidents, audit findings, and training completion.
  • Develop dashboards and presentations for leadership review.
  • Track departmental goals and compliance program effectiveness measures.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Compliance, Legal Studies, Public Administration, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in healthcare compliance, privacy, legal operations, risk management, regulatory affairs, or related field.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and documentation skills.
  • Experience supporting HIPAA Privacy programs.
  • Healthcare industry experience a plus.
  • Certified in Healthcare Compliance (CHC), Certified HIPAA Professional (CHP), Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), or related certification.
  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree or active attorney license preferred; however, legal licensure is not required.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy regulations, including HIPAA.
  • Understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks and audit practices.
  • Ability to interpret policies, regulations, and procedural requirements.
  • Strong project coordination and documentation management skills.

Important Position Disclaimer

This position is a compliance and privacy support role and is not responsible for providing legal advice, rendering legal opinions, appearing in court, representing the organization in legal matters, or otherwise engaging in the practice of law. Any attorney licensure held by an incumbent is incidental to the position and not a requirement for performing the essential functions of the role.

Overview:

About Product:

Finteqhub

А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform.
Learn more

Purpose of the role:

FinteqHub is looking for a QA Tech Lead to shape how our engineering teams approach testing and to help them make good testing decisions on their own. You'll be based in the Payment Integrations team. There you'll drive the migration of our API tests from Java to Go and Gonkey, and from there you'll develop QA practice across all teams.

Our stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. Tests are written in Go, Gonkey (YAML), TypeScript and Playwright, with reporting in ReportPortal and mobile testing on BrowserStack.

Key responsibilities:

  • Audit the legacy Java API test suite and decide what to keep, what to retire, and what should move to a lower test level.

  • Oversee the AI-assisted migration of tests to Go and Gonkey, and make sure no critical checks are lost.

  • Close coverage gaps in line with the test pyramid, starting with scenarios where money is at risk.

  • Help every team define and document its own test strategy and pyramid, and review them.

  • Advise team leads and automation engineers on testing decisions, with a clear view of the risk and cost of each option.

  • Own regression: plan the runs, distribute the checks and report status. Keep daily and nightly runs healthy: tackle flaky tests, and make sure every failure has an owner and a deadline.

  • Lead the investigation of cross-team defects: bring the right people together, find where the problem is and get it reproduced.

  • Set shared QA standards and tooling: ReportPortal, TMS, and formats for test cases and bug reports.

  • Bring AI into everyday testing: agents write tests, engineers review them.

  • Run a biweekly QA sync, mentor engineers, and help manual QAs move into automation.

  • Expand UI test automation as the next stage.

Required Experience:

  • Senior or Lead-level experience in test automation, with a strong focus on API testing.

  • You have built a test strategy and test pyramid from scratch, in more than one product.

  • A track record of changing testing practices across several teams.

  • Strong test design skills: you build coverage from requirements and specs, not just automate existing cases.

  • You see the system as a whole and understand the product, not just the framework.

  • You know where a unit test is enough and where e2e is needed.

  • Ability to align teams and drive decisions without formal authority.

  • Mentoring experience.

  • Experience writing tests in several languages and frameworks, and you pick up new tools quickly.

  • You read Java well enough to audit and migrate an existing test suite.

  • Solid understanding of REST/HTTP, JSON and API contract testing.

  • Hands-on experience with k8s, Docker, PostgreSQL and any message broker.

  • Experience with CI pipelines, investigating failures across services through logs, metrics and the DB, and stabilising flaky tests.

  • You use AI in your daily QA work: generating tests from specs, porting tests between languages, analysing failures, reviewing code.

  • You also know where AI gets things wrong.

  • At least Intermediate level of English.

  • Native-level Russian.

Nice to have:

  • Go (a strong plus).

  • Experience with TypeScript and Playwright.

  • Experience migrating a test suite from one stack to another.

  • Experience building AI-based tooling or agents for QA tasks.

  • Mobile testing experience, including BrowserStack.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewWe are hiring a product manager who can lead people and also do the hands-on product work themselves.
jobs.description:
Overview

We are hiring a product manager who can lead people and also do the hands-on product work themselves. You will own quality and direction for new products across a portfolio of companies. About 5 hours per week goes to helping our digital marketing agency with technical needs. The work happens in TypeScript and JavaScript stacks, with AWS and mobile app releases as regular parts of the week. This role fits a highly capable person who is equally comfortable managing a remote team and testing a build on their own phone.

About Us

New products here start on Lovable and similar platforms so we can test them fast. The ones that work get taken over with time, which means moving the code, the infrastructure, and the app store accounts into our own hands. This role is how that handoff happens.

What You Will Do

  1. Make Sure Stakeholders Never Find a Bug. You test all work before it reaches a stakeholder. That means writing test cases from the acceptance criteria, testing on web and on real iOS and Android devices, and signing off on each release only when it holds up.
  2. Product Ownership. You own product management end to end for new features and emerging products, bridging the gap between raw business ideas and technical engineering specs. You write the acceptance criteria, keep each backlog in priority order, and manage App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and release schedules for our mobile apps.
  3. Rapid AI Prototyping and Development. You direct our AI-assisted workflows (Lovable, Cursor, and emerging AI agents) to spin up and validate feature prototypes quickly. Then you orchestrate the handoff to full engineering production, including the call on when a product has outgrown its starter platform and needs to move to our own codebase and AWS setup.
  4. Hands-on Architecture and Code Review. You stay close enough to the code to perform technical reviews, diagnose build bottlenecks, and directly program code overrides or refinements when AI generation tools hit their limits.
  5. Team Leadership and Construction. You help hire, structure, and scale our internal development organization. You mentor and train remote development teams, set high technical standards, and lead code reviews so AI-generated output is clean, type-safe, and scalable. You also write job descriptions and screen and interview developers and testers, so work that sits with contractors today can move in-house.
  6. Interview Stakeholders and the Team. You talk regularly with stakeholders to learn what they need and with developers to learn where they are stuck, then turn what you hear into clear backlog items.
  7. Support the Agency (About 5 Hours per Week). You take on the agency's technical needs, including AWS accounts, hosting, access, software costs, and the technical side of client projects.

Tech Stack

  • React, TypeScript, and Node.js, front end and back end
  • Supabase and PostgreSQL for application back ends and databases
  • AWS for hosting and infrastructure
  • Data warehouse storage for reporting and analytics
  • AI-assisted development with Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, and emerging AI agents, where most new products begin
  • WordPress for marketing sites, hosted on Cloudways
  • iOS and Android app releases through the App Store and Google Play

Requirements

  • Proven Engineering Leadership: 3+ years of experience managing remote software engineering teams, running agile sprint cycles, and actively driving hiring strategies or organization building.
  • Deep Coding Expertise: 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience (React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL). You have the technical authority to audit other developers' work and enforce structural code quality.
  • AI-Augmented Workflow Competency: Active, practical experience using AI code creation or agentic tools (Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, or similar platforms) to speed up application prototyping and delivery workflows.
  • Product Mindset: Strong UI/UX awareness, product intuition, and the ability to think like a tech founder. You spot product gaps and propose solutions proactively, without needing detailed design direction.
  • Communication: Exceptional English communication skills, written and verbal, with a proven ability to coordinate effectively with international startup teams and founders.
  • A Tester's Eye: You find bugs other people miss, and you write down how to reproduce them so a developer can fix them fast.
  • Spec and Backlog Skills: You turn a rough product idea into a clear spec and a prioritized backlog.
  • Platform Familiarity: Experience with AWS and with getting a mobile app through App Store and Google Play review.
  • Industry Experience: Experience working on SaaS or marketing technology products.
  • Cross-Platform Mobile: React Native, Capacitor, or another way to ship one codebase to both app stores.
  • Startup Technical Leadership: Experience as a fractional CTO, agency tech lead, or startup technical founder.
  • AI Builder Handoffs: Experience moving a product from an AI app builder into a production codebase.
  • Marketing Technology: Familiarity with analytics, tag management, and CRM integrations.

Nice to Have

  • A deep background in marketing and sales

Hours and Language

Fluent English, spoken and written, is required. You will work a combination of US and overseas hours so you overlap with our US stakeholders and with developers in other time zones.

How We Work

  • You carry out direction without needing a manager to check on you, so your team does not have to micro-manage you.
  • You learn from the first mistake and do not need to be told the same thing twice.
  • If a deadline will slip, you tell the team before the deadline date.
  • You give and receive constructive feedback
  • You talk to people directly instead of about them, and you act with honesty and integrity.
  • You are accountable. You own your results and your commitments from start to finish.
  • You are coachable. You ask for feedback, take it in, and change how you work because of it.

How the Role Grows

You start by taking ownership of quality and backlogs for our newest products, plus about 5 hours per week for the agency. As products mature and move off their starter platforms, you take on more of the product ownership. As we hire, you spend more time setting direction, building the team, and deciding what ships.

  • Notice details such as recent or upcoming travel, or planning stage, and use them to choose the best message variation

  • Upbeat, fun, and approachable energy that comes through naturally in written communication
  • Ability to move through high volumes of conversations efficiently without becoming careless
  • Comfortable with repetitive communication work at pace without losing quality or tone

You will lead the technology integration and migration of businesses that join OrderYOYO, from technical due diligence and integration planning through migration, stabilisation and the retirement of legacy platforms.

You will own the integrated programme plan across engineering, product, data and customer-facing teams, protecting restaurant continuity and tracking delivery costs and agreed benefits.

You will coordinate dependencies with Finance, People, Commercial and other functional owners, rather than owning every aspect of corporate integration.

Key responsibilities

Programme leadership

  • Own end-to-end programme plans and a consolidated view of scope, timelines, dependencies, budget forecasts and risks.
  • Lead workstream owners, agree priorities and capacity with functional leads, and run governance, escalating unresolved trade-offs to the CTPO.
  • Embed lessons learned into a repeatable migration and integration approach.

Pre-completion and Day 1

  • Inform due diligence with assessments of migration complexity, product gaps, dependencies, effort, costs and delivery risks.
  • Prepare integration plans before completion and coordinate Day 1 access, environments, tooling and working practices with incoming teams, engineering, IT and security.
  • Coordinate early technical and compliance assessments with specialists and track follow-up actions.

Data and systems

  • Coordinate data migration and integration into our data platform and business systems with data and engineering teams, agreeing mappings, quality checks and reporting requirements.

Customer migration

  • Segment customers by size, value, product usage and complexity; lead platform gap analysis and scope decisions.
  • Recommend migration waves and sequencing based on customer impact, technical readiness and capacity, adapting plans as capabilities mature and lessons emerge.
  • Agree product, data, operational and customer-readiness criteria; coordinate testing and reconciliation of order flows, payments and key integrations, securing accountable-owner sign-off.
  • Coordinate wave runbooks covering preparation, cutover, validation, rollback and support; lead go/no-go recommendations for approval by accountable business and technical owners.
  • Own operational handover, including named support owners, stabilisation exit criteria and business acceptance; plan controlled legacy retirement after migration.

Stakeholders

  • Align engineering, product, customer-facing and finance teams around one plan and timeline, working with customer-facing teams to keep restaurant partners informed and supported.

Commercial outcomes and reporting

  • Partner with Finance to establish and track business cases, covering migration and parallel-running costs, revenue at risk, legacy-retirement savings and forecast cost to complete.
  • Verify realised benefits with business owners and report progress, customer experience and value delivered to the CTPO and leadership team.

Skills and experience required

  • 5+ years of programme management experience in a technology organisation, including at least 3 years leading platform migrations, customer migrations or post-acquisition integrations.
  • Demonstrated ownership of complex, customer-facing platform migrations, including readiness assessment, cutover, post-migration stabilisation and transition into normal operations.
  • Strong technical literacy: comfortable discussing APIs, data pipelines, CRM migrations, cutover plans and infrastructure decommissioning with engineers.
  • Experience segmenting large customer bases into migration waves, with detailed run books, rollback, hypercare and clear go or no-go criteria.
  • Commercial judgement: you can weigh the cost of a feature gap against the revenue at risk and drive a decision.
  • Excellent stakeholder management across engineering, product, commercial and executive audiences, with a proven ability to secure commitments, resolve competing priorities and lead delivery without relying on direct line-management authority.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, including executive-level reporting.
  • Comfortable working across countries, cultures and time zones.

Nice to have

  • Experience in SaaS, restaurant technology, food ordering, payments or marketplaces.
  • Experience with data platform and CRM migrations.
  • Direct post-acquisition integration experience, and running a repeatable migration approach across multiple programmes.
  • A recognised programme management qualification such as MSP, PRINCE2 or PgMP.

What we offer

  • A senior role with direct visibility to the executive team and real influence on how OrderYOYO grows.
  • Ownership of our migration and integration capability from day one, with the autonomy to shape how it works.
  • Room to grow: as the portfolio expands, the opportunity to build this capability into a dedicated function and lead it.
  • Work across nine European markets alongside engineering, product, data and commercial teams.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Responsible for screening prior-authorization and coordination of specialized services requests in the medical care management program, including a broad range of requests for inpatient, outpatient and ancillary services. Adheres to policies and procedures in order to comply with performance and compliance standards and to ensure cost effective and appropriate healthcare delivery. Maintains current knowledge of network resources for referral and linkage to member’s and provider’s needs. Authorizes certain specified services, under the supervision of the manager, according to departmental guidelines. Per standard workflows, forwards specified requests to the clinician for review and processing. Answers ACD line calls from providers and other departments and redirects, as needed.


The Prior Authorization Specialist role belongs to the Revenue Cycle Patient Access team and is responsible for coordinating all financial clearance activities by navigating all pre-registration (to include acquiring or validating patient demographic, insurance, and other required elements along with insurance verification activities), obtaining referral authorization, or precertification number(s).


The role ensures timely access to care while maximizing BMC hospital reimbursement. This role requires adherence to quality assurance guidelines as well as established productivity standards to support the work unit’s performance expectations. This position reports to the Patient Access Supervisor and requires interaction and collaboration with important stakeholders in the financial clearance process including but not limited to insurance company representatives, patients, physicians, Boston Medical Center (BMC) practice staff, case management and Patient Financial Counseling. This is a Remote Position.

Position: Prior Authorization Specialist I

Department: Insurance Verification

Schedule: Part Time, Per Diem

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES/DUTIES:

  • Prioritizes incoming Prior Authorization requests.
  • Processes incoming requests, including authorizing specified services, as outlined in departmental policies, procedures, and workflow guidelines.
  • Refers authorization requests that require clinical judgment to Prior Authorization Clinician, Manager, or Medical Director.
  • Meets or exceeds position metrics and Turn-Around Timeframes while maintaining a full caseload.
  • Supports Prior Authorization Clinicians.
  • Answers ACD line calls, verifies member eligibility and enters into CCMS or Facets the information necessary to complete the caller’s request.
  • Identifies and informs callers of network providers, services, and available member benefits.
  • Informs provider of decision per department procedure.
  • Coordinates resolution of escalated member or provider inquiries as related to Prior Authorization.
  • Works with members, providers and key departments to promote an understanding of Prior Authorization requirements and processes.
  • Maintains general understanding of applicable sections of member handbooks, and evidence of coverage.
  • Monitors accounts routed to registration and prior authorization work queues and clears work queues by obtaining all necessary patient and/or payer-specific financial clearance elements in accordance with established management guidelines.
  • Maintains knowledge of and complies with insurance companies’ requirements for obtaining prior authorizations/referrals, and completes other activities to facilitate all aspects of financial clearance.
  • Acts as subject matter experts in navigating both the BMC and payer policies to get the appropriate approvals (authorizations, pre-certs, referrals, for example) for the scheduled care to proceed. The Authorization Specialist is an important part of the larger patient care team and helps clinicians understand what payer requirements are necessary for the widest possible patient access to services.
  • Uses appropriate strategies to underscore the most efficient process to obtaining insurance verification, authorizations and referrals, including on line databases, electronic correspondence, faxes, and phone calls.
  • Obtains and clearly documents all referral/prior authorizations for scheduled services prior to admission within the Epic environment.
  • Works collaboratively with primary care practices, specialty practices, referring physicians, primary care physicians, insurance carriers, patients and any other parties to ensure that required managed care referrals and prior authorizations for specified specialty visits and other services are obtained and appropriately recorded in the relevant practice management systems for patient appointments/visits prior to scheduled patient visits or retro-actively if not in place at the time of the appointment/visit. Ensure that approval numbers are appropriately linked to the relevant patient appointment/visit.
  • Collaborates with patients, providers, and departments to obtain all necessary information and payer permissions prior to patients’ scheduled services.
  • Liaison between physician and payer for peer to peer review when needed
  • Escalates accounts that have been denied or will not be financially cleared as outlined by department policy
  • Interview patients, families or referring physicians via telephone in advance of the patient’s appointment/visit whenever possible, to obtain all necessary information, including but not limited to, financial and demographic information required for reimbursement and compliance for services rendered.
  • Ensure that all updated demographic and insurance information is accurately recorded in the appropriate registration systems for primary, secondary and tertiary insurances.
  • Review all registration and insurance information in systems and reconcile with information available from insurance carriers. For any insurance updates, utilize any available resources to validate the updated insurance information, insurance plan eligibility, primary care physician, subscriber information, employer information and appointment/visit information. Contact patients as necessary if clarifications or other follow-up is required, and at all times maintain sensitivity and a clear customer friendly approach.
  • For self-pay patients or patients with unresolved insurance, and for financial counseling, refer patients Patient Financial Counseling.
  • Maintains confidentiality of patient’s financial and medical records; adheres to the State and Federal laws regulating collection in healthcare; adheres to enterprise and other regulatory confidentiality policies; and advises management of any potential compliance issues immediately.
  • Participates in educational offerings sponsored by BMC or other development opportunities as assigned/available and complies with all applicable organizational workflows, as well as established policies and procedures.
  • Demonstrates knowledge & skills necessary to provide level of customer experience as aligned with BMC management expectations.
  • Demonstrates the ability to recognize situations that require escalation to the Supervisor.
  • Takes opportunity to know and learn other roles and processes and works together to assist with process improvement initiatives as directed.
  • Consistently meets productivity and quality expectations to align performance with assigned roles and responsibilities.
  • Handle ACD telephone calls and emails in a timely fashion, following applicable scripting and customer service standards. Appropriately manage all calls by either working with the customer or referring the call to the appropriate party.
  • Regularly undergo Quality Audits to achieve the required standard.
  • Contact the Help Desk in the BMC Information Technology Department to report faulty systems or hardware. Notify area supervisor or manager if problem is not addressed in a timely manner. For other broken or malfunctioning equipment to be serviced, contact the appropriate vendor or department and notify supervisor.
  • Communicate with all internal and external customers effectively and courteously.
  • Attend all necessary hospital and department training as required.
  • Assists in the orientation of new personnel under the direction of a manager or Supervisor.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned or required.

(The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required).


Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.



JOB REQUIREMENTS


EDUCATION:

  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • Associate’s Degree or higher preferred.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

None.


EXPERIENCE:

  • 4-5 years of office experience, specifically in either a high volume data entry office, customer service call center or health care office or hospital administration is required.
  • Experience using Insurance payer websites (i.e Blue Cross Blue Shield, Medicare, etc.)
  • Customer service experience preferred.
  • Experience with insurance verification, prior authorization, pre-certification and financial clearance process. ​

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bilingual preferred
  • Ability to process high volume of requests with a 95% or greater accuracy rate
  • Ability to prioritize work load when processing referrals and authorization requests per guidelines and within specified Turn Around Timeframes
  • Effective collaboration skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Thorough knowledge of financial clearance process is a must. Familiarity with insurances, referral authorizations and third party billing procedures.
  • Knowledge of basic medical terminology and ICD-9/CPT coding is helpful.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to build and maintain strong relationships with managers, colleagues, and third party payers.
  • Must be self-directed and highly organized with the ability to multitask, manage complex processes, and maintain fair sense of urgency.
  • Requires ability to make independent decisions under pressure.
  • Requires excellent judgment, diplomacy, collaboration, partnering, teamwork, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.
  • Must be comfortable with ambiguity, exhibit good decision making and judgment capabilities, attention to detail.
  • Knowledge of and experience within Epic is preferred.
  • Demonstrates technical proficiency within assigned Epic work queues and applicable ancillary systems, including but not limited to: ADT/Prelude/Grand Centrale.
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information.
  • Basic computer proficiency inclusive of ability to access, enter and interpret computerized data/information including proficiency in Microsoft Suite applications, specifically Excel, Word, Outlook and Zoom.
  • Knowledge of medical terminology and/ or coding.

Compensation Range:

$25.80- $31.43

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, and licensure/certifications directly related to position requirements. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), contract increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, earned time cash out, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family wellbeing.

jobs.description:
About Ottimate

Ottimate is an AI-powered AP [Accounts Payable] automation platform that empowers finance teams to reduce costs, prevent overpayments, detect fraud, and enforce policy compliance across the entire invoice-to-payment lifecycle.

About the role

We’re looking for a capable, growth-minded software engineer to join our team as its third engineer. This is an ideal opportunity for an early-to-mid-career engineer who wants meaningful ownership, close collaboration with experienced teammates, and the opportunity to grow quickly.

Our team solves real customer problems across a mature financial platform. The work ranges from building product features to investigating production incidents, improving database performance, strengthening security boundaries, and maintaining reliable accounting and payment workflows.

We use AI-assisted development tools extensively, but we do not treat generated code as automatically correct. A successful engineer in this role will know how to use tools such as Claude Code or Codex to navigate unfamiliar systems and accelerate development while remaining responsible for correctness, security, testing, and operational safety.

You do not need experience with every technology or with fintech. We care more about strong fundamentals, curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to learn quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Build, test, and maintain backend product features, primarily using Python, Django, and relational databases.
  • Use AI coding tools to investigate problems, implement changes, write tests, and improve documentation.
  • Critically review AI-generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
  • Turn customer feedback into reproducible technical problems, fix the root cause, check whether customer data was affected, and update it.
  • Translate ambiguous customer feedback into reproducible technical problems and practical product improvements.
  • Own work from initial investigation through implementation, testing, QA, deployment verification, and follow-up.
  • Build and maintain APIs, asynchronous jobs, integrations, internal tools, and data-processing workflows.
  • Write clear, maintainable code with appropriate automated test coverage.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions with the rest of the engineering team.
  • Improve system reliability, observability, documentation, and development processes.
  • Protect financial correctness, tenant isolation, data integrity, auditability, and customer privacy.
  • Gradually take ownership of larger features and technical decisions as you grow in the role.

Requirements

  • Professional software engineering experience at an early-to-mid-career level.
  • Strong working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience designing, querying, and debugging applications backed by relational databases.
  • Familiarity with APIs, automated testing, Git, and collaborative software-development practices.
  • Experience using AI-assisted coding tools in real development work.
  • The ability to evaluate and validate generated code rather than accepting it automatically.
  • Strong debugging skills, including in an unfamiliar codebase, and the habit of asking what a bug did to customer data, then helping correct it.
  • An understanding of common application concerns such as authorization, concurrency, retries, idempotency, and failure handling.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • A careful approach to systems that handle sensitive business and financial data.
  • Comfort working on a small team with broad ownership and changing priorities.
  • Curiosity, humility, and a willingness to ask questions, receive feedback, and learn new systems.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Django or another Python web framework.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, query analysis, and database-performance optimization.
  • Familiarity with Celery or another asynchronous job-processing system.
  • Experience with AWS, ECS, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with observability tools such as ClickStack, Sentry, or OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with TypeScript, Angular, or another modern frontend framework.
  • Experience building or maintaining fintech, accounting, accounts-payable, payments, or ERP-integration software.
  • Experience working directly with customers, support teams, or other non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with access controls, audit trails, data remediation, and safe bulk-data operations.
  • Experience supporting production systems or participating in incident investigation.

What makes someone successful in this role

  • You’ll thrive here if you are pragmatic, dependable, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You should enjoy understanding how systems behave in the real world—not just writing code from a ticket.
  • The strongest candidate will use AI to move faster while retaining ownership of the result. They will verify assumptions, test important behavior, consider failure cases, and communicate clearly when something remains uncertain.
  • We are not looking for someone who already knows every technology or financial concept we use. We’re looking for a generally capable engineer with good instincts, customer empathy, and a strong learning mindset.
  • This role offers close collaboration and mentorship from experienced engineers, along with the opportunity to make a visible impact on a growing product and engineering team.

Benefits

We care deeply about making Ottimate an incredible place to work and invest a significant amount of time and energy into creating and maintaining a company culture that provides our team with a generous level of support whilst inspiring them to do their best work.

The specific benefits/perks we offer are continually evolving, but currently include:

  • Salary Range: USD $130,000-155,000 (depending on level) per year + annual bonus.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and other Company-Subsidized Benefits for you and your family.
  • Employer-sponsored 401(k) with company match.
  • Paid Time Off (and the encouragement to use it).
  • Promote from within philosophy.

Beyond the tangible benefits, though:

  • You will be part of a growing team, at a pinnacle moment of scale for the business, and experience the excitement of working in a startup where each action makes a huge difference.
  • You will have the agency to solve difficult problems creatively, the freedom to explore work that inspires you, and infrastructure to ensure you're constantly challenged and developing.
  • You will work with sharp, passionate teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and positioning our product as a premier finance automation solution.
  • Our commitment to empowering a diverse and inclusive workforce, celebrating differences, and creating a safe space for our employees to bring their whole selves to work is second to note.
  • We are transforming entire industries using innovative technology, including Artificial Intelligence, Payment Tech, and Neural Networks.
  • Our leaders lead with a people-first approach; inspiring excellence, nurturing ideas, and finding creative ways to eliminate obstacles for cultivating growth.
  • We truly love what we do and who we do it with - and we think you will too!

We do not discriminate based on race, color, national origin, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or marital status. If you are excited about the role but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. In addition, paramedics in Nova Scotia participate in various programs both urban and rural such as community-based paramedic programs, collaborative emergency centres, and emergency preparedness and special operations, to name a few.

There are lots of opportunities waiting for you in Nova Scotia. Apply now to learn more about our service and available positions.

Nature and Scope:

Work within a collaborative, inter-professional team to appropriately manage and support caller access to health care services to meet their non-emergent, non-life-threatening health situations. The MCC-N will perform secondary telephone based medical triage of lower acuity 911 EHS calls, performing patient assessment, formulating treatment plans and assisting patients in arranging appropriate care using information and with the support of evidence –based, computer decision support software, clinical guidelines, protocols and other resources. The MCC-N will use critical thinking, therapeutic communication and clinical decision-making skills to assess, plan, implement, educate and evaluate the patients’ health situation and/or informational needs.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Demonstrates accountability for own nursing practice by complying with the Canadian Nurses Association (CAN) Code of Ethics, and Nova Scotia College of Nursing Standards for Nursing Practice.

  • Provides nursing care within the standards defined by professional nursing body, which has been legislated by the province to regulate and license registered nurses.
  • Provides telephone based clinical care advice, alternate care pathway and service referral to individuals through the effective application of registered nursing skills, clinical judgment, computer-based decision support software, appropriate evidence-based clinical guidelines, and other relevant information databases/resources.
  • Using in-depth clinical knowledge, applies process to identify patient care needs, risks and safety issues, educational opportunities, and appropriate health care referrals.
  • Apply critical analysis to the combination of complex information during the care process to provide accurate advice and health information to patients to empower them.
  • Accurately and completely document clinical and other relevant notes within the computer software program in a timely manner throughout and immediately during and after a call.
  • Demonstrates compliance with all program specific metrics, participates in the evaluation and or measurement of these metrics and plays an active role in improving personal, team and program performance.
  • Provides clinical advice and proactively promotes the use of alternative care pathways to operational staff.

Qualifications and Requirements:


  • Diploma in nursing; Bachelor of Nursing or Bachelor of Science in Nursing preferred
  • Clinical nursing experience in an acute care environment (e.g., general medical surgical)
  • Emergency or intensive care unit experience
  • Experience in general nursing triage experience
  • Experience in nursing tele-triage, such as 811 or ECNS
  • Minimum three (3) years recent (within the past five years) clinical experience
  • An active license and good standing as a Registered Nurse with the Nova Scotia College of Nursing (NSCN) and compliance with all applicable laws pertaining to the practice of nursing in the province
  • Current BLS certification
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Emergency Medical Dispatch (EMD) and Emergency Communication Nurse System (ECNS) certifications

Knowledge and Skills:


  • Excellent communication, telephone, web and customer relation skills
  • Good critical thinking, sound clinical decision-making and problem-solving skills
  • Demonstrates a commitment to education and training relating to EHS Medical Communications Centre protocols and processes.
  • Solid knowledge and competence in the use of computers and keyboarding
  • Fluency in English (oral and written) is required; fluency in English and French (oral and written preferred)

jobs.description:
About The Codest

The Codest is a software engineering partner with partner hubs in Poland, working with international companies to build and develop digital products and business-critical systems.

Our experience comes from building products ourselves, including Yieldbird. Today, we help clients strengthen their engineering teams, take responsibility for defined product areas and apply AI where it creates practical value.

We start with the client’s problem, then agree on the right scope, team and delivery model. We value clear responsibilities, honest conversations and relationships that can grow through successful delivery.

The opportunity

We are looking for an experienced business development professional to win new clients and turn our go-to-market strategy into commercial results.

This is a hands-on sales role with ownership of the full sales cycle: identifying target accounts, creating conversations, qualifying opportunities, developing proposals, negotiating terms and closing agreements.

Our priority markets are the Nordics, DACH and the UK. You will focus on established product companies, scale-ups and enterprises, particularly in fintech, payments, banking, marketplaces and SaaS.

You will work directly with our founders, technical leadership, delivery, recruitment and marketing teams. We have a defined market focus and target-account research. You will bring the commercial judgement and execution needed to turn that foundation into business.

What you will sell

You will help clients choose the right engagement for their situation:

  • Software product development and ownership of a defined module or delivery workstream.

  • Team augmentation to strengthen an existing engineering organisation.

  • Discovery, prototyping and practical AI integration engagements.

You should be comfortable discussing a delayed roadmap, a missing capability or a complex integration, working with technical colleagues to shape a credible commercial response.

Requirements

Your responsibilities

  • Generate new business through targeted prospecting, referrals, partner relationships, relevant events and marketing-generated opportunities.

  • Research priority accounts and identify a credible reason to engage.

  • Build relationships with CTOs, CIOs, engineering and delivery leaders, procurement teams and other stakeholders involved in buying technology services.

  • Qualify opportunities carefully and decide where to invest time, including when to walk away.

  • Work with technical and delivery leaders to develop proposals with clear scope, responsibilities, assumptions and commercial terms.

  • Own negotiations and move opportunities through procurement, contracting and signature.

  • Protect commercial viability by aligning commitments with our capacity and agreed margins.

  • Keep CRM updated with realistic forecasts and clear next steps.

  • Ensure smooth delivery handovers and identify account growth opportunities.

  • Share and analyze buyer feedback and sales insights with marketing and leadership.

  • Use AI and sales tools to improve research, prioritisation and preparation while checking the accuracy of their output.

What will you bring

  • At least three years of direct B2B sales experience in software development or IT engineering services.

  • A demonstrable record of acquiring new clients and closing deals you personally helped originate.

  • Experience selling to international customers and navigating buying processes involving several stakeholders.

  • The ability to sell both team augmentation and engagements with a defined delivery scope.

  • Commercial understanding of pricing, delivery costs, margins and contract commitments.

  • Enough technical fluency to discuss software delivery challenges and recognise when to involve an engineering expert.

  • A disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting and follow-up.

  • Practical experience using CRM, prospecting and AI tools to support sales.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

During the recruitment process, we will ask you to walk us through deals you originated and closed: how you gained access, qualified the need, managed stakeholders and secured the agreement. Anonymised examples are welcome.

Your first 90 days

Days 1–30: Understand our offer, delivery capabilities, customer experience and commercial model. Join delivery and recruitment discussions, agree your account priorities and begin prospecting during onboarding.

Days 31–60: Lead qualified buyer conversations, map decision-makers and establish opportunities with a clear problem, potential value, timing and agreed next step.

Days 61–90: Progress suitable opportunities into technical discovery, proposals and negotiations, working towards the first signed engagements. Review results and refine the approach with leadership.

Specific targets will be agreed against the starting pipeline, assigned markets and realistic buying cycles.

Recruitment process

  1. A 30-minute introductory call with our recruiter.

  2. A 30-minute conversation with our CEO about your experience and sales results.

  3. A 60-minute discussion with our CEO and CTO, including an anonymised deal walkthrough and a practical target-account scenario.

  4. Offer.

To apply or ask a question, contact .

nesto is Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

Work Location

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. You'll have the flexibility to work from home or from any of our offices nationwide.

Why We Are Hiring

nesto's AI Stream is building Maestro, our AI underwriting and lending engine. Maestro reads documents, applies credit policies automatically, and generates clear, auditable decisions in minutes. The team is in an active build phase with significant near-term delivery commitments, and we need a senior engineer who can take ownership of major projects and help set technical direction quickly.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Lead major features and projects end-to-end, surfacing trade-offs clearly so delivery stays on track without compromising quality
  • Design and optimize agentic AI workflows that combine deterministic rules with LLM perception, embedding search, and structured output extraction
  • Build and own evaluation pipelines, including golden sets, offline and online evals, and regression tracking, to measure model quality over time
  • Shape architecture decisions for the AI agent platform, setting high technical standards through code reviews and collaborative problem-solving
  • Use AI tooling and agent harnesses to write and ship code faster, so the team can keep pace with its deadlines
  • Mentor peers and collaborate with cross-functional teammates to hit delivery timelines

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend and API skills
  • Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with LLMs, ideally running them in production (prompting, RAG, or structured extraction)
  • A data science, data analysis, or statistics background
  • Experience with model implementation, monitoring, and evaluation across the full lifecycle
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals, including testing, design patterns, and agile practices
  • Comfort with AI-assisted development tooling and agent-based workflows
  • Experience leading projects or stepping into a technical lead role

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), vector databases, and document intelligence pipelines
  • Experience managing AI production systems trade-offs (cost, latency, etc.)
  • Experience working in regulated domains, such as OSFI E-23 compliance

This Role Might Be for You If

  • You want to build something from the ground up and see it through, rather than move into people management
  • You've shipped LLM features to production and care about how they're evaluated
  • You're comfortable letting AI tooling accelerate how you write and review software
  • You've led projects before and are ready to take a tech lead role on product-oriented projects with real deadlines
  • You come from backend or API work and have built data skills alongside it


Why You'll Love Working Here

Job Description

We are looking for a Mid-Level Go Backend Engineer to build and maintain microservices and REST APIs for a high-traffic platform. The role requires independent task ownership, solid knowledge of microservices architecture, PostgreSQL, Redis, and code quality practices, along with active participation in code reviews, incident troubleshooting, and the use of agentic coding tools. The position requires full overlap with Italian business hours.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Go microservices and REST APIs for a high-traffic platform.

  • Experience working in a microservices architecture, including how services communicate through REST and through message brokers.

  • Basic understanding of core microservices patterns such as Circuit Breaker, Bulkhead and Rate Limiting.

  • Conceptual understanding of scaling under load: when a service needs to scale, and how caching and resilience patterns prevent failures.

  • Intermediate experience with PostgreSQL or a similar relational database.

  • Active participation in code reviews through pull requests, both giving and receiving feedback.

jobs.title: Payroll Accountant
jobs.excerpt: Payroll Accountant – RemotePayroll | Accounting | U.
jobs.description:
Payroll Accountant – Remote

Payroll | Accounting | U.S. Payroll Compliance | Financial Operations

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Payroll Accountant to manage end-to-end payroll operations while ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with U.S. payroll regulations.

This is a highly detail-oriented role that combines payroll processing, accounting, tax compliance, reconciliations, and financial reporting. You’ll be responsible for maintaining accurate payroll records, integrating payroll with accounting systems, resolving discrepancies, and supporting audits while ensuring compliance across all payroll processes.

The ideal candidate has strong payroll expertise, excellent analytical skills, and the ability to manage confidential information with accuracy and professionalism.

What You’ll Own

Payroll Processing

  • Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls for organizations ranging from 50–500 employees.
  • Validate employee time entries, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and deductions prior to payroll processing.
  • Administer payroll using platforms such as ADP, Paychex, Gusto, QuickBooks Payroll, BambooHR, or similar systems.
  • Ensure payroll is processed accurately and delivered on schedule.

Accounting & Reconciliations

  • Record payroll journal entries within accounting systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero.
  • Reconcile payroll clearing accounts and payroll-related bank transactions.
  • Record employer contributions, benefit deductions, and payroll liabilities accurately.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies promptly.

Payroll Tax & Compliance

  • Prepare and submit federal, state, and local payroll tax payments.
  • File payroll tax forms including 941, W-2, 1099, and applicable state filings.
  • Monitor changes in payroll tax laws and labor regulations.
  • Ensure payroll processes remain compliant and audit-ready.

Benefits Administration

  • Reconcile healthcare, retirement, and employee benefit contributions.
  • Verify employee deductions align with benefit elections.
  • Coordinate with benefit providers regarding payroll-related discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate payroll deduction records.

Employee Payroll Support

  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries regarding paychecks, direct deposits, tax withholding, and payroll documentation.
  • Support payroll setup for new hires and employee updates.
  • Maintain professionalism and confidentiality when handling employee information.

Reporting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare recurring payroll, headcount, and labor cost reports.
  • Support audits with organized payroll documentation.
  • Perform payroll variance analysis against budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide payroll insights to finance and HR leadership.

Process Improvement

  • Improve payroll workflows using Excel automation, payroll integrations, or APIs.
  • Develop and maintain payroll SOPs and documentation.
  • Recommend process improvements that increase efficiency and reduce errors.

Requirements

Must-Have Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of payroll processing experience.
  • Hands-on experience using at least one payroll platform such as ADP, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, Gusto, or BambooHR.
  • Experience supporting payroll accounting and reconciliations.
  • Working knowledge of U.S. payroll tax regulations and compliance requirements.

Technical Skills

  • Intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, reconciliations).
  • Strong understanding of payroll accounting principles.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality.

Nice-to-Have

  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC).
  • Multi-state or international payroll experience.
  • Experience reconciling payroll with accounting systems.
  • Familiarity with HRIS integrations including BambooHR, Zenefits, or Workday.
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance reviews.

Tools & Platforms

  • ADP
  • Paychex
  • Gusto
  • QuickBooks Payroll
  • BambooHR
  • QuickBooks
  • NetSuite
  • Xero
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Google Sheets

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional numerical accuracy.
  • Strong understanding of payroll compliance and accounting processes.
  • Able to troubleshoot discrepancies under tight deadlines.
  • Professional and discreet when handling confidential information.
  • Organized with strong documentation habits.
  • Proactive in identifying process improvements and ensuring compliance.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Review employee timecards and payroll changes.
  • Process payroll and verify payroll accuracy.
  • Reconcile payroll accounts and journal entries.
  • Respond to employee payroll inquiries.
  • File payroll tax payments and maintain compliance.
  • Reconcile employee benefit deductions.
  • Prepare payroll reports and financial summaries.
  • Update payroll documentation and SOPs.

In short: You ensure payroll is processed accurately, accounting records remain balanced, employees are paid on time, and payroll operations stay compliant with all applicable regulations.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • 100% on-time payroll processing
  • Payroll error rate below 1%
  • Timely payroll tax filings
  • Payroll discrepancies resolved within two business days
  • Accuracy of payroll reconciliations and journal entries
  • Audit readiness and compliance standards maintained

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Fully remote opportunity supporting U.S.-based organizations.
  • High-impact role within finance and accounting operations.
  • Exposure to payroll, tax compliance, HR, and financial reporting.
  • Opportunity to improve payroll systems and operational efficiency.
  • Career growth into Senior Payroll Accountant, Payroll Manager, or Accounting leadership roles.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Practical Assessment (Payroll Reconciliation & Discrepancy Resolution)
  4. Client Interview
  5. Offer & Background Verification

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Payroll Accountant who enjoys ensuring accuracy, maintaining compliance, and supporting efficient payroll operations, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to a growing finance team.

Job Description

A bit about this role:


The Reinsurance and Statutory Capital Strategist is a key financial and risk leader responsible for designing, executing, and optimizing our enterprise reinsurance architecture and statutory capital strategy. This role plays a vital part in maintaining corporate solvency, optimizing risk-adjusted returns, enhancing capital efficiency, and supporting enterprise growth across regulated insurance entities.


This position demands deep experience navigating reinsurance structuring, captive creation and management, affiliate reinsurance arrangements, and statutory capital frameworks. We welcome candidates from across the insurance spectrum: while health insurance experience is preferred, extensive expertise gained within Property & Casualty (P&C), Life, or multi-line re/insurance environments is fully applicable and highly valued.


Beyond technical structuring, success in this role hinges on operational execution, regulatory rigor, and cross-functional leadership: managing high-stakes relationships with insurance regulators, leading statutory audit examinations, hitting filing deadlines, and working collaboratively with executive leadership, treasury, actuarial, and legal teams.


We place the highest value on proven real-world execution, transaction experience, and collaborative leadership. While professional credentials are recognized, a track record of successfully executing reinsurance transactions and optimizing statutory capital is what truly defines success in this role.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:


Reinsurance Strategy, Captives & Risk Transfer Architecture

  • Reinsurance Program Design & Placement: Lead the end-to-end evaluation, structuring, negotiation, and placement of enterprise reinsurance solutions (e.g., quota share, excess of loss, stop-loss, and prospective/retrospective risk transfer structures).
  • Captive Management & Formation: Oversee the operational, financial, and strategic management of captive insurance entities; evaluate and execute captive opportunities to optimize risk retention, tax efficiency, and capital deployment.
  • Affiliate Reinsurance & Intercompany Structuring: Design, implement, and maintain intercompany quota share and affiliate reinsurance arrangements to align risk profiles, manage entity-level capital requirements, and optimize group-wide statutory surplus.
  • Broker & Reinsurer Relationship Management: Serve as the primary liaison to external reinsurance brokers, global reinsurers, and ratings agencies, fostering strong counterparty relationships and securing optimal pricing, terms, and risk-transfer capacity.

Statutory Capital Optimization & Financial Strategy

  • Statutory Capital & RBC Management: Monitor, model, and optimize statutory capital positions, Risk-Based Capital (RBC) ratios, and surplus requirements across all operating risk-bearing legal entities.
  • Capital Strategy & Forecasting: Partner with Treasury, Actuarial, and Corporate Finance to develop long-term capital allocation models, stress test statutory balance sheets, and evaluate strategic capital-raising or risk-mitigation initiatives.
  • Accounting & Transaction Accounting: Oversee statutory accounting treatment, collateral requirements (LOCs, trust accounts), and financial reporting entries associated with complex reinsurance contracts and intercompany arrangements.

Regulatory Engagement & Audit Oversight

  • Regulatory Interfacing & Filings: Serve as the lead subject matter expert interfacing with state departments of insurance (DOIs) and insurance commissioners regarding reinsurance agreements, captive operations, Form D filings, and statutory capital plans.
  • External Audit & Examination Management: Lead audit defense and technical reviews with external financial auditors, state exam teams, and independent actuarial reviewers on all matters related to reinsurance credit, statutory risk transfer, and capital adequacy.
  • Regulatory Compliance & Governance: Ensure strict adherence to statutory accounting principles (SAP), NAIC guidelines, Model Regulation requirements, and state-specific insurance holding company rules.

Executive Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Strategic Advisory: Serve as an expert advisor to the CFO, Chief Actuary, Board of Directors, and executive committees on capital management, risk protection, and emerging capital/reinsurance market opportunities.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Collaborate seamlessly with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Finance, Tax, and Claims teams to ensure reinsurance terms, claims recovery procedures, and capital strategies align with operational capabilities and corporate goals.

Required skills and experience:

(Hands-on execution ability, proven transaction history, and collaborative performance take precedence over formal degrees or certifications).


  • Deep Reinsurance & Capital Expertise: 8+ years of progressive experience in reinsurance, capital management, corporate finance, or risk transfer, with a proven track record of designing and placing complex reinsurance structures.
  • Captive & Affiliate Structuring: Hands-on experience structuring and/or managing captive insurance entities, intercompany reinsurance transactions, or affiliate risk-pooling mechanisms.
  • Cross-Industry Background Welcome: Deep experience within Health Insurance, Property & Casualty (P&C), Life, or Reinsurance Brokerage/Underwriting is fully accepted and valued.
  • Statutory Capital & Accounting Mastery: Thorough understanding of statutory accounting principles (SAP), Risk-Based Capital (RBC) mechanics, statutory surplus management, and NAIC regulatory frameworks.
  • Regulatory & Audit Interfacing: Demonstrated track record of directly engaging state insurance regulators, managing financial examinations, and securing approval for regulatory filings (e.g., Form D intercompany agreements).
  • Collaborative Leadership & Negotiation: Strong negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build consensus across internal finance/legal teams and external brokers, reinsurers, and regulatory bodies.

Desired skills and experience:

(Degrees or professional credentials are preferred but not required; equivalent practical mastery and demonstrated track record are fully recognized).


  • Healthcare Insurance Exposure: Prior experience within managed care, health insurance statutory capital, or healthcare stop-loss/quota-share markets is a plus, but not required.
  • Credentials (Optional): Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA), Casualty Actuarial Society (FCAS/ACAS), or CPA/CFA designations are considered a bonus, but are not required where robust, relevant job experience is demonstrated.

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

If you’re ready to join a company that recognizes your contributions and supports your growth, MCI is the place for you. Apply today!

You will be designing, developing, and maintaining robust and scalable systems that support the company's financial services, ensuring seamless operations and an excellent user experience. In a competitive and fast-paced industry, this team drives innovation by implementing secure, reliable, and cutting-edge solutions to meet evolving customer needs.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Write well designed, testable, efficient code by using best software development practices.
  • Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review.
  • Proposes initial technical implementation which supports architectural changes that solve scaling and performance problems.
  • Work with version control using GitHub, conflict resolution, and automation of continuous integration processes.
  • Create and maintain software documentation.

Requirements

  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Experience hands-on engineering roles.
  • Experience to deal with medium domains with medium/high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web applications work including security, session. management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge in Domain Driven Design. Knowing Microservice Architecture is a plus.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web technologies and techniques.
  • Proven ability to design complex distributed applications built for high performance and throughput while being scalable and reliable.
  • Development using Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Kafka and AWS.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Demonstrated experience profiling and performance tuning Java applications, and using monitoring tools for production application monitoring.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional teams including Chapters Engineering,
  • Architecture, Infrastructure and Mobile Engineering.
  • Proactive mindset with a sense of ownership and accountability for delivering high-quality, user-centric mobile experiences.
  • Ability to mentor peers, share knowledge, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence.
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-changing environment, with openness to feedback and eagerness to learn.
  • Alignment with company values: ownership, excellence, adaptability, and innovation.

INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE:

It is desirable to have practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains such as credit cards, lending, payments, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, along with an understanding of their fundamental workflows and business drivers. Experience in how these domains intersect to influence revenue, risk management, and customer satisfaction is highly valued.

Ideally, candidates will have applied this knowledge to deliver solutions such as loan-origination engines with real-time decisioning; scalable payment-processing platforms integrated with core banking systems and third-party gateways; secure open-finance interfaces compliant with industry regulations; automated fraud-detection pipelines leveraging behavioral analytics; or financial reporting and reconciliation engines for regulatory compliance. The ability to translate complex compliance mandates (e.g., KYC/AML, PCI-DSS, GDPR) into resilient, high-performance systems without compromising user experience is considered a strong asset.

Benefits

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the Use of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

Position Overview

The Implementation Team Manager is responsible for leading a team of Implementation Consultants and Project Managers focused on delivering successful client implementations, accelerating time-to-value, driving solution adoption, and ensuring long-term customer success. This role combines people leadership, operational management, project oversight, and process improvement to ensure implementations are executed consistently, efficiently, and in alignment with client expectations.

As a leader within Professional Services, the Implementation Manager serves as a coach, mentor, and escalation point while partnering closely with Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Support teams to continuously improve implementation outcomes, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Implementation Consultants and Project Managers, driving accountability, collaboration, and high performance.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities focused on consulting, project management, customer engagement, and solution expertise.
  • Coach team members on the effective and responsible use of AI-powered tools to improve productivity, knowledge sharing, problem-solving, and service delivery.

Implementation Delivery & Customer Success
