jobs.description:
Job Title: PV Safety Specialist

Job Location: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

French Version

** Pour être éligible à ce poste, vous devez résider dans le même pays/la même région commerciale où se trouve l'emploi **

Location: Canada, Télétravail

Mission

​Elle est principalement responsable de:

​

  • ​La Responsable PV s’assure que la collecte, la déclaration et la gestion des informations de sécurité liées aux produits the clients sont organisées et réalisées conformément aux exigences mondiales de the clients ainsi qu’aux exigences réglementaires locales.
  • ​En tant que suppléant LPV, elle assiste le LPV dans le maintien de la supervision de la gestion des risques de sécurité et de toutes les autres activités de pharmacovigilance, et veille à la conformité en matière de pharmacovigilance ainsi qu’à l’état de préparation aux inspections pour l’ensemble des fonctions de l’affilié.

Activités et responsabilités 

  • Mise en place du système de pharmacovigilance local:
  • Coordonner et organiser, au niveau national et en liaison avec le Global Safety (GS), toutes les activités liées à la supervision du profil de sécurité du portefeuille.
  • Responsable locale de la pharmacovigilance / Suppléant LPV:
  • La Responsable locale de la pharmacovigilance / Suppléant LPV est chargé d’exécuter les activités de pharmacovigilance courantes, ainsi que d’assurer la fonction de personne désignée en l’absence du LPV.
  • Gestion des cas de pharmacovigilance (PV), quelle que soit la source, conformément aux procédures internes.
  • Mise à jour du PSMF (le cas échéant), conformément aux exigences réglementaires locales.
  • Surveillance de la littérature:
  • Assurer l'examen de la littérature dans les journaux locales et traiter les cas identifiés dans les rapports de sécurité cliniques individuels (ICSR) conformément à la procédure interne.
  • Gestion des interfaces clés:
  • Assurer la supervision et la réconciliation périodique des interfaces pouvant constituer une source potentielle de cas de pharmacovigilance (PV).
  • Supervision des études et programmes:
  • Veiller à ce que des processus appropriés de déclaration de sécurité soient en place au niveau de l’affilié et, le cas échéant, décrits dans les documents locaux pertinents, pour les études interventionnelles et non interventionnelles mondiales et locales ainsi que pour les Programmes d’Usage Compassionnel, conformément aux processus globaux et aux exigences de l’autorité réglementaire locale.
  • Gestion des rapports périodiques:
  • Fournir les informations relatives à la sécurité aux équipes globales pour la préparation des rapports périodiques, si nécessaire.
  • Assurer la mise à jour du tableau de suivi des rapports périodiques avec preuves de soumission et indicateurs de conformité.
  • Garantir la soumission des rapports périodiques (le cas échéant) aux autorités réglementaires locales conformément aux processus globaux et aux exigences des autorités locales.
  • Supervision du Plan de Gestion des Risques (PGR) et de la mise en œuvre des mesures additionnelles de minimisation des risques (RMM):
  • Assurer la supervision de la mise en œuvre du PGR en collaboration avec les équipes concernées, conformément aux directives du Global Safety (GS) et aux exigences des autorités réglementaires locales.
  • Assurer le suivi de la distribution locale des RMM additionnelles ainsi que de leurs indicateurs de conformité.
  • Détection des signaux:
  • Assurer les activités locales de détection des signaux et informer le Global Safety de tout signal local potentiel identifié au cours des activités routinières de pharmacovigilance.
  • Assurer la supervision du rapport d’évaluation des signaux publié sur le portail WRA par le Global Safety.
  • Communication sur la sécurité et réponses aux demandes des Autorités Compétentes Nationales:
  • Garantir le traitement des demandes relatives à la sécurité, des autres problèmes de sécurité significatifs et, le cas échéant, de la gestion de crise locale/globale, conformément aux processus globaux et aux exigences de l’autorité réglementaire locale.
  • Maintenir la supervision de toute communication de sécurité adressée aux professionnels de santé ou aux consommateurs, le cas échéant.
  • Fournir au bureau du QPPV-EEE toutes les informations pertinentes afin de permettre leur supervision et le suivi des demandes provenant du bureau du QPPV-EEE, le cas échéant.
  • Se tenir informée des réglementations locales.
  • Étiquetage et engagements:
  • Garantir la prise en compte et contribuer (le cas échéant) aux mises à jour locales de l’étiquetage de sécurité en collaboration avec les Affaires Réglementaires locales.
  • Contribuer à la mise en œuvre des engagements, le cas échéant.
  • Système Qualité de Pharmacovigilance:

  • Garantir la conformité aux conventions.

  • Archivage:

  • Gestion de l’unité locale de pharmacovigilance (personnel et activités), le cas échéant:

English Version

**To be eligible for this position, you must reside in the same country/sales region where the job is located. **

Location: Canada, Home-Based

Mission

The Candidate is primarily responsible for:

  • The PV (Pharmacovigilance) Manager ensures that the collection, reporting, and management of safety information related to the clients products are organized and conducted in compliance with the clients global requirements and local regulatory requirements.
  • As the Deputy Local Pharmacovigilance Officer (LPV), she supports the LPV in maintaining oversight of safety risk management and all other pharmacovigilance activities, ensuring pharmacovigilance compliance and inspection readiness across all affiliate functions.

Activities and Responsibilities

Establishment of the Local Pharmacovigilance System

  • Coordinate and organize, at the national level and in collaboration with Global Safety (GS), all activities related to oversight of the safety profile of the product portfolio.

Local Pharmacovigilance Officer / Deputy LPV

  • Carry out routine pharmacovigilance activities and serve as the designated responsible person in the absence of the LPV.
  • Manage pharmacovigilance (PV) cases from all sources in accordance with internal procedures.
  • Update the Pharmacovigilance System Master File (PSMF), where applicable, in accordance with local regulatory requirements.

Literature Monitoring

  • Conduct reviews of local medical literature and process identified cases into Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) in accordance with internal procedures.

Management of Key Interfaces

  • Ensure oversight and periodic reconciliation of interfaces that may represent potential sources of pharmacovigilance cases.

Oversight of Studies and Programs

  • Ensure that appropriate safety reporting processes are in place at the affiliate level and, where applicable, documented in relevant local procedures for global and local interventional and non-interventional studies, as well as Compassionate Use Programs, in compliance with global processes and local regulatory requirements.

Periodic Report Management

  • Provide safety information to global teams for the preparation of periodic reports, when required.
  • Maintain the periodic reporting tracking system, including evidence of submissions and compliance indicators.
  • Ensure submission of periodic reports, where applicable, to local regulatory authorities in accordance with global processes and local authority requirements.

Oversight of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) and Additional Risk Minimization Measures (RMMs)

  • Oversee implementation of Risk Management Plans (RMPs) in collaboration with relevant teams, in accordance with Global Safety guidance and local regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor local distribution of additional Risk Minimization Measures (RMMs) and related compliance metrics.

Signal Detection

  • Conduct local signal detection activities and notify Global Safety of any potential local safety signals identified during routine pharmacovigilance activities.
  • Oversee review of signal assessment reports published by Global Safety on the WRA portal.

Safety Communications and Responses to Requests from National Competent Authorities

  • Ensure management of safety-related inquiries, significant safety issues, and, where applicable, local/global crisis management in compliance with global processes and local regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain oversight of safety communications directed to healthcare professionals or consumers, where applicable.
  • Provide the EU QPPV Office (Qualified Person Responsible for Pharmacovigilance) with all relevant information necessary for oversight and follow-up of requests, where applicable.
  • Remain informed of local regulatory requirements.

Labeling and Commitments

  • Ensure consideration of and contribute, where applicable, to local safety labeling updates in collaboration with local Regulatory Affairs.
  • Contribute to the implementation of regulatory commitments when applicable.

Pharmacovigilance Quality System

  • Establish and maintain a local pharmacovigilance quality system in accordance with global processes and local regulatory authority requirements.
  • Be responsible for training and awareness of relevant affiliate personnel and, where applicable, business partners or service providers, while maintaining compliance metrics for local training requirements.

Local Pharmacovigilance Agreements

  • Participate in the initiation, negotiation, drafting, implementation, and updating of local pharmacovigilance agreements with local partners or service providers.
  • Inform the Global Safety International Unit in advance of any locally established contract involving pharmacovigilance activities and/or impacting pharmacovigilance activities (including outsourcing arrangements with partner companies).
  • Ensure compliance with these agreements.
  • Provide timely feedback to the Global Safety International Unit regarding any changes known to the LPV (for example, changes to products covered under a pharmacovigilance agreement).

Business Continuity

  • Ensure continuity of local pharmacovigilance activities, including establishing an out-of-hours coverage system.

Regulatory Intelligence

  • Continuously monitor changes in local legislation, conduct impact assessments, and inform Global Safety of any relevant changes.

Archiving

  • Ensure pharmacovigilance documents are archived in compliance with local regulatory requirements and applicable data protection regulations.

Audits and Inspections

  • Notify Global Safety immediately upon receipt of an audit notification from a business partner or an inspection notice, and serve as the local point of contact.
  • Ensure implementation of CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) plans within established timelines.

Management of the Local Pharmacovigilance Unit (Staff and Activities), Where Applicable

  • Supervise the local pharmacovigilance team and promote pharmacovigilance standards throughout the organization.
  • Ensure that pharmacovigilance activities are adequately resourced.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Phorest started in 2002 on a busy salon reception desk as a simple text-reminder tool.

Today, we're a SaaS company and a trusted partner to over 155,000 hair, beauty and medspa professionals worldwide. Our all-in-one software and AI-driven tools help them manage bookings, take payments, market their services, grow their client base and get the best from their teams.

Everything we build helps the salon and medspa industry thrive.

We're also a Certified B Corp, and 25% of the company is owned by Phoresters. When the company grows, everyone has a stake in that.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineering team at Phorest.

You'll work alongside talented engineers, product managers and designers to build and improve the technology that powers thousands of salons, spas and MedSpas around the world.

This is an opportunity to work on a large-scale, distributed platform, solving interesting technical challenges and building software that makes a real difference to the businesses that use Phorest every day.

Our technology stack includes Java, event-driven architecture and modern cloud technologies such as Docker and Serverless. We value clean code, pragmatic decision-making and continuous improvement, with feature flags and continuous delivery helping us get great work into production quickly.

You'll join a collaborative, supportive team where you'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, share your knowledge and continue developing your skills.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable, reliable backend services and systems.

  • Work closely with engineers, product managers and designers to turn business requirements into well-designed, shippable features.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, making informed decisions about architecture, performance and scalability.

  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, following engineering best practices.

  • Build and improve RESTful APIs and integrations that support our platform.

  • Take ownership of features from initial design through to deployment and ongoing improvement.

  • Participate in code reviews, share knowledge and support the development of other engineers.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our systems, development processes and overall engineering standards.

  • Stay curious about emerging technologies and bring a practical approach to introducing new tools and solutions where they add value.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Java and object-oriented software design.

  • You have experience designing, building and maintaining backend services in a production environment.

  • You're comfortable working with RESTful APIs, with GraphQL experience being a bonus.

  • You have a good understanding of JavaScript and modern web technologies.

  • You understand the principles of scalable, distributed systems and can reason about technical trade-offs.

  • You care about code quality, testing, maintainability and building software that lasts.

  • You're confident contributing to technical discussions and sharing your ideas and opinions.

  • You're a collaborative team player who enjoys working across disciplines and supporting others.

  • You're proactive, take ownership of your work and look for ways to improve how things are done.

  • You have a growth mindset, enjoy learning and know when to adopt new technologies and when to keep things simple.

Benefits

🧘 Your wellbeing is important to us - we provide private healthcare, 2 Wellness Days, an employee assistance program and a free online GP service.

💰 As part of our Financial Wellbeing, we provide competitive Compensation, an Employee Share Purchase Scheme, Pension, Life Assurance, and Income Protection.

🚵🏿 We help you travel by providing a bike to work scheme as well as tax saver transport tickets.

🦸‍♀️ We support the women who work in Phorest by offering 2 weeks leave for Fertility Treatment, Pregnancy Loss and Menopause.

🍼 We care for your family and provide Enhanced Maternity and Paternity Benefits.

🌳 We grow our own timber! We provide a great learning environment and extensive development opportunities. We run development programs and provide access to many online resources including LinkedIn learning.

🏠 Moving house? Phorest employees get 3 moving days.

Want to learn more about Phorest? Check out for our blog and Insights on building an evergreen company from the team here at Phorest.

Phorest is an equal opportunity employer. For this position, flexi-time and working from home is possible. We are also open to remote work. Get in touch to ask for more information or to chat about your future with Phorest!

So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Job Summary

Our premier destination marketing solutions power destinations across the globe, helping communities attract visitors, meetings, conventions, and sporting events. The Destination Insights team partners with Destination Marketing Organizations (DMOs), Convention & Visitor Bureaus (CVBs), and other destination stakeholders to deliver both technology solutions and strategic guidance that help clients make smarter, data-driven decisions.

We are seeking a customer-facing Senior Data Insights Analyst to support the development and delivery of innovative analytics solutions, reporting products, and strategic insights for destination customers. This individual contributor role combines business analysis, analytics, reporting, and data visualization to transform complex data into actionable recommendations and customer-facing analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable discussing business goals with a customer, designing reporting solutions, analyzing data, developing dashboards, and partnering with technical teams to deliver repeatable analytics and reporting solutions. This role serves as a bridge between customer needs, business objectives, and technical implementation, helping ensure our solutions deliver measurable value to customers and internal stakeholders.

Who We Are

  • Data-driven thinkers, grounding our insights and recommendations in measurable data and business context.
  • Innovators, leveraging design thinking and other frameworks to help our customers embrace change and unlock new opportunities for growth.
  • A team that values curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement in pursuit of better customer outcomes.

How We Show Up to Work

  • Demonstrate polished, professional relationships with colleagues and customers.
  • Assume positive intent and be collaborative, creating space for different perspectives and expertise.
  • Be dependable, accountable, organized, and effective in managing priorities and commitments.
  • Be proactive, curious, adaptable, and willing to try new approaches.
  • Be empathetic to the needs and experiences of customers and colleagues.
  • Be open to feedback and committed to continuous growth.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

  • Essential Functions

    • Lead customers and stakeholders to understand business objectives, gather requirements, define KPIs and reporting needs, and design data-driven solutions.
    • Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics products, including dashboards, reports, KPI frameworks, and other repeatable reporting solutions.
    • Analyze complex datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and actionable business insights, translating findings into clear recommendations.
    • Work with Data and Engineering personnel to define data requirements, business rules, KPI calculations, and reporting requirements. Validate data quality, business logic, and reporting accuracy.
    • Serve as a customer-facing analytics resource by presenting findings, facilitating discussions, providing strategic recommendations, and supporting solution adoption.
    • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data, Sales, Implementation, and Client Success teams to enhance analytics products and services.
    • Contribute to repeatable analytics solutions, standards, documentation, and best practices for the Destination Insights team.
    • Translate analytical findings into clear narratives, presentations, and recommendations tailored to customer business goals and executive audiences.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Analytics & Data Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business questions into repeatable analytical, reporting, and dashboard solutions. Advanced SQL skills for querying and analyzing large datasets, investigating data issues, preparing analysis-ready outputs, and validating business logic and reporting results.
  • Experience working with relational databases, cloud data warehouses, and multiple data sources.
  • Understanding of relational data structures, KPI development, reporting frameworks, and how data is organized for analytics and business intelligence.
  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker Studio or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Knowledge of data quality management, validation methodologies, and troubleshooting data inconsistencies.
  • Working knowledge of data pipelines, data transformations, and cloud data environments sufficient to document requirements, communicate effectively with Data and Engineering teams, investigate issues, and validate analytics outputs.
  • Ability to clearly document source-data requirements, business rules, KPI calculations, reporting logic, and acceptance criteria.

Consulting & Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Experience leading customer and stakeholder discovery, eliciting requirements, facilitating discussions, and translating business needs into analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Ability to present insights, recommendations, and reporting solutions to customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation and business communication skills.

Collaboration & Work Style

  • Ability to independently manage projects and priorities from concept through delivery.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with cross-functional teams to solve complex business challenges.
  • Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail and commitment to continuous improvement.

Experience/Credentials:

  • You have 5-8 years of related experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis, including experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, mathematics, business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Skilled in working with large data sets, including strong proficiency in SQL for analysis and validation.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings and recommendations directly to customers, executives, or senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience leading requirements gathering, stakeholder discovery sessions, and KPI definition workshops.Proficiency with analytics, reporting,and presentations tools such as Google Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint and similar platforms.
  • Other ideal qualifications include:
    • Experience in the tourism or hospitality industry
    • Experience with hospitality technologies, particularly Simpleview CRM and event and meeting technology.

About Us

Don’t have all the skills/experience mentioned above? At Granicus, we are trying to build diverse, inclusive teams. We do not have degree requirements for most of our roles. If you don’t meet every requirement above but are excited to learn more, we encourage you to apply. We might just be able to find another role that could be a perfect fit!

Security and Privacy Requirements

  • Responsible for Granicus information security by appropriately preserving the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability (CIA) of Granicus information assets in accordance with the company's information security program.
  • Responsible for ensuring the data privacy of our employees and customers, their data, as well as taking all required privacy training in a timely manner, in accordance with company policies.

The Team

  • We are a remote-first company with a globally distributed workforce across the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Armenia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Culture

  • At Granicus, we are building a transparent, inclusive, and safe space for everyone who wants to bea part of our journey.

  • Coffee with Mark sessions – Our employees get to interact with our CEO on very important andsometimes difficult issues ranging from mental health to work-life balance and current affairs.
  • Microsoft Teams communities focused on wellness, art, furbabies, family, parenting, and more.
  • We bring in special guests from time to time to discuss issues that impact our employeepopulation

The Impact

Job Title: Backend Engineer — Blockchain Indexing & Marketplace

Job Location: San Francisco, CA, USA

About NodeMeta

NodeMeta is a Web3 ecosystem built on BNB Smart Chain, developing decentralized products including an NFT marketplace, staking ecosystem, and blockchain-powered commerce platforms.

About the Role

NodeMeta is looking for a Backend Engineer to join our fully remote Web3 team and take ownership of the backend, indexing, and API layer across our growing ecosystem.

You’ll work on both existing blockchain infrastructure and new products being built from the ground up. The role has a strong focus on blockchain indexing, API development, data consistency, performance, and production-ready backend systems.

Key responsibilities:

  • Design and develop backend services using Node.js and Express.
  • Build and maintain blockchain indexers for NFT, staking, marketplace, and payment events.
  • Process real-time and historical blockchain data reliably.
  • Build REST APIs for NFT browsing, search, filtering, listings, bids, and transactions.
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas for marketplace, transaction, user, and blockchain data.
  • Implement Redis caching and optimize database and API performance.
  • Handle blockchain reorganizations, duplicate events, and on-chain/off-chain data consistency.
  • Build backend services for SmartCommerce orders, payments, settlement, and fulfillment.
  • Integrate IPFS/Arweave metadata with marketplace APIs.
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests and maintain clear technical documentation.

NOW HIRING · FULL-TIME · India remote

Cyber Security Lead

Take our cyber security to the next level across a global, AI-first e-commerce and production group.

● India remote ● Full-time ● Start: asap

Security is already a priority at TCG, and we are investing to take it further. We are looking for a Cyber Security Lead to strengthen and lead our information security across the group: our shops, our production sites, and the platforms that connect them.

About TCG

In 2004, our founders flew to China for the Canton Fair. No plan B, no investors. The Customization Group is now a global leader in mass customization and print-on-demand e-commerce, manufacturing personalised products in Germany, Poland, the USA and Latvia and selling through 20+ own shops and 1,000+ partner stores. 750+ people, 40+ nationalities.

The Role

You lead cyber security across the group, building on the processes and controls already in place and raising the bar further. The scope covers our own online shops, internal platforms, cloud and on-premise infrastructure, and the production sites across several countries. You work closely with IT, development, legal and management as the central point for all things security.

In short: Senior ownership of cyber security for a multi-country group, with a direct line to leadership and a clear mandate to strengthen it further.

What You Will Do

  • → Drive the security roadmap. Review our current setup, sharpen priorities, and keep the plan moving with the business.

  • → Strengthen detection and response. Further develop our incident response process, from monitoring and triage through to containment, recovery and lessons learned.

  • → Harden our platforms. Work with development and infrastructure teams on secure architecture, access management, vulnerability management and penetration testing.

  • → Manage third-party risk. Review vendors, partners and integrations, and make sure the people we work with meet our standards.

  • → Keep us compliant. Translate GDPR, NIS2 and customer requirements into practical controls, and support audits and customer security questionnaires.

  • → Build awareness. Make security part of how 750+ people work, through training, clear policies and being approachable.

  • → Use automation and AI. We are an AI-first company that builds its own internal tools, so there is room to automate monitoring, reporting and routine checks.

Who We're Looking For

Sounds like you?

  • →5+ years in cyber security, with hands-on experience in incident response, security operations or security consulting.

  • →Broad technical grounding across cloud and on-premise environments, networks, identity and web application security.

  • →Incident experience. You have been in the room when something went wrong and know how to lead calmly through it.

  • →Regulatory fluency. Comfortable with GDPR and NIS2; familiarity with ISO 27001 or similar frameworks.

  • →Pragmatic judgement. You can tell the difference between a real risk and a theoretical one, and explain both to non-technical leaders.

  • →Continuous improvement mindset. You take what works, find what can be better, and make it happen.

  • →English at a professional level; German is a plus.

Probably not a fit if...

  • →you want a purely advisory role, here you own outcomes

  • →you only want to work on greenfield projects, here you build on and improve what is already running

  • →you see security mainly as saying no, here the job is making it safe to say yes

Nice to have: a certification such as CISSP, CISM, OSCP or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor · experience in e-commerce or manufacturing environments · a forensics background

What We Offer

  • → Real ownership — you lead and further develop security for a global group, with direct access to leadership

  • → International exposure — teams across Germany, Poland, Latvia, the USA, the UAE and Vietnam

  • → Latest tooling — including the internal AI tools we build in-house

  • → Local benefits — health coverage, paid leave & local perks

How We Hire

1

Apply, two minutes. Your CV is enough to start, no cover letter needed.

2

Call with recruiting. A first conversation about the role, the setup, and the salary range, openly, before you invest more time.

3

Interview with the hiring manager. A conversation about how you think, how you work, and the technical and leadership side of the role.

4

A quick conversation with the team. If that goes well, you meet the people you would be working with day to day.

5

Offer. If it is a fit on both sides, we make you an offer and take it from there.

Ready to lead security with us?

Send your CV. No cover letter needed. If your experience and mindset fit, we will talk within a few days.

jobs.title: Sales Closer | Fixum + Provision (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.excerpt: Das ist dein Job bei uns Du kennst E-Commerce, verkaufst gern und suchst ein lukratives Standbein neben deinen anderen Projekten?
jobs.description:
Das ist dein Job bei uns
Du kennst E-Commerce, verkaufst gern und suchst ein lukratives Standbein neben deinen anderen Projekten? Bei EVOLVE kommen laufend Anfragen von Onlineshops rein, die mit uns wachsen wollen. Die Leads entstehen über unseren Content und sind bereits angewärmt. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Interessenten zu beraten, passende Angebote zu machen und die Zusammenarbeit zum Abschluss zu bringen. Kaltakquise gehört nicht dazu, Nachfassen schon.

Wie deine Woche aussehen kannDienstagvormittag. Erstgespräch mit dem Gründer einer Naturkosmetik-Brand. Meta läuft solide, Google stagniert, die Conversion Rate ist ausbaufähig. Du stellst die richtigen Fragen, erkennst, wo das größte Potenzial liegt, und holst für die Google-Ads-Analyse einen unserer Spezialisten mit dazu. Am Nachmittag steht das Angebot. Am Donnerstag fasst du bei zwei offenen Angeboten nach, klärst letzte Fragen zur Laufzeit und bekommst eine Zusage. In der Woche darauf ist der Vertrag unterschrieben und das Projektteam übernimmt. Genau das ist der Job.

Wofür wir arbeitenWir sind einer der führenden ganzheitlichen Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum.
Denn was wir immer wieder sehen: Agenturen und Dienstleister betreuen Brands nischig und siloartig, Kanal für Kanal, ohne Blick aufs Ganze. Dabei bleiben enorme Potenziale auf der Strecke.
Wir verstehen uns deshalb nicht als Dienstleister, sondern als Teil des Unternehmens unserer Kunden. Dafür arbeiten bei EVOLVE 30 Spezialisten in sechs Fachbereichen zusammen, vollständig remote.

So funktioniert Sales bei EVOLVEWir verkaufen keine Standardpakete, sondern Lösungen, die zum Geschäft des Kunden passen.

  • Beratung vor Abschluss: Kunden sollen nach dem ersten Gespräch merken, dass wir ihr Geschäft verstehen

  • Fachexperten auf Abruf: Für tiefergehende Analysen, etwa zu Google Ads, Paid Social oder Conversion, ist bei Bedarf jemand aus dem Team mit im Call

  • Angebote in Minuten statt Stunden: KI-gestützte Vorlagen nehmen dir die Fleißarbeit ab

  • Saubere Übergabe: Nach dem Abschluss übernimmt das Projektteam, und du kannst dich auf den nächsten Deal konzentrieren

Was dich hier erwartet

  • Beratungsgespräche: Du führst etwa 3–7 Sales-Gespräche pro Woche mit E-Commerce-Unternehmen

  • Bedarfsanalyse: Du verstehst, wo der Shop steht, und holst deinen Gegenüber fachlich wie menschlich ab

  • Angebote: Du erstellst passende Angebote und begleitest Interessenten bis zur Entscheidung

  • Nachfassen: Du bleibst dran, denn der Abschluss liegt in deiner Hand

  • Eigenes Netzwerk: Du bringst eigene Kontakte und Kunden ein, wofür es eine höhere Provision gibt

Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Account Management oder Business Development, in einer Marketing- oder E-Commerce-Agentur

  • Echtes E-Commerce-Verständnis: Du sprichst mit Shopbetreibern auf Augenhöhe über Kanäle, Kampagnen, Margen und Zahlen

  • Ein authentisches, souveränes Auftreten, mit dem du Vertrauen aufbaust, ohne Druck zu machen

  • Ausdauer im Nachfassen und Freude daran, Deals selbst zu Ende zu bringen

  • Idealerweise ein Netzwerk in der E-Commerce- bzw. D2C-Szene oder einen eigenen Kundenstamm

  • Du bist bereits selbstständig tätig oder hast weitere Auftraggeber bzw. Einkommensquellen

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau

Der Rahmen

  • Freie Mitarbeit mit flexiblem Vergütungsmodell: reine Provision oder Fixum plus Provision, ganz wie es für dich besser passt

  • Provision von 600 bis 3.000 € auf jeden Abschluss und noch mehr auf Kunden, die du selbst mitbringst

  • Verdienstpotenzial: Bei rund 15 Gesprächen und 7 Abschlüssen bei 12.000 € im Monat liegst du auf reiner Provisionsbasis bei etwa 8.500 € pro Monat

  • Zeitaufwand: etwa 10–15 Stunden pro Woche, gut vereinbar mit anderen Projekten

  • 100 % remote, Zeiteinteilung und Arbeitsweise bestimmst du selbst

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege

So läuft der Prozess

  • Deine Bewerbung → Kurzer Fragebogen mit Video → Erstgespräch → Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Entscheidung und Start: Wir entscheiden schnell und stimmen den Einstieg gemeinsam ab.

  • Wie lange das dauert: Zwischen den einzelnen Schritten liegen nur wenige Tage. Wenn du parallel in anderen Gesprächen bist, sag uns Bescheid. Dann richten wir uns danach.

Deine Perspektive

  • Zum Start: Du übernimmst unsere Inbound-Leads und lernst unsere Leistungen und Cases kennen.

  • Mittelfristig: Du bringst eigene Kontakte ein und baust zusätzliche Kanäle wie Messen oder Speaking auf.

  • Langfristig:Wenn es auf beiden Seiten passt, wollen wir die Zusammenarbeit ausbauen. Eine Festanstellung ist dabei ausdrücklich möglich, wenn das für dich passt.

Deine AnsprechpartnerinVanessa, unsere HR Managerin, ist dein erster Kontakt und freut sich auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.description:
HR Director – People Operations, Talent Acquisition & Hospitality | Remote

Position Type: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Central Time (CT)
Industry: Hospitality / Hotel Operations
Department: Human Resources / People Operations
Language Requirements: Bilingual English & Spanish

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients in the hospitality industry is hiring an experienced HR Director to lead people operations, talent acquisition, payroll, compliance, and employee engagement across multiple hotel locations.

This is a hands-on HR leadership role for someone who can balance strategic people management with day-to-day operational execution. You’ll work closely with executive leadership and hotel managers to build scalable HR systems, improve hiring outcomes, strengthen employee retention, and maintain consistent standards across locations.

The ideal candidate brings experience supporting multi-site operations, understands the staffing and compliance challenges of hospitality, and can confidently communicate with both executive leadership and frontline employees in English and Spanish.

You’ll take ownership of the entire employee lifecycle, from recruiting and onboarding through performance management, payroll, employee development, and separation.

What You’ll Own

Talent Acquisition & Recruiting Operations

  • Develop and maintain a multi-channel recruiting pipeline for hourly hospitality employees and leadership positions.
  • Build an effective Employer Value Proposition (EVP) that attracts qualified candidates.
  • Manage recruiting processes across multiple hotel locations.
  • Develop practical skills assessments to evaluate candidates and reduce mis-hires.
  • Coordinate candidate screening, interviews, assessments, and hiring decisions.
  • Partner with hotel managers to understand staffing requirements and hiring priorities.
  • Maintain organized candidate pipelines and recruiting documentation.
  • Improve hiring efficiency, candidate quality, and workforce readiness.

Employee Onboarding & Knowledge Management

  • Design and manage centralized digital pre-boarding and onboarding workflows.
  • Ensure new hires arrive on their first day prepared to perform their responsibilities.
  • Develop and maintain standardized onboarding checklists.
  • Build and organize Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) libraries.
  • Maintain HR documentation and knowledge-management resources using tools such as Notion.
  • Ensure consistent onboarding experiences across hotel locations.
  • Work with hotel leadership to reinforce company expectations and brand standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding efficiency and employee readiness.

Performance Management & Leadership Coaching

  • Manage the company’s structured performance management and accountability framework.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and growth pathways for employees.
  • Coach hotel managers on delivering timely, constructive feedback.
  • Support performance evaluations and employee development conversations.
  • Maintain accurate performance documentation.
  • Guide managers through corrective action and employee relations matters.
  • Support compliant employee separation processes.
  • Promote accountability while maintaining a supportive and respectful workplace culture.

Payroll, HRIS & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end payroll processing across multiple hotel locations.
  • Review timecards, payroll records, and employee information for accuracy.
  • Identify and resolve payroll discrepancies.
  • Monitor overtime, labor costs, and timekeeping accuracy.
  • Evaluate labor cost efficiency across locations.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
  • Ensure payroll practices and employee benefits comply with applicable employment regulations.
  • Support compliance requirements across relevant jurisdictions.
  • Use HRIS and payroll platforms such as Paylocity to maintain accurate records and workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to improve payroll accuracy and operational efficiency.

Employee Engagement & Retention

  • Develop initiatives that strengthen employee engagement and retention.
  • Build recognition programs that reinforce positive performance.
  • Establish clear career development and advancement pathways.
  • Partner with hotel managers to address employee concerns proactively.
  • Identify factors contributing to employee turnover.
  • Promote a welcoming, professional, and accountable hospitality culture.
  • Encourage consistent communication between employees and leadership.
  • Support a positive employee experience across all hotel locations.

Executive Partnership & Workforce Planning

  • Partner directly with executive leadership on people strategy and workforce planning.
  • Provide insights into staffing needs, retention challenges, and operational priorities.
  • Support organizational growth through scalable HR processes.
  • Collaborate with hotel leadership on employee performance and workforce issues.
  • Identify opportunities to improve HR systems and operational consistency.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives supporting hotel operations.
  • Provide clear updates on workforce priorities, risks, and ongoing HR initiatives.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in People Operations, Human Resources, HR Generalist, Talent Acquisition, or a related role.
  • Experience supporting multi-site or multi-location operations.
  • Background in hospitality, retail, customer service, or similarly fast-paced operational environments.
  • Strong understanding of hospitality staffing requirements, frontline employee management, and HR compliance.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end payroll processing.
  • Experience reviewing timecards, overtime, and payroll discrepancies.
  • Familiarity with HRIS and payroll platforms.
  • Ability to manage recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and employee relations.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to develop and maintain HR processes, SOPs, and onboarding systems.
  • Strong understanding of employee performance documentation and compliant separation procedures.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish proficiency — essential.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with executive leadership and effectively with Spanish-speaking frontline employees.
  • Availability to work consistently during U.S. Central Time operational hours.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Strong judgment when handling confidential employee and payroll information.

Remote Work Requirements

  • Quiet, private, and dedicated workspace.
  • Reliable high-speed internet with at least 50 Mbps download and 50 Mbps upload speeds.
  • Documented backup plan for power interruptions.
  • Backup connectivity solution to maintain availability during internet disruptions.
  • Ability to remain accessible during U.S. Central Time operational hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing HR operations across multiple hotel properties.
  • Experience supporting hourly hospitality workforces.
  • Hands-on experience with Paylocity.
  • Experience using Notion for SOPs, documentation, and knowledge management.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace.
  • Experience developing structured recruiting and onboarding processes.
  • Experience implementing performance management frameworks.
  • Experience building employee engagement and retention programs.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership in a growing hospitality organization.
  • Demonstrated success improving HR processes and operational efficiency.

Tools & Platforms

Paylocity – Payroll & HRIS

  • Payroll processing
  • Employee records management
  • Timekeeping and attendance tracking
  • Payroll discrepancy resolution
  • HR reporting
  • Employee information management

Notion – Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • SOP development
  • Employee onboarding checklists
  • HR documentation
  • Internal knowledge libraries
  • Workflow organization
  • Process standardization

Google Workspace

  • Google Sheets
  • Google Docs
  • Google Drive
  • Google Calendar
  • Collaborative reporting and documentation

Additional Tools: Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) | HRIS Platforms | Payroll Systems | Employee Performance Management Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Take ownership of HR challenges and proactively solve problems.
  • Understand the realities of managing hourly hospitality employees.
  • Can manage both strategic HR initiatives and daily operational responsibilities.
  • Are comfortable communicating with executives and frontline hotel employees.
  • Can confidently switch between professional English and conversational Spanish.
  • Believe accountability and employee support should work together.
  • Provide timely, constructive feedback and document important conversations.
  • Understand that payroll accuracy and labor compliance require exceptional attention to detail.
  • Build systems and processes before operational problems become urgent.
  • Can independently manage multiple priorities across hotel locations.
  • Approach employee relations matters with professionalism, fairness, and discretion.
  • Enjoy improving recruiting, onboarding, and employee retention.
  • Are comfortable working remotely while remaining responsive to operational needs.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing overnight payroll flags, timecard discrepancies, or compliance matters requiring immediate attention.

You might then review recruiting pipelines, coordinate candidate assessments, prepare offer letters, or follow up with hotel managers about open positions.

Throughout the afternoon, you’ll connect with hotel leadership to discuss employee performance, coach managers through corrective conversations, or review employee documentation.

You may also update onboarding checklists or SOPs in Notion, evaluate labor cost trends, and identify opportunities to improve HR processes.

Before wrapping up, you’ll coordinate with executive leadership on workforce priorities, employee relations matters, and upcoming operational needs.

In short: You’ll ensure the right people are hired, properly onboarded, accurately paid, effectively managed, and supported throughout their employment.

Key Metrics for Success

Talent Acquisition

  • Time-to-fill for open positions
  • Candidate pipeline quality
  • Hiring efficiency
  • New-hire performance and retention
  • Reduction in hiring mismatches

Payroll & Compliance

  • Payroll accuracy
  • Timely payroll processing
  • Timecard accuracy
  • Overtime and labor cost monitoring
  • Compliance documentation completeness
  • Reduction in payroll discrepancies

Employee Experience

  • Employee retention rates
  • Turnover reduction
  • Onboarding completion and readiness
  • Employee engagement
  • Performance review completion
  • Employee development and internal growth

HR Operations

  • SOP documentation and adoption
  • Consistency of HR processes across locations
  • Responsiveness to employee and management issues
  • Quality of performance documentation
  • Efficiency of HR workflows
  • Workforce planning effectiveness

Why This Role Stands Out

This opportunity offers the chance to take meaningful ownership of HR operations across multiple hotel locations while working directly with executive leadership.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Build scalable HR systems and processes.
  • Strengthen recruiting and onboarding operations.
  • Improve payroll accuracy and compliance.
  • Coach hotel leaders on employee performance.
  • Develop initiatives that support employee engagement and retention.
  • Help shape the company’s people strategy as operations grow.

This is a strong fit for an HR professional who enjoys combining people leadership, operational accountability, and process improvement.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced HR Director, People Operations Manager, HR Generalist, or Human Resources professional with expertise in multi-location operations, hospitality recruiting, payroll, HR compliance, performance management, and employee engagement, we’d love to hear from you.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is bilingual in English and Spanish, comfortable supporting U.S. Central Time operations, and ready to take ownership of a growing hospitality organization’s people function.

Apply today to help build a high-performing workforce and scalable HR operations across multiple hotel locations.

Standardisera accesskontroll genom interna ramverk och bibliotek som andra team bygger vidare på.

Arbeta nära arkitektur, produkt och säkerhet för att bygga en skalbar och robust accesshantering.

Du har flera års erfarenhet av IAM och har modellerat komplexa auktoriseringsstrukturer i praktiken, inte bara konfigurerat färdiga lösningar. Du kliver in i ett skede där mycket avgörs. Här får du arbeta med en av de svåraste och mest intressanta frågorna i modern SaaS – vem får göra vad, och varför – och sätta en standard som hela organisationen bygger på.

As Product Manager, you will work across product and project management to expand corporate payment card options, support new currencies and global capabilities, and ensure WEX processing platforms remain aligned with Mastercard and Visa requirements. This role is a central connection point between payment networks and internal product, engineering, treasury and operational teams. It is well suited to someone who enjoys payments technology, implementation delivery, vendor relationships and improving complex workflows.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a balanced focus on project execution and product lifecycle management. You will coordinate card product, BIN, currency and processor implementations while also reviewing network bulletins, assessing platform impacts, refining work with impacted teams and helping maintain compliance across TAG, t-Chek and ePP.

  • Review Mastercard and Visa bulletins and mandates, identify changes that affect WEX processing platforms, and coordinate timely communication and action with impacted teams.
  • Help ensure processing platforms remain compliant with card-network requirements, reducing the risk of non-compliance fees and impacts to network licenses.
  • Coordinate implementation of new card products, BINs and currency options, including processor configuration, testing, timelines, reviews and approvals.
  • Work with Mastercard, Visa and internal vendors/partners to clarify requirements, manage dependencies and deliver implementation projects.
  • Partner with engineering teams and other product managers to refine epics and requirements, prioritize work, manage backlogs and deliver roadmap commitments.
  • Coordinate across WEX Bank, European issuing entities, Treasury, Commercial Solutions, Fraud, Disputes, Accounting and other stakeholders to understand impacts and align delivery.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative information to assess customer and business needs, inform prioritization and evaluate outcomes.
  • Improve end-to-end workflows for mandate intake, impact assessment, routing, implementation and tracking; explore AI and automation where they can reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Communicate status, risks, tradeoffs and decisions clearly to stakeholders and influence progress without direct authority.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology or a related field. Candidates with substantial card-network or payments experience may be considered without a degree on a case-by-case basis.
  • Approximately 3–7 years of product management experience, with relevant experience in card processing products, payment networks or related platforms.
  • Experience leading projects and coordinating with vendors and cross-functional partners to deliver critical implementations.
  • Ability to partner closely with engineering and product teams to prioritize work and deliver features or platform changes.
  • Experience identifying customer or business problems, prioritizing roadmaps, writing detailed requirements, managing backlogs and maintaining clear documentation.
  • Strong execution and project coordination skills, including managing timelines, dependencies, testing and approvals.

  • Experience applying AI or automation to improve workflow efficiency, information intake, impact assessment or documentation.

This role helps WEX grow its Corporate Payments card product options and respond to market demand for expanded network capabilities while protecting the business from missed Mastercard and Visa requirements. Overview:

Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent is seeking a Director, AI Transformation within Cvent Consulting to lead customer-facing AI transformation work, beginning with our most advanced customers: Fortune 500 companies that are paving the way with AI transformation. This leader will work directly with customers and partners to understand the business outcomes they want from AI, and will shape how Cvent’s platform, data, and services are built, packaged, and delivered around those outcomes.

An example is partnering with one of our major clients to roll out a headless version of Cvent on their proprietary technology, either by connecting to the client’s MCP or by using Cvent’s MCP. The ultimate goal is to understand the outcomes the client wants to achieve, learn from that work, and then work with that client to take the resulting solution to market together and turn it into repeatable offerings for other customers and partners. The Director will build trusted executive relationships, ensure engagements are scoped and delivered to a high standard, and partner closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Professional Services, and Marketing. This role is consulting-led and partners with Sales on commercial opportunities and partner relationships rather than owning a sales quota.


In This Role, You Will:

  • Lead customer-facing AI transformation engagements, starting with our most advanced Fortune 500 customers who are paving the way with AI transformation: understand their goals, workflows, and measurable outcomes, and design how Cvent helps them achieve those outcomes.
  • Lead rollouts of headless versions of Cvent on a client’s proprietary technology, such as partnering with a major client to embed Cvent into their own environment, either by connecting to the client’s MCP or by using Cvent’s MCP, from discovery through launch and adoption; use each rollout to understand the outcomes the client wants to achieve, define success measures, and capture lessons that can be applied to other customers and partners.
  • Once solutions are built with these transformative customers, work with them to define how to take those solutions to market together, including joint positioning, packaging, co-selling, and shared customer success stories, in partnership with Sales, Product, and Marketing.
  • Translate customer outcomes into clear input for Cvent’s product and technology roadmap, working with Product and Technology so that Cvent is built around how customers want to use AI.
  • Build and deepen executive-level relationships with customer and partner leaders; represent Cvent in client meetings, partner forums, and industry events; and help teams navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Build and manage AI transformation partnerships with major clients and with technology and ecosystem partners; co-develop joint solutions and go-to-market approaches that create value for customers.
  • Partner with Sales on business development: identify and qualify AI transformation opportunities, shape solutions and proposals, support large and strategic client opportunities, and translate customer and partner priorities into coordinated action.
  • Develop repeatable services and reusable intellectual property, such as AI readiness assessments, outcome frameworks, playbooks, and reference approaches, that strengthen Cvent Consulting’s value proposition.
  • Oversee the engagement lifecycle: define scope, requirements, staffing, work plans, milestones, deliverables, and governance; manage changing needs, risks, budgets, and timelines to deliver high-quality, timely, measurable results.
  • Use metrics and reporting to track customer outcomes, adoption, pipeline, and engagement financial performance (including revenue, margin, and resource capacity); communicate results and adjust plans in a timely way.
  • Build, coach, and develop the AI transformation team as the portfolio grows, drawing on Consulting, Professional Services, and Technology resources; foster accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Technology, Marketing, and other leaders to track emerging AI trends and market needs, share customer success stories, and evolve Cvent’s consulting offerings.

Here's What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Business, or a related field, or equivalent education, training, and experience; an MBA or similar advanced degree is preferred.
  • 8+ years of related experience, including leadership of complex projects, consulting engagements, enterprise programs, or technology transformation initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with AI solutions, such as generative AI, agentic workflows, and API- or MCP-based integrations, in enterprise or technology environments, and the ability to connect them to business outcomes.
  • Experience working with Fortune 500 or other large enterprise customers on AI initiatives; experience collaborating with client and technology partner teams, including joint solution development on proprietary or custom platforms, joint go-to-market, and co-selling.
  • A record of turning customer business outcomes into solutions and product requirements, working effectively with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience supporting business development and partner ecosystems, including shaping opportunities and supporting strategic deals alongside Sales.
  • Experience in consulting, professional services, enterprise technology, or SaaS; experience supporting enterprise customers is highly valued.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including direct and indirect reports, with a record of coaching talent and the ability to build a team as the portfolio grows.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including the ability to define scope, build work plans, coordinate cross-functional resources, manage risk, and respond effectively to changing priorities.
  • Financial and analytical capability, including experience assessing project profitability, revenue, margins, budgets, and operating performance.
  • Strong executive communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence stakeholders across client, partner, and internal organizations.
  • Proficiency with project management, reporting, and spreadsheet tools; experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM is a plus.
  • A customer-focused, consultative mindset; sound judgment and timely decision-making in a fast-changing environment; and a passion for using technology to solve business challenges.
  • Ability to travel up to 15%, depending on client and partner proximity, and to spend time on-site with clients as engagement needs require.

Physical Demands
Multiple positions may be filled from this announcement.
We are not able to offer sponsorship for this position.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

About Zazz

Zazz is a global IT services and technology company providing managed IT services, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, software engineering and technology consulting. Its managed services team supports clients through proactive monitoring, service desk support, infrastructure management and ongoing improvement. Zazz combines technical delivery with a focus on dependable services, clear accountability and long-term client relationships.

Role purpose

The Senior Service Desk and Project Engineer combines advanced third line support with project management and hands-on project engineering. You will own complex technical escalations, manage assigned IT projects from scope through to completion, and implement the solutions those projects deliver. Working with service delivery leadership, engineers, clients and suppliers, you will maintain reliable services while delivering controlled, well-documented improvements.

Service desk support remains a core responsibility. Project ownership and protected delivery time will be agreed with your manager, with competing priorities and capacity risks escalated early.

Key responsibilities

Third line service desk support
  • Own complex incidents and service requests escalated from L1 and L2, diagnosing issues across cloud services, identity, servers, networks, endpoints and integrations.
  • Lead technical investigation during major incidents, restore service safely and coordinate specialist or supplier support while retaining clear ownership and client updates.
  • Work to the applicable client SLAs and Zazz escalation procedures. Escalate technical blockers and service risks promptly, including when a credible route to resolution is unclear.
  • Investigate recurring faults through Problem Management, document root causes and workarounds, and deliver permanent remediation through approved changes.
  • Maintain accurate HaloPSA records, including impact, priority, diagnosis, actions, time, next steps and handovers. Validate the outcome before resolution and closure.
  • Coach L1 and L2 engineers, improve troubleshooting guidance and publish reusable knowledge to strengthen capability and reduce repeat escalations.

Project management and PMO responsibilities

Manage assigned projects and contribute to consistent project management office practices, using HaloPSA to maintain visible plans, ownership, costs and delivery status.

  • Define objectives, scope, deliverables, assumptions, exclusions and acceptance criteria with the client and internal stakeholders. Contribute technical estimates and delivery plans to statements of work.
  • Set up parent projects and child tasks in HaloPSA with named owners, realistic dates, milestones, dependencies, time budgets and completion criteria. Maintain schedules and assess the impact of changes.
  • Build project budgets covering engineering effort, hardware, software, licensing and supplier costs where applicable. Obtain approval, track actuals and forecast remaining effort and cost against the agreed baseline.
  • Plan resources with service delivery leadership and coordinate engineers, suppliers and client teams. Monitor critical dependencies and resolve scheduling conflicts before they delay delivery.
  • Maintain risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies and decisions. Escalate blockers, forecast overspend and missed milestones with clear recovery options and accountable owners.
  • Control scope changes through documented impact assessment and approval. Provide regular client updates and at least weekly internal reporting on progress, budget, milestones and decisions required.
  • Close projects with agreed acceptance, reconciled time and costs, lessons learnt and an operational handover. Contribute to project templates, portfolio reporting and improvements to delivery standards.

Hands on project engineering
  • Assess client environments and translate approved requirements into practical technical designs and implementation plans, seeking specialist review where needed.
  • Deliver client onboarding, migrations, infrastructure upgrades and service improvements across Microsoft 365, identity, cloud, networking, endpoint management, monitoring and backup environments.
  • Prepare and execute approved changes with risk assessments, prerequisites, implementation steps, testing, rollback plans and agreed maintenance windows. Obtain required technical and client approvals.
  • Configure and validate solutions, troubleshoot implementation issues, coordinate user acceptance testing and provide agreed support during go-live and stabilisation.
  • Produce configuration records, diagrams, operating procedures and support documentation in IT Glue and other approved systems. Transfer monitoring, access, support ownership and outstanding actions to the service desk.

Security and commercial responsibilities

Apply least privilege, secure credential handling and client security requirements throughout support and project work. Coordinate security incidents with the appropriate security specialists. Identify out-of-scope work and commercial opportunities for review, and obtain approval before committing expenditure or additional delivery. Record chargeable and non-chargeable time accurately against the correct ticket or project task.

Person specification

Essential experience and skills
  • Proven third line support or senior infrastructure engineering experience in an MSP or comparable environment supporting multiple clients, systems and business priorities.
  • Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Windows Server, identity and access management, and endpoint administration.
  • Advanced troubleshooting across DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, switching, routing, firewalls, VPNs and wireless networks, with an understanding of how infrastructure components and services interact.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably Microsoft Azure, together with virtualisation, backup, recovery, monitoring and security controls.
  • Demonstrable delivery of IT projects, including personal responsibility for plans, budgets, milestones, dependencies, risks, stakeholder updates and client acceptance.
  • Practical IT service management knowledge covering Incident, Request, Problem and Change Management, SLA management and structured escalation.
  • Experience using PSA or ITSM, remote monitoring and management, and documentation platforms. Ability to maintain reliable ticket, project and time records.
  • Clear client communication, sound technical judgement and the ability to organise competing demands, mentor colleagues and explain risks and options to non-technical stakeholders.

Desirable experience and qualifications
  • Experience with HaloPSA, NinjaOne, Huntress, IT Glue, Keeper, Addigy or Druva, and with Google Workspace, Apple environments, AWS or Google Cloud.
  • PowerShell scripting, repeatable deployment methods and automation that improves support quality or reduces manual effort.
  • ITIL, Microsoft, cloud or networking qualifications, and PRINCE2, APM or PMP certification; relevant practical experience is equally valued.
  • Experience supporting regulated clients, security remediation and projects involving third-party suppliers or geographically distributed teams.

Measures of success ​

Performance will be reviewed against agreed service and project objectives, taking account of assigned scope, available capacity and dependencies. Measures will include:

  • Reliable technical resolution, timely escalation and clear communication against applicable client commitments.
  • Projects delivered to agreed scope, milestones, budget and acceptance criteria, with risks and changes raised early.
  • Accurate HaloPSA records, time reporting, documentation and effective transition into ongoing support.
  • Positive client feedback, stronger L1 and L2 capability, and measurable reductions in recurring issues or avoidable manual work.
