jobs.description:
Our client, SimpleTrials, is growing again!

Fully Remote | Life Sciences SaaS | $180K OTE Earning Potential

SimpleTrials is a growing provider of cloud-based Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) and electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) solutions, helping organizations simplify clinical trial operations, improve oversight, and maintain regulatory compliance.

Our solutions support pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, medical device manufacturers, Contract Research Organizations (CROs), academic research institutions, and nonprofit research organizations.

With customers operating across more than 60 countries, SimpleTrials combines powerful functionality, flexibility, and a customer-focused approach to help research organizations manage clinical trials more efficiently.

As we continue to expand our market presence, we are building a high-performing sales organization focused on accelerating growth, developing strategic customer relationships, and delivering measurable value to our clients.

Position Overview

SimpleTrials is seeking a motivated, results-oriented Account Executive (AE) to join our growing Business Development team.

This individual will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition, managing the full sales cycle, and developing relationships with organizations seeking modern, efficient, and cost-effective clinical trial management solutions.

The ideal candidate brings a successful track record in B2B SaaS or technology sales, strong consultative selling skills, and the ability to engage multiple stakeholders throughout complex purchasing processes.

Prior experience selling eClinical, clinical research technology, or Life Sciences software is preferred but not required. We welcome candidates from other B2B SaaS and technology sectors who demonstrate strong sales fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, technical aptitude, and a willingness to learn the clinical research industry.

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in shaping and scaling the sales organization while contributing directly to SimpleTrials' continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

New Business Development & Revenue Growth

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO, and academic research markets.
  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through product demonstrations, proposal development, negotiations, and contract execution.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities through outbound prospecting, inbound leads, referrals, and industry networking.
  • Achieve or exceed assigned sales targets and new customer acquisition goals.
  • Develop account strategies to engage prospective customers and identify opportunities within target markets.
  • Collaborate with Business Development Representatives (BDRs) and Marketing to maximize lead generation, qualification, and conversion.

Consultative Selling & Customer Engagement

  • Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospective customers' operational challenges, business objectives, existing technology environments, and purchasing requirements.
  • Present and demonstrate SimpleTrials solutions in a way that clearly connects product capabilities to customer needs and measurable business value.
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders, including Clinical Operations, Clinical Research, IT, Quality Assurance, Procurement, and executive leadership.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple decisionmakers, technical evaluations, compliance reviews, and procurement processes.
  • Develop compelling value propositions that differentiate SimpleTrials from competing solutions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to prospective customers throughout the evaluation and purchasing process.

Sales Execution & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date opportunity records, activity tracking, and sales forecasts within Salesforce CRM.
  • Develop and execute account plans and follow-up strategies to advance opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Prepare and deliver proposals, pricing recommendations, presentations, and responses to customer inquiries.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support product demonstrations, technical evaluations, security questionnaires, and RFP responses.
  • Manage contract negotiations while balancing customer requirements and company commercial objectives.
  • Provide reliable pipeline reporting, revenue projections, and deal updates to sales leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Marketing to provide feedback on lead quality, campaign effectiveness, market trends, and customer engagement.
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and technical teams to address prospective customer requirements.
  • Facilitate smooth customer handoffs following contract execution to support onboarding and long-term customer satisfaction.
  • Share competitive intelligence, customer feedback, and market insights that help guide product positioning and go-to-market strategy.
  • Participate in industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to build awareness and generate new business opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of successful B2B sales experience, preferably in SaaS, enterprise software, cloud technology, or another technology-driven industry.
  • Demonstrated experience managing the full sales cycle, including prospecting, discovery, presentations, negotiation, and closing.
  • Proven ability to achieve sales targets and consistently develop qualified pipeline.
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to identify business challenges and communicate solution value.
  • Experience selling to multiple stakeholders and navigating complex organizational buying decisions.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or comparable systems.
  • Ability to quickly learn new software applications, industry terminology, and technical concepts.
  • Self-motivated, accountable, adaptable, and comfortable working in a growing organization.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Experience selling software or technology solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, CRO, or other Life Sciences organizations.
  • Familiarity with eClinical technologies such as CTMS, eTMF, EDC or related clinical research software.
  • Understanding of clinical trial operations, research workflows, or regulated environments.
  • Experience selling software requiring technical evaluations, security reviews, or regulatory compliance assessments.
  • Familiarity with industry regulations and standards such as ICH-GCP, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, or GxP.
  • Experience selling to mid-market or enterprise customers.
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and structured sales methodologies such as MEDDICC, SPIN Selling, or Challenger Sales.

Important: Candidates do not need prior clinical research or eClinical industry experience to be successful in this role. We place significant value on proven sales ability, coachability, intellectual curiosity, and the motivation to become a knowledgeable advisor to our customers.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days – Learn & Integrate

  • Develop a working understanding of SimpleTrials, its CTMS and eTMF capabilities, target markets, and competitive positioning.
  • Learn the company's ideal customer profile, sales process, qualification standards, and value propositions.
  • Shadow discovery calls, product demonstrations, and customer discussions.
  • Become familiar with Salesforce workflows, sales materials, pricing structures, and proposal processes.

Days 31–60 – Build Pipeline & Engage Prospects

  • Begin independently managing discovery conversations and assigned sales opportunities.
  • Develop a qualified pipeline through outbound outreach, inbound lead engagement, and collaboration with BDRs.
  • Demonstrate the ability to communicate SimpleTrials' core value propositions and address common customer objections.
  • Lead prospect discussions and coordinate demonstrations with appropriate internal support.

Days 61–90 – Execute & Advance Opportunities

  • Independently manage active sales opportunities across the sales cycle.
  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, pipeline management, and opportunity progression.
  • Develop accurate sales forecasts and maintain strong CRM discipline.
  • Progress qualified opportunities toward commercial decisions and contract execution.
  • Establish a performance and development plan aligned with assigned revenue targets.

What We're Looking For

Beyond experience and qualifications, we value individuals who demonstrate:

  • Ownership: Take accountability for results and proactively move opportunities forward.
  • Curiosity: Ask thoughtful questions, understand customer needs, and continuously learn.
  • Resilience: Stay motivated and resourceful throughout challenging sales cycles.
  • Collaboration: Work effectively with colleagues across functions to deliver the best customer experience.
  • Integrity: Build trust through transparency, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset.
  • Growth Mindset: Embrace feedback, improve continuously, and contribute to building a scalable sales organization.

Why Join SimpleTrials?

  • Meaningful impact: Help organizations conduct clinical research more efficiently and support the development of new therapies and medical technologies.
  • Growth opportunity: Join an expanding organization where your contributions directly influence company performance and market growth.
  • Career development: Build expertise in the growing eClinical technology market and develop professionally within an evolving sales organization.
  • Collaborative environment: Work closely with experienced leadership and cross-functional teams in a supportive, results-driven culture.
  • Product value: Represent validated, flexible CTMS and eTMF solutions designed to address real operational challenges for clinical research organizations.

Compensation & Benefits

SimpleTrials offers a competitive compensation package consisting of base salary and performance-based incentive compensation.

Additional compensation and benefits details will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Equal Opportunity

SimpleTrials is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and building an inclusive workplace. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs without regard to protected characteristics under applicable law.

Join SimpleTrials and help shape the future of clinical trial management technology.

Salary: $90,000+ / year

jobs.title: Technical Onboarding & Payments Support Specialist
jobs.excerpt: About FinSetWe work with prop trading firms, forex and CFD brokers, iGaming operators, and other high-risk businesses, matching them with the right acquirers, PSPs, banking partners, and payment infrastructure.
jobs.description:
About FinSet

We work with prop trading firms, forex and CFD brokers, iGaming operators, and other high-risk businesses, matching them with the right acquirers, PSPs, banking partners, and payment infrastructure.

But we’re not introducers who make an introduction and step away.

We’re hands-on operators who stay involved from the first conversation through onboarding, integration, compliance, corporate structuring, licensing, and ultimately live processing.

As part of our infrastructure, FinSet provides clients with access to our gateway and orchestration platform, which connects merchants to multiple payment providers through a centralized integration.

The Role

We are looking for a Technical Onboarding & Payments Support Specialist to own the technical support side of our client journey—from initial gateway integration and sandbox testing through launch and ongoing live processing.

You will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants and will sit between the client’s technical team, FinSet, our gateway/orchestration technology provider, and the PSPs and acquirers connected to the merchant.

This is not a copy-and-paste support role.

We need someone who can understand a technical problem, investigate it, communicate clearly with developers, work through API documentation, and attempt to solve issues independently before escalating them to our technology partners.

When escalation is necessary, you will be responsible for communicating the issue clearly to the appropriate technical team, following it through to resolution, and translating the outcome back to the client.

The objective is simple: make integrations easier, launches smoother, and technical issues faster to resolve.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

Technical Onboarding & Integration

Guide new clients through the technical integration with FinSet’s gateway and orchestration platform.

You’ll work directly with client developers to help them understand the API documentation, integration requirements, authentication, credentials, sandbox environment, payment flows, testing procedures, and the steps required to move into production.

You should be comfortable reading API documentation and explaining technical concepts to developers without simply forwarding documentation and expecting them to figure everything out themselves.

You’ll help troubleshoot integration issues, identify likely causes, and work with the client to resolve problems wherever possible.

When an issue requires intervention from our gateway/orchestrator technical team, you’ll gather the necessary information, escalate it properly, and manage communication until the issue is resolved.

Sandbox Testing & Going Live

Once the initial integration is complete, you’ll help merchants successfully move from sandbox testing into their live environment.

This includes:

  • Assisting clients with navigating the gateway/orchestration platform.

  • Helping configure and connect PSP/acquirer credentials as providers are onboarded.

  • Coordinating technical requirements between the merchant and the relevant PSPs.

  • Helping merchants perform test transactions and validating payment flows.

  • Troubleshooting failed tests and identifying whether issues originate with the merchant integration, gateway/orchestrator, PSP, or configuration.

  • Making sure the technical side of the setup is ready before the merchant begins live processing.

You’ll effectively act as the technical owner of the merchant’s journey from integration → testing → production.

Ongoing Payments Support

Your responsibility doesn’t end when the merchant goes live.

You will be the first point of contact for technical support in the communication channels we maintain with our clients.

When merchants experience technical issues, you’ll investigate first rather than immediately escalating.

Depending on the issue, you may need to coordinate with:

  • The merchant’s development or technical team.

  • FinSet’s internal team.

  • Our gateway/orchestrator technical team.

  • PSP or acquirer technical support teams.

You’ll be responsible for keeping communication organized and ensuring issues continue moving toward resolution rather than getting lost between different providers.

Issues may include transaction failures, API errors, configuration problems, credential issues, payment-method setup, routing questions, webhook/callback issues, PSP connectivity, or other payment-processing problems.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate has previous experience in payment gateways, payment orchestration, PSPs, acquiring, or technical payments support.

Experience working directly for or with a payment gateway or orchestration platform would be particularly valuable.

You should:

  • Be comfortable reading and understanding API documentation.

  • Be able to explain API and integration requirements clearly to developers.

  • Understand the basics of REST APIs, API requests/responses, authentication, webhooks/callbacks, credentials, sandbox vs. production environments, and common HTTP/API errors.

  • Have a practical understanding of online payment flows and how merchants, gateways, orchestrators, PSPs, and acquirers interact.

  • Be able to troubleshoot methodically rather than immediately escalating every issue.

  • Know how to collect the right technical information—error messages, request/response details, transaction IDs, timestamps, logs, configuration details, etc.—before escalating an issue.

  • Communicate technical problems clearly and efficiently with external technical support teams.

  • Be comfortable working directly with client developers as well as less-technical client stakeholders.

  • Take ownership of issues and follow them through until they are resolved.

  • Be highly organized and able to manage several merchant integrations and support conversations simultaneously.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally in English.

Strong Advantages

We’d especially like to hear from candidates who have:

  • Worked for a payment gateway or payment orchestration platform.

  • Worked in technical support or technical onboarding for a PSP, acquirer, fintech, or payment company.

  • Supported merchants through API integrations.

  • Experience configuring PSPs or payment methods within gateways/orchestrators.

  • Experience troubleshooting live payment-processing issues.

  • Familiarity with payment routing, declines, webhooks, callbacks, transaction statuses, MID configuration, credentials, and payment-provider integrations.

  • Experience working with high-risk industries such as forex, CFDs, prop trading, iGaming, crypto, or similar verticals.

Coding experience is helpful but not required. We’re not hiring a software engineer.

We’re looking for someone technical enough to understand integrations, investigate issues intelligently, communicate effectively with developers, and know when and how to involve deeper technical resources.

What Success Looks Like

A successful person in this role becomes the technical person our clients trust when they need help.

Clients shouldn’t need to figure out which provider to contact or chase multiple technical teams themselves. You take ownership, investigate the problem, involve the right parties when necessary, and keep things moving.

Over time, you’ll develop a strong understanding of our gateway/orchestration infrastructure and the PSPs we work with, allowing you to resolve an increasing percentage of questions independently and escalate only when deeper technical intervention is genuinely required.

Your success will ultimately be measured by how smoothly merchants move from onboarding to integration, from integration to live processing, and how effectively technical issues are resolved once they’re processing.

Location & Availability

This is a fully remote position, and candidates can be based anywhere.

However, your regular working hours must align with Eastern European / Middle Eastern business hours, as you’ll need to be available during the hours when our team, clients, and partners are actively communicating.

Job Title: Over-the-Telephone Interpreter (Advanced Level)

Department: Interpreter Operations

Reports To: Contractor Liaison – United Kingdom Interpreters

Location: Work at Home position, any place in United Kingdom

Summary of position:

Renders accurate and complete meaning between source language and target language in the consecutive mode of interpretation; facilitates communication between a speaker of English and a speaker of another language.

Principal Accountabilities:

  • Exhibits excellent interpreting skills and professional attitude whilst interpreting
  • Demonstrates accuracy, excellent note-taking skills, objectivity and an ability to handle difficult situations
  • Provides accurate and complete interpretations of verbal messages as uttered by LanguageLine Solutions' clients and their customers of limited English proficiency
  • Remains impartial and unbiased while using correct protocol
  • Displays deep understanding of the culture of both languages; recognizes and is sensitive to cultural differences
  • Manages the flow of the call and avoids taking over the call
  • Avoids interaction with the limited English speaker w/o client's permission

  • Exhibits knowledge of industry-specific terminology and protocol, i.e. medical/court/insurance/government agencies

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Language Proficiency:

  • Demonstrates superior proficiency in English and second language

  • Maintains neutrality towards client and limited English speaker
  • Demonstrates ability to speak clearly without accent interference
  • Understands common procedures and practices of industries served by LanguageLine Solutions
  • Displays cognitive skills needed to effectively interpret, i.e. speed of understanding and expression
  • Concentrates on and follows the thread of the conversation for an extended period of time; manages flow of call when necessary
  • Remembers blocks of information and delivers same with accuracy
  • Grasps the meaning of the message and anticipates direction of the dialogue
  • Maintains confidentiality and upholds ethical standards at any time

Customer Service skills:

  • Maintains a professional demeanour throughout the interpreting assignment

**Remote in the Northeastern Territory**

Salary: $120,000 - $150,000 plus commission and incentives

We are seeking an entrepreneurial, highly creative, and consultative SeniorDirector, Business Development to drive growth for our expanding healthcare communications and health education agency.

This is not a traditional sales role. We are looking for a curious "hunter" who enjoys opening doors, building relationships, and partnering with pharmaceutical marketers to solve meaningful business challenges. The ideal candidate is energized by developing new ideas, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting clients with innovative solutions that improve healthcare professional engagement, strengthen patient education, and ultimately help more patients receive better care.

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply sell agency services - they bring ideas. Someone who can walk into a meeting with a Professional or Consumer Brand Manager, ask insightful questions, understand their business challenges, and leave with the beginnings of a solution. This person should be equally comfortable discussing brand strategy, omnichannel engagement, field force effectiveness, patient engagement, digital innovation, AI-enabled solutions, and educational initiatives that create value for brands, healthcare professionals, and patients.

Success in this role requires equal parts business development, strategic thinking, creativity, and relationship building. You will become a trusted partner to pharmaceutical marketing teams by helping them solve challenges - not by selling products, but by bringing fresh ideas that improve outcomes.

Primary Stakeholders

The Senior Director, Business Development will primarily build relationships with commercial marketing leaders within pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations, including:

  • Professional Brand Managers
  • Consumer Brand Managers
  • Brand Directors
  • Omnichannel Marketing Leaders
  • Patient Marketing & Patient Services Teams
  • Digital & Innovation Teams

Success in this role comes from understanding the priorities of these stakeholders, uncovering unmet needs, and introducing innovative educational, digital, AI-enabled, and engagement solutions that help brands improve healthcare professional engagement, enhance the patient experience, and achieve their commercial objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a strategic growth plan to achieve and exceed annual revenue goals.
  • Identify, research, and engage Professional Brand Managers, Consumer Brand Managers, Brand Directors, and other commercial leaders within pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.
  • Build trusted executive relationships by understanding client business objectives, commercial challenges, and patient needs.
  • Lead consultative discovery conversations that uncover opportunities where innovative educational, digital, AI-enabled, and engagement solutions can create measurable value.
  • Bring fresh strategic ideas to every client interaction and proactively recommend solutions that improve healthcare professional engagement, strengthen patient education, enhance patient support, and drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with internal strategy, medical, creative, and digital teams to develop customized solutions that address client needs.
  • Present agency capabilities, strategic recommendations, and creative concepts that differentiate our organization from traditional healthcare agencies.
  • Lead the complete business development process from prospecting through proposal development, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Build, manage, and accurately forecast a healthy sales pipeline.
  • Represent the agency at industry conferences, client meetings, and networking events while expanding the agency's visibility and reputation. This role requires 25% travel.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Healthcare, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of successful business development, strategic partnerships, or pharmaceutical agency experience.
  • Proven success selling strategic marketing, digital, communications, educational, or commercial solutions to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.
  • Existing relationships with pharmaceutical marketing organizations strongly preferred.
  • Naturally curious and highly creative with the ability to identify unmet needs and develop innovative solutions.
  • Strong executive presence with exceptional presentation, communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-growing organization.
  • Passion for helping pharmaceutical companies improve healthcare professional engagement and patient outcomes.

Success Metrics:

  • Annual new business revenue.
  • Qualified sales pipeline generated.
  • Proposal-to-win conversion rate.
  • Average deal size.
  • Client retention and account growth.
  • Growth of strategic pharmaceutical relationships.
  • Forecast accuracy and CRM pipeline health.

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Competitive base salary ($120,000-150,000 based on experience).
  • Commission and performance incentives.
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with company match.
  • Flexible hybrid/remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to help build and shape a high-growth healthcare agency.

About Us

We are a healthcare communications and health education agency that partners with pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies to solve some of healthcare's biggest engagement challenges. Through innovative strategy, compelling creative, AI-enabled technologies, educational resources, digital platforms, and omnichannel engagement solutions, we help brands improve healthcare professional engagement, strengthen patient education, increase meaningful interactions, and ultimately improve patient outcomes. We're building a different kind of healthcare agency - one driven by curiosity, creativity, innovation, and a passion for solving meaningful problems. If you're energized by building relationships, bringing big ideas to clients, and helping shape the future of healthcare engagement, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Director, Escalation Management is responsible for leading Escalation Management for Services, including a team of Escalation Engineers who serve as the technical escalation point for implementation and support issues before L3 Engineering.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Director, Escalation Management is responsible for leading Escalation Management for Services, including a team of Escalation Engineers who serve as the technical escalation point for implementation and support issues before L3 Engineering. This role owns ITIL-aligned Problem Management and Release Management practices for Services, prioritizes escalations across customers and product lines, drives root cause analysis and corrective actions, and runs cross-functional defect review with Product and Engineering.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Escalation Engineers, setting goals, priorities, and coverage across product lines and technology stacks.

  • Ensure implementation and support issues are triaged, reproduced, and fully documented before escalation to L3 Engineering.

  • Prioritize escalations across customers from a Services perspective, weighing customer impact, severity, business risk, and contractual commitments.

  • Own the ITIL Problem Management practice for Services, including problem identification, problem control, and error control, with problem records, known errors, and published workarounds.

  • Research, document, and publish root cause analysis (RCA) reports, and drive corrective and preventive actions to completion with Engineering, Product, and Platform teams.

  • Host a recurring Defect Review Board with each product line to agree defect priority, target fix versions, and owners, and publish outcomes to Services stakeholders.

  • Apply ITIL Release Management practices to track and communicate L3 ticket status and which product versions, patches, and hotfixes contain each fix.

  • Partner with Platform and Cloud Management to schedule and sequence patch and release upgrades to customer cloud environments to minimize customer impact.

  • Help customers and Services resources understand differences between end-of-life and new-stack products, and work with Product to identify and close functionality gaps.

  • Report on escalation volume, aging, fix status, upgrade schedules, and RCA outcomes, and lead communication for high-severity customer escalations.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience (required).

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise software support, escalation engineering, sustaining engineering, or technical services (required).

  • 5+ years leading technical teams (required).

  • Hands-on experience with ITIL Problem Management, including root cause analysis, known error management, and RCA reporting (required).

  • Working knowledge of ITIL Release Management, Deployment Management, and Change Enablement practices (required).

  • Experience coordinating software releases, patches, or upgrades in cloud or SaaS environments (required).

  • Experience running cross-functional defect triage or review forums with Product and Engineering (required).

  • Ability to prioritize competing needs across a large customer base and lead through influence (required).

  • Clear written and verbal communication with executives, customers, and technical staff (required).

  • Preferred: Familiarity with ITIL standards and formal RCA methods (for example, 5 Whys, Ishikawa, Kepner-Tregoe, or fault tree analysis).

  • Preferred: Experience supporting migrations from legacy or end-of-life products to new platforms.

  • Preferred: Familiarity with medical imaging, radiology, or clinical software, including on-premise and hosted deployments.

  • Preferred: Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP and multi-tenant SaaS operations.

  • Preferred: Proficiency with ITSM and issue tracking tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Salesforce Service Cloud.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position may require occasional travel.

Working Environment

Remote (United States).

Physical Demands

The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Position Objectives:

The Revenue Manager role focuses on yield and revenue management across a group of hotels, offering hands-on support, analysis, and strategic recommendations to property managers to maximize revenue performance. The role requires proficiency in advanced revenue management systems to facilitate automated rate adjustments, forecasting, and reporting, alongside a strong foundation in traditional revenue management practices. Additionally, the Revenue Manager will manage OTA (Online Travel Agent) relationships, utilize promotional tools, and work with various departments to implement integrated revenue strategies.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Revenue Management System Support:

    • Monitor and adjust data within revenue management systems (e.g., Duetto, IDeaS) for optimal pricing and forecasting.

    • Analyze and make informed adjustments to pricing recommendations, ensuring accurate automated yielding.

    • Train property managers on systems like Opera Cloud, RMS Cloud, and Protel PMS for consistent use across the network.

  • Booking Pace & Forecasting:

    • Review booking pace through pickup reports, identifying trends and resolving discrepancies.

    • Use historical data, seasonal trends, and budget expectations for monthly forecasting, providing actionable insights to property managers.

    • Coordinate with hotel managers on group bookings to ensure timely reviews, room releases, and strategic rate positioning.

  • Competitor Intelligence & Market Analysis:

    • Utilize STR Global and other tools to maintain competitive intelligence, benchmarking each property’s performance against market standards.

    • Review and interpret STR data to optimize pricing and revenue strategies.

    • Manage OTA partnerships, utilizing promotional tools to drive revenue and optimize multi-channel campaigns.

  • Revenue Strategy Development:

jobs.excerpt: Vice President, Product Management – Exposure Command & Vulnerability Management Rapid7 is looking for an experienced and visionary leader to join our Product team as Vice President, Product Management for our Exposure Command and Vulnerability Management product suite.
jobs.description:
Vice President, Product Management – Exposure Command & Vulnerability Management

Rapid7 is looking for an experienced and visionary leader to join our Product team as Vice President, Product Management for our Exposure Command and Vulnerability Management product suite. In this role, you will set the strategic direction for Rapid7's flagship exposure and vulnerability management platform, driving the products that help thousands of security teams around the world identify, prioritize, and eliminate risk across their entire attack surface.

About the Team

The Product Management team at Rapid7 defines the future of cybersecurity by transforming complex security challenges into seamless, customer-centric cloud solutions that protect thousands of global enterprises. Our Exposure Command team sits at the center of Rapid7's mission — building the platform that brings together vulnerability management, attack surface management, cloud security, and application risk into a unified, actionable view of exposure.

About the Role

Reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Office, Vice President, Product Management for Exposure Command and Vulnerability Management, your primary responsibility will be to own and evolve the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and execution for Rapid7's core exposure management platform.

Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Partner with the Chief Product & Technology Officer and senior executive leadership to define and execute a multi-year product vision for Exposure Command, InsightVM, and adjacent vulnerability and attack surface management capabilities that positions Rapid7 as the definitive leader in the Gartner Exposure Assessment Platform category.

  • Drive the evolution from point-in-time vulnerability management to continuous, risk-based exposure management — translating market trends such as CTEM (Continuous Threat Exposure Management), autonomous remediation, and AI-driven exposure validation into differentiated product capabilities.

  • Lead cross-functional orchestration across engineering, UX design, data science, threat intelligence, and go-to-market teams to ship high-quality, customer-validated product releases on time and within scope.

  • Own the product portfolio P&L lens — partnering with finance, sales, and marketing to define packaging, pricing, and competitive positioning that drives ARR growth and customer retention across the Exposure Command product line.

  • Establish a robust customer engagement and feedback framework — including Customer Zero, advisory boards, and field validation loops — to ground product decisions in real-world security operations workflows and practitioner needs.

  • Champion the platform integration strategy, ensuring Exposure Command's 500+ connectors, third-party data ingestion, and ecosystem partnerships deliver a seamless, unified experience that reduces tool sprawl for security teams.

  • Define and track product-level OKRs and KPIs — including adoption, feature utilization, NPS, and risk reduction outcomes — to continuously measure and communicate the business impact of the product portfolio.

  • Build, mentor, and scale a world-class product management organization, identifying senior leadership talent, establishing development paths, and fostering a culture of customer obsession, rigorous execution, and continuous learning.

  • Serve as an external evangelist and thought leader for exposure management — representing Rapid7's product vision at industry conferences, with analysts (Gartner, Forrester, IDC), and in strategic customer and partner conversations.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include

  • 15+ years of progressive product management leadership experience, including direct ownership of complex cloud-native enterprise security or cybersecurity SaaS products at scale, with at least five years at the director or VP level.

  • Deep domain expertise in vulnerability management, exposure management, attack surface management, or adjacent cybersecurity domains — with a clear point of view on where the market is heading and how to build a winning product against that trajectory.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous market and customer signals into a crisp, compelling product strategy, and to rally engineering, design, and GTM teams around a shared roadmap and set of priorities.

  • Strong understanding of hybrid and cloud-native security architectures — including SaaS platforms, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), CI/CD pipelines, and CNAPP/AppSec tooling — sufficient to engage deeply with both customers and engineering.

  • Track record of driving measurable business outcomes: ARR growth, expansion within installed base, improved win rates, and category leadership recognition from analysts and customers alike.

  • Exceptional executive communication skills — capable of presenting complex product strategy and technical tradeoffs in a clear, compelling narrative to C-suite, board, customers, and analysts.

  • Strong cross-functional influence and collaboration skills, with a history of building alignment across engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success without direct authority.

  • Experience building and scaling product management teams, with a coaching mindset and the ability to develop senior PMs into leaders.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, publicly traded company environment with the organizational maturity to navigate competing priorities, resource constraints, and executive stakeholders.

  • Embody Rapid7's core values and foster a culture of excellence, psychological safety, and customer impact across the product organization.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy — apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.

jobs.title: Amazon Image Brief & Conversion Associate
jobs.excerpt: Amazon images are where most listings win or lose.
jobs.description:
Amazon images are where most listings win or lose. The main image decides whether anyone clicks. The six behind it decide whether they buy — and whether the parcel comes back.

We are hiring one person to own that. Take a live listing, work out from its reviews and returns why it is not converting, and write the image brief that fixes it — a brief a remote designer can execute without a single follow-up question.

This is an operational and analytical role, not a design role. You will not be making the artwork. You decide what it has to say, in what order, and you hold the returned files to that standard.

The split is 75 / 25.

  • 75% — the briefs. The conversion thinking, the ranked USPs, the seven slots, the QA of what comes back.
  • 25% — analysis and reporting. Part of it is the work that feeds the brief: pulling the reviews, reading them properly, turning them into a persona and a pain-point list. The rest is the follow-up reporting we owe clients — sales and traffic, return reasons, and what actually moved once new images went live.

You will work across markets. Mostly European and US listings, across many markets and languages, in categories you have never shopped in yourself.

What you will do

Image briefs and conversion thinking — 75% of the role

  • Diagnose why a listing is not converting: what the gallery fails to answer, which objection nobody addressed, where the buyer loses confidence and leaves.
  • Know what each slot is for. The main image earns the click. Images two to seven answer objections in the order a buyer actually raises them. The size and fit slots decide whether the sale stays sold.
  • Rank seven USPs by what wins the click and what prevents a return. They are not the same list, and the order is the decision.
  • Write the brief for each slot in our template: one message per slot, one headline, an optional subline, a maximum of three to four callouts, every line adding something new.
  • Apply the two-second rule. One idea per image, legible at thumbnail size on a phone. If a slot needs a paragraph to work, it is not a slot.
  • Work inside the client’s brand book — colours, fonts, existing assets — naming exactly which asset to reuse and where the file lives.
  • Keep sizing accurate and internally consistent: backend size chart against image size chart, US against EU conventions.
  • Know Amazon image policy cold: main-image rules, no price, ratings, review counts or badges, and how the gallery renders on a phone.
  • QA the returned files against the brief and say precisely why something is not working — hierarchy, contrast, whitespace, text density, whether a close-up box earns its place.

The analysis behind the briefs — part of the 25%

  • Download the reviews yourself and read them properly: themes, frequency, and the exact words customers use.
  • Pull Voice of the Customer and the return report, and weight return reasons against units actually sold.
  • Turn that into a buyer persona and a ranked pain-point list — for categories you did not grow up in.
  • Separate “we can fix this on the listing” from “the product is the problem”.
  • Evidence only. Never invent a return reason, a measurement or a number, and ask when something is missing.

Reporting that follows up sales — the rest of the 25%

  • Find and download the right reports without being walked through it: Sales & Traffic, Search Query Performance, Returns, Voice of the Customer.
  • Build the recurring follow-ups: sales and traffic trend, return rate by size, conversion before and after an image update.
  • Merge two exports on ASIN or SKU and produce a clean pivot, without hand-counting rows.
  • Deliver a one-page summary that says what matters, why it matters and what to do about it. Not a data dump.

Making the workflow better with AI — across all of the above

  • Use Claude and ChatGPT as part of the work, not as a novelty: review analysis, first-draft copy, translation, summarising exports.
  • Work inside our Claude projects, with the context and templates already there, and keep them current as the accounts change.
  • Build repeatable workflows — project instructions, skills, prompt templates, SOPs — so the next product of a kind is faster than the last.
  • Know where AI is unreliable and check it. Invented numbers, invented quotes and plausible-sounding measurements are the failure mode, and they are your responsibility, not the tool’s.
  • Have an opinion about the tooling itself. We write our briefs in PowerPoint today and we are open to something faster — if you know a better way to brief a designer, we want to hear it and we will let you build it.

Requirements

Must-have:

  • Two to three or more years working directly on Amazon listings — agency, brand or aggregator — with hands-on Seller Central or Vendor Central access.
  • A real point of view on what makes an Amazon listing convert, and examples to back it. Image and A+ content strategy — not PPC only, not logistics only.
  • Fluent in Amazon image policy and in how the gallery behaves on mobile.
  • Experience improving a listing off the back of return-rate or review data. We will ask you to describe one.
  • Solid Excel or Google Sheets: pivot tables, lookups, merging two exports on ASIN or SKU, and a per-size or per-ASIN breakdown from a raw Amazon report.
  • You build with AI, you do not only prompt it: you have set up projects, custom instructions, reusable prompts or skills that someone other than you then used. Claude preferred, ChatGPT fine.
  • Working knowledge of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or an equivalent.
  • Experience with listings for a market that is not your own.
  • Evidence-only discipline, and the judgement to ask rather than assume.
  • Fluent written English to a professional standard, and the self-direction to run your own queue.
  • Using AI to localise images — making sure the copy both converts in the market’s own language and still fits a design that was built in English. (In-house native-speaker review is available for proofreading; you own the brief and the message, not the grammar.)
    •

Strong plus:

  • Design tool literacy — Figma, Canva or Photoshop enough to mark up and QA — plus experience briefing offshore designers.
  • Apparel, footwear or other sized goods. Fit and sizing returns are the core problem we are solving.
  • A second European language — German especially — or hands-on experience with a non-US marketplace.
  • An outdoor, sports or equestrian background.
  • Recurring client reporting experience, with written commentary rather than just the numbers.
  • Microsoft Teams. We run day-to-day work and client communication in it, so having worked in it before is an advantage.
  • Anything you have built with AI that saved a team real time. Tell us about it.
    •

What this role is not

  • It is not a graphic design job. We have designers. We need the person who tells them what to make and why.
  • It is not a PPC or an operations job, although you will need to understand how both affect a listing.
  • It is not a role where you decide the answer and look for the data afterwards.
    •

Overview

About Certara

Certara’s purpose is to assist in accelerating the development of meaningful medicines that make an impact on our society and the people that need them most. Our portfolio spans the discovery, preclinical, clinical, and post-marketing phases of drug development, working with over 1200 commercial companies, 250 academic institutions, and numerous regulatory agencies.

About Certara Data Sciences Team

We build software solutions for scientists. Certara’s data science software enables companies to use data as effectively as possible at every point in the process. With our industry-leading products, researchers can manage, visualize, and interact with data. Scientists are freed from tedious data processing and can focus on their core task – making confident decisions for the benefit of patients. Within the team, innovation and creativity are highly valued, and everyone is given the opportunity for training and continuous development.

About the Role

As a Product Manager, you will deliver value to our customers through improvements to our applications. Specifically, you will be responsible for the development and successful adoption of our applications by our customers. You will be working at the intersection of multiple teams that include user experience, subject matter experts, engineering, and marketing.


Responsibilities

Responsibilities

Customer Understanding & Advocacy

  • Engage with our SMEs and customers to deeply understand data workflows and pain points.

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Identify and validate recurring customer problems that represent market opportunities and align with organizational capabilities.
  • Understand the competitive landscape and be able to talk about strengths and weaknesses of our competition.

Product Management

  • Guide product lifecycle from ideation to development to go-to-market to scaled product-market-fit – ensuring successful execution of all steps.

  • Build roadmap that aligns with our application’s vision and strategy.
  • Partner with sales and customer success teams to ensure successful outcomes for our customers.
  • Translate product vision and strategy into reasoned software priorities.
  • Understand the personas of customers, and how each persona engages with our software.
  • Ensure customer requirements are met with enterprise grade capabilities in performance, scalability, and reliability; authentication; access control; and software validation and compliance.

  • BS/BA in science or technology related field or equivalent work experience.

  • Proficiency in shaping an idea in way that delivers immediate business value beginning with Minimum Viable Product

Certara bases all employment-related decision on merit, taking into consideration qualifications, skills, achievement, and performance. jobs.description:
Hiring: Full-Time Product Manager - Remote - $12,000 - $15,600/yr

🚀 About the Client 🚀

🤖 An AI-driven business ecosystem– Building AI tools, marketing systems, and coaching programs that help entrepreneurs slash labor costs, save time, and build high-converting funnels.

🚀 $1M+ in subscription sales within months of launch– Their flagship AI business lab now carries a valuation of over $20M.

🌏 700+ entrepreneurs served globally– With documented success stories across a fast-growing, high-ticket client community.

🏆 Led by an award-winning founder– 13+ years in marketing and AI, an international keynote speaker, and a multi-award business competition winner.

🎤 Masterminds, bootcamps & live events– From virtual bootcamps to luxury in-person masterminds across the US.

⚡ Fast, ambitious, and growing– A high-energy team where speed, ownership, and excellence are the standard.

⚒️ Key Responsibilities of the Product Manager 📝

🔎 Requirements Gathering & Business Analysis

📝 Product Scoping, PRDs & Backlog

🤝 Developer Hand-off & Project Coordination

🧪 Product QA & Testing

📚 Product Documentation & Communication

🎓 Member Training & Support

Additional Information:

Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring a Product Manager? 🏢

Our client is hiring a Product Manager to take true end-to-end ownership of their product. Today, pieces of project management are covered, but no one fully owns product thinking—and the founder who has carried this function can no longer give it the attention it needs as his responsibilities expand. You'll become the bridge between the business, its members, and the development team: turning ideas and customer needs into validated scopes, PRDs, and user stories, keeping 2–3 feature projects moving, and confirming every release works as designed and delivers the right user experience. This is a product owner role, not a task-coordinator role, with real room to grow into broader product or operational leadership.

If you're a sharp, customer-minded product person who loves turning messy ideas into clear specs, isn't afraid to push back, and thrives in a fast-moving, AI-first environment—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 💼 Digital Product Experience– 2+ years as a Product Manager, Product Owner, Assistant Product Owner, or Business Analyst on a web app, SaaS, mobile, AI, or crypto product.
  • 📝 Requirements & Scoping– Proven skill gathering business requirements and writing PRDs, scopes of work, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • 🔍 QA Testing & Bug Tracking– Hands-on experience testing software against specs and logging issues clearly.
  • ✍️ Succinct, Direct Communication– Strong spoken and written English; you get to the root of an issue in as few words as possible.
  • 💪 Constructive Pushback– You challenge ideas, offer creative input, and speak up when an approach doesn't make sense.
  • 🤖 Strong AI Skills– Comfortable going beyond chat interfaces with developer-oriented AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, ChatGPT Codex) to prototype and "vibe code" concepts.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🧠 AI Product Background– Experience on AI-driven products is highly desirable.
  • 📊 CRM, Funnel or Coaching Business Experience– Familiarity with CRMs, funnel tools, or community and coaching businesses.
  • 🇪🇸 Spanish Language Skills– Helpful for collaborating with the South American development team.

Your responsibilities include:

🔎 Requirements Gathering & Business Analysis

  • Run short (15–20 minute) discovery sessions with users, clients, and key stakeholders, as directed by the client
  • Analyze business requirements, customer feedback, software constraints, and UI/UX flows
  • Turn raw input into clear, concise documentation—no bloat
  • Review requirements with leadership to close gaps and align on direction
  • Gather user feedback and review behavior data (such as heat maps) to see what is and isn't working

📝 Product Scoping, PRDs & Backlog

  • Translate approved requirements into PRDs, scopes of work, epics, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
  • Audit existing builds and integrations before scoping, so the team extends rather than rebuilds
  • Ask the questions that expose gaps early and flag risks and unknowns
  • Help size and prioritize the backlog while advancing 2–3 feature projects at once
  • Review concept prototypes and contribute creative, customer-centric, churn-reducing feature ideas

🤝 Developer Hand-off & Project Coordination

  • Brief the development team on approved PRDs, scopes, and visual prototypes
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business needs and the dev team, working closely with the internal Developer PM
  • Run the board day to day: cards, statuses, blockers, and sprint check-ins
  • Obtain timelines from developers, track milestones, and flag scope changes that affect dates or budget
  • Chase developers and stakeholders for answers and decisions

🧪 Product QA & Testing

  • Write test cases from acceptance criteria and test new features on staging before release
  • Validate that features work as designed and deliver the intended user experience—not just that they're bug-free
  • Log bugs with steps, screenshots, and severity; retest fixes and sign off or send back
  • Run regression checks on core flows before each release
  • Help the support team reproduce and escalate user-reported issues, and join customer calls when product issues need investigating

📚 Product Documentation & Communication

  • Keep PRDs, user stories, release notes, feature guides, and FAQs current
  • Maintain a clear record of product decisions and why they were made
  • Send a short weekly update covering what's done, what's next, and what's blocked
  • Share short, bulleted QA summaries with leadership
  • Document completed features so marketing can prepare launch campaigns

🎓 Member Training & Support

  • Run onboarding and how-to sessions for members
  • Build short guides, videos, and walkthroughs
  • Answer member questions and triage issues as a fix, bug, or feature request
  • Spot repeat questions and feed them back into the product and the docs

🏡 Want to Know More About the Client?

Our client is an AI-driven business ecosystem on a mission to impact 1 million entrepreneurs by making business simple, scalable, and sustainable—even for those with zero tech or marketing experience. Their suite of offerings includes a subscription-based AI business lab, a proven AI marketing framework, an AI marketing agency, a 10-week AI accelerator for SMEs, elite masterminds, live events, and custom AI tools. Clients use their systems to build high-converting funnels, cut labor costs with AI, and generate consistent high-ticket revenue.

Founded by a marketing and AI leader with 13+ years of experience working alongside some of the most recognizable consumer brands, the company hit $1M+ in subscription sales within months of launch and now carries a $20M+ valuation, serving 700+ entrepreneurs worldwide. It's a fast-paced, high-standards environment where you'll work directly with the founder and see the impact of your work every single day. 🌟

Culture and Core Values:

This is a no-BS, high-trust team where wins are celebrated publicly and feedback is given privately. You'll get hands-on mentorship early on, then full ownership once the training wheels come off.

  • ⏱️ Protect Leadership's Time– Every update, doc, and decision should save time, not consume it.
  • ⚡ Speed of Execution & Directness– Action over contemplation, with fast, concise communication.
  • 🔍 Proactive Ownership & Resourcefulness– Find the answer before you escalate; no waiting for orders.
  • ✅ Extreme Organization & Quality Control– Details matter, and nothing ships until it's right.
  • 🧠 Continuous Learning & AI Mastery– Stay curious, keep leveling up, and let AI multiply your impact.

This is the kind of team where your ideas shape what gets built, and your growth keeps pace with the business. 💯

What's in it for you? 😏

Joining this client means not just filling a role but embarking on a personal development journey. The growth potential is substantial, with opportunities to:

  • 📈 Growth Path– The role is built to evolve into broader product or operational leadership as you prove yourself.
  • 🧑‍🏫 Mentorship from a Product-Led Founder– Learn directly from someone with 15+ years in product and a successful exit.
  • 🤖 AI-First Environment– Work hands-on with Claude, Claude Code, Codex, and other leading AI tools every day.
  • 💬 Your Voice Matters– Pushback and creative input are expected, not just tolerated.
  • 🏆 Recognition That Counts– Wins are celebrated publicly and your impact is visible.
  • 🌎 Remote Flexibility– Work from anywhere with solid overlap with Australian hours.

Your next big opportunity starts here—ready to take the leap? 🚀

Perks:

  • 13th Month Bonus (Wild right?! 🤯)
  • Permanent work-from-home / remote set-up 🌴
  • Health insurance 🧑‍⚕️
  • Dental insurance 🪥
  • Mental health insurance 🧠
  • Great starting salary 💰
  • Growth opportunity 📈
  • Performance-based raises 💸
  • Prizes and bonuses 🏆

Specifics:

Time

  • Full-time; 8 hours/day, Monday–Friday, with solid overlap with AEST (Australian) hours. Launch periods may occasionally require extra availability, including weekends.
  • This is a remote position so you can have the freedom to work from anywhere

Miscellaneous

  • Attire - business casual when in meetings
  • Professional setup
  • Clean background
  • Good camera
  • Good microphone
  • Strong wifi

Tech Stack

  • 📋 Jira (or similar project management tool)
  • 📄 Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets)
  • 🤖 Claude / Claude Artifacts
  • 💻 Claude Code / ChatGPT Codex (Highly Preferred)
  • 💬 Intercom

Compensation

  • Fixed Rate $12,000 - $15,600/yr
Salary: $1,000 – $1,300 / month

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Shared Hosting
jobs.excerpt: Who We Are At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support.

Shared hosting is the foundation of our business. It is where most of our customers begin, where millions of small businesses and creators keep their websites running every day, and where the durability of our relationship with them is decided. This is not a greenfield product — it is a large, mature, revenue-critical platform with real customers, real constraints, and enormous leverage in every point of retention we earn back.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for our shared hosting platform, with a clear mandate: make the experience after purchase so good that customers stay.

Most of the hosting industry competes on the first 60 seconds — the price on the landing page. We intend to win on everything that happens afterward: how quickly a customer gets a working site, how rarely they need to contact support, how confidently they understand what they are paying for, and whether they renew. You will own that journey end to end, and you will be measured on retention, not on shipped features.

This is a role for a product manager who is energized rather than intimidated by a large legacy platform, who reads support transcripts for fun, and who understands that in a high-volume, low-ARPU business, a one-point improvement in renewal rate is worth more than most new products.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

Own the strategy and roadmap

  • Define and own the multi-quarter vision, strategy, and roadmap for the shared hosting platform across brands, and get real alignment on it from engineering through executive leadership.
  • Make explicit, defensible prioritization calls about where we invest — and where we deliberately do not — in a portfolio with more legitimate demands than capacity.
  • Build the business cases that unlock investment: sizing, cohort impact modeling, and a credible view of payback.

Own retention as a product problem

  • Diagnose churn properly. Separate first-term churn from renewal-term churn, voluntary from involuntary, price-driven from experience-driven — then build a roadmap that attacks the largest addressable causes rather than the loudest ones.
  • Fix the renewal moment. Introductory-to-renewal price transitions are the single largest churn event in this industry. Partner with pricing, billing, and lifecycle marketing to make renewal transparent, well-timed, and defensible on value rather than surprising.
  • Recover involuntary churn. Own the product surface of failed payments, expiring cards, dunning, and reactivation — some of the highest-ROI work available on a subscription base this size.
  • Reduce refund and cancellation rate inside the money-back guarantee window by finding and removing the specific early-life failures that cause it.

Own the customer experience end to end

  • Compress time-to-first-published-site. Own provisioning, onboarding, domain connection, and the first-session experience. Every day between purchase and a live site is a day of churn risk.
  • Modernize the control panel experience. Shape the customer-facing evolution of our hosting management experience — including the migration path off cPanel-era tooling — with usability and continuity for existing customers as first-order constraints, not afterthoughts.
  • Attack support contact drivers. Partner with Customer Care to identify the top reasons customers contact us — DNS and domain confusion, email deliverability, performance complaints, malware remediation, billing questions, migration failures — and convert contact-rate reduction into a funded product roadmap. Lower contact rate and higher satisfaction are the same work done well.
  • Make performance and reliability legible. Customers experience uptime and speed through their own site and through what we tell them. Own the customer-facing side of incidents, status, diagnostics, and resource limits.

Operate with rigor

  • Define the metric tree for the platform and instrument it. Partner with data science on cohort analysis, survival curves, and driver models so that the team argues from evidence rather than anecdote.
  • Run a disciplined experimentation program — with enough statistical honesty to kill your own ideas.
  • Maintain a genuine voice-of-customer practice: recurring customer interviews, support transcript and ticket mining, NPS and CSAT verbatim analysis, and session review. Bring that evidence into every prioritization conversation.
  • Watch the competitive set closely — GoDaddy, SiteGround, Hostinger, IONOS, WP Engine — as well as substitution pressure from website and commerce SaaS platforms, and translate what you learn into strategy rather than feature copying.

Lead without authority

  • Partner daily with engineering, design, and program management as the accountable owner of outcomes for your area.
  • Work across Customer Care, Trust & Safety, infrastructure and SRE, billing, monetization, lifecycle marketing, data science, and multiple brand teams — none of whom report to you, all of whom you need.
  • Communicate crisply to very different audiences, from an engineering design review to an executive roadmap review, without changing the substance of the message.

What you'll own

You will be accountable for a defined set of platform metrics, expected to include:

  • Gross and net revenue retention; first-term and multi-term renewal rate
  • Unit churn and refund rate within the guarantee window
  • Activation rate and time-to-first-published-site
  • Support contact rate per account and first-contact resolution
  • CSAT and NPS for the hosting experience
  • Attach rate on adjacent products, and cost to serve per account

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • 5+ years in product management, including meaningful time on a self-serve subscription product at consumer or SMB scale.
  • A track record of owning a retention or customer experience metric and moving it. You can walk us through the diagnosis, the bets you made, what worked, what didn't, and how you knew.
  • Genuine technical fluency. You are comfortable in conversations about DNS, SSL, the LAMP/WordPress stack, control panels, email delivery, caching and CDNs, and resource isolation — enough to earn credibility with engineers and to reason independently about tradeoffs. You do not need to have written the code.
  • Strong quantitative instincts. You are fluent with SQL or an equivalent, you design experiments that produce trustworthy answers, and you are comfortable with cohort and retention analysis.
  • Real customer proximity. You seek out customers and frontline support teams directly and regularly, and you can hold the customer's perspective in a room full of competing internal priorities.
  • Comfort with legacy scale. You know how to make durable progress on a platform carrying a decade or more of accumulated decisions, migrations in flight, and customers who cannot be disrupted.
  • Sound judgment about volume economics. You understand that at millions of accounts, small percentage movements are large dollar outcomes — and you can tell the difference between a rounding error and a real result.
  • Excellent written communication and the ability to bring partner teams along without formal authority.
  • A bias to action. You get things done, and you would rather ship a decisive partial improvement than perfect a plan.

Great advantage will be

  • Direct experience in web hosting, domains, or web presence products.
  • Depth in the WordPress ecosystem.
  • Experience with pricing and packaging, renewal pricing, or subscription monetization.
  • Experience running large-scale platform or infrastructure migrations with a customer-experience lens.
  • Background adjacent to support operations — contact-driver reduction, self-service, or help content.
  • Experience shipping in a multi-brand portfolio where one platform serves several distinct customer bases.
  • Hands-on work applying AI to customer support, onboarding, or site management experiences.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days. You have your own independent point of view on why customers leave, grounded in data and in direct customer and frontline contact — not inherited from the existing narrative. You have identified the three largest addressable retention opportunities and sized them.
  • Six months. A funded, sequenced roadmap is in market with early experiments read out, and your partner teams in Care, marketing, and engineering treat you as the owner of this space.
  • Twelve months. Measurable, defensible movement in renewal rate and support contact rate, and a shared company-wide understanding of where shared hosting is headed over the next two years.

Why you’ll love us.

  • Work-life balance.Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.

  • We celebrate one another’s differences.  We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees.  We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally.

  • We care about you.We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K,Life/AD&D/STD/LTD,Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more!

  • Where can we take you?We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

The target compensation range for this position is $140,000 to $170,000 annually. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to: candidate’s qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience, as well as internal equity and market conditions.
