Be a part of something extraordinary, where your ideas and contributions truly matter. Let’s shape the future of travel together.

About the role

Ventrata is excited to announce that we're looking for a skilled Sales Manager based in Australia, with a passion for tours, activities, and attractions, to drive new business growth across Asia-Pacific (APAC), with an initial focus on Australia and New Zealand (ANZ).

This is our very first sales role in the ANZ region. You won’t be stepping into an established territory with a ready-made pipeline – you’ll be the one building it. As the face of Ventrata in ANZ, you’ll open doors, build on our existing client relationships, expand our market presence, and help lay the foundations for future growth.

This role is a great fit if you enjoy taking full ownership – shaping the region as if it were your own business, spotting opportunities and acting on them, and taking pride in being responsible and accountable for the results you achieve.

And this is just the beginning. As our business in ANZ grows, so will the opportunities. If you’re ambitious and looking to grow – in your career, your impact and what you build – this is a place where you can do exactly that.

The role is remote and will be based in Australia. For consideration, you should be based within the region to work during standard local business hours (AEST/NZST). Additionally, you will be traveling for prospective customer visits, client meetings, or regional trade shows and conferences.

Key Information

Location: Remote Australia

Duration: Full-time

Must-have: A proven track record in a revenue-generating sales role within the ticketing, travel-tech, or SaaS industry. Direct experience working with (or for) major Attractions, Tours, Sightseeing operators, or Leisure/Resort properties is essential. You should speak the language of our clients fluently and understand their unique technical and operational pain points.

Key Responsibilities

  • Territory Ownership & Revenue Growth: Take ownership of your assigned territory across Australia and New Zealand, driving new business acquisition, building a strong pipeline, and delivering against revenue targets. Work closely with leadership to shape regional priorities and growth opportunities.
  • Prospecting & Business Development: Proactively identify, engage, and qualify new business opportunities through targeted outbound activities, networking, industry events, and strategic account targeting. Build relationships with key decision-makers and develop opportunities within medium-sized and enterprise accounts.
  • End-to-End Sales Execution: Own the entire sales cycle, from initial discovery and product demonstrations through commercial negotiations, contract execution, and closing. Understand customer needs, build compelling business cases, and effectively communicate Ventrata's value proposition.
  • Market Development & Competitive Intelligence: Develop a strong understanding of the ANZ market, including customer needs, industry trends, and the competitive landscape. Identify opportunities to strengthen Ventrata's regional presence and provide actionable feedback to leadership and Product.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Success Handover: Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Sales Operations, and Customer Success to drive opportunities forward. Ensure seamless handovers to Customer Success, sharing commercial commitments, customer expectations, and relevant context to support successful onboarding and long-term relationships.
  • Pipeline Management & Forecasting: Maintain accurate CRM records, manage opportunities proactively, and provide reliable revenue forecasts. Monitor pipeline health, identify risks early, and maintain sufficient pipeline coverage to consistently deliver against sales targets.

Requirements

  • Proven history of achieving or exceeding enterprise sales targets within the travel, ticketing, or SaaS sector (with a focus on attractions, tours, activities, or resorts).
  • Strong understanding of tour, activity, and attraction operations (or Property Management Systems/Connectivity if focusing on resorts).
  • Reside in Australia with full working rights.
  • Willing and able to travel regularly to prospective client sites, trade shows, and industry events across ANZ and occasionally internationally.
  • Current passport and ability to travel internationally.
  • Strong sales account planning skills and the focus to execute strategic plans.
  • Creative and analytical problem-solving skills with an unrelenting passion for achieving revenue targets.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Self-starter who thrives working remotely and can independently manage their time and sales pipeline.

Benefits

  • We are fairly informal about working hours. We want to make sure you like your job and want to go the extra mile for us.
  • Unlimited paid holiday days.
  • WFH or work remotely.
  • Annual company retreats — Once a year, the entire team comes together for a week of collaboration, team building and celebration. So far we've met in Spain, South Africa, Italy, Portugal and France.
  • Hardware/ remote setup package.
  • Base salary + uncapped commission structure with accelerators for earnings above OTE.

Did we catch your eye or maybe also your heart, and do you want to become part of the Ventrata family? Send us your CV and join us!

More About Ventrata

Ventrata is an enterprise ticketing platform designed for high-volume attractions, museums, observatory towers, sightseeing tours, and activity operators. Our all-in-one solution powers online, in-person, and third-party sales, and provides robust functionality for resource management, hardware integrations, and 24/7 live support.

Leading brands across diverse verticals trust Ventrata's solutions, and our focus on building long-term connections is key to mutual success. Since 2016, we have worked with many City Sightseeing operations and have teamed up with notable companies like Big Bus Tours and Historic Tours of America. Our recent partnerships, including those with English Heritage, Paradoxon, the Empire State Building, Thames Clippers, and many others established over the past two years, show strong potential to evolve into enduring, long-term relationships. These examples represent just a few of our many collaborations driving the innovation behind the 21 million tickets we sold in 2023 — a 60% increase from the previous year.

What truly sets us apart is our independence — we've been profitable since 2018, with no reliance on venture capital. This financial stability allows us to innovate and grow on our own terms.

We value collaboration and freedom, ensuring that every team member has the space to take ownership, be heard, and drive real impact.

  • Manage challenging conversations while maintaining professional relationships.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

About GovPilot:

GovPilot provides cloud-based software solutions to local governments, aiming to make our communities better places to live and work. As a mission-driven company, GovPilot is committed to creating impactful technology that serves the public good.

We are looking for team members who take pride in their work and seek to consistently improve themselves, their skills, and their knowledge. If this sounds like you–and the type of work environment where you’d thrive–we hope you’ll join us!

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Unlimited PTO.

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Professional development opportunities and learning budget.

The Position:

The Implementation Specialist, part of the GovPilot Professional Services team, is responsible for leading end-to-end deployments of our SaaS applications across all areas of municipal government. Guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful adoption. Acting as both a project lead and product expert, you’ll collaborate closely with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into effective, scalable system solutions.

You will play a key role in ensuring each customer realizes measurable value from our platform while providing a seamless, high-quality onboarding experience.   • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients re-engineer business processes to maximize the value of the platform
  • Architect custom system solutions for unique client requirements that go beyond standard platform configurations
  • Consult with clients on data strategy, advising on data cleansing and restructuring to ensure long-term platform health

  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder client relationships with professionalism, navigating competing priorities and organizational politics effectively required
  • Proven ability to re-engineer client business processes and architect system solutions that go beyond standard platform configurations required
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational change management initiatives within client engagements, driving adoption across multi-stakeholder environments required
  • Ability to independently navigate technically complex or politically sensitive client situations, escalating to senior leadership only when necessary required
  • Experience partnering with Product or Engineering teams to communicate client-side feature gaps and influence roadmap decisions required
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business explanations required
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills required
  • Excellent organizational, time-management, and prioritization skills required
  • Ability to learn new technologies and concepts quickly required
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering implementations on time with strong Post Deployment Survey scores and measurable user adoption outcomes required
  • PMP or CSM certification a plus

Why Join Us:

GovPilot's Professional Services team is where strategy meets execution. You'll lead implementations that directly transform how local governments serve their communities, working with real clients, on real projects, with visible and measurable outcomes. This is a team that's investing in the methodology, tooling, and talent to scale, meaning there's a real opportunity to shape how we work, not just execute within a system someone else built. If you're someone who takes pride in delivering complex projects well and wants to grow within a mission-driven company, you'll find your place here.

jobs.excerpt: At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all.
jobs.description:
At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day:“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”That question drives everything we do.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.

Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.

Position Summary

The Account Executive – MI Clarity is responsible for driving awareness, adoption, and utilization of MI Clarity, an AI-powered prognostic assay designed to assess both early and late distant recurrence risk in postmenopausal patients with HR-positive/HER2-negative, node-negative early-stage breast cancer.

The Account Executive will partner with oncologists, breast surgeons, pathologists, nurse navigators, and healthcare systems to educate stakeholders on the clinical value of the test, integrate the assay into clinical workflows, and increase appropriate utilization.

This role requires a strong understanding of oncology, breast cancer treatment pathways, molecular diagnostics, and value-based clinical conversations. Success is measured through account engagement, clinician adoption, testing utilization, and long-term strategic growth.

Job Responsibilities

  • Educate healthcare providers and care teams on the clinical utility, prognostic value, and evidence supporting MI Clarity, including its ability to identify both early and late distant recurrence risk in eligible breast cancer patients.

  • Present clinical data, validation studies, and evidence-based insights, while explaining the differentiation of AI-driven pathology analysis from traditional genomic and molecular assays.

  • Conduct in-person and virtual educational programs and lead consultative, evidence-based discussions on risk stratification, treatment planning, extended endocrine therapy considerations, and opportunities to reduce overtreatment and undertreatment.

  • Position MI Clarity as a clinical decision-support tool that optimizes patient care, addressing questions related to assay performance, patient selection, workflow integration, turnaround time, and clinical interpretation.

  • Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to drive awareness, adoption, and utilization of MI Clarity.

  • Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including medical oncologists, breast surgeons, pathologists, advanced practice providers, nurse navigators, health system administrators, and other clinical decision-makers.

  • Identify and engage key opinion leaders, decision-makers, and clinical champions within target accounts to support adoption and long-term utilization.

  • Support implementation of testing workflows and operational integration within healthcare systems and clinical practices.

  • Analyze territory and account performance data to identify growth opportunities, monitor utilization and adoption trends, and develop targeted engagement strategies.

  • Maintain accurate CRM documentation, forecasting, and account activity records.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Marketing, Operations, Customer Support, and other internal teams to support customer success and business objectives.

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in compliance with company policies, healthcare regulations, and industry standards, maintaining accurate, balanced, and approved clinical and promotional communications.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; life sciences or healthcare-related field preferred.

  • 3+ years of successful sales experience in one or more of the following: Oncology, Diagnostics, Molecular Testing, Pathology, Medical Device, Pharmaceutical sales

  • Strong understanding of breast cancer treatment pathways and oncology terminology.

  • Proven ability to build relationships with healthcare providers and health systems.

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and consultative selling skills.

  • Ability to interpret and communicate clinical data.

  • Ability to travel within assigned territory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling oncology diagnostics or precision medicine solutions.

  • Existing relationships within oncology or breast centers.

  • Experience launching new products or assays.

  • Familiarity with pathology workflows and digital pathology.

  • Knowledge of prognostic and predictive breast cancer assays.

  • Provider engagement and educational activity

  • Successful workflow implementation within target accounts

  • Territory growth and market penetration

  • CRM accuracy and activity execution

Physical Demands

  • Ability to sit or stand for extended periods.

  • Ability to lift routine office materials.

Additional Information

  • Travel required, including possible evenings, weekends, or holidays.

Conditions of Employment: Individual must successfully complete pre-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification.

This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time.

Job details

Job Location: Remote (ONLY Romania)

Effort Schedule: 8 Hours/Day

Contract: B2B

Business Hours: EET Timeframe

Language: English

Client Facing Role: Yes

Project Team Size: +10 members

Methodology: Agile/Scrum

Travel Required: No

About the Role

We are looking for a Data Analyst – Data Lake to support data analysis, data preparation and analytical modelling activities within an enterprise Data Lake environment in the automotive industry.

The role involves analysing data from operational systems and the Data Lake, supporting data ingestion and transformation, developing analytical models, and preparing datasets and dashboards to address business needs.

The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills with practical technical knowledge of SQL, Python and data platforms, working with business stakeholders, architects and analytics teams to deliver reliable, well-documented and validated data outputs.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse data from operational systems and the Data Lake to address business requirements and identify relevant insights.
  • Prepare, transform and validate data using SQL, Python, R, Scala and other appropriate technologies.
  • Design and maintain data preparation workflows and analytical processes using Dataiku.
  • Support physical or virtual data ingestion into the Data Lake, including source identification, transformation rules, validation and ingestion controls.
  • Develop analytical models aligned with business needs and document the underlying variables, business rules, assumptions and limitations.
  • Perform ad hoc and exploratory data analyses using appropriate analytical and statistical methodologies.
  • Develop dashboards or provide technical and functional specifications to support their implementation, using relevant BI tools.
  • Define and validate business indicators, calculation rules, data sources and reconciliation criteria.
  • Contribute to data quality assurance by validating datasets, identifying inconsistencies and supporting the investigation and remediation of data issues.
  • Perform manual functional testing and document test scenarios, results and identified non-conformities.
  • Maintain technical and functional documentation, ensuring traceability of data sources, transformations, analyses and validation results.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects and analytics teams to clarify requirements and ensure that delivered data outputs meet business expectations.
  • Monitor the quality and consistency of deliverables, identify risks or dependencies, and support corrective actions where required.
  • Work within an Agile delivery environment, using tools such as Jira, Confluence and Xray to support documentation, testing and traceability.
  • Follow applicable data governance, security, confidentiality and data protection requirements.

Requirements

  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in data analysis or a related data-focused role.
  • Good knowledge of SQL and experience using Python and/or Scala for data analysis and processing.
  • Understanding of statistical methodologies and practical data analysis techniques.
  • Experience working with data ingestion, data transformation and analytical modelling.
  • Experience with at least one BI or dashboarding tool, such as Looker, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), Tableau, QlikView or Qlik Sense.
  • General knowledge of cloud data platforms and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including relevant services such as BigQuery, Airflow and DataProc.
  • Understanding of database concepts, data structures and data modelling principles.
  • General knowledge of servers, operating systems, databases and networks.
  • Experience with functional testing, data validation and documenting test results.
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working and tools such as Jira, Confluence and Xray.
  • Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Intermediate English proficiency or higher.

Technologies

  • Data Analysis: SQL, Python, R and/or Scala
  • Data Preparation & Workflows: Dataiku
  • Cloud & Data Platforms: GCP, BigQuery, Airflow, DataProc and relevant AI services
  • BI & Visualization: Looker, SAP Analytics Cloud, Tableau, QlikView or Qlik Sense
  • Version Control: Git
  • Delivery & Testing Tools: Jira, Confluence and Xray

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically skilled and analytical professional who can work across data preparation, analysis, ingestion and modelling activities, while ensuring that the resulting datasets and analytical outputs are accurate, traceable and aligned with business requirements.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on data analysis capabilities with an understanding of Data Lake environments, data quality, documentation and collaboration across business and technical teams.

At Cigna Global Health Benefits (GHB), we help globally mobile populations access high-quality healthcare wherever life and work take them. As a Business Communications Lead Analyst, you will play a key role in advancing business priorities through strategic communications that inform, engage, and inspire stakeholders across a global organization.


This role combines communications expertise, project leadership, and business acumen to help executives senior leaders and teams connect employees to the organization's goals, priorities, and achievements. You will partner across functions to develop compelling content, manage communications plans and programs, and deliver insights that drive engagement, awareness, and business outcomes. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are energized by working with leaders across a global enterprise, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact.


Responsibilities

  • Support the development and execution of integrated communication strategies that align employees and stakeholders with GHB business priorities and objectives.
  • Drive the creation and delivery of high-impact communications across multiple internal and external channels, including digital, print, executive presentations, organizational announcements, and leadership messaging.
  • Manage communications plans, timelines, budgets, and workflows to ensure initiatives are delivered on time and with measurable results.
  • Produce reports, dashboards, and analyses that provide insights into communication effectiveness, stakeholder engagement, and key performance indicators.
  • Partner with business leaders and functional teams to translate complex information into clear, engaging, and actionable communications.
  • Lead or support the development of executive thought leadership content that strengthens leadership visibility and reinforces strategic priorities.
  • Coordinate content review, approvals, quality assurance, and distribution processes to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with brand standards.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to understand stakeholder needs and identify opportunities to improve communication effectiveness and employee engagement.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying new approaches, tools, and communication strategies that enhance business results.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in communications, corporate communications, public relations, employee communications, or related fields.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and evaluating communication strategies within a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including business writing, editing, and presentation development.
  • Proven ability to build relationships, influence stakeholders, and collaborate effectively across teams and leadership levels.
  • Experience working directly with senior executives and business leaders.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to leverage data and insights to measure communication effectiveness and inform decisions.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and other business communication tools.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting global organizations or international business communications.
  • Knowledge of executive communications, thought leadership, media relations, or social media strategy.
  • Experience in the healthcare, insurance, or health services industry.
  • Familiarity with employee engagement, change management, or internal communications programs.

If you will be working at home occasionally or permanently, the internet connection must be obtained through a cable broadband or fiber optic internet service provider with speeds of at least 10Mbps download/5Mbps upload.

About Cigna Healthcare

Cigna Healthcare, a division of The Cigna Group, is an advocate for better health through every stage of life. We guide our customers through the health care system, empowering them with the information and insight they need to make the best choices for improving their health and vitality. Join us in driving growth and improving lives.

jobs.excerpt: Reporting to a Technical Support Supervisor, the Technical Support Specialist will act as a critical resource for Control4 customers in the custom electronics industry.
jobs.description:
Reporting to a Technical Support Supervisor, the Technical Support Specialist will act as a critical resource for Control4 customers in the custom electronics industry. This role requires deep technical knowledge, advanced problem-solving abilities, and expertise in supporting a wide array of products and technologies in the smart and connected ecosystem. The Control4 Technical Support Specialist will handle technical inquiries, installation guidance, troubleshooting, configuration support, and service needs for Control4 in addition to a vast portfolio of 100+ brands and solutions, which requires commitment and ownership beyond the level of a traditional technical support role.

This role is suited for an individual with a minimum of 2 years of Control4 installation and programming experience who is passionate about emerging technologies, eager to tackle challenges, and capable of quickly adapting to new tools and platforms. The Control4 Tech Support Specialist will excel at navigating complex issues, providing creative and effective solutions, and empowering our fellow professionals with the knowledge and confidence to succeed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical resource for Control4 customers, delivering expert-level support for installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and return processing needs.
  • Providing basic support for 80+ third-party brands with limited or no formal training.
  • Provide Tier-1 support for ADI and Snap One’s 20+ exclusive brands and solutions.
  • Manage and resolve complex technical issues spanning a diverse range of products, brands, and categories, including but not limited to: Audio/video distribution (analog, digital, IP), home theater systems, commercial audio (70V, DSPs, mixers), TVs and displays, digital signage, music streaming, surveillance and security systems, HVAC and lighting control, home automation, video conferencing, power management, structured wiring, custom mounts, and more.
  • Aid in the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, including detailed troubleshooting guides, configuration procedures, and knowledge base articles to support internal teams and external customers.
  • Process product returns efficiently while ensuring adherence to technical verification protocols.
  • Participate in beta testing of new products and solutions, providing actionable feedback to product teams.
  • Actively contribute to team training initiatives by sharing insights and techniques to enhance team performance.

YOU MUST HAVE:

  • 2+ years of professional experience installing and/or programming Control4 products.
  • Hands-on experience installing, configuring, and troubleshooting surveillance, professional audio video, and other technology solutions.
  • Experience troubleshooting across multiple product categories and technologies.
  • Experience with IoT, audio/video, networking, home automation, and surveillance technologies.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to learn and apply new technical concepts quickly.
  • Exceptional English communication skills, both verbal and written, with a customer-first mindset.

WE VALUE:

  • Control4 Automation Programmer certification or Control4 Certified Technician certification.
  • Advanced networking knowledge, including VLANs, firewalls, managed switches, and enterprise wireless setups.
  • Experience with ADI’s proprietary exclusive-brand products and platforms: OvrC, Luma, Binary, WattBox, Clare, and others.
  • Experience in commercial and residential audio/video systems, including DSPs, projectors, and streaming solutions.
  • Experience with professional specialized technology systems such as motorized window treatments, centralized lighting, and power management solutions.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
  • Collaborative work environment with access to cutting-edge technology.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, PV Energy & Performance Engineering
jobs.excerpt: Join the Origis Energy Team! Origis Energy is accelerating the transition to a carbon-free future by Reimagining ZeroSM.
jobs.description:
Join the Origis Energy Team!

Origis Energy is accelerating the transition to a carbon-free future by Reimagining ZeroSM. As one of America’s leading renewable energy and decarbonization solution platforms, the company continues to expand and reimagine its contribution to the world’s net-zero goals. Origis Energy puts customers first to deploy a wide range of sustainable solutions for grid power generation, performance optimization, and long-term operation of solar and energy storage plants across the U.S. Founded in 2008, Origis Energy is headquartered in Miami, FL.

The Origis team,regarded as one of the leading developers in the U.S., is committed to living five core values in all interactions both with each other and external stakeholders:

Solve for Tomorrow. A role with Origis Energy puts you at the forefront of the transition to clean energy. Are you ready to bring new ideas? Do you exist to find solutions? That’s how we revolutionize energy and build a carbon-free future - through unmatched service and relentless innovation.

Rise Together. To succeed here, you’ll collaborate with others and work as one team, across various teams includingsolar and energy storage development, financing, engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) and operations, maintenance and asset management. Are you open to diverse perspectives and prepared to work seamlessly across disciplines to reach our collective goals?

Perform at Peak. We’re seeking team members who bring authentic energy and passion to every task. How can you use your natural strengths, genuine optimism and intelligence to make your greatest contributions to Origis?

Inspire & Grow. The Origis team is comprised of knowledgeable, passionate solar and energy storage experts who bring deep expertise and solution-driven thinking to clients. A successful Origis team member encourages others and sets a high bar for growth. We have a culture of continuous improvement because each team member takes the role of both learner and mentor.

Be Resilient. The spirit in which we tackle the energy challenges and objectives of our clients means we consistently stretch for the extra mile. We all take initiative and remain adaptable, overcoming obstacles by prioritizing respect.

Position Description
Origis is seeking a Senior Manager PV Energy & Performance Engineering whose primary responsibility will be modeling, analyzing, and optimizing plant performance for utility solar plus energy storage projects. This role combines deep technical rigor with real-world impact. You will collaborate closely with Business Development, Project Engineering, EPC, Asset Management, and Operations to deliver defensible energy performance assessments and engineering solutions that strengthen reliability, optimize generation, and support long-term project performance.

The Senior Manager PV Energy & Performance Engineering is a regular, full-time position, reporting to the Senior Director PV Performance & Technology, and is eligible for our generous employee benefits package, including employer paid health insurance, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching contributions, and other great benefits.

Key Responsibilities
• Management of PV production estimates for early to late-stage developments and proposals.
• PVsyst energy modeling, including terrain shade analysis, soiling and snow profiles, probability of exceedance analysis, and life cycle degradation projections.
• Work cross functionally to drive design optimization and identify project risks and mitigations.
• Collaborate with technical and procurement teams to efficiently model and assess equipment optionality.
• Conduct capacity testing, including exhibit review, test plan development, and implementation.
• Perform technical due diligence on PPA documentation and M&A activities to support contract negotiations.
• Contribute to process development and initiatives aimed at furthering modeling team capabilities and accuracy.
• Track and manage workflow of solar modeling team and proactively work with internal stakeholders to manage their expectations.
• Works across the organization and with IE’s and OE’s to achieve consensus in the target energy outputs for the solar and solar plus storage projects.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering, Physics, or equivalent.
• 4+ years of experience in solar energy modeling and optimization.
• Knowledge of data sources, system loss factors, and competency in modeling tools for utility scale PV System production assessments.
• Strong understanding of DC collection systems, plant design, and key drivers of solar asset performance.
• Experience with PVsyst a must; Python, PVLIB experience a plus.
• Demonstrated expertise conducting ASTM E2848 PV capacity and performance testing.
• Familiarity with battery energy storage system is a plus.

Key Attributes for Success
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills and time management skills.

• Superb attention to detail.

  • Ability to perform in a high-growth, fast-paced, collaborative work environment.
    • Team player; ability to work with multidisciplinary team.
    • Ability to work with all levels of management and various functional teams.
    • Strong organization, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
    • Proven ability to handle multiple projects and meet deadlines.
    • Versatility, flexibility, and willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm.
    • Good judgement with the ability to make timely and sound decisions.

Location Austin, TX or Remote for the right individual.
Travel Up to 20% travel required as necessary.
Job Level Senior Manager (Subject Matter Expert) - no direct reports

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Senior AWS Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $120,000–$170,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are seeking an experienced AWS Cloud Engineer to design, build, and operate large-scale, secure, and highly available cloud platforms on Amazon Web Services. This is a deeply hands-on engineering role spanning architecture, infrastructure-as-code, automation, security, observability, and continuous operational improvement of mission-critical production workloads. The successful candidate will bring strong working knowledge of the AWS service portfolio, deep DevOps fundamentals, and a pragmatic, cost-aware design mindset, and will partner with application, security, and SRE teams to deliver resilient, cloud-native solutions that scale with the business.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of cloud engineering experience, with at least three years focused on AWS in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS core services, including EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudFront, and CloudFormation.
  • Production-grade experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Solid experience designing and operating Amazon EKS or ECS clusters at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines across infrastructure and application workloads.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python and Bash, with familiarity in Go or PowerShell considered a plus.
  • Deep understanding of cloud security, IAM, encryption, key management, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience implementing observability, monitoring, and alerting in cloud-native environments.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional or DevOps Engineer – Professional certification.
  • Experience with multi-account AWS Organizations and centralized governance.
  • Familiarity with service mesh, eBPF-based observability, and zero-trust networking.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and well-architected cost-optimization frameworks.
  • Experience operating regulated workloads (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC 2, FedRAMP).

Autonomy comes early here: you'll make real judgment calls, own client relationships, and fix process gaps without getting queued behind approvals. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: OverviewVerantos () is the market leader in high-accuracy real-world evidence (RWE) generation.
jobs.description:
Overview

Verantos () is the market leader in high-accuracy real-world evidence (RWE) generation. The Verantos RWE platform integrates heterogeneous real-world data sources and generates evidence with the accuracy necessary for regulatory and reimbursement use. The platform leverages data science and artificial intelligence, along with advanced data sources such as electronic health records (EHR), to generate RWE capable of supporting complex clinical studies. Some of the largest biopharma companies in the world are Verantos customers.

We use a heterogeneous AWS-centric tech stack with data processing, AI, workflows, and analytics. Our teams are cross-functional and collaborative, bringing together engineering, product, design, QA, and clinical domain experts to deliver meaningful, real-world impact.

Description

We are building the Verantos Evidence Platform on AWS with Snowflake, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and a mix of containerized services. We need a Senior Platform Engineer who can take ownership of the platform's infrastructure, CI/CD, and developer experience. You'll be part of the Verantos Evidence Platform team and collaborate with DevOps teammates across the company.

This is a small, lean team where infrastructure decisions have an outsized impact on everyone's productivity. The role is as much organizational as it is technical: communicating changes before they land, getting buy-in, and building systems the whole team can operate independently.

This is a fully remote, US-based role.

Responsibilities

  • Simplify and maintain the CI/CD pipelines for a multi-project monorepo, ensuring they are predictable, fast, and operable by the broader engineering team without specialized knowledge.
  • Plan and execute infrastructure changes incrementally, with clear rollout steps, validation strategies, and rollback plans that are communicated to the team before work begins.
  • Build and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, monitoring, and alerting that enable other engineers to independently troubleshoot and respond to production issues.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teammates across the organization to align on shared infrastructure standards including network design, permissions models, and deployment patterns.
  • Contribute directly to application code in Python and Typescript when platform concerns cross into the application layer, such as database performance, service configuration, or integration points.
  • Partner with QA to ensure infrastructure changes are properly tested and that the team has confidence in what's being shipped to each environment.
  • Actively use and champion AI tools to accelerate infrastructure and developer experience work.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, or SRE, with meaningful time spent in environments where reliability and compliance matter.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, and container orchestration (ECS, EKS, or similar), including comfort with networking fundamentals like load balancing, TLS termination, and proxy configuration.
  • Solid Python skills and willingness to work across the stack when platform concerns extend into application code.
  • Has built and maintained CI/CD pipelines that other engineers actually trust, and has executed infrastructure changes incrementally rather than through high-risk big-bang rollouts.
  • Experience working in a small team where you had to balance speed, simplicity, and doing things right, rather than defaulting to enterprise-scale tooling.
  • Actively uses AI tools in daily work to accelerate delivery while maintaining high standards for security and code quality.
  • Communicates clearly and works effectively across engineering, QA, and compliance stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with healthcare data infrastructure or compliance frameworks such as HIPAA or HITRUST.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake administration and performance tuning in a platform that serves both transactional and analytical workloads.
  • Experience collaborating effectively across time zones and cultures in a fully remote environment.

Why Verantos?

At Verantos, we are pioneering technologies that power advanced real-world evidence (RWE). Advanced RWE helps understand how patient characteristics and behaviors affect health outcomes – helping to predict the progression of a disease, a patient’s responses to a therapy, or the risk of adverse events. Come and join a team at the intersection of cutting-edge technology, complex data, and healthcare research. We offer:

  • Flexible work location to support employees in the new pandemic-shaped reality.
  • Medical, dental, vision benefits.
  • 401K plan with employer match.
  • Work-life balance.
  • Opportunity to work with healthcare technology visionaries.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $180,000–$220,000, plus benefits.

PLEASE NOTE:Open to remote candidates; however, occasional travel to Charlotte may be required.

The Position

As LendingTree's Utah Lending Manager, you will be an addition to the legal department supporting the business licensing function.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Maintain the Utah Lending Manager license.
  • Complete the required annual Continuing Education.
  • Maintain communication with the legal department.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must be at least 18 years of age or older.
  • The applicant has never had a loan originator license revoked in any governmental jurisdiction.
  • Must not have been convicted of, or pled guilty or nolo contendere to, a felony in a domestic, foreign, or military court--
    • During the 7-year period preceding the date of the application for licensing and registration; or
    • At any time preceding such date of application, if such felony involved an act of fraud, dishonesty, or a breach of trust, or money laundering.
  • Must demonstrate financial responsibility, character, and general fitness to determine that the loan originator will operate honestly, fairly, and efficiently within the purposes of this title.
  • Holds an active Mortgage Loan Originator license.
  • Within the past 5 years, must have at least 3 years active full time licensed lending experience and a minimum of 45 first lien residential mortgages.

Why Join Us

By joining our team, you’ll have the unique opportunity to work in a dynamic fintech environment, collaborating with talented professionals while playing a pivotal role in ensuring compliance excellence. If you’re passionate about combining regulatory expertise with creative problem-solving and enjoy working in a fast-paced innovation-driven industry, this position is for you.

ABOUT LENDINGTREE

LendingTree is the nation’s leading online lending marketplace. We connect consumers with multiple lenders so they can easily compare options and find the right fit — from mortgages and personal loans to credit, savings, and insurance products.

Our founder, Doug Lebda, started LendingTree in 1996 after his own frustrating house-hunting experience. What began as a simple idea to make loan shopping easier has grown into a platform that empowers millions of people to make smarter financial decisions every day.

What else you should know:

  • We’re a publicly traded company (NASDAQ: TREE).
  • We’ve welcomed several other companies into the LendingTree family to expand our reach and capabilities.
  • We’ve built the LendingTree app and My LendingTree dashboard to give consumers tools to manage and monitor their financial health.
  • We’re also committed to giving back — through philanthropic programs, volunteer opportunities, and partnerships that strengthen the communities where we live and work.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision insurance, 401(k) matching, life insurance, pet insurance

Compensation: $15/hr DOE

OUR CULTURE

We’re a collaborative, entrepreneurial team that values curiosity, creativity, and getting things done together. Our teammates are some of the brightest, most driven people you’ll meet — and we celebrate innovation, inclusion, and ownership. jobs.title: Senior AI Research Scientist (Model-based RL)
jobs.excerpt: About PhaidraPhaidra is building the future of industrial automation.
jobs.description:
About Phaidra

Phaidra is building the future of industrial automation.

The world today is filled with static, monolithic infrastructure. Factories, power plants, buildings, etc. operate the same they've operated for decades — because the controls programming is hard-coded. Thousands of lines of rules and heuristics that define how the machines interact with each other. The result of all this hard-coding is that facilities are frozen in time, unable to adapt to their environment while their performance slowly degrades.

Phaidra creates AI-powered control systems for the industrial sector, enabling industrial facilities to automatically learn and improve over time. Specifically:

  • We use reinforcement learning algorithms to provide this intelligence, converting raw sensor data into high-value actions and decisions.
  • We focus on industrial applications, which tend to be well-sensorized with measurable KPIs — perfect for reinforcement learning.
  • We enable domain experts (our users) to configure the AI control systems (i.e. agents) without writing code. They define what they want their AI agents to do, and we do it for them.

Our team has a track record of applying AI to some of the toughest problems. From achieving superhuman performance with DeepMind's AlphaGo, to reducing the energy required to cool Google's Data Centers by 40%, we deeply understand AI and how to apply it in production for massive impact.

Phaidra’s ability to achieve its mission is determined by our ability to work together — as defined by our core values: Agency,Velocity, Craft, and Truth. We seek individuals who embody these values, as they are instrumental in ensuring our team consistently delivers excellence and fosters an engaging and supportive culture

Phaidra is based in the USA, but we are 100% remote with no physical office. We hire employees internationally with the help of our partner, OysterHR. Our team is currently located throughout the USA, Canada, UK, Sweden, Spain, Portugal, the Netherlands, Singapore, Australia, and India.

Who You Are

Research Scientists at Phaidra lead our efforts in developing novel algorithmic architecture towards the end goal of bringing intelligent control systems to industrial sector.

Having pioneered research in the world's leading academic and industrial labs as PhDs, post-docs or professors, Research Scientists join Phaidra to work collaboratively within and across research fields.

Drawing on expertise from a variety of disciplines including model-based reinforcement learning, planning and optimal control, deep learning, world models, and safe reinforcement learning, our Research Scientists are at the forefront of groundbreaking research and applying it to real-world industrial control systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evaluate model-based reinforcement learning agents — including planning-based controllers (MPC, MPPI) — and the software prototypes needed to deploy them on real industrial control systems.
  • Develop learned dynamics and world models (learned surrogates) that generalize across systems, including the training pipelines — pretraining, curriculum learning, active/adversarial learning, and fine-tuning — needed to make them reliable for planning and control.
  • Research and implement methods for e.g. safe RL, constrained control, scenario planning and Bayesian RL, to develop agents that satisfy safety constraints during deployment.
  • Report and present research findings and developments including status and results clearly and efficiently both internally and externally, verbally and in writing.
  • Participate in and organize ambitious collaborative research projects, and work with external collaborators and partners to translate research into production outcomes.
  • Mentor and guide Research Engineers to apply research findings and developments to industrial domains.
  • Independently defines new research directions
  • Translates research into practical outcomes
  • Owns the development and rollout for an entire research area or large project

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in a technical field or equivalent practical experience, with a strong background in model-based reinforcement learning and demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following:
    • Planning algorithms
    • World models / learned dynamics surrogates
    • Reinforcement Learning and Deep Learning
    • Control Theory
    • Safe / constrained RL
  • Either:
    • 2+ years of research experience in academia or industry after PhD graduation.
    • 5+ years of research experience in academia or industry after Master’s graduation.
  • Extensive research in the fields of {ModelBased, ModelFree, Safe} RL and Control Theory, with particular depth in model-based methods.
  • Hands-on experience building and evaluating agents against simulators (e.g. differentiable simulators or world models) and closing the sim-to-real gap.
  • Alignment with Phaidra's values: Agency, Velocity, Craft, & Truth.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • PhD in machine learning, control, or a closely related field.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with model-based RL and planning agents applied to real-world dynamical or industrial systems.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including vectorized/differentiable simulators and scaling experiments on distributed compute (e.g. Ray, Kubernetes, GCP).
  • A proven track record of publications in RL, control, or a related area.
  • A real passion for AI and applying it to industrial systems to improve resource efficiency.

Our Stack

  • Python
  • PyTorch, scipy
  • Kubernetes, Docker, Ray
  • GCP

Onboarding

In your first 30 days...

  • You will be immersed in an onboarding program that introduces you to Phaidra and our product.
  • You will spend time in the research team and get introduced to the different tracks of research that we perform.
  • You will learn how other teams operate, interact, and approach problems.
  • You will read various parts of our handbook and familiarize yourself with the documentation culture at Phaidra.
  • You will set up your development environment and get introduced to various parts of our code base.

By your first 60 days...

  • You will have a solid understanding of what Phaidra does and how we do it.
  • You will have met with team members across Phaidra and started building relationships that will help you be successful at your job.
  • You will have a good understanding of our research tracks, which allowed you to form a plan for your first project, or maybe, you have already started one.

By your first 90 days...

  • You will have been fully integrated in the team and with team members across the company.
  • You will have started to contribute to knowledge sharing throughout Phaidra.
  • Your project is in full swing and you might have some early results already.

General Interview Process

All of our interviews are held via Google Meet, and an active camera connection is required.

  1. Meeting with People Operations team member (30 minutes)
  2. Meeting with Hiring Manager (30 minutes)
  3. Technical Conversation with Research team member (60 minutes)
  4. Technical Conversation with Hiring Manager (60 minutes)
  5. Culture fit interview with Phaidra’s co-founders (30 minutes)

Base Salary

UK Residents:
  • Tier 1 (London): 96,159 GBP - 132,219 GBP
  • Tier 2 (Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Bristol): 90,502 GBP - 124,441 GBP
  • Tier 3 (Smaller cities / rural areas): 84,847 GBP - 116,664 GBP

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for equity. Final salary will be determined based on several factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, expertise, education and location. In some cases, final compensation may fall outside the posted range. Salary ranges are regularly reviewed and may be adjusted in response to market trends.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fast-paced, team-oriented environment where your work directly shapes the company’s direction.
  • We are a 100% remote company.
  • Competitive compensation & meaningful equity.
  • Outsized responsibilities & professional development.
  • Training is foundational; functional, customer immersion, and development training.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance (exact benefits vary by region).
  • Unlimited paid time off, with a required minimum of 20 days per year.
  • Paid parental leave (exact benefits vary by region).
  • Flexible stipends to support your workspace, well-being, and continued professional development.
  • Company MacBook.

Please note: Not all of Phaidra’s benefits and perks listed above apply to temporary employees such as interns.

On being Remote

We take a thoughtful and intentional approach to remote collaboration. Inspired by pioneers like GitLab, we embrace proven best practices to foster an exceptional remote work environment. Our culture is documentation-first, and we prioritize asynchronous communication to support focus and flexibility across time zones. While we value independence, we stay closely connected through tools like Slack and video conferencing. Weekly all-hands meetings help us align and build strong relationships, and we regularly host virtual team-building activities and social events to maintain a sense of camaraderie.

Equal Opportunity Employment

Phaidra is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Phaidra is governed on the basis of merit, competence, and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status. We welcome diversity and strive to maintain an inclusive environment for all employees. If you need assistance with completing the application process, please contact us at .

jobs.description:
Overview

Company Overview:

Elevate your security career with Allied Universal® Enhanced Protection Services, a global leader in security and threat mitigation. We specialize in risk consulting, executive protection, intelligence, investigations, and emergency response, offering exciting career opportunities for professionals passionate about security and safety. Join our innovative team committed to excellence in the security industry and make a meaningful impact. Explore key roles, such as executive protection agents, intelligence analysts, armed security operatives, x-ray screeners, and security consultants.

Job Description

Logistics and Supply Chain Intelligence Analyst

Location: RemoteAnnual Salary: $95,000Experience Level: Mid-Senior LevelEmployment Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Logistics and Supply Chain Intelligence Analyst to identify, assess, and communicate risks that may affect global logistics operations, transportation networks, shipments, and critical facilities.

This role is responsible for monitoring risk intelligence platforms, analyzing operational and external data, identifying emerging threats, and producing actionable intelligence to support timely decision-making and supply chain resilience. The successful candidate will translate complex, fragmented information into clear risk assessments, operational recommendations, and executive-ready reporting.

The ideal candidate combines experience in intelligence analysis, supply chain risk, transportation operations, or corporate security with strong communication skills, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-tempo environment.

The analyst will collaborate closely with logistics, transportation, procurement, operations, security, Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and crisis-management stakeholders. Experience using AI-enabled analytical tools to improve research, reporting, and workflow efficiency is highly desirable.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Monitor risk intelligence platforms, including Everstream and Cargo Signal, to identify threats, disruptions, and anomalies affecting shipments, transportation lanes, ports, terminals, carrier networks, distribution nodes, and facilities.
  • Identify and escalate high-impact events that could affect service continuity, shipment integrity, facility operations, carrier performance, or customer commitments.
  • Analyze information from security audits, incident reports, carrier scorecards, operational dashboards, exception data, and vendor intelligence to identify trends, vulnerabilities, and systemic risks.
  • Assess transportation and supply chain threats, including severe weather, natural disasters, cargo theft, civil unrest, labor actions, port congestion, infrastructure disruptions, geopolitical developments, cyber-related operational impacts, and carrier instability.
  • Produce timely, accurate, and actionable intelligence products for logistics, operations, security, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Manage the intelligence cycle, including information collection, collation, evaluation, analysis, production, dissemination, and feedback.
  • Develop dashboards, recurring reports, executive summaries, and risk indicators that communicate shipment exposure, facility vulnerabilities, disruption trends, and mitigation priorities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners to maintain shared situational awareness and support coordinated risk-management decisions.
  • Support incident response and disruption management through concise intelligence updates, escalation notes, and operational impact assessments.
  • Develop transportation lane, logistics node, and facility-specific threat assessments to support routing decisions, seasonal risk reviews, operational planning, and business continuity.
  • Identify opportunities to improve alert triage, analytical workflows, reporting standards, data synthesis, and supply chain risk intelligence processes.
  • Maintain high standards of analytical quality through source validation, peer review, critical evaluation, and clear communication of assumptions, confidence levels, and potential operational impacts.
  • Apply approved AI-enabled tools, including generative AI and agentic systems, to improve research, information synthesis, drafting, and workflow efficiency while maintaining human oversight, validation, and appropriate data-handling practices.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders in a fast-paced, embedded operating environment, building trusted relationships and delivering actionable insights under tight deadlines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in intelligence, supply chain management, logistics, transportation, security studies, business analytics, international affairs, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in intelligence analysis, logistics analysis, supply chain risk, transportation operations, GSOC, corporate security, military intelligence, customs, law enforcement, commercial intelligence, or a closely related analytical discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing risks affecting shipments, transportation lanes, facilities, distribution networks, or broader supply chain operations.
  • Experience synthesizing multiple operational and external information sources into actionable analysis, disruption reporting, and decision support.
  • Experience collaborating with stakeholders across logistics, operations, security, transportation, or related business functions.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and time-sensitive escalations in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong research, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to synthesize fragmented information into clear judgments and practical recommendations.
  • Working knowledge of supply chain and logistics operations, including shipment visibility, transportation lanes, distribution nodes, facilities, route disruptions, carrier performance, exception management, and service risk.
  • Ability to monitor and interpret intelligence from platforms such as Everstream, Cargo Signal, and comparable risk-visibility, shipment-tracking, and event-monitoring tools.
  • Experience analyzing incident reports, security audits, vendor intelligence, carrier performance metrics, and operational dashboards to identify patterns and emerging risks.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to brief operational teams and senior leadership.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, spreadsheets, reporting tools, presentations, and data visualization or dashboard-support workflows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Sound professional judgment, discretion, and the ability to communicate and escalate material risks promptly.
  • Understanding of AI-enabled analytical tools, including the capabilities and limitations of large language models, the importance of source verification, human review, and the responsible handling of sensitive or proprietary information.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with the following experience or attributes will receive additional consideration:

  • Experience as an embedded analyst supporting a corporate headquarters, logistics function, operations center, or corporate security program.
  • Experience supporting headquarters-based or client-facing operations, with the ability to work closely with stakeholders and maintain strong day-to-day working relationships.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication and collaborative problem-solving skills suited to a fast-paced, stakeholder-intensive environment.
  • Experience using multiple large language models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, summarization, and analytical deliverable development.
  • Familiarity with generative AI and agentic workflows, including the ability to identify appropriate use cases and recognize limitations in accuracy, context, reasoning, and information synthesis.
  • Experience with AI-enhanced tool development, low-code experimentation, workflow prototyping, or “vibe coding” to improve internal processes or augment existing tools.
  • Experience in a fusion center, GSOC, transportation security, customs, supply chain security, or commercial risk intelligence environment.
  • International experience and demonstrated cultural awareness and sensitivity.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

  • Remote work environment, with routine computer use, telephone or radio communications, virtual meetings, and participation in briefings.
  • Work primarily involves sitting and working at a computer, with occasional standing and walking.
  • Minimal physical exertion is expected, with limited or no routine exposure to extreme temperatures.
  • Must be able to submit to drug screening to the extent permitted by applicable law.
  • Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit a current resume highlighting relevant experience in intelligence analysis, logistics and supply chain risk, transportation operations, corporate security, and analytical reporting. Applicants should also describe any relevant experience with risk intelligence platforms, AI-enabled analytical tools, and cross-functional operational support.

We look forward to connecting with candidates who can deliver timely, accurate, and actionable intelligence to strengthen supply chain resilience and support informed operational decision-making.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com

If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

In this role, you will take direct responsibility for taking recurring administrative, financial, and operational tasks off the Directors' desks. From managing billing and financial reporting to conducting market research and scheduling business development meetings, you will act as a trusted executor who ensures the firm's core operational engine runs smoothly without needing constant chasing.

Financial & Billing Operations

Business Development & Operational Support

  • Outbound Outreach & Research: Research local UK estate agents, mortgage brokers, and property professionals, make confident initial telephone contact, and arrange meetings as needed
  • Schedule & Priority Management: Manage the Directors' calendars, coordinate appointments, take comprehensive meeting notes, and follow up on action items.
  • Process Execution: Execute recurring administrative routines, set up digital filing systems, and keep internal business operations organise.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Executive / Operations Support Background: Proven experience as a Directors' Assistant, Operations Assistant, or Executive Assistant directly supporting busy business owners, founders, or senior leadership.
  • Commercial & Numerical Aptitude: Strong proficiency with numbers, financial reporting, invoicing, and basic bookkeeping/data analysis.
  • Confident Outreach Skills: Comfortable picking up the phone to conduct research, engage third parties, and book meetings without requiring a hard sales background.
  • Unscripted & Professional Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English with an articulate, natural tone suited for UK business interactions.

  • High Accountability & Judgment: Self-motivated and proactive, with the sound judgment to work independently while knowing precisely when to escalate critical financial or legal queries.

Working Arrangements

  • Setup: Full-time (40 hours per week), dedicated remote position based in South Africa or the Philippines
  • Hours: Strict alignment with UK business hours to provide real-time operational support to the Managing Directors.

What Success Looks Like

The two Directors are completely freed from routine billing, reporting, and administrative chasing; business development meetings with local UK estate agents are booked consistently; financial reporting is executed with 100% accuracy; and the Directors save significant hours each week, allowing them to focus on firm growth and family life.

QUALIFICATIONS

Master’s degree preferred.

Experience


Six (6) + years of software engineering experience, with at least three (3) years shipping production Generative AI agents, workflows, or applications — including evaluation, failure handling, and a human review loop — or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Hands-on experience building and operating production workloads on AWS required. Cloud certification without production ownership is not sufficient.

Hands-on experience with Python, React, GitHub Actions, and Terraform required, including ownership of CI/CD and infrastructure rather than editing templates.

Experience embedding with business users or a vendor delivery team to co-develop, rather than receiving a completed specification, preferred.

Experience in insurance, claims, healthcare, or another heavily regulated operational domain preferred.


Skills & Knowledge

jobs.title: Human Centered Design Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

JerseySTEM is a nonprofit organization dedicated to providing STEM education to underserved communities across New Jersey. We currently serve 27 schools and are growing. Our small but mighty team of volunteers keeps operations running and we need your help.

Our current Expense Reimbursement Processor is stepping down at the end of June 2025. This role is intentionally scoped to payment processing only; it does not involve approving expenses or managing our books so that we have appropriate internal financial controls.
