  • Process monthly invoices from recurring vendors (e.g., background checks, classroom materials)
  • Flag any unusual, unapproved, or duplicate submissions to the Finance Lead before processing
  • Maintain a simple payment log each month for reconciliation purposes

What You Won't Do

To maintain proper financial controls, this role does not include:

    • Approving expense reports (done by board members / department leads)
    • Accessing or managing the savings account
    • QuickBooks entry or tax-related work
    • Signing authority on the bank account (view + bill pay access only)

Qualifications

  • Organized and reliable because you'll own a monthly deadline
  • Comfortable with online banking and Google Sheets
  • Understanding of basic expense control concepts (approvals before payment)
  • Prior bookkeeping, accounts payable, or office administration experience is a plus
  • Nonprofit or small organization experience is a plus, but not required

    Your Impact

    Every check you process keeps a JerseySTEM instructor paid, a school program running, and a New Jersey student in a STEM classroom. Without this role, 20+ schools and hundreds of kids are at risk of losing their programs.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewKemin is seeking a strategic leader to advance our Animal Nutrition and Health Technical Services function, driving the development of technical capabilities that strengthen commercial growth, enhance scientific credibility, and deliver meaningful customer value.
jobs.description:
Overview

Kemin is seeking a strategic leader to advance our Animal Nutrition and Health Technical Services function, driving the development of technical capabilities that strengthen commercial growth, enhance scientific credibility, and deliver meaningful customer value. This role will lead the strategy and execution of large-animal research, field validation programs, and technical knowledge development, positioning Kemin as an industry leader in applied science, product performance, and technical education.

The ideal candidate is a business-minded technical leader who views Technical Services as a key driver of growth, leveraging credible, differentiated science to generate data that supports product claims, accelerates sales, and creates customer value. They will have a proven track record of building high-performing teams, improving sales effectiveness, increasing product adoption and retention, and establishing a clear link between technical investments and measurable commercial outcomes.

This is a remote-based position that requires up to 75% travel to support customers, research activities, and business initiatives.

Join the Kemin Team and Transform Lives!

We are a privately held, family-owned-and-operated global biotechnology company driven by curiosity and committed to transforming the quality of life for people, pets, and the planet.

We create solutions that strengthen health and wellbeing, provide nutrition and immune support for pets and production animals, safeguard the planet’s natural resources, and protect the global food supply chain for generations to come.

We supply over 500 specialty ingredients for various industries, including human and animal health and nutrition, pet food, aquaculture, nutraceutical, food technologies, crop technologies, textiles, biofuels, and animal vaccines.

We employ 3,500 global employees and operations in 90 countries, including manufacturing facilities in Belgium, Brazil, China, Egypt, India, Italy, San Marino, Singapore, South Africa, and the United States.

As a valued member of our team, you'll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your financial, physical, and professional well-being:

  • Competitive Financial Package: Enjoy a rewarding salary, uncapped bonus opportunities, a 401k match program, and generous paid vacation and holidays.
  • Health and Wellness Support: Stay fit and healthy with our fitness reimbursement for the whole family, access to an on-site fitness center, a restaurant offering seasonal fresh food options, and free fresh fruit in break areas.
  • Career Development and Advancement: Unlock your potential with opportunities for growth and development throughout your entire career.
  • Continued Learning Opportunities: Grow your skills with our in-house learning platforms, offering thousands of training resources both live and online, and take advantage of tuition reimbursement for external post-secondary pursuits.
  • Service Opportunities: Make a positive impact with paid time off for service, partnerships with The World Food Programme and Habitat for Humanity, and local community initiatives.

Responsibilities

Technical Services Function Leadership

  • Lead, develop, and scale the Technical Services organization across species and regions.
  • Define the vision, structure, and operating model for technical support aligned to commercial strategy.
  • Establish clear priorities, KPIs, and resource allocation for maximum business impact.
  • Recruit, develop, and coach technical talent to build a high-performing, credible field organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, scientific rigor, and customer-centric execution.

Technical Capability Development

  • Own and continuously enhance the organization’s technical expertise and competitive differentiation.
  • Standardize tools, methodologies, and training for consistent, high-quality technical delivery.
  • Ensure the team can effectively translate science → application → economic value.
  • Build advanced capabilities in:
    • Gut health / microbiome / fermentation
    • Production system optimization (beef, dairy, equine, etc.)
    • Data interpretation and ROI modeling

Large Animal Research & Trial Governance

  • Lead strategy and execution for large animal field research and validation trials.
  • Establish a robust pipeline of commercially relevant trials aligned to business priorities.
  • Define and enforce trial design standards, statistical rigor, and data integrity expectations.
  • Ensure compliance with animal welfare, regulatory, and internal research protocols.
  • Oversee external research partners (universities, contract research, key accounts).

Applied Science & Knowledge Creation

  • Drive development of research that advances industry understanding and supports product claims.
  • Translate study outcomes into practical application guidelines and differentiated positioning.
  • Publish, present, and disseminate findings to build technical credibility and thought leadership.
  • Ensure insights are captured and embedded into sales enablement and marketing narratives.

Commercial & Strategic Enablement

  • Act as a strategic partner to commercial leadership, aligning technical priorities to growth objectives.
  • Ensure technical efforts directly support:
    • Product adoption
    • Market expansion
    • Key account penetration
  • Guide development of technical value propositions and proof points.
  • Support high-impact customer engagements where technical credibility is critical.

Cross-Functional Influence

  • Represent the voice of the customer and field reality into R&D, product management, and marketing.
  • Shape innovation pipelines based on validated needs and performance gaps.
  • Partner with regulatory to ensure claims substantiation and compliant positioning.
  • Align closely with supply chain on product usability and application requirements.

External Engagement & Industry Leadership

  • Build relationships with key opinion leaders, universities, and industry organizations.
  • Position the company as a leader in applied nutrition and feed additive science.
  • Deliver technical presentations at industry events, customer meetings, and scientific forums.

Qualifications

  • Education and Experience:
    • PhD, DVM, or MS (PhD preferred) in Animal Science, Nutrition, Microbiology, or related field with 10–15+ years in animal nutrition/feed additives with progressive leadership responsibility
    • Proven experience leading field research, technical teams, and commercial enablement
  • Builds and scales high-impact technical organizations.
  • Drives alignment between science, strategy, and execution.
  • Influences cross-functional stakeholders at senior levels.
  • Deep expertise in applied nutrition and production systems.
  • Strong command of trial design, statistics, and data interpretation.
  • Ability to convert complex science into clear, actionable insights.
  • Connects technical activities to revenue growth and market differentiation.
  • Prioritizes resources based on business impact and ROI.
  • Anticipates industry trends and positions the organization accordingly.

This senior, hands-on role will translate business priorities into practical, scalable enablement that helps partner sellers confidently position solutions, engage customers and contribute to effective selling motions. About the Role

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. You will be the technical anchor for a team of Senior Engineers handling:

  1. AI: Architect and develop a multi-agent AI framework where autonomous agents coordinate to solve domain-specific technical queries.
  2. Backend: Ingesting massive sensor streams and running multi-agent AI systems.
  3. Data: Organizing tons of industrial data into a Medallion Architecture.
  4. Frontend: Building the "Control Room" and complex AI interfaces.
  5. DevOps: Deploying across hybrid cloud (AWS/Azure) and edge (K3s) environments.

Your challenge is to ensure these distinct pieces fit together. ensuring the backend model is consumable by the frontend’s "Visualizations" and that the "Data Pipelines" are reliably deployed by DevOps.

Job Duties

  • Technical Orchestration: You will drive cross-boundary architectural decisions. You will decide how the Backend serves live telemetry to Frontend dashboards and how Data Engineering pipelines feed the Knowledge Graph.
  • Code & Quality Standards: Enforce high standards across the stack. You will review API designs (FastAPI), ensure the Frontend maintains strict Component Architecture, and verify that Data pipelines implement appropriate quality gates.
  • The "Expert": When the DevOps engineer faces a connectivity issue between Cloud and On-Prem, or the Backend engineer struggles with concurrency in a distributed stream, you are the senior voice in the room, guiding the solution.
  • Team Leadership: Conduct code reviews, mentor senior developers, and translating high-level product requirements into technical tasks (ADO) for the squad.

Technology Stack

You do not need to be an expert in every single tool, but you must be able to discuss technical trade-offs across the entire stack:

  • Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI), Kafka, Neo4j, LangGraph.
  • Frontend: React, Angular 16+, TypeScript, RxJS, Plotly.js.
  • Data: Apache Airflow, Delta Lake, Polars/Spark.
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/K3s), Terraform, Hybrid Cloud

Desired Profile

  • The Architect-Implementer: You can draw the system architecture on a whiteboard, but you are not afraid to open an IDE to debug a failing pipeline or a slow query.
  • The Polyglot: You are likely a Backend or Full-Stack native, but you understand the complexity of Frontend state management (NgRx/Signals) and the constraints of Medallion Data Architectures.
  • Reliability Mindset: You understand that we are dealing with critical industrial environments. You prioritize testing, validation, and security.

Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Engineering, with at least 2+ years leading technical teams.
  • Deep proficiency in Python Backend Development.
  • Solid understanding of Frontend complexity (SPA architecture, async data loading).
  • Experience designing or managing Data Intensive Applications (understanding ETL, Streams, or Data Lakes).
  • Familiarity with DevOps/Cloud concepts (Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD).
  • Advanced English communication skills.

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Experience with Digital Twins, IoT, or Industrial Data.

  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.

Job Title:

Clinical Counselor: SUD and Mental Health

Who is Navita Health?

Navita Health is a next-generation behavioral health company committed to transforming the way people experience recovery from substance use disorder (SUD) and mental health challenges. Our name, meaning “new life,” is exactly what we aim to create for every person we serve.

Through compassionate care, real-time access, and innovative technology, we deliver a personalized, holistic, and coordinated support system. Whether it's through assessments, peer-led services, outpatient care, or digital tools, Navita Health offers an integrated platform that simplifies the path to healing and empowers individuals to rebuild their lives with confidence.

We don’t just treat symptoms—we restore hope, build sustainable resilience, and help people embrace a healthier future.

Position Summary:

Clinical Counselor is a part of the Assessment and Clinical Team. This is a W2, full time role. The Assessor is responsible for conducting Diagnostic Assessments and evaluations for individuals experiencing substance use and mental health concerns. This role involves utilizing clinical expertise to identify client needs, develop individualized treatment plans, and provide recommendations for appropriate care. The Assessor collaborates with a multidisciplinary team of clinicians, peer supporters, case managers, qualified mental health specialists and medical staff to ensure holistic, client-centered treatment approaches.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Diagnostic Assessment:
    Conduct in-depth clinical assessments to evaluate the nature and severity of substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders. Utilize structured interviews, evidence-based tools, and collateral information to inform diagnosis and care planning.
  • Diagnostic Evaluation:
    Apply current diagnostic criteria (e.g., DSM-5) to identify substance use disorders and co-occurring mental health conditions, ensuring clinical accuracy and compliance with professional standards.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in the ASAM Criteria (4th Edition) and level-of-care determination
  • Treatment Planning:
    Develop individualized treatment plans based on assessment outcomes, client history, and presenting needs. Collaborate with internal and external providers to create integrated care strategies.
    During quarterly treatment plan reviews, 1:1 counseling, assess client progress and current clinical diagnosis to determine the appropriate point for initiating discharge planning. Identify and document readiness for discharge, anticipated supports, and continued care needs to ensure a smooth transition from services.
  • Documentation and Compliance:
    Maintain timely, accurate, and confidential clinical documentation, including assessments, diagnostic impressions, treatment recommendations, and progress notes, in accordance with organizational, legal, and ethical guidelines. Report any necessary compliance concerns for all service lines to the Navita Health Quality Team. Efficiency with documentation and completion.
  • Client Counseling and Engagement:
    Provide 1-1 counseling through interventions, psychoeducation, and motivational support for clients during the assessment process. Support clients in understanding substance use, treatment options, and recovery pathways.
  • Referral and Coordination:
    Provide referrals to appropriate services including medical care, mental health treatment, detoxification, peer support, and community-based resources. Communicate effectively with care teams to support continuity of care.
  • Professional Development:
    Stay current on emerging trends, best practices, and regulatory changes in the fields of addiction counseling and behavioral health through ongoing education and training.

Qualifications:

  • Licensure:
    Active and unrestricted LICDC license as required by state regulations, in OH.
Active Co-occuring License, such as, LPC, LPCC, LIMFT, LISW, PsyD, PHD, or equivalent
  • Education:
    A Master’s degree or higher that meets the behavioral science degree requirements or Nursing degree from an accredited school or university. Master’s degree in nursing, counseling, psychology, social work, or a related behavioral health field.
  • Experience:
    Demonstrated experience in substance use and mental health assessment, diagnosis, and treatment planning preferred.
  • Preference given to those clinicians with experience working with Peer Supporters and/or Supervisory credential to oversee Peer Supporters (Peer Supervisor, LICDC-CS).
  • Knowledge and Skills:
    • Strong understanding of addiction, behavioral health disorders, and treatment modalities.
    • Proficiency in clinical documentation and diagnostic assessment tools.
    • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
    • Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • LICDC + Co-occurring license as a LPC, LPCC, LIMFT, LISW, PsyD, PHD

Working Conditions:

  • Contractor position, remote, work from home. Must be located in Ohio or MN
  • May require flexible scheduling to accommodate client needs, including occasional evenings or weekends.

Healthcare’s helping hand.

CHG shook things up in 1979 by inventing the locum tenens staffing model. We connect doctors with patients who need their care. As the largest physician staffing firm in America, our providers treat millions of patients each year.

Our industry is growing and demand is high. This means you’ll have plenty of opportunities to grow and develop in your career. Keeping healthcare healthy can be as fun as it is rewarding

CHG has gone to market with MSP (Managed Service Provider) as a new offering. There are currently two confirmed MSP clients, with additional prospects in active conversation. CHG has dedicated Account Management resources for MSP and needs someone focused specifically on MSP implementations as part of ECS Operations.


The Sr. Implementation Manager, MSP is the operational owner of an MSP client implementation once a contract is signed. This role blends client-facing work, management of internal stakeholders and staffing vendors and project management of specific, named client MSP implementations, and is responsible for ensuring each MSP implementation is executed successfully.


On the client side, this role is the point of contact credible enough to sit with executive-level client stakeholders for implementation purposes, similar to how the Account Manager owns the account relationship for other CHG offerings. This is not an Account Management role; client-facing scope is limited to gathering and executing on MSP and operational-workflow requirements with the client’s Health Care Organization (HCO) stakeholders, not the broader client relationship.


On the internal side, this role functions as a program manager. It is not focused on technology adoption, that is Locumsmart’s role; instead, this role directs internal CHG stakeholders and client stakeholders, on what needs to happen for each implementation and holds them accountable to the project plan.


This role sits within ECS Implementation, reporting to the Manager, ECS Implementation Team, parallel to existing Implementation Managers on the team. Travel is estimated at 25% or more, driven by client request and need. Depending on MSP client volume, this role may not be full-time to start; Operational Strategy project work will be supplemented as capacity allows.


Responsibilities

  • Own MSP implementations end to end once a contract is verbally agreed upon with client, coordinating across CHG divisions and Locumsmart leadership through kickoff and ongoing delivery
  • Partner with the client to create the implementation project plan and ensure proper execution
  • Report on milestones and program progress to stakeholders and executive leadership. Responsible for raising red flags if the implementation is off track or identifying wins to replicate success

jobs.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies

Certified as a Great Place to Work®

Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance

Principal Architect - AI

PRIMARY PURPOSE: The AI Principal Architecture within the Transformation Office serves as the enterprise executive accountable for AI architecture strategy, governance, and platform direction—driving large-scale business transformation through applied Generative AI, Agentic AI, and advanced intelligence capabilities. This role establishes and evolves the enterprise “intelligence layer” as a strategic capability, ensuring AI is delivered securely, ethically, and at scale across the organization’s Lines of Business, shared services, and core technology ecosystem.


Operating at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product/platform strategy, risk governance, and execution oversight, this leader defines the end-to-end architectural vision and operating model for LLM-powered platforms, agentic systems, and conversational/automation capabilities. The role influences enterprise prioritization and investment decisions, sets cross-functional standards, and ensures AI capabilities integrate effectively with legacy and modern environments across AWS and Azure, translating complex AI innovation into measurable business value and operational outcomes.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES


Enterprise AI Strategy, Governance & Executive Leadership

  • Owns and sets the enterprise Generative AI and Agentic AI architecture vision and multi-year roadmap, aligning to enterprise strategy, transformation priorities, operating model, and risk posture.
  • Chairs or co-leads executive architecture and AI governance forums (e.g., AI Architecture Review Board), establishing decision rights, design authorities, exception processes, and enterprise adoption guardrails.
  • Directs the enterprise “intelligence layer” strategy, defining reference architectures, standards, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that enable consistent, scalable AI adoption across the enterprise.

Agentic AI & Platform Architecture at Scale

  • Defines and governs the enterprise agentic AI strategy and platform blueprint, including design, deployment, and lifecycle management of autonomous and semi-autonomous agents using platforms such as AWS AgentCore and Azure AI Agent Service.
  • Establishes enterprise patterns for multi-agent orchestration, reasoning, tool-use, memory, human-in-the-loop controls, observability, fail-safes, and model/agent lifecycle management, ensuring scalable and auditable decision workflows.
  • Sets enterprise standards for GenAI and agentic solutions across AWS and Azure, ensuring reliability, resilience, performance, security, cost optimization, and regulatory compliance.

Enterprise RAG, Knowledge Architecture & Reuse

  • Owns the enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) strategy and common frameworks, defining best practices for retrieval strategies, embeddings, vector stores, context management, evaluation, and performance tuning.
  • Establishes enterprise standards for knowledge governance, including content provenance, permissions and access models, lineage, data quality, and safe/approved knowledge sources.

Integration, Modernization & Cross-Platform Enablement

  • Defines enterprise integration patterns that enable AI solutions to interface with legacy platforms (e.g., mainframes, SQL Server, on-prem systems) and modern cloud services, balancing modernization with resiliency and minimizing operational disruption.
  • Partners with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, and Platform teams to ensure the AI ecosystem is embedded within enterprise identity, networking, monitoring, disaster recovery, and service management capabilities.

Data, Ontologies, and AI-Ready Enterprise Foundations

  • Partners with data, analytics, and platform teams leveraging technologies such as Palantir, Databricks, and Snowflake to define shared enterprise data architectures, ontologies, governance models, and operating practices that enable AI, agentic workflows, and advanced analytics at scale.
  • Establishes standards for AI-ready data products, metadata, semantic layers, and measurable data quality thresholds tied to AI performance and outcomes.

Risk, Compliance, and Responsible AI Executive Accountability

  • Serves as the executive technical authority to security, risk, legal, compliance, and audit stakeholders—ensuring AI solutions align with model risk, privacy, security, regulatory requirements, and Responsible AI principles.
  • Establishes enterprise practices for model governance, evaluation, red teaming, bias mitigation, explainability, and controls, ensuring outputs are reliable, auditable, and aligned to business policy and ethical standards.

Portfolio, Value Realization & Operational Outcomes

  • Leads the AI architecture portfolio across the enterprise, prioritizing capabilities and investments based on business value, risk, feasibility, and reuse.
  • Defines success metrics and mechanisms to track value realization (e.g., productivity, cycle-time reduction, loss cost improvement, customer experience, quality, compliance outcomes).
  • Partners with Technology and Business leadership to ensure AI initiatives transition effectively into production operations with clear support, ownership, and continuous improvement mechanisms.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Builds and develops enterprise AI architecture talent, including coaching senior architects, establishing capability standards, and creating communities of practice across AI engineering and enterprise architecture.
  • Influences platform/tooling decisions, vendor strategy, and ecosystem partnerships to accelerate innovation while managing cost, risk, and long-term maintainability.
  • Represents the organization as a senior AI architecture leader in executive engagements, internal stakeholder communications, and cross-enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Travel as required.

QUALIFICATIONS


Education & Licensing

Master’s degree in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline from an accredited college or university preferred.


Experience

Ten (10+) years of related, progressive experience in in enterprise architecture, platform architecture, or large-scale solution architecture, with seven (7+) years leading delivery and/or architecture of enterprise-scale GenAI, RAG, and Agentic AI capabilities in complex corporate environments, or an equivalent combination of education and experience required.


Demonstrated executive-level expertise with AWS AgentCore and Azure AI Agent Service; deep mastery of agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) required.

Proven experience establishing enterprise AI governance, driving cross-LOB adoption, and operationalizing AI solutions within security, risk, and compliance constraints.


Skills & Knowledge

  • Enterprise leadership and influence: Ability to drive alignment and decision-making with executive stakeholders across Technology, Security, Risk, Legal/Compliance, and Lines of Business
  • Architectural authority: Expert ability to bridge Data Science, AI Engineering, and Enterprise Architecture—ensuring solutions are statistically sound, governed, scalable, and aligned to business outcomes
  • Technical depth: Advanced mastery of Python, SQL, and PySpark; deep expertise in vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search), LLM platforms, and AI/ML lifecycle management
  • Cloud & platform expertise: Proven leadership in AWS and Azure enterprise environments; strong functional exposure to advanced analytics platforms such as Palantir Foundry/AIP
  • Transformation leadership: Demonstrated success operating within a Transformation Office or enterprise innovation function—establishing operating models, reusable patterns, and governance to scale adoption responsibly
  • Business value orientation: Ability to translate architecture decisions into measurable outcomes, cost efficiency, operational resilience, and risk reduction
  • Ability to work in a team environment

jobs.description:
Why Join Evotix?

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue Excellence, show Leadership, deliver Impact, earn Trust, and Empower those around them.

Overview

The expected total earnings for this role is $100,000-150,000. This is made up of both a base salary and a commission package, depending on location and experience.

Our customers already trust us. Your job is to keep that trust strong, and make it grow.

We truly value our customers. Happy, engaged customers renew. They renew for longer. And they buy more. That’s the chain this role runs on. You’ll own a large book of enterprise accounts, and your first job is making sure each customer is getting real value and feels heard. When they do, healthy, longer-term contracts and expansion follow.

You’ll work with EHS Directors, executives and budget holders, often in the same account at once. You’ll run many accounts, renewals, deals and stakeholders in parallel, and keep every one of them moving.

This is a fast, busy role. Priorities shift daily, deadlines are real, and the details matter. We need someone who thrives in that, stays organized under pressure, and acts with urgency.

What You'll Do

Keep customers engaged and renewing

  • Build real relationships with day-to-day users, EHS Directors and executive sponsors in every account.
  • Check in often and early. Know how each customer is doing, spot risk before it becomes a problem, and act fast.
  • Own the renewal cycle from start to finish. Start conversations early, and aim for longer-term contracts, not short extensions.
  • Work with Customer Success to make sure customers are adopting the product and getting results they can point to.
  • Bring in the right people (Product, Implementation, leadership) when an account needs help.
  • Your outcome: engaged customers, healthy contracts, and renewals that are on time and on longer terms.

Grow our biggest accounts

  • Spot where Evotix can solve bigger problems, then sell additional modules and own expansion and upsell deals through to close.
  • Study your customer base, then build account and territory plans that show where the next opportunity is.
  • Sell consultatively to EHS Directors, C-level leaders and budget holders.
  • Drive complex, multi-stakeholder deals to close, and prospect steadily to keep your pipeline full.
  • Your outcome: a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline and wider adoption of the Evotix portfolio.

Deliver the best of Evotix

  • Work with Customer Success, Sales, Solutions Consulting and customer squads to find and move opportunities forward.
  • Line up pricing, collateral and deal strategy with sales leadership, and bring in Implementation at the right moment.
  • Partner with Events and Marketing to raise our profile in target accounts.
  • Share customer needs, market insight and competitor moves with Product and Marketing.
  • Your outcome: a seamless customer experience and a repeatable renewal, upsell and cross-sell playbook.

Keep the deal machine tight

  • Keep CRM records, pipeline data, activity and forecasts complete and accurate, including renewal dates and account health.
  • Handle tenders, service order forms and purchase-order requirements.
  • Negotiate terms with guidance from sales leadership and get agreements signed.
  • Represent Evotix at conferences, exhibitions and industry forums. Customer visits and international travel may be required.
  • Your outcome: well-run deals, forecasts people can trust, and a smooth handover to Implementation.

What You Bring

Required

  • Experience selling SaaS software, with a track record of hitting revenue targets.
  • Proven success keeping customers happy and renewing, ideally on multi-year terms.
  • Proven success growing existing accounts through expansion, upsell or cross-sell.
  • Strong consultative selling skills, including with senior executives and several decision-makers at once.
  • Experience building account plans, generating pipeline and moving complex deals forward.
  • Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting, with CRM habits you don’t skip.
  • Excellent organization and prioritization. You can juggle many accounts and stakeholders without dropping details.
  • A sense of urgency. You move fast, follow up fast and finish what you start.
  • Clear writing, resilience and flexibility when plans change.
  • A hungry, self-starting, collaborative style. You’re honest, you listen well and you build relationships easily.
  • Desirable
  • Experience selling EHS, health and safety, sustainability or related enterprise software.
  • Experience helping shape renewal, expansion or team-selling playbooks.
  • Time in a PE-backed SaaS company or another fast-scaling business.

Please note that Evotix is unable to offer visa sponsorship. You must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application.

Interview Process

jobs.description:
About Ceresti

Ceresti is on a mission to reduce avoidable hospitalizations and improve care for people living with dementia while improving the lives of their families and caregivers. We envision a world in which family caregivers of people living with dementia are supported and have the knowledge, skills, and confidence to provide the best possible care for their loved ones.

Ceresti is a tech-enabled dementia care provider with a differentiated model of care that improves outcomes and delivers guaranteed cost savings by including family caregivers in the care team. We offer health plans and accountable care organizations a turnkey solution for engaging a population that has limited participation in traditional clinical programs.

Our culture is rooted in agility, innovation, and collaboration. We believe every idea—no matter how small—can spark a meaningful improvement. Together, we create solutions that make a lasting impact on the healthcare ecosystem, enabling more compassionate and cost-effective care for those who need it most.

The Role

Ceresti's security and privacy controls only count if we can prove they work. As GRC Analyst, you turn what the security team does every day into documented, audit-ready evidence — the record behind our SOC 2, HITRUST, and HIPAA obligations.

You will report to the Chief Information Security Officer and work across Security, IT, Engineering, and Operations: gathering evidence, keeping policies current, assessing vendors, and supporting the privacy and data program. This is the governance side of security. The Security Analyst operates and monitors the controls; you prove they are working.

This role is targeted to someone early in their career who is organized, writes clearly, and wants to learn how a regulated healthcare company earns and keeps its certifications. You will have a lot of exposure to the entire security program.

What You Will Do

Audit evidence and control documentation

  • Collect evidence for SOC 2 Type 2 and HITRUST including internal audit testing of controls.
  • Track control evidence status and keep the CISO informed.
  • Coordinate with control owners across Security, IT, and Engineering to gather audit artifacts.

Policy and vendor risk

  • Update security and privacy policies, manage versions, and track that people have read/acknowledged them.
  • Maintain documented proof that policies are being followed across the company.
  • Run third-party vendor risk assessments, document findings, and escalate anything that needs a decision.

Privacy and data lifecycle

  • Support HIPAA and other healthcare compliance obligations alongside the CISO.
  • Support the data retention, de-identification, and disposal program.

• Support the Privacy and Data Program.

What Success Looks Like

In the first year, we would expect to see:

  • Evidence for SOC 2 and HITRUST that is accurate, complete, and on time, with no recurring gaps.
  • Policies that stay current, with documented proof people are following them.
  • Vendor risk assessments finished on schedule, with risks written down and escalated appropriately.
  • Retention, de-identification, and disposal actions happening on schedule and recorded.

What You Bring

Required

  • One to three years of experience in governance, risk and compliance, audit, or a related field.
  • Working knowledge of at least one of SOC 2, HITRUST, or HIPAA, and the appetite to learn the others quickly.
  • Clear, precise writing. Much of this role is producing documents other people depend on.
  • Attention to detail, and the patience to track many small items to completion.
  • Comfort following up with colleagues for evidence without being pushy.

Preferred

  • Exposure to a GRC or compliance-automation platform.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with vendor risk assessments or BAA tracking.

• External audit exposure.

How you work

  • You know when to resolve something yourself, escalate, and anticipate options.
  • You follow through on small commitments without being reminded.
  • You ask when something is unclear instead of guessing.
  • You treat compliance as something that protects patients and caregivers, not as paperwork.

What We Offer

• Full-time remote work

  • Competitive base salary with final offer based on experience, skills, and location
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits
  • Equity participation in a growing healthcare technology company

• PTO and a culture that respects it

  • A collaborative, mission-driven environment where your work directly supports family caregivers and improves outcomes for people living with dementia

Additional Information

Employment is contingent on successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable law.

Ceresti is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love—driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager for our AI agents. ShopMy is building a growing fleet of agents that do real work for internal teams and external clients, from brands and creators to the people who support them. As these agents move toward improving from their own track record, someone has to own what each agent is for and keep it pointed at useful work. That is you.

In this role you sit between the people an agent serves and the agentic system itself. You deeply understand the client's need, whether that client is an internal team or an external brand or creator, and you translate that need into concrete demands on the agents: how they should behave, how they delegate, what good output looks like, and where their boundaries sit. You work closely with the teams and clients each agent serves, along with product and engineering, turning recurring evidence from real runs into a system that gets measurably better over time.

What We're Looking For

We need someone who embodies three qualities:

You are a systems thinker. You deeply understand the people an agent serves, whether an internal team or an external brand or creator, and you see how their work actually flows: where decisions happen, where context gets lost, where things slow down. You assume the requests and complaints you are handed are incomplete, and you read between them to find the need actually worth solving. You know where an agent genuinely helps and where it does not.

You are hands-on with agents. You do not just write requirements and hand them off. You are in the prompts, documents, and delegation yourself, you prototype and test against real runs rather than writing long specs, and you partner with engineering to ship the harder capabilities. You earn trust through what works.

You live on the frontier of agents. You have real intuition for LLMs: how they are prompted, how they delegate to one another, and how they are evaluated. You set the bar for what a great agent feels like, accurate, reliable, on-tone, and trusted, and you keep up with what is newly possible.

What You’ll Do

  • Deep dive with customer teams to deeply understand their processes and problems, and decide and prioritize where to plug in agents for the greatest impact
  • Own and deeply understand the customer need behind each agent, whether the client is an internal team or an external brand or creator, and convert it into clear requirements and priorities for the agents
  • Garden agents against that need: watch for recurring gaps, quality drift, confusing delegation, weak eval coverage, and agents being stretched beyond their shape
  • Own prompt and document quality, delegation shape, locked instructions, and agent boundaries for your agents with a high bar for precision
  • Help shape the agentic orchestration system itself, not just the individual agents: spot flaws, friction, and missing capabilities in how agents are coordinated, and act as a product driver for where the system should go next
  • Triage the improvement queue: act on the agent-side changes you own, route tool and capability gaps to engineering, and route product ambiguity to product owners
  • Partner with the people an agent serves, along with product and engineering, so every agent has the right scope, knowledge, and tools to succeed, without taking over their domains

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years in product management, or a closely related role where you owned a product, workflow, or service against real customer needs
  • A keen understanding of business processes and strong business judgment: you can reason about where the leverage and the ROI are, and focus the agents there

jobs.title: Director of Safeguarding and Risk
jobs.excerpt: About Us: At Kooth, our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalized digital mental health care that empowers young people to thrive.
jobs.description:
About Us:

At Kooth, our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalized digital mental health care that empowers young people to thrive. Grounded in an early-intervention model, we help youth aged 13–25 build resilience, access timely support, and lead fulfilling lives. We are more than a digital service — we are a movement for inclusive, evidence-informed mental health care.

Our culture is rooted in our values: Alongside You, Flexible, Compassionate, Committed, and Safe. These guide everything we do - how we show up for young people, how we collaborate as a team, and how we build solutions that meet communities where they are. With Kooth, you’ll be part of something bigger than yourself: meaningful work with measurable impact.

We bring this mission to life through Soluna, California’s first-in-the-nation digital behavioral health service for 13–25-year-olds. Soluna removes barriers to care by providing nearly immediate access to 1:1 coaching, Care Navigation, and self-guided tools helping young people find real support, build resilience, and discover hope when they need it most. Together with state and local partners, we’re transforming access to mental health support for youth. Learn more at .

What We’re Looking For:

As the Director of Safeguarding and Risk, you will be responsible for leading the safeguarding strategy for Kooth Behavioral Health services in the US and assisting the Global Head of Safeguarding with Kooth’s global trust and safety framework.

You will be accountable for ensuring that the Kooth offer is safe and aligned with regulatory frameworks, both locally and nationally, and that policies and procedures are fully embedded with appropriate assurances in place for internal and external stakeholders.

You will play a crucial role in ensuring the satisfaction, engagement, and overall success of our users. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and local and national healthcare systems to promote our behavioral health platform and drive positive outcomes and engagement.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Management & Leadership

  • Responsible for the overall leadership and management of the Safeguarding and Trust & Safety functions and frameworks across North America.
  • Assists and deputizes for the Global Head of Safeguarding within agreed designated areas of responsibility.
  • Works closely with the VP of Clinical Excellence in setting the strategy for the US Clinical & Safeguarding Department, in line with the wider global clinical and safeguarding function and organizational priorities.
  • Leads and builds a high-performing risk team and ensures they are delivering key strategic objectives.
  • Ensures that US practices are aligned with the wider Kooth global frameworks.
  • Sets a tone of compassionate leadership, providing supportive, challenging, and demanding high standards in line with business expectations.
  • Supports the HR function in confidential matters that may result from performance issues, including leading investigations.
  • Ensures that all team members are appropriately trained and supported to lead on designated areas of responsibility within the risk functions.

Analytics, Reporting & Insights

  • Prepares monthly reports to demonstrate function activity, trends, and challenges, including improvement plans.
  • Supports the Global Head of Safeguarding in ensuring that any safeguarding-specific risks within the organization are visible to the executive team and board of directors.
  • Uses data from a variety of sources to produce narratives explaining how risk is increased and mitigated. This includes both quantitative and qualitative data from internal and external sources.
  • Leads the incident reporting framework relating to practice, including investigations, root cause analysis, and reporting of lessons learned, as appropriate.

Stakeholder Management

  • Engages, influences, and partners across the organization, as well as externally, to ensure a clear understanding of the responsibilities of the risk team.
  • Represents the company at industry conferences and meetings, building relationships with key stakeholders while using expertise and experience to demonstrate the company’s commitment to ensuring safety for vulnerable service users.
  • Ensures that risk policies are developed in conjunction with relevant local stakeholders, as required, and that any challenges to implementation are appropriately managed through transparent and supportive conversations, leading to mutual resolution.
  • Responsible for the timely and accurate provision of relevant risk activity to local commissioners and stakeholders in line with contract compliance requirements.
  • Leads the provision of timely responses to data requests from local and national stakeholders, as appropriate (including police), in line with duty of care.

Behavioral Health

  • Remains up to date with relevant evidence-based practices in the behavioral health domain, generally and within digital health specifically.
  • Ensures that clinical policies and procedures are fit for purpose and aligned with regulatory and best practice frameworks regarding any risk elements.
  • Ensures an appropriate level of governance for relevant teams where there is a risk element, including product, content, and service delivery (including auditing, as appropriate).
  • Supports the Risk Team Specialists in conducting practice audits, as appropriate to the role, as part of the overall governance function.

Risk Management

  • Ensures the appropriate application of relevant risk legislation across the organization, working closely with the legal and risk team to identify and address any gaps.
  • Leads the risk team in establishing, embedding, and reviewing risk processes, including risk management, risk reporting, and risk prevention.
  • Analyzes organizational needs in relation to risk training and makes recommendations based on this analysis and other relevant data.
  • Offers specialist advice to internal staff as the company expert on risks and their applicability within youth behavioral health (including vulnerable adults).
  • Leads the implementation of actions to mitigate identified risks.
  • Oversees the development of all policies relating to risk and leads the implementation of those policies.
  • Leads the on-call provision, ensuring that practitioners are adequately supported in dealing with risks, which may include being part of the on-call rotation.
  • Leads the implementation of lessons learned actions following risk incidents.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • Master’s degree or higher in Psychology, Social Work, Medicine, Mental Health, Counseling, or a closely related field.
  • 7+ years of experience managing risk in a relevant field, with demonstrated knowledge of regulatory frameworks and challenges related to youth behavioral health.
  • Clinical license in a relevant field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading safety and safeguarding initiatives within digital healthcare or behavioral health environments.
  • Proven people management experience, including leading, developing, and supporting high-performing teams.
  • Experience developing, implementing, and managing organizational strategies related to safeguarding, clinical safety, and risk management.
  • Strong understanding of online trust and safety frameworks, including content moderation, user protection, and digital platform safety.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA regulations and healthcare privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Comprehensive understanding of child and adult protection laws, safeguarding regulations, and applicable state and federal regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience conducting compliance risk assessments, identifying potential vulnerabilities, and implementing effective risk mitigation strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience managing clinical and patient safety protocols, incident response frameworks, investigations, and corrective actions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex risks and make sound, evidence-based decisions.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with cross-functional teams and senior leadership.
  • Proven ability to navigate sensitive situations with sound judgment, discretion, empathy, and professionalism.
  • Strong strategic thinking, organizational skills, and the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits

What You’ll Get:

Compensation: The base salary for this role is up to $130,000 annually. We’re committed to transparency and value our candidates time, which is why we share salary ranges in all states—regardless of local requirements. Final compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including your education, experience, skills, and overall alignment with the role.

Kooth offers a competitive base salary, employee equity program, and comprehensive benefits including:

  • Excellent Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Remote-first flexibility and work-from-home support
  • Paid parental leave
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • 8 Paid Holidays, plus two half-day holidays (Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve)

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Kooth is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and provides equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Reasonable Accommodations:

Kooth is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, sincerely held religious beliefs, or other protected reasons under applicable law. If you require accommodations during the application or interview process, please contact our HR team.

Ready to Join Us?

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and be part of a team that values purpose-driven work, apply today. Together, we’re shaping the future of digital mental health care.

jobs.description:
About Hubtype

Hubtype builds Visual AI Agents for WhatsApp: AI for the thinking, UI for the doing. Enterprise brands use our platform to automate customer service, sales and operations on the channel their customers already use every day, combining LLM agents with interactive interfaces, human handover and deep integration into their own systems.

We work with airlines, retail and luxury, insurance, telco and mobility brands across Europe and Latin America, including Wizz Air, Ralph Lauren, Michael Kors, Tendam, RACC and Verisure. We work closely with Meta's teams on new WhatsApp capabilities such as Coexistence and WhatsApp Calling.

The role

Every project we sell succeeds or fails on its scope. When a deal closes with a vague scope, Customer Success inherits a promise nobody priced, delivery runs over and the client’s business case breaks. Your mission is to stop that from happening.

You are the bridge between business and technology. You sit with the client’s business owner and their IT team, with our Account Executives and with Customer Success, and you turn “we want an AI agent on WhatsApp” into a solution design, an integration plan, an effort estimate and a business case that everyone agrees on before the contract is signed.

We are looking for someone technical enough to earn the respect of a client’s IT team and commercial enough to hold the room with their business owner. You will work on mid-market and enterprise deals in sectors such as airlines, insurance, retail, telco and banking. If a deal can’t be delivered as sold, you say so before it closes, not after.

What you’ll do

  • Technical scoping on every deal: run discovery with business and IT stakeholders (use cases, conversation volumes, systems of record, authentication, compliance) and turn it into a solution design and a statement of work that delivery can be held to.
  • Support Sales across the full cycle: demos, proofs of concept with success criteria agreed upfront, technical answers in RFPs and security questionnaires, and a structured handoff to Customer Success once the deal closes.
  • Scope upsells and change requests in existing accounts together with Customer Success, with the same rigor as new business.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • 3+ years in a client-facing technical role: sales engineer, solutions consultant, solution architect or technical consultant at a SaaS company or integrator. This is a mid-senior role.
  • You have scoped and estimated software projects for mid-market and enterprise clients, and you have lived with the consequences of your own estimates.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to CX, messaging platforms, conversational AI, CCaaS or CPaaS is important. If you have worked with Twilio, Infobip, Zendesk, Genesys, Salesforce Service Cloud or similar, you already speak the client’s language.

Skills

  • Integration fluency. This is the main filter. REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JSON: you read a client’s API documentation and tell their IT team exactly what we need from them.
  • You can build. JavaScript or TypeScript (our open source framework, Botonic, is React based) or Python, well enough to prototype an integration or a demo yourself.
  • AI-native. You actively use AI tools in your workflow: research, prep, analysis, prototyping. We are an AI company and we expect the team to work that way.
  • LLMs in production. Prompting, retrieval, tool calling, guardrails and evaluation, and an honest view of where they fail.
  • Commercial judgment. You understand how a SaaS deal is priced, can explain a cost model to a CFO without losing the IT director, and are comfortable telling an Account Executive that a deal is not ready.
  • Clear writing. Solution designs and statements of work that the client’s procurement team and our delivery team read the same way.
  • Native Spanish and fluent English, both mandatory. Most of our clients are in Spain, while RFPs, technical documentation and part of our client base are in English. Catalan highly valued, as a large part of our client base is in Catalonia.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with the WhatsApp Business Platform: template categories and approval, per message pricing, WhatsApp Flows, Coexistence, Calling API.
  • Contact center platforms such as Genesys Cloud, Zendesk or Salesforce Service Cloud, and experience integrating them with messaging channels.
  • Sector experience in airlines, insurance, retail or telco.
  • Knowledge of sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC. Not a requirement; we will notice it in how you qualify a deal technically.
  • Catalan or French at C1/C2 level, not basic or conversational. A real plus, especially Catalan given the volume of clients in Catalonia. Between similar CVs, we will choose the candidate with the stronger language skills.

Serve as the functional and solution leader for Order-to-Cash (OTC) processes and systems across BFS. Lead enterprise-wide process analysis, solution design, and business transformation initiatives that span multiple functions, systems, and business units. Act as the subject matter expert for OTC business processes, applications, integrations, and technology capabilities. Build strong partnerships with business leaders, stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and external partners to drive strategic outcomes. Facilitate complex discovery, design, and decision-making sessions to define business capabilities, requirements, future-state processes, and technology solutions. Evaluate solution alternatives and provide recommendations that balance business value, customer experience, standardization, risk, scalability, supportability, and total cost of ownership. Lead the analysis and resolution of complex business, process, data, integration, and production issues across the OTC landscape. Ensure solution designs address cross-functional dependencies across order management, pricing, contracts, billing, rebates, finance, procurement, transportation, warehouse, installation, and external applications. SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 10+ years of experience in business systems analysis, solution design, enterprise applications, or business process transformation. jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, results-driven Healthcare Recruiter with proven, hands-on experience recruiting within the US Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) industry.

The successful candidate must have a demonstrated track record of successfully sourcing and hiring Behavior Technicians, Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), and Board Certified Behavior Analysts (BCBAs) for the US market.

This role is suited to an independent recruiter who knows how to build a candidate pipeline, engage qualified talent, maintain consistent follow-ups, and move candidates efficiently through the recruitment process. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of hiring outcomes rather than simply completing daily recruitment tasks.

Proven ABA recruitment success is essential. Candidates who can demonstrate strong hiring results will be prioritised over those with more years of experience but limited results.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently source and recruit Behavior Technicians, RBTs, and BCBAs within the US market.
  • Use Indeed as the primary recruitment platform to identify and engage qualified candidates.
  • Explore alternative sourcing channels, including LinkedIn, relevant job boards, professional networks, and university outreach.
  • Proactively screen applicants, conduct initial assessments, and identify candidates who meet the role requirements.
  • Maintain consistent, timely follow-ups with candidates to minimise drop-offs and keep the recruitment pipeline moving.
  • Manage candidates throughout the recruitment process, from initial outreach and screening through to interviews, offers, and placement.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified ABA professionals for current and future hiring needs.
  • Monitor recruitment progress, identify sourcing challenges, and adjust strategies to improve hiring outcomes.
  • Communicate promptly with candidates and relevant stakeholders, ensuring a responsive and professional candidate experience.
  • Track recruitment performance, with an emphasis on qualified candidates, successful placements, and time-to-fill.

Minimum Requirements

  • Mandatory: Hands-on experience recruiting for the US ABA industry.
  • Demonstrated success hiring Behavior Technicians, RBTs, and BCBAs.
  • Strong understanding of the US ABA recruitment market and the challenges of sourcing qualified clinical and behavioral support professionals.
  • Proven ability to source, screen, engage, and progress candidates independently.
  • Strong working knowledge of Indeed and experience using additional recruitment platforms and sourcing methods.
  • Excellent communication, organisation, and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and adapt sourcing strategies when results are limited.
  • A proactive, persistent, and target-driven approach to recruitment.
  • Ability to demonstrate previous recruitment results, including hiring volumes, successful placements, or improvements in recruitment performance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional experience within the ABA industry, behavioral health, healthcare recruitment, or clinical staffing.
  • Experience recruiting for ABA providers, clinics, or in-home therapy services.
  • Experience with university outreach, referral programmes, and alternative candidate sourcing strategies.
  • Familiarity with US hiring processes and the qualifications required for RBTs and BCBAs.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a recruiter who:

  • Takes initiative and actively hunts for candidates rather than waiting for applications.
  • Responds quickly to applicants and hiring stakeholders.
  • Follows up persistently and professionally until candidates progress or are appropriately closed out.
  • Is resourceful and willing to test new sourcing methods when traditional channels are not delivering.
  • Works with minimal supervision and requires little day-to-day direction.
  • Understands that recruitment success is measured by quality hires and placements, not simply the number of messages sent or applications reviewed.
  • Can clearly demonstrate what they have achieved in previous ABA recruitment roles.

A passive, task-oriented approach to recruitment will not be suitable for this position.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

The number and quality of successful ABA placements.

The ability to consistently generate qualified RBT, Behavior Technician, and BCBA candidates.

Candidate responsiveness, engagement, and progression through the hiring funnel.

Effective follow-up and reduced candidate drop-off.

Ability to meet agreed hiring targets and timelines.

Independence, initiative, and adaptability in sourcing.

At Capital Blue Cross, we promise to go the extra mile for our team and our community. This promise is at the heart of our culture, and it’s why our employees consistently vote us one of the “Best Places to Work in PA.”

Provides administrative support to assigned clinical team, as directed by the Team Lead and/or Manager. The Clinical Support Specialist will perform administrative tasks that support clinical processes (e.g. UM, CM, PHM), including but not limited to building medical management records (e.g. authorizations and referral management), compliance report monitoring, and completion of member/provider communications

Responsibilities and Qualifications

  • Assists with medical record documentation requests and leverages medical management system to initiate case and/or authorization to support clinical processes (e.g. UM, CM).
  • Conducts fax and telephonic outreach; and written communications to members and/or providers to communicate status of UM/CM processes (e.g. verbal notification, engagement status, discharge plan).
  • Supports administrative functions with community events (e.g. health fairs)
  • Accurately documents all interventions in the member’s medical management record in accordance with established policies and procedures.
  • Actively participates in supporting department compliance and performance through administrative activities such as report monitoring/distribution, and other tasks as assigned by leadership.
  • Adheres to all regulatory and compliance standards, including adherence to all Capital and department specific policies and procedures.
  • Interacts courteously and professionally with customers, including internal staff, vendor partners, providers, and members to support collaborative medical management functions.
  • Identifies and reports potential quality of service/care issues as established and within the guidelines of intradepartmental processes.
  • Promotes personal growth through participation in staff meetings, appropriate in-services, and corporate training.
  • Identifies opportunities and proposes alternatives for improving the Population Management functions.

Skills:

  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Demonstrated strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to follow job responsibilities as outlined in departmental policies and procedures.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.

Knowledge:

  • Working knowledge and operation of a personal computer, including proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Working knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Working knowledge of the health insurance industry, health plan benefits and product lines (e.g., PPO, POS, HMO, FEP, Senior Products, Traditional/Comprehensive).
  • Knowledge of regulatory and accreditation standards and requirements (e.g. NCQA, CMS).

Experience:

  • Minimum 2 years’ experience in the medical field (e.g. medical assistant, medical secretary) or 2 years’ experience in a managed care clinical department.

Education and Certifications:

  • High School Diploma required.
  • Continued higher education preferred.

About Us

We recognize that work is a part of life, not separate from it, and foster a flexible environment where your health and wellbeing are prioritized. At Capital you will work alongside a caring team of supportive colleagues, and be encouraged to volunteer in your community. We value your professional and personal growth by investing heavily in training and continuing education, so you have the tools to do your best as you develop your career. And by doing your best, you’ll help us live our mission of improving the health and well-being of our members and the communities in which they live.
