jobs.description:
Remote | Australia | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or demonstrated interest in family medicine.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or an interest in internal medicine.

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Physician Assistant or Physician Associate program, preferably in the clinical phase of training.

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking to earn supplemental income while applying your professional skills and expertise to meaningful projects.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Family Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Internal Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Nurse Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$20/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$28/hr

Physician Assistant

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$23/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$30/hr

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or study track required (see list above)

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States
  • Additional Markets Under Consideration: United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval
  • Schedule: Variable, including potential weekday and weekend assignments
  • Evaluation Platform: DataCompute
  • Project Duration: Based on client requirements and project availability
  • Selection Process: Qualified applicants may be required to complete a medical knowledge or clinical reasoning assessment before selection.

Specific assignments, schedules, and workloads will be communicated as they become available.

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.
  • Clinical Reasoning and Evaluation: Ability to assess medical scenarios, interpret clinical information, and distinguish evidence-based reasoning from inaccurate or unsupported conclusions.
  • Research and Evidence Verification: Ability to research medical literature, interpret clinical guidelines, and validate findings using authoritative healthcare resources.
  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.
  • Experience reviewing medical records, clinical case studies, laboratory results, or diagnostic documentation.
  • Familiarity with evidence-based medicine, differential diagnosis, and established clinical practice guidelines.
  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

We are looking for a Virtual Assistant (VA) to serve as an operational extension of our high-performing providers - someone who streamlines administrative workflows, strengthens patient engagement, and brings the kind of steady consistency that helps practices grow and thrive.

We are looking for a true self-starter - someone who is confident in their ability to figure things out, ask smart questions, and move work forward without needing a roadmap for every task.

This is a fully remote role, but we do have a few requirements to ensure strong collaboration with our providers and core team:

  • You must be located within the United States.

  • Availability Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET.

What You’ll Do

Provider & Practice Support

  • Precharting patient appointments thoroughly and accurately so providers can walk into every visit fully prepared.
  • Acknowledge provider requests quickly, complete tasks on time, and proactively post status updates in Trello whenever a task can't be completed right away.
  • Double-check every piece of work before contacting a patient or sending a report to a provider, with a goal of zero avoidable errors.
  • Manage provider inboxes and calendars, including patient scheduling, follow-ups, and virtual consultations.
  • Support patient communication workflows, including appointment reminders, reorder messages, and post-treatment check-ins.

Marketing & Growth Assistance

  • Track engagement and campaign performance using prebuilt reporting templates.
  • Identify local collaboration or event opportunities to support practice expansion.
  • Maintain a practice growth tracker to help providers monitor performance and identify new opportunities.

Administrative & Operational Tasks

  • Support order tracking, inventory management, and reorders for consumables and marketing materials.
  • Prepare monthly performance reports summarizing activity and outcomes.
  • Collaborate with the Skin Clique core team to address scheduling, billing, and system-related questions.
  • Ensure all communications, documentation, and patient information remain compliant and confidential.

What Success Looks Like

  • Providers feel genuinely supported and consistently say their VA makes their practice run better.

  • Precharts and patient-facing work are accurate, thorough, and reviewed before they go out.
  • Trello is always up to date, so providers never have to wonder where a task stands.
  • Improved provider efficiency, with less time on admin and more time with patients.
  • A positive impact on patient experience and local brand visibility.

What You Bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfort managing multiple providers and priorities in a virtual environment.
  • A medical, healthcare, aesthetics, or wellness background is a nice-to-have, but not required.
  • Experience with EMRs (Zenoti), scheduling tools, CRMs, Trello, or social media management platforms is a plus.

jobs.description:
Eaton's Electrical Sector is seeking a General Manager, Life Safety & Distributed Power Infrastructure (LSDPI). The business is central to how we protect people and property, support resilient power and digital infrastructure, and create value in highly regulated markets.

The opportunity:

We are seeking a commercially driven General Manager to lead and grow this sizeable, profitable portfolio. With direct P&L responsibility, the GM will work with product line strategy, marketing, engineering, and commercial leaders to determine where we invest, accelerate, modernise, expand or reshape the portfolio, comprising Emergency Lighting, Fire and Intrusion, North America Fire and Distributed Power Infrastructure (single-phase UPS and white-space products).

This is a senior leadership role with a clear strategic ambition to grow beyond $1bn revenue by 2030. The GM will lead 1500 people through ten direct reports and shape strategy across EMEA and globally, including operations in the United States and China. The role will combine direct leadership of Product Line Management, Marketing, Engineering and Operations with influence across the sales organisation, supply chain and quality. It carries full accountability for business performance and portfolio direction.

What you’ll do:

Translate strategy into profitable growth
• Lead overall LSDPI strategy and execution, delivering profitable growth and market expansion across EMEA and global product lines.
• Build and execute long-term business plans aligned with divisional and regional priorities, with full P&L responsibility and delivery of financial targets.
• Lead transformation and growth initiatives that strengthen competitive positioning and accelerate business performance.

Shape portfolio and market choices
• Define product strategy, roadmaps and lifecycle plans, making clear choices on where Eaton should invest, accelerate, modernise, localise, expand, contain or stop.
• Identify market trends, customer needs and competitive opportunities, ensuring strong market visibility and effective positioning of the portfolio across EMEA.

Accelerate Life Safety growth
• Partner with regional sales leaders and country organisations to strengthen coverage in priority growth countries and achieve growth objectives.
• Drive new product development, localisation, digitalisation and innovation, including the launch and adoption of connected life-safety platforms.
• Expand regulatory-led services and digital solutions that increase lifecycle value, customer retention and recurring revenue.

Scale Distributed Power Infrastructure
• Accelerate single-phase UPS growth through channel and broader commercial reach, regionalising global product-line strategies for EMEA market and customer requirements.
• Leverage project synergies in Buildings and Data Centre segments by strengthening engagement with account teams.
• Deliver on the opportunity to scale the white-space portfolio.

Keep strategy connected to execution
• Provide strategic leadership to Engineering to support innovation, product development and customer requirements.
• Align Engineering with market needs, technology trends, regulatory requirements and product-roadmap priorities, fostering innovation and accelerating speed-to-market.
• Partner with Sales, Supply Chain and Quality to align commercial, engineering and operational priorities and support world-class operational performance and customer outcomes.

Build the organisation and lead transformation
• Build and lead a high-performing, internationally distributed leadership team and organisation, with clear accountability for business, portfolio and functional outcomes.
• Develop talent, succession, organisational capability and leadership effectiveness across the division.
• Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation and customer focus.
• Lead organisational transformation and change management where required to improve execution and support the next phase of profitable growth.

Success will be reflected in profitable growth, stronger market positions, faster innovation, successful portfolio modernisation, increased recurring revenue, stronger organisational capability and disciplined execution through the matrix.

What you'll bring:

  • Broad general management experience with direct P&L accountability in a sizeable, complex and international business.
    • Experience working across multiple product lines, countries or market channels in a large global organisation.
    • Experience translating enterprise and regional priorities into end-to-end business, product-line and commercial strategy.
    • Strong commercial and product-line orientation, with evidence of converting strategy into accelerated profitable growth.
    • Experience leading product management, marketing, engineering and operations, and aligning sales, supply chain and quality through a matrix.
    • Track record of portfolio transformation, new product introduction, digitalisation and innovation in highly regulated markets.
    • Success influencing senior commercial, engineering, operational and functional leaders to align priorities and investment choices.
    • Experience building and leading cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience in electrical, power management, lighting, fire, life safety, building technology or another regulated engineered-product environment.

Qualifications:

  • Significant general management and leadership experience, including direct P&L responsibility at $XXXm scale.
    • Experience leading managers and geographically distributed cross-functional teams.

How you'll lead:

Eaton’s Culture Model calls on leaders to Win Together, Think Big and Act Boldly. In this role, that means:

Win Together - Build trust and alignment across product lines, countries and functions. Bring product, commercial, engineering and operational priorities into a coherent direction, respecting matrix accountabilities while challenging local optimisation. Create constructive tension where growth ambition, investment, portfolio priorities and execution capacity do not align.

Think Big - Connect customer needs, market opportunity, regulation and technology across the full LSDPI portfolio. Identify where connected products, digital services, stronger channels and Eaton’s broader commercial reach can create meaningful customer and enterprise value. Balance long-term portfolio direction with near-term performance and customer commitments.

Act Boldly - Make explicit choices rather than producing broad strategic themes. Challenge incremental thinking, outdated technology, weak market coverage and unsupported investment logic. Surface difficult trade-offs and provide clear direction that enables teams to make decisive portfolio, product, market and investment choices.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.excerpt: ABOUT SOLVI DIGITALSolvi Digital is a B2B marketing agency built for industrial businesses.
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOLVI DIGITAL

Solvi Digital is a B2B marketing agency built for industrial businesses. We work with manufacturers, construction firms, engineering companies, renewables and utilities businesses, logistics operators and specialist trades across the UK.

Most of these businesses are good at what they do and have been trading for decades, but new customers struggle to find them. Their website does not bring in enquiries, and their growth still depends on reputation and repeat work. We sell them marketing that is measured on pipeline and revenue.

THE ROLE

We are hiring a Sales Development Representative to book first meetings between industrial decision makers and our sales team. You will spend most of your day on the phone, calling into industrial sectors we have already mapped, with email and LinkedIn used to follow up.

Your job is done when a qualified prospect joins a meeting with our Business Development Manager or Sales Director. They run the meeting, write the proposal and close the deal. You will work closely with both of them and report to the Sales Director.

This is a high-volume role with one objective, which is to create real commercial opportunities.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

Making high-volume outbound calls every day into our target industrial sectors

Reaching out to owners, managing directors and commercial, sales and marketing directors

Running short qualifying conversations to find out whether there is a real problem and a reason to talk now

Booking first meetings into the diaries of the Business Development Manager and Sales Director

Following up by email and LinkedIn so that booked meetings go ahead

Writing a handover note for every meeting so the person taking it knows the prospect's situation before they join

Logging every call, conversation and meeting in Pipedrive

Telling us what you hear on the phone, such as objections, timing and which sectors are responding, so we can improve the targeting and the scripts

HOW WE SELL

You will not be building an outbound process from scratch. Ours is already in place and it works. The data and targeting are mapped and the call approach has been tested on industrial buyers. Your part is getting enough of the right conversations and making sure the meetings you book take place.

HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED

At least 5 to 6 qualified meetings booked every week

At least 75% of booked meetings taking place (your sat rate)

Daily call activity and conversations logged in Pipedrive

How many of your meetings turn into proposals and new clients

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

At least one year in an outbound role with daily call targets, such as SDR, BDR, appointment setting or telesales

Very strong on the phone. You are comfortable cold calling senior people all day, and you enjoy it

A record of hitting or beating meeting or activity targets

You can hear no all day and still make the next call well

Good written English for follow-up emails and handover notes

Organised in a CRM. Experience with Pipedrive, HubSpot or similar helps

Experience selling into industrial, manufacturing, construction or B2B services is useful but not essential

COMMISSION

Commission is paid on meetings sat. A meeting counts as sat when the prospect turns up, and the meeting goes ahead with our Business Development Manager or Sales Director.

You need 14 qualified meetings sat in a calendar month before meeting commission is paid. That sits just below what our minimum of 5 booked meetings a week at a 75% sat rate produces, so a month with one slow week still pays. Once you reach 14, every sat meeting that month earns commission, counting from the first one.

Meetings 1 to 17: £35 each

Meetings 18 to 21: £50 each

Meetings 22 and above: £70 each

The higher rates for meetings 18 onwards apply in any month where at least 70% of your booked meetings took place. In a month below 70%, every sat meeting pays £35.

On top of that, you earn £100 for every new retained client and £50 for every new project client that comes from a meeting you booked.

What a month looks like:

13 meetings sat: no meeting commission

14 meetings sat: £490

18 meetings sat: £645

20 meetings sat: £745

24 meetings sat: £1,005

Plus any new client bonuses.

In your first two months, the minimum is lower while you settle in: 8 sat meetings in month one and 11 in month two, then 14 from month three.

BENEFITS

Full work from home

Statutory holiday plus your birthday off

Workplace pension

jobs.description:
Macmillan is one of the Big 5 Publishers with mission-critical systems running royalties, distribution, and the supply chain that books move through from manuscript to consumer. Those systems cannot be turned off. They also cannot stay as they are. The organization has committed to a multi-year modernization of its core technology platforms, the build of a Publishing Operating System that enables imprints to operate more efficiently, and the productionization of AI capabilities across the publishing lifecycle. This is a rare opportunity to help redefine the technology foundation of a global publishing company in the AI era.

This is a role for someone who has built and shipped AI-powered products at scale and now wants to shape the technical future of an industry that is being fundamentally transformed by AI.

A link to a LinkedIn, GitHub, Hugging Face, or personal portfolio is mandatory for consideration for this role.

THE ROLE

As a Senior AI Engineer (Full-Stack / Applications), you will design, build, and operate production-grade, cloud-native applications with AI at their core. This role sits at the intersection of strong software engineering and deep AI expertise, with a focus on turning state-of-the-art AI capabilities into robust, scalable, and high-quality user-facing products.

This role prioritizes deep AI knowledge alongside strong software engineering skills to ensure an effective utilization of AI capabilities in production systems.

You will work across the full lifecycle of AI-powered systems: from evaluating and optimizing models, to integrating them into end-to-end applications, to deploying, monitoring, and iterating on them in production. Candidates may bring deeper expertise in either application development or applied AI, and we value engineers who are excited to collaborate and grow across disciplines. We do not expect candidates to match every technology or qualification listed below. Strong candidates will bring deep expertise in some areas alongside curiosity, adaptability, and strong collaboration skills.

In this role you will be flexibly assigned to short-term PoC projects, mid-term rapid MVP projects and long-term product development, based on your skills, interests, and company priorities.

Our current and future tech-stack: Google Cloud, AWS, Firebase, Python, Typescript, Django, Terraform, Github, Cloud Firestore, EventArc, PubSub, GCIP, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions v2, React, BigQuery, Github Actions, commercial AI services, Open Source AI Models, Langfuse, Snowflake, PostgreSQL.

What You'll Do:

  • Own AI-powered features end-to-end, from scoping, design and requirements engineering to feature evaluation, deployment and operation.
  • Design, build and maintain cloud-native, event-driven AI applications across the full stack.
  • Evaluate, integrate, and optimize AI models for production use, balancing quality, latency, reliability and cost.
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional team members, including non-technical stakeholders, to refine requirements and align technical solutions with business objectives.
  • Build and maintain robust AI inference, evaluation, and monitoring pipelines.
  • Develop and implement robust, automated AI application evaluation frameworks.
  • Analyze AI application performance data and experiments, using insights for data-driven improvements.
  • Operate and improve production systems, taking ownership of reliability, quality, and technical debt.
  • Stay current with AI advancements and share knowledge to upskill the team.
  • Plan, track, and break down work effectively in an agile team.
  • Provide technical leadership, drive design reviews, write ADRs and contribute to hiring and onboarding.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident response and post-mortems for AI-powered systems and help define SLOs and error budgets.

What You'll Bring:

  • Pragmatic, result-oriented analytical problem solving skills that can overcome ambiguity.
  • Friendly, concise, audience-oriented communication in written and spoken form (English) with effective asynchronous communication.
  • Self-organized, purpose-driven individual that likes to collaborate with and enable their team.
  • A T-shaped engineer with strong general software engineering and AI skills, paired with deep expertise in at least one area:
    • Frontend: Advanced experience with React and TS, building high-quality, user-facing apps.
    • Backend: Deep experience designing and operating scalable, event-driven Python systems in cloud-native environments.
    • AI: In-depth knowledge of frontier AI models, evaluation, integration into AI-powered product features, and production best practices.
  • Strong theoretical understanding and practical experience with current AI model internals.
  • Proven experience with AI model deployment & utilization strategies, evaluation methodologies, and monitoring frameworks in production environments.
  • Proven experience owning features end-to-end, from technical design to production.
  • Strong understanding of how to integrate AI into production systems, including the challenges of non-deterministic behavior.
  • Solid understanding and practical application of MLOps and LLMOps best practices for AI applications.
  • Familiarity and hands-on experience with major AI service providers and their offerings.
  • Working knowledge of fine-tuning methods and their appropriate application.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to bridge AI research/concepts and robust, production-ready engineering implementations.
  • Experience breaking down complex AI objectives into requirements & actionable tasks.
  • Experience leveraging and refining agile practices and processes within an AI/ML team context, including effective requirements, design, and code reviews.
  • Proven experience in quickly assessing and adopting new technologies & frameworks.
  • Able to implement Clean Architecture & Onion Architecture principles.
  • Experience building and operating cloud-native systems, ideally on Google Cloud / Firebase with solid DevOps and MLOps fundamentals, including CI/CD, observability, and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Working knowledge of AI safety and security.
  • Solid testing discipline across the stack.
  • Mentorship and technical-leadership experience: growing other engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing technical direction across teams.
  • Working knowledge of AI safety and security: OWASP Top 10 for LLMs, prompt injection, data exfiltration risks, content moderation, and PII / GDPR handling.
  • Solid testing discipline across the stack - unit, integration, and contract tests for both deterministic code and AI components.
  • Experience operating production systems on-call

What We'd Love to See:

  • Experience in the publishing or media industry
  • Experience with our entire TechStack
  • Experience with MLOps on Vertex AI & Weights and Biases
  • Experience in applied research
  • Experience applying & implementing SRE methodologies
  • Advanced understanding of ML, LLMs and trends in the AI market
  • Specialized, deep expertise in a relevant area.

This position offers a base salary between $200,000-$225,000 and is eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to applicable plan terms.

This position is classified as remote but is tied to our New York, NY office located at 120 Broadway. Employment is subject to New York State tax withholding under applicable regulations.

Macmillan Publishers is the U.S. trade company that is part of the Holtzbrinck Publishing Group, a large family-owned group of media companies headquartered in Stuttgart, Germany. Holtzbrinck Publishing Group's publishing companies include prominent imprints around the world that publish a broad range of award-winning books for children and adults in all categories and formats.

U.S. publishers include Celadon Books, Farrar, Straus and Giroux, Flatiron Books, Henry Holt & Company, Macmillan Audio, Macmillan Children’s Publishing Group, The St. Martin's Publishing Group, and Tor Publishing Group. Lifecycle Marketing Manager

PlanHub is the leading pre-construction SaaS platform and marketplace helping general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers connect and grow their businesses. Built with tradespeople in mind, PlanHub is designed around the user workflow to help boost productivity, maintain deadlines, increase revenue, and create relationships. Easily post projects or submit bids with anytime-anywhere collaboration for every commercial construction trade.

We are hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help users move from registration to their first valuable outcome, and from there to regular, long-term use.

This is a strategy and execution role. You will define user journeys, build programs directly in HubSpot, own lifecycle messaging and cadence, and measure results. You will also help shape the lifecycle requirements for our planned email platform and user-profile migration.

We are looking for someone who can set direction, build and optimize programs independently, and use data to prioritize opportunities across lifecycle stages and channels.

What you'll do to make an impact:

  • Define user lifecycle journeys, activation milestones, and progression criteria in partnership with Marketing Operations and Product, with distinct programs for general contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers.
  • Design, build, and optimize HubSpot workflows for onboarding, activation, plan upgrades from Basic to Premier, retention, and win-back.
  • Own lifecycle messaging, copy, cadence, and campaign execution, partnering with Product Marketing and Design on positioning and creative.
  • Segment and personalize communications by trade, geography, behavior, and plan, working with Product on the signals that make project recommendations relevant.
  • Plan and manage communications across email, in-app messaging, and additional channels where they improve results.
  • Run experiments with clear hypotheses, success measures, and appropriate comparison groups to understand the effect on activation, repeat usage, retention, and upgrades.
  • Build and maintain lifecycle reporting in partnership with Marketing Operations, including cohort and funnel analysis, and communicate findings to Marketing, Product, and leadership.
  • Lead lifecycle program requirements for the planned email platform and user-profile migration, partnering with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering on event definitions, consent and suppression needs, vendor evaluation, and launch validation.
  • Monitor email engagement, deliverability, and suppression practices, working with Marketing Operations, Product, and Engineering to maintain healthy sending practices.

What you will accomplish in your first 90 days:

  • Audit existing lifecycle programs, workflows, and data availability, and recommend a prioritized lifecycle roadmap.
  • Launch or improve activation programs for general contractor and subcontractor users.
  • Establish a lifecycle dashboard with agreed activation definitions and baseline cohort reporting, including 30-, 60-, and 90-day retention where historical data is available.
  • Deliver a lifecycle requirements document for the planned migration, including program priorities, required events and attributes, consent and suppression needs, and launch acceptance criteria.

What will make you stand out:

  • Five or more years of experience in lifecycle marketing, CRM, or marketing automation, ideally in a marketplace, product-led, or SaaS business with a high-volume user base.
  • Deep, hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lists, properties, segmentation, and the underlying data model.
  • Strong analytical skills, including cohort and funnel analysis, experiment design, and experience using SQL or a business intelligence tool.
  • Experience running high-volume email programs, including campaigns and automated sends, with examples of tests you ran and results you improved.
  • Experience building behavioral and event-triggered programs.
  • A record of setting lifecycle strategy and personally building, launching, and optimizing the programs.
  • Strong copywriting skills and the ability to turn product value into clear, relevant customer communications.
  • Working knowledge of email deliverability, consent management, suppression practices, and compliance requirements.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with Marketing Operations, Product Marketing, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Experience with a customer data platform (CDP).
  • Experience with Braze, Iterable, Klaviyo, or a similar orchestration platform.
  • Experience supporting an email platform migration or implementing new behavioral data and messaging capabilities.
  • Background in B2B marketplaces, construction, or SMB customers.
  • Knowledge of email deliverability and compliance requirements.

How we will measure success:

Success will be measured by improvements in activation, repeat usage, 90-day retention, and upgrades and reactivation attributable to lifecycle programs, alongside healthy unsubscribe, complaint, bounce, and deliverability metrics.

What's in it for you:

Join a company that’s just landed on the Inc. 5000 for the sixth year in a row, recognized among America’s fastest-growing private companies. You can make an immediate impact as PlanHub moves to dominate the industry!

PlanHub Offers:

  • An awesome culture where you will be empowered, make an impact, and learn a ton
  • Remote friendly
  • An excellent benefit package, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • Open time-off policy
  • 401(k) plan with a company match

This role offers a base salary of $105,000 - $120,000 per year, depending on experience. This role also includes the benefits described above, including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, a 401(k) with company match, and an open time-off policy.

This is a remote position open to candidates located within the United States. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas or support employment outside the United States at this time.

  • Familiarity with integrating workplace and support tools like Slack (bots and workflows), Jira, Zoom, and BI reporting pipelines.
  • Prior customer-facing experience in a technical support role, preferably at a B2B technology company.

About the job:

At Wiz, technical support is never an afterthought. It is core to how our platform functions and a key part of how we create magic for our customers every day. To deliver a truly magical support experience at global scale, we put AI at the forefront of how we operate. As a Manager of Applied AI, Solutions Support Engineering, you will be an AI-first technical leader guiding the team of internal tool and automation developers who build the tools and architecture that make this experience possible.

Rather than managing customer-facing support engineers directly, you will lead the builders behind our support platform ecosystem. You will own our primary Zendesk ticketing environment, build integrations with Salesforce and ServiceNow, and lead the development of our intelligent ticket routing, browser and IDE extensions, and automated triage, pre-investigation, and resolution workflows.

You will thrive in this role not only by leading and mentoring your team, but by getting your hands directly into the technology. Leading from the front, you will split your time between writing and reviewing code alongside your team, using AI models and tools like Gemini and Claude Code to build internal tools and run our development pipeline, owning our Zendesk platform, and coaching the developers who power our support organization.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and guide an AI-first team of internal tool and automation developers, scheduling and running sprints in Jira, managing epics and defects, and driving day-to-day technical execution and team growth.
  • Own the tooling and automation roadmap that powers our technical support experience, designing the tools and architecture that handle the heavy lifting of case resolution.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader, actively writing, reviewing, and shipping code in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, and Apex across internal web apps, background automation jobs, and CRM integrations.
  • Champion an AI-first development pipeline by using AI models, APIs, and coding tools (like Gemini and Claude Code) to build internal tools faster, power automated ticket triage and pre-investigation workflows, and maintain high quality and reliability across our automations.
  • Own the administration, architecture, and custom development of our Zendesk platform (including embedded apps, webhooks, declarative workflows, and routing/SLA logic), while building custom integrations and workflows across ServiceNow and Salesforce (including Apex code).
  • Lead the development and maintenance of our internal support tooling suite, including skills- and availability-based ticket routing, browser and IDE extensions, and integrations with Slack, Jira, Zoom, and PagerDuty.
  • Maintain the cloud infrastructure that runs our support tools and automations on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using containerized services, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and Terraform while keeping access and customer data secure.
  • Partner closely with Support leadership, frontline Solutions Support Engineers, Product, and the CTO team to spot workflow bottlenecks and build new tools and automations that keep AI at the forefront of our support experience.

  • Define and enforce iOS engineering standards across the team: code structure, MVVM/Clean Architecture patterns, feature flag strategy, PR size and quality expectations, and release processes

We are trying to solve problems from scalable connections to bespoke external systems to crafting data contracts between services which reliably create product value.We believe in taking data and transforming it into consistent models, and making it available to application services securely and reliably.

You'll help shape how those systems work: how data is organized, how changes are processed, how pipelines recover when something fails, and how the architecture scales as we grow. You'll also support the shared data foundations used by analysts, data scientists, and engineering teams. We measure success by making sure it is accurate, appropriately accessible, ready when the product needs it, and most importantly: provides value to our users.

What you'll do

  • Embed with engineering teams to turn application requirements into data models, pipeline designs, and clear interfaces between systems.
  • Design, build, and operate production data operations using SQL, Python, PySpark and cloud data technologies such as Databricks, integrating APIs, databases, and structured, semi-structured, and unstructured content.
  • Build ingestion and transformation workflows that deliver usable data to application services and downstream capabilities.
  • Design customer-aware data flows that preserve tenant boundaries, source permissions, and data lifecycle requirements, including updates, deletions, and regional constraints.
  • Make pipelines resilient through incremental processing, checkpointing, safe retries, backfills, replay, and data-quality checks.
  • Build observability that helps the team understand data freshness, completeness, processing progress, and failures across the pipeline.
  • Evaluate architecture and tooling choices against product needs, balancing reliability, performance, maintainability, and operating cost.
  • Maintain and improve shared datasets and pipelines that support both application features and internal analytics, avoiding unnecessary duplication of data and processing.
  • Contribute to design reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment practices. Share what you learn and mentor less experienced engineers.

Skills and requirements

We expect to see:

  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, including building and operating production data pipelines and contributing to their architecture.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization.
  • Experience integrating external APIs and working with changing schemas, imperfect source data, and incremental updates.
  • Experience applying software engineering practices to data systems, including version control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD tooling, observability logging and monitoring.
  • You love solving hard problems with the ability to investigate issues across ingestion, transformation, and downstream delivery.
  • The ability to explain technical tradeoffs and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver customer value through reliable, understandable, and maintainable solutions.
  • A track record of sharing knowledge and helping other engineers grow, along with the communication and self-direction needed to work effectively on a distributed team.
  • Experience with Azure/GCP and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or comparable technologies.

Helpful, but not required

  • Experience building data systems for customer-facing applications, particularly multi-tenant products or integrations with third-party services.
  • Experience with document processing, knowledge systems, or pipelines that support AI-powered features.
  • Experience with access controls, data governance, regional data requirements, or customer-data retention and deletion.
  • Experience with event-driven processing, infrastructure as code, and monitoring or optimizing cloud workload costs.
  • Examples of work you're proud of, whether from a previous role, a personal project, open source, or contributions to the Stack Overflow community.

What you’ll get in return:

  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Generous paid vacation
  • Generous parental leave, family care leave, and unlimited sick days
  • Industry-leading health benefits that are applicable per country of residence for all our full-time employees
  • Company-paid Life Insurance
  • Home Internet stipend
  • Professional allocation for your growth and development
  • One-time allowance to assist with your home office setup
  • Company-paid access to Calm, Prosus Academy and Overdrive

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

As a Product Dvl Engineer in the Signal Integrity team you will focus on the electrical design, simulation, and verification-validation testing of high speed products in the connector and/or cable assembly, radio system industry—targeting high speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure. You will be expected to independently work on projects in the areas of signal integrity for product and system design including modeling, simulation, testing and circuit board layout.  You will work collaboratively within a broader cross functional team of mechanical, manufacturing, & operations to execute leading edge products designs. Subject matter expert in signal integrity design, simulation and validation activities through product development cycles

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience

8+ years of relevant work experience in electrical design, RF design, or PCB design

Proficient with signal integrity analysis tools (Agilent ADS, Ansys HFSS, CST, or equivalent tools)

A solid understanding of electromagnetic theory and electrical circuit behavior

Strong analytical capabilities to interpret simulation and lab data to identify issues and provide solutions to fix identified problem.

Familiarity with printed circuit board design, fabrication and assembly.

Fluent in English (both verbal and written) to facilitate global communication both internally and with external customers.

This role combines full-stack web application engineering with hands-on AI and machine learning development, enabling you to deliver both the user-facing systems that serve federal employees and retirees and the AI-powered capabilities that make those systems smarter and more efficient over time.

Join us to build software that makes an impact and implement human-centered solutions that we can be proud to say we worked on together.

If you’re passionate about improving lives through digital products and services, Coforma is a great company for you.

$150,235 to $169,146 Annual Salary + Benefits + Growth Potential
Placement within this range will be based on the competency level of the candidate. An offer will be made at one of the following tiers:
  • Tier 1 — $150,235.80: Meets stated qualification and experience requirements. May need guidance and training beyond onboarding to perform the more complex functions of the role.
  • Tier 2 — $159,691.20: Experienced and fully competent. Will be able to independently perform key responsibilities of the role once onboarding is completed.
  • Tier 3 — $169,146.60: Highly experienced and can perform all responsibilities of the role at a higher level than expected once onboarding is completed.
To honor our company-wide equitable pay system, the posted salary range and corresponding tier salaries are non-negotiable.
This is a US-based remote position open to applicants in the states listed below. Some travel may be required.
To ensure we remain compliant with all state, county, and local employment and tax regulations, applicants must currently reside in one of the following states to be considered for employment with Coforma. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

You will be working on building a retirement benefits management system for federal government employees. Key areas this role will be responsible for include:
  • Application Engineering:
    • Build modular, responsive web applications using React and/or Vue.js in alignment with accessibility and UX best practices.
    • Design and implement secure, scalable APIs using TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, or Java (Spring Framework).
    • Integrate with enterprise systems via SOAP/RESTful APIs with robust error handling.
    • Implement authentication, authorization, and secure configuration in accordance with client agency security policies.
    • Optimize database access and performance using SQL Server and Entity Framework Core.
    • Add observability through structured logging, metrics, and tracing and support incident response with clear runbooks.
  • AI and Machine Learning:
    • Design and implement AI agents and large language model (LLM)-powered applications that automate and enhance retirement data workflows.
    • Build, evaluate, and maintain machine learning models for classification, prediction, and anomaly detection.
    • Integrate LLMs into production systems using prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks.
    • Develop and maintain data pipelines that ingest, validate, and transform large-scale structured and unstructured data.
    • Apply explainable AI practices appropriate for a regulated, auditable government environment.
    • Track model performance and manage the machine learning (ML) lifecycle using tools such as MLflow.
  • Collaboration and Delivery:
    • Participate in Agile ceremonies, conduct code reviews, and contribute to release planning and documentation.
    • Work across technical and policy teams to translate business requirements into reliable, AI-driven solutions.
    • Uphold software engineering best practices such as version control, CI/CD, testing, and peer review across both application and AI workstreams.

What We're Looking For

The strongest candidates bridge two worlds well: they can reason about a React component and a retrieval pipeline in the same conversation. The ideal engineer will read systems before rewriting them, evaluate models critically, and understand that in a mission-critical retirement system, reliability, security, and explainability matter as much as capability.


Who You Are and What You Know (Knowledge and Experience Requirements)
  • Full-time resident of the contiguous United States (must be legally authorized to work in the US now and in the future without sponsorship)
  • Ability to pass a Public Trust background check and any applicable background and/or security checks related to project requirements
  • Proficiency in React, Vue.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, ASP.NET Core, and Java (Spring Framework)
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with SQL Server as well as familiarity with EF Core
  • Experience with enterprise integrations including message queues, database RPC, REST, and SOAP APIs
  • Understanding of authentication, authorization, and security best practices
  • Hands-on experience building or deploying LLM-based solutions (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source models)
  • Familiarity with agentic AI patterns (tool use, planning, memory, and multi-step reasoning)
  • Experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and embedding-based retrieval
  • Experience using coding agents such as CoPilot or Claude Code
  • Effective prompt engineering and experience evaluating LLM outputs for reliability and correctness

Preferred Qualifications and Experience
  • 5+ years of experience building applications with open-source programming languages
  • 5+ years of experience working with modern frameworks, libraries, or runtimes
  • 5+ years of experience working with APIs and databases of various types
  • 5+ years of experience working with infrastructure tools and Infrastructure as Code
  • Experience developing software in a remote environment
  • Experience working in the digital services, federal government, or federal government contracting industries

Other

  • Internet: Will prioritize and maintain access to strong, reliable internet for the remote nature of our work, except when on vacation or holiday.
  • Security: Will keep the highest security practices to ensure privacy and security of Coforma and client information, given the nature of our work, even when on vacation.
  • Travel Flexibility: On request and with advanced notice, will attend in-person events such as meetings, workshops, and trainings as assigned for projects that require it.

jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman Instructional Designer / Train-the-Trainer Specialist to develop and deliver technical learning solutions for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role transforms subject matter expert knowledge, standard operating procedures, system releases, technical changes, and lessons learned into effective courses, labs, job aids, microlearning products, exercises, and performance-based assessments.

The Instructional Designer / Train-the-Trainer Specialist will apply adult-learning principles, accessible-content standards, technical-writing practices, and instructional-design methodologies to create practical learning experiences for Government IT personnel. The successful candidate will deliver virtual and classroom sessions, facilitate technical exercises, prepare instructors and subject matter experts to deliver training, and evaluate whether learners can apply new knowledge and skills in operational settings.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Instructional Designer / Train-the-Trainer Specialist will:

  • Conduct training-needs analyses and collaborate with subject matter experts to identify target audiences, performance gaps, learning requirements, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate complex technical information into clear, practical, and measurable learning objectives.
  • Convert subject matter expert knowledge, standard operating procedures, technical documentation, releases, migrations, upgrades, and lessons learned into structured learning products.
  • Design and develop instructor-led courses, virtual courses, eLearning, labs, simulations, exercises, demonstrations, job aids, reference guides, and microlearning.
  • Develop train-the-trainer programs that prepare instructors, coaches, and technical subject matter experts to deliver consistent and effective training.
  • Create course outlines, design documents, storyboards, instructor guides, learner guides, presentation materials, facilitator notes, lab instructions, and assessment plans.
  • Develop knowledge checks, quizzes, scenario-based exercises, practical demonstrations, performance tasks, and proficiency assessments.
  • Design assessments that measure whether learners can perform required technical tasks, not merely recall course content.
  • Tailor training content and delivery methods to specific systems, technologies, user roles, proficiency levels, and operational requirements.
  • Apply adult-learning principles and instructional-design methodologies throughout analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation.
  • Develop accessible training content that supports diverse learners and applicable accessibility requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are accurate, current, technically validated, clearly written, and consistently formatted.
  • Coordinate technical reviews and validation with subject matter experts, system owners, instructors, quality personnel, and Government stakeholders.
  • Incorporate reviewer comments, testing results, learner feedback, and lessons learned into updated courseware.
  • Deliver engaging virtual, classroom, side-by-side, pair-programming, workshop, lab, and blended-learning sessions.
  • Facilitate practical exercises, discussions, demonstrations, coaching sessions, and learner-assessment activities.
  • Observe and evaluate instructors or subject matter experts during practice delivery and provide constructive feedback.
  • Support pilot sessions, course testing, release-readiness training, and post-deployment learning activities.
  • Align training content with system releases, migrations, upgrades, modernization efforts, operational priorities, and workforce learning paths.
  • Coordinate course schedules, learner communications, enrollment information, prerequisites, technical access, training environments, and supporting materials.
  • Maintain course files, version histories, review records, source materials, accessibility documentation, assessments, and completion evidence.
  • Track participation, completion, assessment results, learner feedback, proficiency outcomes, and recommended improvement actions.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness and recommend improvements to content, delivery methods, exercises, assessments, and supporting resources.
  • Support technical knowledge transfer during transition-in and transition-out activities.
  • Protect sensitive Government, program, personnel, training, and technical information.

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Educational Technology, Adult Education, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience.

  • Experience in instructional design, technical training, curriculum development, train-the-trainer programs, technical writing, or adult education.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government programs.
  • Experience designing technical training for infrastructure, cloud, networking, cybersecurity, software, data, ITSM, or enterprise systems.
  • Experience working with technical subject matter experts to extract, organize, validate, and communicate complex knowledge.
  • Experience converting standard operating procedures, technical documentation, system releases, migrations, and lessons learned into training products.
  • Experience developing instructor-led training, virtual instructor-led training, eLearning, labs, simulations, job aids, microlearning, and assessments.
  • Experience developing train-the-trainer curricula and preparing instructors or subject matter experts to deliver courses.
  • Experience applying ADDIE, SAM, Bloom’s Taxonomy, backward design, adult-learning theory, or comparable instructional-design methodologies.
  • Experience developing performance-based assessments, scenario-based exercises, practical demonstrations, rubrics, and proficiency measures.
  • Experience facilitating virtual and classroom sessions, technical labs, workshops, pair-programming activities, or guided exercises.
  • Knowledge of Section 508 and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines applicable to electronic training content.
  • Experience developing accessible documents, presentations, multimedia, eLearning, and learner resources.
  • Experience with Articulate Storyline or Rise, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Microsoft 365, or comparable content-authoring tools.

  • Familiarity with ITIL Version 5 or ITIL 4 practices and enterprise IT service-management environments.

  • Ability to work independently while maintaining accountability, discretion, and consistent follow-through.

jobs.description:
We're hiring a Product Manager to own product scope and delivery across multiple concurrent client engagements at Bolder Apps. You'll work directly with US-based startups and established companies while our engineering teams, increasingly AI-augmented, build. We want someone who's done this before in an agency or consultancy setting, juggling different clients, different products, and different priorities without dropping the ball. If you've managed technical products where the client relationship and the delivery timeline both mattered, we want to talk.

About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

  • Own product scope and delivery for multiple concurrent client engagements, each with its own priorities, stakeholders, and roadmap
  • Run the day-to-day of software and mobile app development projects: sprint planning, backlog grooming, release coordination
  • Sit between the client and the engineering team. Translate business asks into technical scope and technical constraints back into plain language for the client
  • Track budget, timeline, and scope on every project and flag risk before it becomes a problem, not after
  • Coordinate QA, staging, and release handoffs so nothing ships without a real check
  • Keep project documentation, specs, and status current enough that anyone on the team can pick up context without a meeting
  • Run client-facing standups, demos, and status calls during US business hours
  • Push back on scope creep and unrealistic timelines instead of just absorbing them

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in software development. Technical project management experience is a plus.
  • Agency or consultancy background. You've managed multiple client accounts at once, each with different priorities, and you know how to context-switch without losing quality on any of them.
  • Mobile app development project experience. You understand iOS/Android release cycles, app store review timelines, and the extra coordination mobile adds versus a straightforward web project.
  • English proficiency at C1 or above. You'll be running client calls and writing specs that clients read directly, not just talking to internal teammates.
  • Available to overlap with US Eastern time. This isn't a "check in occasionally" role, it's live coordination during the client's business day.
  • Comfortable working with technical tooling: Jira, Linear, GitHub issues, or equivalent. You can read a technical spec or a bug report and know what it means for the timeline.
  • Direct communicator. When a project is slipping, you say so early, with a plan, not two weeks later with an excuse.
  • Comfortable with AI-augmented development workflows. You don't need to write code, but you understand what an agentic dev process changes about estimation and QA.

Benefits

  • Full-time, fully remote role, with overlap into US Eastern time for client coordination
  • Opportunity to work on building exciting products for the US market
  • Steady pipeline of client work as part of a growing team
  • Direct line to decision-makers, no extra layers between you and the people who own the outcome
  • A peer network of other operators working on overlapping projects

jobs.title: AI-Native Platform Engineer - DevOps, Security & Compliance | Zenara Health
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara HealthLocation: Remote - India Type: Full-time Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time.
jobs.description:
Description

AI-Native Platform Engineer — DevOps, Security & Compliance, Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. We work with sensitive healthcare data, so reliability, security, access control, backups, and compliance are not side concerns — they are part of the product ..

We are a startup, not a department. We move quickly, but we need to move with discipline because customers and patient data depend on us.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Platform Engineer to own DevOps, production reliability, security operations, and compliance foundations.

This is not a narrow DevOps ticket role.

This is not a compliance paperwork role.

This is a hands-on platform ownership role.

Today, platform, security, and compliance work is spread across people who are already covering other responsibilities. We need one full-time owner who keeps systems running, backed up, updated, monitored, secure, and HIPAA-ready ..

You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and a part-time senior security and compliance consultant ..

Here is the test: can you prove that backups restore, deployments roll back, secrets are controlled, alerts work, access is locked down, and compliance evidence exists before a customer asks for it?

We are looking for a calm, methodical operator who automates the boring things, finds the scary things, and closes the important gaps.

Our Platform Vision

We are building an AI-native healthcare software company. That means our platform must support speed without creating unacceptable risk.

The platform should make the safe path the easy path: reliable deployments, observable systems, tested recovery, controlled access, documented evidence, automated checks, and continuous security awareness.

You will help build this operating system, including:

  • Deployment and rollback workflows
  • Monitoring and alerting
  • Backups and restore verification
  • Secrets and access management
  • Cloud configuration reviews
  • Security checks on new code and infrastructure
  • HIPAA compliance evidence
  • Vendor and AI-tool risk tracking
  • Daily automated security and compliance checks
  • Incident response basics
  • Platform documentation and runbooks

The goal is to create a platform that lets a small engineering team move fast without gambling with production or patient data.

What You’ll Do

  • Own production platform operations: deployments, monitoring, alerts, updates, and reliability.
  • Own backups and regularly prove restores work .
  • Manage access control, secrets, cloud configuration, and security checks.
  • Organize HIPAA-related policies, controls, audit evidence, and customer security documentation .
  • Identify, prioritize, and close platform and security gaps.
  • Build a daily security and compliance agent that sweeps systems and reports findings .
  • Work weekly with a senior security and compliance consultant.
  • Create runbooks, checklists, and automation for repeatable operational work.
  • Support incident response, recovery, and prevention.
  • Help free other team members from ad hoc platform and security work.

What We’re Looking For

  • Hands-on experience keeping startup systems and platforms running.
  • Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, monitoring, backups, and recovery experience.
  • Experience with access control, secrets management, cloud configuration, and security basics.
  • Ability to prove backups restore and systems recover.
  • Ability to code and automate routine platform or security tasks.
  • Comfort using AI agents to build automation and operational workflows.
  • Calm judgment during incidents and production issues.
  • Strong ownership and documentation habits.
  • Practical mindset: you can prioritize risks rather than create endless theoretical lists.

Our Current Stack

  • Azure AKS / Kubernetes
  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform
  • Helm
  • CI pipelines
  • PostgreSQL
  • Redis
  • Some AWS
  • TypeScript applications using Node.js / Hono and React
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Healthcare data, HIPAA, patient-data protection, vendor risk, and AI-tool risk

What “AI-Native Platform Engineering” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to inspect configurations, draft runbooks, and automate checks.
  • Build recurring security and compliance sweeps.
  • Use AI to accelerate infrastructure review without blindly trusting it.
  • Create workflows that surface risks before humans remember to check.
  • Automate operational evidence gathering.
  • Maintain human approval for sensitive actions.
  • Keep permissions, secrets, and production access tightly controlled.
  • AI should help you create a more reliable platform, not become another unmanaged risk.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or HIPAA experience.
  • Security background, such as cloud security, SOC, or incident response.
  • Compliance framework experience, especially HIPAA or SOC 2.
  • Azure and AKS production experience.
  • Kubernetes at production scale .

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will review the current setup, agree the top platform and security gaps, demonstrate a backup restore and deployment rollback, and produce a prioritized improvement list ..

Within your first 90 days, monitoring and alerting will be in place, top security gaps will be closed, the first version of the daily security/compliance agent will be running, and compliance evidence will be organized ..

Over time, success means Zenara has a reliable, secure, HIPAA-ready platform, clean customer security reviews, and platform work no longer depends on non-specialists.

Schedule

Live collaboration requires overlap with the US team. For engineering roles, the current collaboration window is approximately 6:00 PM to 12:00 AM IST, though final expectations should be confirmed during the hiring process.

Production incidents and critical deployments may occasionally require availability outside normal collaboration windows.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • Support from a senior security expert

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Is calm, methodical, and reliable.
  • Likes automating operational work.
  • Cares about security but can still move pragmatically.
  • Wants broad ownership across DevOps, security, and compliance.
  • Can operate independently without a large platform team.
  • Understands that healthcare data requires discipline.

You may struggle if you want a large ops team around you, only want one narrow specialty, treat compliance as paperwork only, cannot automate, or are careless with secrets and access.

If you want to build the operating foundation for an AI-native health-tech company, we would love to hear from you.
