In 2025, Level acquired BAM Strategy — expanding our capabilities into digital experience, CRM strategy, personalization, and loyalty. The result is a fully integrated growth engine that connects acquisition to retention, media to lifecycle, and performance to long-term customer value.

Today, our 250-person team operates fully remote across the U.S. and Canada, supporting 150+ ambitious brands.

Your Role (and Impact)

Sitting within Level's Martech & Analytics team, this person takes a brief and runs with it. They own their work from setup through deployment, make sound judgment calls without being told every step, and bring forward recommendations when something could work better. The ideal candidate is a self-directed, proven operator who can step into an existing instance, diagnose what is broken, and fix it with minimal oversight.

  • Own the build, QA, and deployment of email campaigns in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer end to end, ensuring every send is accurate, on time, and on brand
  • Translate briefs and journey maps into working builds, filling gaps with sound judgment and raising questions early when a brief is incomplete or a requirement won't work as written
  • Configure audience targeting, personalization, and dynamic content within existing templates and data schemas to improve relevance and engagement
  • Manage the send calendar, including scheduling, dependency sequencing, and deployment-readiness checks for rendering, links, suppression, and compliance (CAN-SPAM, TCPA, CASL)
  • Configure and maintain multi-step, multi-channel journeys (email, plus SMS and push where in scope), implementing segmentation, flow control, and decision logic
  • Run journey QA on logic, timing, and audience entry/exit conditions before activation, so issues are caught before they reach customers
  • Audit existing campaign and journey builds, workflows, and data schemas, diagnose what is broken, redundant, or misconfigured, and fix it without disrupting live sends
  • Recommend improvements to journey logic, segmentation, and program performance, explaining the marketing rationale as well as the technical approach
  • Bring a proposed solution, not just the problem, when escalating structural or data-quality issues that require architecture-level decisions
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and client stakeholders, setting expectations, flagging risks, and explaining technical trade-offs in plain language
  • Document builds and fixes so the team has a clean, reliable handoff trail

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Haves:

  • Hands-on production experience in Adobe Campaign (Classic or Standard) and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform
  • A track record of owning CRM work end to end with minimal oversight; you are comfortable being the person who makes it work
  • Proven ability to step into an existing instance built by others, diagnose problems, and repair prior configuration rather than only building greenfield
  • Strong lifecycle marketing understanding: you can explain why a journey is designed a certain way and spot when it isn't serving the customer or the business
  • Sound judgment on when to make a call yourself and when to escalate, with the confidence to push back on a brief that won't work
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for email template troubleshooting and customization
  • Working knowledge of email/SMS compliance regulations

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (strongly preferred), such as Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, AMPscript, and SQL query activities
  • Experience with additional CRM and marketing automation platforms, such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, Klaviyo, or Braze
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Platform segments, schemas, and audience activation
  • SQL or scripting (JavaScript) for workflow customization and troubleshooting
  • Telecom or B2C subscription-industry CRM experience
  • Agency-side or client-facing experience

Education & Experience

Must-Haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, or a related field (or 4 additional years of equivalent professional experience)
  • 5 to 8 years of hands-on CRM and lifecycle marketing experience, with significant production work in Adobe Experience Cloud email and journey platforms

Preferred:

  • Adobe Certified Professional or Expert in Adobe Campaign or Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification (e.g., Email Specialist, Developer, or Consultant)
  • Agency experience supporting CRM programs for multiple clients simultaneously

AI Expectations

At Level, proficiency with AI tools is a core part of your role—not a nice-to-have. Your success in this position depends not only on your functional expertise, but also on your ability to actively integrate AI into how you work.

You are expected to:

  • Experiment continuously with AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) to improve the speed, quality, and impact of your work (e.g., draft briefs, summarize research, analyze data trends, generate initial strategic frameworks, identify patterns in large datasets).
  • Proactively document and share what you learn—your prompts, process improvements, and use cases—so others can benefit and we can grow together.
  • Approach AI with an iterative mindset, refining how you apply it to your work over time. The first idea is rarely the best; testing, tweaking, and improving is part of the process.
  • Lean into discomfort, especially when tools or workflows feel unfamiliar. Growth happens when you're stretching beyond what's comfortable or routine.

AI is not a shortcut—it’s a skillset. You’re expected to use it as a force multiplier for creativity, strategy, and execution, not as a substitute for thoughtful work. As our tools evolve, your ability to adapt and lead through change will be a key part of your performance and growth at Level.

Our Core Values

  • No Ego, All In
    We don't do "that's not my job." We win together, step in where needed, and care more about the outcome than the org chart.
  • Better Every Day
    We want the feedback, even when it stings. We test, learn, adapt, and keep raising the bar.
  • Relentless for Results
    Activity is nothing without outcomes. We care about the work that moves the business forward.
  • Driven by Truth
    We challenge assumptions, follow the data, and tell clients what they need to hear, not just what is easy to say.

Perks & Benefits

At Level, we support our people across the U.S. and Canada with benefits designed to promote flexibility, wellbeing, and long-term growth.

  • Fully remote across the U.S. & Canada, plus monthly WFH stipend and Summer Fridays
  • Generous time off, including unlimited PTO (U.S.), competitive vacation (Canada), and parental/family leave options
  • Comprehensive health benefits, mental health support, and company-paid disability & life coverage
  • Employer retirement contributions (401(k) in the U.S., RRSP match in Canada)
  • Quarterly performance reviews and career advancement opportunities

Remote First

This role is open to U.S. and Canada residents and is fully remote. Occasional travel may be required for company events and team working sessions. We are unable to sponsor visas at this time.

Level Is Built on Inclusion

We celebrate what makes you, you. Level Agency provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities during the recruitment process. If you require an accommodation, please let us know during your application or interview process.

Ready to Apply?

We care more about what you can do than whether your career path was perfectly linear.

Let's build something together.

AI HIRING DISCLAIMER

We use AI-assisted tools to support parts of our hiring process, including resume screening and interview note-taking or summarization. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment. All hiring decisions are made by Level's hiring team.

Le ou la spécialiste CRM senior est une personne technique, pragmatique et à l’aise en production, qui crée, déploie et maintient des campagnes courriel et des parcours client dans Adobe Experience Cloud pour les clients de Level. Ce n’est pas un rôle d’ingénierie pure : nous cherchons quelqu’un qui comprend pourquoi un parcours existe, et pas seulement comment le construire. Cette personne apporte à chaque projet le sens du cycle de vie client d’une vraie marketeuse ou d’un vrai marketeur.

À propos de Level

Level Agency est une agence de marketing de performance propulsée par l’IA, conçue pour les marques prêtes à faire voler en éclats les succès d’hier.

Nous aidons des marques complexes, dont le cycle de décision est long, à surpasser leur dernier résultat grâce à l’IA, à la science des données, à la créativité et à une itération acharnée.

Nous sommes spécialisés dans les marchés où les enjeux sont élevés et où les parcours sont complexes : éducation, technologies B2B, services financiers, santé, produits de grande consommation (PGC), commerce électronique, et plus encore. Notre travail couvre tout l’écosystème de la performance : planification et achat média, créatifs de performance, SEO et recherche IA, CRM et automatisation, et analytique avancée.

En 2025, Level a acquis BAM Strategy, élargissant ses capacités à l’expérience numérique, à la stratégie CRM, à la personnalisation et à la fidélisation. Le résultat : un moteur de croissance entièrement intégré, qui relie l’acquisition à la rétention, les médias au cycle de vie, et la performance à la valeur client à long terme.

Aujourd’hui, notre équipe de 250 personnes travaille entièrement à distance partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, au service de plus de 150 marques ambitieuses.

Votre rôle (et votre impact)

Au sein de l’équipe Martech et analytique de Level, cette personne prend un mandat et le mène à terme. Elle assume la responsabilité de son travail, de la configuration jusqu’au déploiement, prend de bonnes décisions sans qu’on lui dicte chaque étape et propose des recommandations lorsqu’une approche pourrait être améliorée. La candidate ou le candidat idéal est une personne autonome et éprouvée, capable de prendre en charge une instance existante, de diagnostiquer ce qui ne fonctionne pas et de le corriger avec très peu de supervision.

  • Assumer de bout en bout la conception, l’assurance qualité et le déploiement des campagnes courriel dans Adobe Campaign (Classic ou Standard) et/ou Adobe Journey Optimizer, en veillant à ce que chaque envoi soit exact, livré à temps et fidèle à la marque
  • Traduire les mandats et les cartes de parcours en builds fonctionnels, en comblant les lacunes avec un bon jugement et en soulevant rapidement des questions lorsqu’un mandat est incomplet ou qu’une exigence ne fonctionnera pas telle qu’elle est rédigée
  • Configurer le ciblage d’audience, la personnalisation et le contenu dynamique à partir des gabarits et des schémas de données existants, afin d’améliorer la pertinence et l’engagement
  • Gérer le calendrier d’envois, y compris la planification, le séquencement des dépendances et les vérifications de préparation au déploiement (rendu, liens, listes de suppression et conformité : CAN-SPAM, TCPA, LCAP/CASL)
  • Configurer et maintenir des parcours multiétapes et multicanaux (courriel, ainsi que SMS et notifications push lorsqu’ils font partie du mandat), en mettant en œuvre la segmentation, le contrôle des flux et la logique décisionnelle
  • Effectuer l’assurance qualité des parcours (logique, synchronisation, conditions d’entrée et de sortie des audiences) avant l’activation, afin de repérer les problèmes avant qu’ils n’atteignent les clients
  • Auditer les campagnes, parcours, flux de travail et schémas de données existants, diagnostiquer ce qui est défectueux, redondant ou mal configuré, et le corriger sans perturber les envois en cours
  • Recommander des améliorations à la logique des parcours, à la segmentation et à la performance des programmes, en expliquant la justification marketing autant que l’approche technique
  • Présenter une solution proposée, et pas seulement le problème, lorsqu’on escalade des enjeux structurels ou de qualité des données qui exigent des décisions d’architecture
  • Communiquer clairement avec les équipes internes et les parties prenantes des clients, en fixant les attentes, en signalant les risques et en expliquant les compromis techniques en langage simple
  • Documenter les builds et les correctifs afin que l’équipe dispose d’une trace de transfert claire et fiable

Compétences et qualifications

Incontournables :

  • Expérience pratique en production dans Adobe Campaign (Classic ou Standard) et/ou Adobe Journey Optimizer / Adobe Experience Platform
  • Un historique démontrable de travaux CRM menés de bout en bout avec une supervision minimale : vous êtes la personne qui fait en sorte que ça fonctionne
  • Capacité éprouvée à prendre en charge une instance conçue par d’autres, à diagnostiquer les problèmes et à réparer une configuration existante, plutôt que de seulement bâtir à partir de zéro
  • Solide compréhension du marketing de cycle de vie : vous pouvez expliquer pourquoi un parcours est conçu d’une certaine façon et repérer quand il ne sert pas le client ou l’entreprise
  • Bon jugement pour décider quand trancher vous-même et quand escalader, avec l’assurance nécessaire pour contester un mandat qui ne fonctionnera pas
  • Communication écrite et verbale claire, y compris pour expliquer des enjeux techniques à des interlocuteurs non techniques
  • Connaissance pratique de HTML/CSS pour le dépannage et la personnalisation des gabarits de courriel
  • Connaissance pratique de la réglementation en matière de courriels et de SMS

Atouts :

  • Expérience pratique dans Salesforce Marketing Cloud (fortement souhaitée), notamment Journey Builder, Email Studio, Automation Studio, AMPscript et activités de requêtes SQL
  • Expérience avec d’autres plateformes de CRM et d’automatisation du marketing, comme Microsoft Dynamics 365, Klaviyo ou Braze
  • Expérience avec les segments, les schémas et l’activation d’audiences dans Adobe Experience Platform
  • SQL ou scripts (JavaScript) pour la personnalisation et le dépannage des flux de travail
  • Expérience en CRM dans le secteur des télécommunications ou des abonnements B2C
  • Expérience en agence ou en contact direct avec les clients

Formation et expérience

Incontournables :

  • Baccalauréat en marketing, systèmes d’information, informatique, administration des affaires ou dans un domaine connexe (ou 4 années supplémentaires d’expérience professionnelle équivalente)
  • De 5 à 8 ans d’expérience pratique en CRM et en marketing de cycle de vie, dont un volume important de travaux en production sur les plateformes de courriel et de parcours d’Adobe Experience Cloud

Atouts :

  • Certification Adobe Certified Professional ou Expert en Adobe Campaign ou Adobe Journey Optimizer
  • Certification Salesforce Marketing Cloud (p. ex. Email Specialist, Developer ou Consultant)
  • Expérience en agence, à soutenir simultanément les programmes CRM de plusieurs clients

Attentes en matière d’IA

Chez Level, la maîtrise des outils d’IA fait partie intégrante de votre rôle, et n’est pas un simple atout. Votre réussite dans ce poste repose non seulement sur votre expertise fonctionnelle, mais aussi sur votre capacité à intégrer activement l’IA à votre façon de travailler.

On s’attend à ce que vous :

  • Expérimentiez continuellement avec des outils d’IA (p. ex. ChatGPT, Midjourney, Claude, Perplexity) pour améliorer la rapidité, la qualité et l’impact de votre travail (p. ex. rédiger des mandats, résumer des recherches, analyser des tendances dans les données, générer des cadres stratégiques initiaux, repérer des tendances dans de grands ensembles de données)
  • Documentiez et partagiez de façon proactive ce que vous apprenez (vos requêtes, vos améliorations de processus et vos cas d’usage), afin que les autres en profitent et que nous progressions ensemble
  • Abordiez l’IA avec un état d’esprit itératif, en affinant votre façon de l’utiliser au fil du temps. La première idée est rarement la meilleure : tester, ajuster et améliorer fait partie du processus
  • Acceptiez l’inconfort, surtout lorsque les outils ou les flux de travail vous sont peu familiers. La croissance survient lorsqu’on dépasse ce qui est confortable ou routinier

L’IA n’est pas un raccourci, c’est une compétence. On s’attend à ce que vous l’utilisiez comme multiplicateur de force pour la créativité, la stratégie et l’exécution, et non comme substitut à un travail réfléchi. À mesure que nos outils évoluent, votre capacité à vous adapter et à mener le changement sera un élément clé de votre performance et de votre croissance chez Level.

Nos valeurs fondamentales

  • Pas d’ego, tous engagés
    Chez nous, pas de « ce n’est pas mon travail ». Nous gagnons ensemble, nous intervenons là où c’est nécessaire et nous nous soucions davantage du résultat que de l’organigramme.
  • Meilleurs chaque jour

  • Guidés par la vérité

Avantages sociaux

Chez Level, nous soutenons nos employés partout aux États-Unis et au Canada grâce à des avantages conçus pour favoriser la flexibilité, le bien-être et la croissance à long terme.

  • Télétravail complet partout aux États-Unis et au Canada, avec allocation mensuelle de télétravail et vendredis d’été

  • Cotisations de l’employeur à la retraite (401(k) aux États-Unis, cotisation de contrepartie au REER au Canada)

Remote First : le télétravail d’abord

Ce poste est ouvert aux résidents des États-Unis et du Canada et se fait entièrement en télétravail. Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des événements de l’entreprise et des séances de travail d’équipe. Nous ne sommes pas en mesure de parrainer des visas pour le moment.

Level mise sur l’inclusion

Nous célébrons ce qui fait de vous qui vous êtes. Level Agency offre des mesures d’adaptation raisonnables aux personnes candidates en situation de handicap pendant le processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin de mesures d’adaptation, faites-le-nous savoir lors de votre candidature ou de votre entrevue.

ABOUT US

City Science is an SME founded in 2015 with a core mission of delivering decarbonisation. We help organisations who are committed to decarbonisation achieve meaningful and quantifiable carbon reductions quickly and efficiently.

Our software and product development team produce innovative and uniquely insightful digital tools, like Cadence and our decarbonisation tool, to successfully deliver our projects.

We work collaboratively across our consultancy team made up of transport, energy, sustainability, carbon accounting and applied data science specialists to provide integrated solutions to our clients. Our range of clients is extensive and includes forward-thinking local authorities like Oxfordshire County Council, sub-national transport bodies like England’s Economic Heartland and national organisations like Department of Energy Security & Net Zero (see our full list of projects here).

We have a series of emerging services lines (which are all underpinned by market areas), including the following focused within:

  • Net Zero Strategies & Roadmaps (e.g. Area-based future decarbonisation pathways, green growth strategies)
  • Net Zero Development (e.g. Transport evidence bases for Local Plans and infrastructure strategies)
  • Sustainable Transport (e.g. Local cycle & walking infrastructure plans (LCWIPs), bus service planning and movement strategies)
  • Net Zero Transport (e.g. Electric Vehicle charging strategies and net zero transport pathways)
  • Transport Modelling (e.g. Strategic, freight, micro-simulation and active travel modelling)
  • Heat & Retrofit (e.g. Heat pumps sizing, internet of things)
  • Energy Planning (e.g. Local Areas Energy Plans)
  • Energy Modelling (e.g. DNO capacity, building monitoring/benchmarking)
  • Data Engineering (e.g. Future technology roadmaps)
  • Carbon Accounting (e.g. Business decarbonisation, circular economy)

About the Role

We are looking to grow our team of developers working across the full stack to deliver cutting edge applications and tools to support our decarbonisation mission. This role requires highly talented individuals who can take a proactive role in problem solving. Successful candidates must be able to show extremely high aptitude in mathematics and analytical problem solving.

Existing coding skills are not required but are desirable and driven candidates with self-taught skills are particularly encouraged to apply. City Science predominantly uses JavaScript and Python, but other languages are also used, and all experience is considered. Experience working with cloud-based services is also desirable. Experience using AI to support software development is welcome but we expect candidates to demonstrate and develop independent skills, motivation and communication throughout the application process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a range of applications and tools that support clients to plan, monitor, evidence and visualise their decarbonisation pathway
  • Energy Modelling (e.g. Home Energy Model, building physics/benchmarking)
  • Support staff internally to provide insights with a high level of automation/digitisation, meeting or exceeding industry standard practices
  • Manage the full development stack and work flexibly to meet emerging need
  • Collaborate across teams and grow relationships between consultancy professionals and software developers
  • Drive new technologies and integrated ways of working
  • Communicate the case for decarbonisation through cutting edge software tools

Requirements

  • BSc 2:1 or better in a STEM subject (1st class degree, PhD or higher-level qualification desirable)
  • Able to demonstrate very strong mathematical and numerical skills
  • Drive to learn and develop coding and technology skills across the full stack (experience and/or self-taught skills desirable)

· Excellent problem solver

  • Can demonstrate ability to work as part of a team, collaborating effectively with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Proven science communicator to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Passion to make the case for, and execute, decarbonisation

Rewards & Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on a diverse range of projects across the consultancy business
  • Opportunity for career progression
  • 25 days annual leave entitlement
  • Competitive salary (based on skills and experience)
  • Ongoing mentoring, training and support from senior professionals within the business (including towards professional chartership)
  • Paid membership of a maximum of two institutions

· Flexible working arrangements

  • Membership of our group pension scheme

FURTHER INFORMATION

We are building a team who are motivated by collaboration with the desire to solve problems for our customers. We want people to own their field of responsibility, take decisions, be pro-active and have pride in everything they do. Our team of experts includes prize-winning consultants, experienced technologists and distinguished academics.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, and we passionately believe in supporting each person reach their full potential.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  2. If successful after the first screening process you will be invited to take part in numerical or aptitude test

This one-year position will focus on building and launching a system for preserving and sharing legal scholarship using Digital Object Identifiers (DOIs) within the service.

Perma.cc has provided web citation preservation to the legal community for over a decade. The adoption of DOI—standard elsewhere in scholarly publishing—is increasingly critical in law, with Bluebook requirements on the horizon. The project will design a plan for incorporating DOI into the ecosystem, coordinate the planning and rollout of DOI minting, and document sustainable operational models for the future.

As the Perma.cc Legal Digital Scholarship Project Manager, your responsibilities will include:

Analysis, Requirements Gathering & Standards Tracking

  • Review current practices at HLSL and Perma.cc and identify requirements for DOI assignment to legal scholarship and web materials.
  • Track developments in legal citation standards related to DOI and ensure project alignment.

Evaluation & System/Workflow Design

  • Evaluate options for DOI minting (such as CrossRef membership or other registration methods) and make recommendations.
  • Develop and document criteria and workflows for DOI assignment, in line with existing standards in other fields.

Stakeholder Engagement & Outreach

  • Lead outreach to law journals, faculty, clinics, and other stakeholders to establish procedures for DOI registration.
  • Serve as primary liaison to DOI registration agencies to arrange necessary permissions and clarify technical needs.

Technical Collaboration & Implementation

  • Collaborate with technical teams at Perma.cc and HLSL to design and pilot the integration of DOI processes into existing systems.

Documentation, Policy Development & Reporting

  • Prepare clear documentation and policy recommendations for the ongoing management of DOIs at HLSL and Perma.cc.

Job Description:

Position Summary

RxSafe / Eyecon is seeking a motivated, results-driven Inside Sales Representative to expand the use of Eyecon pharmacy counting and verification technology and create new opportunities for the broader RxSafe portfolio. This position will spend the majority of its time proactively calling and emailing pharmacies, following up on inbound and marketing leads, conducting virtual discovery and product presentations, and moving qualified Eyecon opportunities through the sales process.


Eyecon is purpose-built for pharmacy workflow and helps pharmacies improve prescription counting accuracy, efficiency, and documentation through visual counting and verification technology. The Inside Sales Representative will become a product expert who can clearly connect Eyecon's capabilities to the day-to-day challenges faced by pharmacy owners, pharmacists, technicians, and managers.


In addition to selling Eyecon, this role will identify pharmacy needs that may be a fit for RxSafe automation solutions, qualify those opportunities, and generate high-quality leads for the RxSafe sales team. This is a fully remote position with no routine customer visits. Success requires a self-starter who is highly organized, persistent, comfortable working independently, and able to create structure and momentum in a remote environment.


About RxSafe / Eyecon

RxSafe provides pharmacy automation and technology solutions designed to help pharmacies improve accuracy, safety, efficiency, workflow, and medication adherence. The product portfolio includes Eyecon visual counting and verification solutions along with RxSafe pharmacy automation systems. This role is an important front-line position for introducing pharmacies to our technology, growing Eyecon sales, and creating new opportunities across the RxSafe portfolio.


Key Responsibilities

Eyecon Sales

  • Own the inside sales process for Eyecon opportunities, from initial prospecting and qualification through virtual presentation, quoting, follow-up, negotiation, and close.
  • Conduct high-volume outbound calls and targeted email outreach to independent, community, and other pharmacy prospects.
  • Follow up quickly and consistently on inbound leads, marketing campaigns, trade-show leads, and other sales inquiries.
  • Conduct discovery conversations to understand prescription volume, current counting processes, workflow challenges, business needs, purchasing requirements, and decision-makers.
  • Present and demonstrate Eyecon virtually, clearly communicating its value in pharmacy accuracy, efficiency, workflow, visual verification, and documentation.
  • Develop quotes, manage follow-up, address objections, and advance qualified opportunities through the sales pipeline.
  • Achieve established Eyecon revenue, activity, pipeline, and customer acquisition goals.
    •

RxSafe Lead Generation

  • Identify customer needs and workflow challenges that may be a fit for RxSafe pharmacy automation solutions.
  • Introduce the broader RxSafe product portfolio at a high level and create interest in relevant solutions.
  • Qualify, document, and hand off high-quality RxSafe opportunities to the appropriate sales representative.
  • Coordinate with the RxSafe sales team to ensure effective lead handoff, follow-up, and visibility into opportunity progression.

  • Maintain a disciplined cadence of phone, email, and virtual follow-up activity.
  • Build and manage an organized sales pipeline, prioritizing opportunities based on fit, urgency, and likelihood to close.
  • Maintain accurate and timely records of contacts, activities, opportunities, next steps, and lead progression within the CRM and company systems.

Estimated Travel: Approximately five trade shows annually, plus occasional company meetings or training.

• High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong phone presence and confidence initiating outbound sales conversations.
  • Ability to quickly build rapport and establish credibility with pharmacy professionals and business owners.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and disciplined, with the ability to thrive in a fully remote work environment with limited day-to-day supervision.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Provides senior level support for complex analysis and investigations to identify, assess, and mitigate insider risks affecting Molina Healthcare’s employees, members, operations, systems, data, and reputation. This role integrates technical and behavioral information, advises leaders and cross-functional partners, and advances monitoring, investigative, reporting, and risk-reduction capabilities to strengthen the Insider Threat Program.

ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES:

  • Leads the identification, triage, analysis, and investigation of insider threat indicators and anomalous activity to enable timely, defensible risk decisions.
  • Analyzes and correlates complex technical and non-technical information from user activity monitoring, user and entity behavior analytics, data loss prevention, insider risk management, security information and event management, endpoint telemetry, Human Resources information, and other enterprise sources.
  • Conducts proactive threat hunting and develops hypotheses, timelines, link analyses, behavior profiles, and threat assessments to identify emerging risks before incidents occur.
  • Leads complex insider threat inquiries and investigations from initiation through closure, including interviews, evidence gathering, case documentation, risk assessments, executive summaries, and recommendations.
  • Presents findings and mitigation strategies to leaders and program stakeholders and ensures investigations follow applicable policies, privacy requirements, legal obligations, and ethical standards.
  • Develops and enhances detection use cases, investigative methodologies, operating procedures, dashboards, metrics, and performance reporting to improve program effectiveness.
  • Identifies monitoring, detection, reporting, and investigative gaps and supports implementation and optimization of analytical technologies, automation, and other program capabilities.
  • Contributes to policies, standards, procedures, awareness materials, audits, assessments, tabletop exercises, and maturity initiatives that strengthen insider risk management.
  • Partners with Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Information Security, Corporate Security, Internal Audit, and business leadership on cross-functional investigations and risk mitigation.
  • Communicates complex insider risk issues to technical and non-technical audiences and provides subject matter guidance, training, and awareness to promote reporting and reduce risk.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • At least 5 years of experience in insider threat, counterintelligence, digital forensics, intelligence analysis, corporate investigations, cyber threat intelligence, or a related field, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Experience leading investigations involving technical and behavioral indicators and preparing executive-level reports and briefings.
  • Experience analyzing information from data loss prevention, user and entity behavior analytics, security information and event management, endpoint detection and response, insider risk management, user activity monitoring, email security, or comparable security platforms.
  • Advanced knowledge of insider threat methods, investigative techniques, risk management principles, cybersecurity concepts, data protection controls, security operations, and privacy and compliance considerations related to employee monitoring.
  • Strong analytical, critical-thinking, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze large volumes of information, develop actionable conclusions, communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, and handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Global Counter-Insider Threat Professional, Certified Insider Threat Analyst, Certified Insider Threat Program Manager, or comparable credentials.
  • Experience applying artificial intelligence, automation, and data analytics to improve investigative efficiency.
  • Experience with insider risk management, threat analytics, case management, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience in healthcare, another regulated industry, intelligence, military, law enforcement, or corporate investigations.

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

Benefitfocus, Inc., a Voya company, is a leading provider of cloud-based benefits software solutions for consumers, employers, insurance carriers and brokers. Benefitfocus has served numerous consumers on its platform that consists of an integrated portfolio of products and services enabling clients to shop, enroll, manage and exchange benefits information more efficiently. Get to Know the Opportunity:

The Partnership Executive serves as the strategic business owner and executive sponsor for a portfolio of voluntary carrier and ecosystem partners. This role is responsible for maximizing partner value through relationship management, growth strategy, commercialization, governance, contracting, and cross-functional leadership.

The Partnership Executive develops and executes strategies that drive revenue growth, partner retention, platform adoption, and innovation while ensuring alignment between partner objectives and organizational goals. Acting as a trusted advisor to senior executives and key partner stakeholders, this leader identifies opportunities to expand existing partnerships, foster new strategic relationships, influence product direction, and deliver measurable business outcomes for partners, customers, and Voya.

Strategic Partnership Management

Governance & Risk Management

  • Analyze sales, enrollment, revenue, premium, and other partnership performance metrics.

jobs.description:
Olá, nós somos o CESAR!

Somos um centro de inovação e de educação que há quase 30 anos forma pessoas e impulsiona organizações, potencializando suas estratégias digitais. Resolvemos problemas complexos e desafiadores em um ambiente de trabalho descontraído, descentralizado e repleto de benefícios para nossos colaboradores, que atuam como protagonistas, interagindo diretamente com clientes de escala global.

Como Pessoa Engenheira de Dados (Ontologista), sua missão será criar ontologias, taxonomias e estruturas de relações semânticas robustas. Você unirá o mundo da Engenharia de Dados com a modelagem do conhecimento, assegurando que as informações ofereçam uma cobertura abrangente para ingestão e inferência por máquinas.

Buscamos um profissional capaz de compreender processos complexos e traduzi-los de forma simples, expandindo técnicas de recuperação de dados e atuando diretamente com IA Generativa e Grafos de Conhecimento. Você fará parte de um time ágil, otimizando pipelines e garantindo a qualidade do produto de ponta a ponta. Topa? Vamos nessa!

Como será o seu dia a dia (Responsabilidades)

  • Ontologia e Modelagem Semântica: Criar ontologias, taxonomias e modelos de dados lógicos, semanticamente ricos e extensíveis. Garantir a cobertura de subdomínios para inferência de máquinas, atuar na otimização de Grafos de Conhecimento e criar novos esquemas utilizando IA Generativa.
  • Engenharia de Dados e Pipelines: Desenvolver produtos analíticos utilizando Airflow, DataProc, PySpark e BigQuery (GCP), aplicando padrões de ingestão streaming e batch sob princípios sólidos de Data Warehouse.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Realizar mapeamento, linhagem de dados e documentação dos fluxos de informação. Proporcionar visibilidade sobre problemas de qualidade e trabalhar com os donos do negócio para resolvê-los.
  • Otimização e DevOps: Otimizar soluções existentes (pipelines e infraestrutura) buscando alto desempenho, segurança e baixo custo. Atuar em um ambiente Ágil com entregas frequentes utilizando TDD e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Comunicação e Liderança Técnica: Coordenar projetos multifuncionais, comunicando requisitos de conhecimento para equipes de engenharia. Compreender processos complexos, defender soluções bem projetadas e manter-se atualizado sobre o domínio dos produtos, IA e serviços conectados.

O que precisamos que você tenha (Requisitos Obrigatórios)

  • Experiência Prática: Atuação comprovada no mercado (2 anos ou mais) em Engenharia de Dados, trabalhando desde o conceito até as operações em produção.
  • Recuperação e Modelagem: Habilidades comprovadas em técnicas de recuperação e pesquisa de dados, com base sólida para alinhar as melhores práticas de modelagem de ontologias em toda a organização.
  • Ecossistema Cloud (GCP) e Dados: Experiência na construção de pipelines escaláveis e custo-efetivos utilizando Google BigQuery, ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow/Astronomer) e bancos de dados relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server).
  • Streaming e Mensageria: Vivência com plataformas de streaming de dados em tempo real, como Apache Kafka e GCP Pub/Sub.
  • Cultura DevOps: Ferramentas de CI/CD e infraestrutura como código, incluindo Tekton, GitHub Actions, Git/GitHub, Terraform e Docker.
  • Metodologia Ágil: Ferramentas de gerenciamento de projetos como Atlassian Jira.
  • Idioma:Inglês Avançado para comunicação diária com times globais.

Será um diferencial se você tiver

  • Certificações Profissionais ativas do Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Mestrado ou pós-graduação equivalente em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência/Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.

Aqui no CESAR, nós temos algumas práticas que proporcionam uma rotina mais positiva para a pessoa colaboradora:

  • Horário flexível e estrutura horizontal;
  • Programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento;
  • Cultura voltada para a Diversidade & Inclusão, onde você pode ser livre pra ser quem é!

Gostou? Espera só para conferir nosso pacote variado de benefícios:

  • DayOff no mês do aniversário;
  • Gympass, Moodar e Cíngulo (Foco em saúde física e mental).

Use your skills to make an impact

jobs.description:
PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH

Location: Remote, Latin America (LATAM)

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Openings: 1

Industry: Real Estate Finance / Private Lending

Compensation: $1,300 to $1,800 USD/month

Experience: 1.5+ years at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time (ET)

English Proficiency: Advanced written and spoken English required

Start Date: As soon as possible (early November 2026)

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based private real estate lender that provides short-term, business-purpose loans to real estate investors.

The company finances Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR rental and Ground-Up Construction projects and works with a third-party loan servicer, note buyers and capital partners to manage its loan portfolio.

As its portfolio grows, the company is building out its remote operations team to keep every funded loan accurately tracked and every borrower well supported.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Loan Servicing Specialist to own the post-closing servicing workflow and borrower and partner follow-through.

You will board funded loans with the third-party servicer, manage construction draws, monitor maturities, payments and delinquencies, and answer borrower and partner questions until each one is resolved.

The third-party servicer prepares servicing calculations; this specialist reviews and coordinates them. Speed, accuracy, ownership and exceptional borrower service are central to the role.

What You'll Do

Loan Boarding & Records

  • Board funded loans with the third-party servicer.
  • Validate terms, balances, reserves and maturity dates.
  • Maintain accurate records in the company's loan portal and servicing systems.

Construction Draws

  • Manage construction draw requests end to end: budget and reserve checks, inspections, documentation, review and approvals within delegated limits.
  • Coordinate disbursements and give borrowers proactive updates.

Maturities, Extensions & Payoffs

  • Monitor upcoming maturities and coordinate extensions.
  • Coordinate payoffs and extensions with the servicer, reviewing its calculations, statements and documents for accuracy.
  • Track completion and lien releases.

Portfolio Monitoring

  • Identify inactive or stalled loans with no recent progress, updates or borrower communication.
  • Contact the relevant parties, document status and escalate risks.
  • Monitor missed payments and delinquencies, follow up with borrowers and the servicer, and escalate potential defaults or unresolved issues.

Borrower & Partner Support

  • Answer borrower, note buyer and warehouse lender questions about loans, draws, balances, payments, extensions and payoffs.
  • Own each inquiry until it is resolved.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 1.5 years of hands-on experience at a U.S. hard money or private real estate lender, originating or servicing business-purpose investment property loans (Fix & Flip, Bridge, DSCR and/or Ground-Up Construction).
  • Direct experience servicing short-term hard money or business-purpose loans.
  • Experience with construction draw management, payoffs and extensions.
  • Advanced written and spoken English.
  • High attention to detail.
  • Ability to work in Gmail, GoHighLevel (GHL) or a similar CRM, and an online loan portal for documents, files and workflow.
  • Hardworking, dependable, proactive and accountable. You take ownership and follow up without reminders.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced lending business, handling urgent requests and meeting deadlines without compromising accuracy or controls.
  • Availability to work 8:45 AM to 5:45 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Preferred

  • Experience working with a third-party loan servicer.

Please note: conventional consumer mortgage experience alone (FHA, VA, Fannie Mae or Freddie Mac loans) does not meet the experience requirement.

How Success Is Measured

  • Funded loans are boarded quickly and accurately.
  • Draw requests are processed on time and within approved budgets.
  • Maturities, extensions and payoffs are handled before deadlines.
  • Stalled loans, missed payments and potential defaults are flagged early.
  • Borrower and partner questions get fast, accurate answers.

Why Join Us?

  • Fully Remote Opportunity: Work from anywhere in Latin America with a U.S.-based lender.
  • Competitive Compensation: Earn $1,300 to $1,800 USD per month.
  • Meaningful Responsibility: Own the health of a growing loan portfolio.
  • Professional Growth: Build deeper experience in U.S. private real estate lending and servicing.

Important Notes

  • Candidates must reside in Latin America.
  • Direct experience servicing hard money or business-purpose loans is required.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time business hours is required.
  • Excellent English communication skills are essential.
  • Please submit your CV in English and include the lender(s) you worked for, your dates of employment and the loan types you handled.

This is a remote/telecommute position.

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer – Linux & Kubernetes auf Bare Metal (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Dein PurposeWir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung.
jobs.description:
Dein Purpose

Wir betreiben unsere Hosting-Plattform auf eigener Hardware und bauen sie gerade grundlegend neu: Kubernetes auf Bare Metal, alle Ebenen vom Kernel bis zur Plattform in eigener Verantwortung. Du gibst deinem Team dabei die technische Richtung. Deine Urteilskraft kommt aus dem Betrieb, also aus echten Störungen und Kundenproblemen. Daraus entscheidest du im Team, bringst Vorhaben spürbar voran und lässt deine Kolleg*innen fachlich mitwachsen. Personalverantwortung hast du nicht, dafür umso mehr fachlichen Einfluss.

Deine Skills:

  • Du gehst fachlich voran, ohne disziplinarisch zu führen. Du machst Komplexität für Kolleg*innen auf jedem Level greifbar und nimmst sie auf dem Weg mit, durch Feedback, Wissenstransfer und ständiges Sparring.

  • Du beherrschst mindestens eine Ebene richtig tief, ob Kernel, Storage, Netzwerk oder Container-Runtime. Die übrigen verstehst du gut genug, um Wechselwirkungen zu erkennen. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut.

  • Du analysierst Störungen bis zur Ursache, erkennst Muster hinter wiederkehrenden Problemen und definierst sinnvolle Monitoring- und Alerting-Regeln.

  • Software-Engineering: Du baust Plattformkomponenten und Automatisierung selbst, idealerweise in Go, und kannst die Lösungen anderer fachlich bewerten.

Herausforderungen, mit denen wir uns gerade beschäftigen:

  • Multi-Tenant-Hosting unter echter Last: Tausende Kunden-Workloads teilen sich unsere physischen Server – präzise Ressourcensteuerung (cgroups, Namespaces), CPU-/Memory-Scheduling sowie Storage- und Netzwerk-Performance auf Systemebene gehören zum Alltag.

  • Automatisierter Node- und Cluster-Lifecycle: Vom Provisionieren der Hardware über Kernel- und Runtime-Updates (CRI-O, crun) bis zu unterbrechungsfreien Rollouts im laufenden Betrieb.

  • Eigene Operatoren und Plattform-Services: Statt gemanagte Cloud-Dienste zusammenzustecken, entwickeln wir unsere Kubernetes-Controller, APIs und die Integration in Storage und Netzwerk (CNI, BGP) selbst.

Das bieten wir dir:

Tiefgang statt Standard

Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt.

Expertise, die ihresgleichen sucht

Du diskutierst auf fachlich höchstem Niveau, teilst dein Wissen und lernst gemeinsam mit anderen Experten. Unsere Expertise geben wir nicht nur intern , sondern auch gerne auf Konferenzen, Camps und in der Tech-Community weiter und gestalten so die Zukunft der Branche mit.

Wir lieben Tech

Bei uns triffst du auf Menschen, die Tech genauso feiern wie du. Diese Leidenschaft leben wir im Alltag – und darüber hinaus. Ob Open-Source-Engagement, Community-Arbeit oder der Support von Tech-Events: Wir sind aktiv dabei und bringen uns ein.

Technologische Verantwortung

Deine Expertise zählt. Du prägst Entscheidungen und bleibst nicht beim Offensichtlichen stehen. Du bekommst den Raum, deine Ideen umzusetzen, Systeme mitzugestalten und Verantwortung zu übernehmen – auf Augenhöhe und mit Rückhalt.

Technik trifft Menschlichkeit

Bei uns findest du die coolsten Kolleg*innen, jede Menge Humor und echten Team-Spirit. Zusammenarbeit ist für uns ein fester Teil des Daily Business. Auch nach Feierabend gibt es jede Menge Möglichkeiten, ob Fußball, Padel oder D&D - wer Lust hat, ist dabei.

Rundum-sorglos-Setup

Bei uns soll´s dir richtig gut gehen. Freie Hardwarewahl? Check. Standardpaket an Benefits? Klar. Vitamine, Koffein & H2O? Safe. Und obendrauf: Unbefristeter Vertrag, Gleitzeit, 30 Urlaubstage, bAV , Schulungsangebote und ein faires Gehalt.

Requirements

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du führst die Vorhaben deines Teams fachlich und technisch an, konzipierst neue Funktionen und Stabilitätsverbesserungen

  • Architekturentscheidungen triffst du gemeinsam mit unserer Systemarchitektur und ihr bindet euch bei allen Ideen, Projekten und Veränderungsprozessen gegenseitig frühzeitig ein

  • Mit dem PO übersetzt du Prioritäten in konkrete Arbeitspakete, dabei bewertest du Aufwand und Risiko und sprichst Empfehlungen aus

  • Du bleibst nah am Tagesgeschäft, bist erste Anlaufstelle für technische Fragen an dein Team und spielst Erkenntnisse aus dem Betrieb in die Architektur zurück

  • Du hältst den Qualitätsstandard hoch, steuerst nach, wenn etwas nicht passt

jobs.title: Senior MDM Steward
jobs.excerpt: At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs.
jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

LifeStance Health Values

  • Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.

  • Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.

  • Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.

  • One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

Benefits
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

ROLE OVERVIEW


The Senior MDM Data Steward serves as the authoritative steward for patient and provider domains for master data across the Enterprise Data Platform, providing leadership for the operational governance, quality, and integrity of enterprise identity data. This role owns the stewardship framework supporting patient and provider master records and is accountable for ensuring that Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) patient global identifiers and MDM provider global identifiers within the Silver (conformed canonical) layer remain accurate, complete, traceable, and trusted for analytics, reporting, regulatory compliance, operational decision-making, and AI-driven use cases.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior MDM Data Steward leads identity resolution activities, establishes and maintains stewardship standards, and exercises judgment in the review and disposition of complex match, merge, and identity exception scenarios. The steward proactively identifies data quality risks, drives remediation efforts across source systems, oversees survivorship rule execution, and serves as the primary escalation point for patient and provider identity-related issues. In partnership with Business Data Owners, Data Governance leaders, and source-system stakeholders, this role influences stewardship practices, promotes data quality accountability, and drives continuous improvement of master data management processes.


The Senior MDM Data Steward also owns the maintenance and ongoing governance of patient and provider business glossary terms, data quality rules and definitions, lineage context, stewardship procedures, issue records, and related governance artifacts within Snowflake Horizon Catalog. Through active monitoring, analysis, and stewardship leadership, the role ensures critical business and technical metadata remains current, actionable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards and strategic data management objectives.


Consistent with LifeStance’s values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

COMPENSATION: $109,000 - $130,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

KEY RESPONSIBILITES 

Identity Resolution, Match Stewardship, and Operational Leadership (approximately 40%)


  • Lead enterprise MDM stewardship operations by directing work queue activities, adjudicating complex identity resolution scenarios, resolving potential matches and duplicates, correcting improperly merged identities, and establishing consistent record governance practices for manually reviewed records.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for patient identity management issues, investigating overlays, duplicates, and cross-system identity conflicts originating from athenaOne, AdvancedMD, and other source systems; determine root causes, drive corrective actions, and recommend process improvements to reduce recurrence.
  • Own the governance and integrity of the provider master data domain, establishing and enforcing standards for the reconciliation of NPI, taxonomy, licensure, credentialing status, payer enrollment, practice location, employment status, and related attributes across enterprise source systems.
  • Provide leadership for provider data quality and governance initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of provider practice, location, and organizational affiliation data supporting operational, analytical, credentialing, reimbursement, and regulatory reporting needs.
  • Partner with Data Architecture to evaluate and tune Verato match thresholds, referential matching configuration, survivorship, and attribute precedence rules; measure the effect on auto-match, potential-match, unmatched, and false-positive rates before changes are promoted.
  • Ownership over establishing and maintaining enterprise standards for data stewardship decisions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of exceptions, adjudication rationale, survivorship outcomes, merge and unmerge activities, and record-resolution actions to support auditability, compliance, and continuous improvement efforts.

Data Quality, Issue Management & Silver Layer Validation (approximately 25%)

  • Establish and own the business acceptance standards for patient and provider mastered records, source-to-global ID crosswalks, identity resolution outcomes, and golden-record quality within the Snowflake Silver layer, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and operational objectives.
  • Provide oversight of EMPI patient and provider global ID integrity within the Snowflake Silver layer by proactively identifying data quality defects, validating adherence to business rules, and directing remediation efforts with Data Engineering and DataOps teams to ensure timely resolution.
  • Define, govern, and continuously refine master data quality standards and performance thresholds, including metrics related to unmatched records, duplicate records, orphaned source IDs, stale provider attributes, missing NPI values, invalid affiliations, and incomplete required attributes; communicate performance trends and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Lead the governance and lifecycle management of patient and provider master data issues, prioritizing remediation activities based on business impact, overseeing issue resolution progress, and providing transparent reporting on ownership, remediation status, risk exposure, and closure outcomes.
  • Independently lead strategic trend analysis and root-cause investigations to identify systemic defects across registration, scheduling, provider onboarding, credentialing, human resources, interfaces, and source application workflows; recommend and influence corrective actions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
  • Own the maintenance and governance of master data lineage and identifier crosswalks, ensuring accurate traceability between source-system MRNs, provider identifiers, and enterprise global IDs while supporting audit, compliance, and operational reporting requirements.
  • Serve as the primary business lead for identity-related incidents and data quality escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring corrective actions are effectively prioritized, tested, and promoted through established release and change-management processes.

Governance, Metadata & Policy (approximately 20%)

  • Establish and govern enterprise patient and provider master data standards, defining business terminology, required attributes, permissible values, data ownership, attribute precedence, relationship hierarchies, and merge/unmerge policies to ensure consistent and compliant master data management practices across the organization.
  • Own the stewardship framework and metadata management processes for Patient and Provider domains by maintaining business glossary terms, data quality standards, stewardship procedures, issue records, and lineage documentation within the Snowflake Horizon Catalog, ensuring transparency and accessibility for business and technical stakeholders.
  • Serve independently as the primary stewardship leader for Patient and Provider domains within the Data Governance Steering Committee, influencing enterprise governance decisions and partnering with Business Data Owners to establish data definitions, quality expectations, usage standards, and remediation priorities.
  • Provide governance leadership and strategic recommendations to Business Data Owners, enabling informed decision-making regarding business definitions, quality thresholds, and stewardship policy changes while ensuring alignment with enterprise data management objectives.
  • Lead the evaluation and governance of changes impacting master data policies, including data definitions, identity matching criteria, survivorship logic, and quality thresholds; facilitate cross-functional review, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and decision-making through established governance processes.
  • Independently ensure stewardship operations adhere to HIPAA minimum-necessary requirements, HITRUST controls, and organizational privacy and security policies, establishing robust auditability and oversight for manual merge, split, correction, and identity-resolution activities.
  • Partner with Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to assess regulatory and policy impacts on identity management practices, providing stewardship leadership for consent restrictions, sensitive data handling requirements, healthcare regulatory obligations, golden-record usage, and downstream data access controls.
  • Drive the development and continuous improvement of master data standards that support regulatory reporting, quality initiatives, reimbursement processes, payer requirements, and broader enterprise business objectives, ensuring data assets remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose across the organization.

Source-System Improvement, Reporting & Enablement (approximately 15%)

  • Provide leadership and oversight for enterprise master data remediation efforts, directing corrective actions to registration, provider credentialing, human resources, practice operations, and other source-system owners; ensure timely resolution, accountability, and sustainable process improvements that prevent recurring data quality issues within mastered records.
  • Partner with operational and business leaders to strengthen upstream data governance and capture processes, identifying opportunities to enhance controls, workflows, and accountability measures that reduce the creation of duplicate, incomplete, and conflicting patient and provider records at the source.
  • Develop, own, and present executive-level stewardship performance reporting, delivering monthly scorecards and actionable insights on duplicate rates, unmatched records, match accuracy, exception backlog and aging, source correction effectiveness, provider data completeness, global ID coverage, and recurring root-cause trends to support informed decision-making.
  • Serve as the primary stewardship liaison with MDM vendors and implementation partners, providing leadership in troubleshooting match-quality issues, evaluating configuration recommendations, validating platform capabilities, assessing business impacts, and guiding release planning and implementation decisions.
  • Lead business stewardship activities for MDM platform implementations and enhancements, overseeing data profiling, duplicate remediation strategies, threshold calibration, user acceptance testing, cutover readiness, workflow adoption, stakeholder engagement, and post-production stabilization to ensure successful implementation outcomes and sustained business value.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Information Systems, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare data stewardship, health information management (HIM), patient identity, provider data management, or MDM operations, including direct responsibility for patient or provider master data quality.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise EMPI or MDM platform, including steward queue management, duplicate remediation, merge/unmerge workflows, survivorship, and match-rule evaluation. Verato experience is strongly preferred; Reltio, NextGate/Rhapsody, Profisee, IBM Initiate, or comparable experience is acceptable.
  • Working knowledge of healthcare patients and provider data structures and workflows. Experience with athenaOne is strongly preferred; familiarity with Salesforce provider credentialing and Workday as provider data sources is a plus.
  • Provider data expertise, including NPI/NPPES, taxonomy, state licensure, credentialing lifecycle, payer enrollment, locations, affiliations, and organizational relationships.
  • Proficient SQL skills and the ability to independently query Snowflake to investigate identity issues, validate global ID assignments, profile defects, and verify remediation.
  • Experience defining data quality rules, managing issue backlogs, performing root-cause analysis, and communicating trends and business impact to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of HIPAA privacy and security requirements as applied to identity data, access, auditability, and merge/unmerge operations.
  • Ability to document standards, facilitate cross-functional decisions, train operational users, and communicate data quality findings to non-technical leaders.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional Master Data Management (MDM) initiatives, providing strategic direction, driving stakeholder alignment, and coordinating business and technical teams to achieve measurable data quality, governance, and operational outcomes.
  • Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States
  • LifeStance is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.
  • Demonstrates awareness, inclusivity, sensitivity, humility, and experience in working with individuals from diverse ethnic backgrounds, socioeconomic statuses, sexual orientations, gender identities, and other various aspects of culture.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE


  • Experience with Snowflake Horizon Catalog or another enterprise data catalog/governance platform, including business glossary, ownership, quality, and lineage documentation.
  • Experience reading data models, interpreting automated test results, and working within medallion or layered data architectures.
  • Experience in behavioral health, multi-site outpatient practice, or another complex healthcare delivery environment.
  • Familiarity with referential, probabilistic, and deterministic matching methods and their operational tradeoffs.
  • Experience supporting an EMPI or MDM implementation, including source profiling, initial-load remediation, threshold calibration, testing, cutover, and stabilization.
  • Experience producing stewardship scorecards and presenting data quality trends to governance or operational leadership.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to adjust focus.

Absolute Security is looking for a Sales Engineer (SE) to provide technical sales support as a solution expert within our fast-growing North American Mid-Market East business, supporting our East Coast customers and partners.
