The SE owns the end-to-end technical sales process, from initial discovery through validation to commercial win. The SE is a technical evangelist for our software platform, representing the company with potential customers, partners, and at events.

You lead deep discovery that uncovers each customer’s current state, the cost of staying there, and the outcomes they want, then position technical solutions that deliver real business value. You can tailor demonstrations to align with the pain discovered. You can build Proof of Value (PoV) plans that validate the solution is strongly aligned with the customer needs and delivers quantifiable business value. You can lead the PoV with the customer, then partner with your account teams to turn the results into business proposals and wrap-up presentations that clearly demonstrate the value delivered. You can smoothly handle objections while remaining focused on the important differentiators. Finally, you can effectively build technical champions inside accounts and operate independently of them, but in partnership with your AE and CAM.

You will be expected to quickly come up to speed on our Absolute Secure Endpoint (Visibility, Control, Resilience, Resilience for Security and Resilience for Automation tiers) and Secure Access product offerings (Absolute VPN, Absolute ZTNA and Absolute Insights for Network). Your deep product knowledge, as well as in-depth knowledge of security, networking, and operating systems will help you to effectively position our products, while also helping to solve difficult technical problems for potential customers during pre-sales presentations, demonstrations, and evaluations.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end technical sales cycle for your opportunities, from discovery and validation through to commercial win
  • Partner with your account team to establish and execute sales strategy across your assigned East Coast territory
  • Assist with ongoing qualification and discovery to ensure proposed solutions address customer pain
  • Deliver tailored technical sales presentations and demonstrations to prospective customers and partners
  • Plan and execute Proof of Value (PoV, evaluation) activities. This includes scoping the PoV to align with the business pain, defining relevant success criteria and metrics, designing the PoV environment, installing and configuring Absolute’s products, providing technical support to prospective customers, and executing the PoV in accordance with the agreed-upon success criteria
  • Work with leadership to relay data-driven customer insights to Product Management and help prioritize roadmap features
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activities in Salesforce.com
  • Align tightly with technical counterparts across our channel and OEM business, educating and enabling them to uncover and develop new sales opportunities
  • Provide technical expertise to support renewals, expansion, upsell, cross-sell, and net new business
  • Regularly travel within the assigned East Coast territory to support sales activities, strengthen partner relationships, and engage with customers; up to 30% travel may be required
  • Manage your territory with minimal oversight, independently learning, troubleshooting, and escalating issues when necessary
  • Assist with customer vendor assessments by providing accurate technical and security information and timely, thorough responses to due diligence requests
  • Protect the security and privacy of Absolute and its customers

What You’ll Bring:

  • Hands-on experience administering Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, both endpoints and servers, with a clear understanding of the unique management, performance, and security challenges each platform presents
  • Experience with complex technical sales cycles, including deep discovery as well as scoping, executing, and presenting complex Proof of Value (evaluations)
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to all levels of people, from IT, Network and Security managers to Line of Business owners to CIO and CISOs
  • Strong understanding of data-in-transit security (TLS, IPsec, VPNs, PKI, and certificate management), network services and design (routing, LAN/WAN architecture, and firewall configuration), and authentication protocols (SAML, RADIUS, and related methods)
  • Skilled in endpoint and network troubleshooting, leveraging tools such as cURL, Wireshark, and log analysis to identify, isolate, and resolve complex technical issues across diverse environments

Nice to have skills:

  • Experience with selling methodologies such as Command of the Message and MEDDPICC
  • Experience with Demo2Win methodology
  • Experience selling SASE, SSE, VPN, EDR, Incident Response or other endpoint or network security tools
  • Experience with programming or scripting languages such as PowerShell, Python, or Bash
  • Experience with Cloud IaaS vendors including networking and security service operation
  • Security (CISSP, GIAC, CompTIA Security+, etc.) or networking (CCNA, CompTIA Network+, etc.) certifications
  • Experienced in patch and configuration management for endpoints and servers to maintain security, stability, and compliance
  • Experience in IT or Security operations

Join the “Get Stuff Done” Culture Shaping the Future of Cybersecurity and Resilience

Are you passionate and committed to cybersecurity and cyber resilience in the new era of Frontier AI? If the answer is yes, then Absolute Security may be the home for you.

In the new AI-driven business world, Absolute Security has emerged as a leader in Autonomous Cyber Resilience. Thousands of customers trust our AI-native platform to defend their organizations against threats, reduce risk, and recover immediately from disruptions before they turn into financial losses. Through partnerships with the world’s leading endpoint device manufacturers, Absolute is embedded in the firmware of 600 million endpoints. This unique position gives us an almost ubiquitous presence in the world’s PC and advanced AI workstation environments.

As part of our mission to become the World’s Most Trusted Security Company, we are shaping the next decade of security, compliance, and resilience through innovations that help customers remain defended against AI-driven threats and challenges, stop downtime when disruption hits, and drive meaningful change in the IT and cybersecurity markets. To further our goals, we are searching for the best and brightest to join our Get Stuff Done (GSD) culture. We seek motivated candidates who are innovators, sellers, marketers, financiers, operators, engineers, developers, and customer professionals to join our world-class team.

Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Frost & Sullivan, and other top industry analyst firms recognize Absolute Security as critical to the emerging Cyber Resilience market, and a key competitor in the endpoint management and security, secure network access, and Zero Trust markets. The company has earned prestigious product and leadership honors including the Frost & Sullivan Competitive Strategy & Leadership award, the Cybersecurity Excellence Award for Cyber Resilience solutions, and the SC Magazine Power Players list.

Absolute Security is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with international offices in Vancouver, BC; Austin, TX; Ankeny, IA; Reading, UK; Tokyo, Japan; and Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are seeking candidates in US and Canada.

The Opportunity

Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. We build and operate systems that support Grafana’s business operations and customer experience, working closely with product teams and internal business partners.

The Usage squad works on billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and cloud marketplace integrations. Our software helps customers understand their consumption and costs, and helps internal teams operate accurate, reliable billing processes.

We are looking for a Staff Fullstack Engineer with strong backend experience who enjoys making complex business systems reliable, understandable and easier to operate. You will help deliver new capabilities while improving existing services, reducing repetitive manual work and addressing edge cases that affect customers and internal stakeholders.

This is a hands-on Staff engineering role within the AppCore Usage squad. You will lead complex technical work, contribute directly to implementation and share ownership with the squad’s other Staff and Senior engineers. Your primary focus will be Usage’s systems and outcomes, collaborating with adjacent teams when the work requires it.

Our ownership includes application code, data stores, deployment configuration and the cloud infrastructure supporting our services. You should be comfortable following a problem across those boundaries and making improvements with the appropriate platform teams.

We are remote-first and global. For this role, we prefer candidates in NASA’s Eastern Time zone to provide more overlap with our EMEA colleagues.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your initial focus will be approximately 75% backend and 25% frontend. This balance will evolve with the squad’s priorities. You should be comfortable delivering across the stack, from business logic and APIs through to the interfaces customers and internal teams use.

  • Design, build and operate backend services and APIs supporting billing, rates, usage calculations, usage visibility and marketplace workflows.
  • Build and maintain backend services primarily in Go, with Node.js also present in our stack, and contribute to TypeScript/React applications to deliver complete features.
  • Improve the correctness and reliability of billing and usage workflows, including validation, reconciliation, error handling and recovery.
  • Identify recurring manual tasks and replace them with maintainable automation, clear operational workflows and appropriate controls.
  • Maintain and evolve the infrastructure supporting our services, including Kubernetes workloads, scheduled jobs, cloud resources and deployment configuration.
  • Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines to make changes repeatable, reviewable and safe across environments.
  • Investigate production issues across application code, databases and infrastructure, including resource exhaustion, failed jobs, slow queries and replication delays.
  • Plan and execute service deployments, database changes and infrastructure migrations, including validation, monitoring and recovery plans.
  • Build and maintain integrations with cloud marketplaces and external business systems where required by the squad’s work.
  • Deliver projects from understanding requirements and proposing an approach through implementation, testing, rollout and production support.
  • Make changes traceable and testable, supporting audit requirements and clear explanations of system behaviour.
  • Collaborate with product management, Support, DealOps, GTM, infrastructure teams and adjacent AppCore squads to clarify requirements and resolve dependencies.
  • Share technical leadership through design discussions, code reviews, mentoring and practical improvements.
  • Participate in the squad’s on-call rotation after onboarding. Improve dashboards, alert quality, runbooks and recovery procedures, and follow through on incident findings.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You enjoy engineering work where correctness, reliability and business impact matter. You find value in improving an established system, removing a recurring operational problem or making a billing workflow easier to understand and support.

You take ownership from understanding the problem through delivery and production support. You can turn an ambiguous request into manageable increments, make sound trade-offs and follow through without needing each step prescribed. You ask useful questions, seek feedback and raise uncertainty or blockers early.

You adapt as priorities change, learn unfamiliar systems and technologies, and contribute where the squad needs you. You bring a strong backend specialty while remaining willing and able to work on frontend features and supporting infrastructure.

You reason about how a service behaves in production: how it is deployed, where its data lives, what happens when dependencies fail, and how the team detects and recovers from problems.

You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation. In a distributed team, you make decisions, progress and risks visible so colleagues can contribute across time zones. You work independently while staying connected to the squad.

As a Staff engineer, you bring technical depth and sound judgment while remaining close to implementation. You collaborate constructively with other experienced engineers, welcome different perspectives and help the squad reach decisions and move forward.

We embrace thoughtful use of AI-assisted development. We value engineers who use these tools to support exploration, implementation, testing and documentation while taking responsibility for the quality and correctness of the result.

Requirements

  • Substantial experience designing, delivering and operating production backend systems, with the depth and judgment to lead complex work hands-on.
  • Strong experience building and operating production backend systems in Go, our primary backend language.
  • Professional experience contributing to frontend applications using TypeScript and React, or comparable technologies, and willingness to work across the stack as priorities change.
  • Experience reasoning about distributed systems, including partial failures, retries, consistency and interactions between services.
  • Experience with relational databases, including data modelling, schema migrations, query performance and safe production changes.
  • Practical experience deploying and troubleshooting containerised services and jobs in Kubernetes.
  • Experience managing cloud infrastructure through code and working with CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration and controlled rollouts.
  • Ability to investigate production problems using logs, metrics and traces, and turn findings into lasting improvements.
  • A record of delivering projects end to end, clarifying requirements, making trade-offs and following through after release.
  • Experience working remotely, with clear asynchronous communication and dependable collaboration across time zones.
  • Ability to learn unfamiliar domains and technologies, adjust your approach as new information emerges, and take ownership beyond your main area of expertise.
  • Experience writing readable, well-tested software that other engineers can understand, maintain and operate.
  • Willingness to participate in on-call and take responsibility for the production behaviour of the systems you build.
  • Experience supporting colleagues through code reviews, mentoring and constructive technical discussions.

Bonus Points For

  • Usage metering, billing engines, pricing and rates, financial reconciliation or customer-facing cost management applications.
  • Reducing operational toil and automating workflows with recurring exceptions or manual interventions.
  • Systems with auditability, traceability or financial-control requirements.
  • MySQL operations, replication, database upgrades and performance tuning.
  • Terraform, Jsonnet and Kubernetes deployment configuration.
  • Argo Workflows or comparable deployment and job-orchestration tooling.
  • Cloud infrastructure involving managed databases, object storage, service accounts and access controls, particularly on GCP.
  • Data synchronisation pipelines and BigQuery integrations.
  • Cloud marketplace integrations across AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Integrations with business platforms such as NetSuite or Salesforce.
  • Observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, Loki or OpenTelemetry.

In Canada, the compensation range for this role is $186,368 - $223,642 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

jobs.title: Senior Mobile Developer (Contract)
jobs.excerpt: Ready to accelerate your career? Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact.
jobs.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self-contained innovation group (Initial three-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end-to-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff.

The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team.

The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. That judgment lets us discard weak ideas cheaply and invest deeply in the ones that earn it.

This is a fit for someone with strong product and commercial instincts, sound technical judgment, and a high degree of ownership. You identify gaps, propose a path forward, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect requirements. You own outcomes, make clear trade-offs to meet timelines, and raise consequential risks early.

What you'll do:

  • Work with the Project Lead, Product Manager and Web Developer to turn ambiguous problems into unified driver-and-admin experiences
  • Build the smallest end-to-end prototype that can test the idea, often within one to two weeks
  • Bring prototypes to customers and the market validation group, then rapidly translate feedback into V2, V3, and beyond
  • Challenge assumptions, cut scope, and keep the group moving without waiting for perfect requirements
  • Make deliberate, reversible technical choices during validation while protecting security, privacy, and data integrity
  • Build within the shared codebase, behind feature flags and in isolated modules that can be removed cleanly
  • Integrate with our platform backend and third-party APIs using existing contracts and patterns
  • Once a concept is validated, identify and complete the work required to harden, scale, test, and release it
  • Prepare validated features and technical context for a clean handoff to the core product and engineering team

What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 6–8 years as a software engineer at a senior level, with a track record of product work at startups and in fast-paced environments
  • You've built from nothing, cut scope under time pressure, and shipped
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take an unfamiliar domain and an under-specified problem and make progress without waiting to be handed a spec
  • Strong product thinker who can connect driver and administrator needs, commercial value, and technical choices across mobile and web
  • Strong communicator who identifies gaps, proposes a path forward, and keeps the work moving
  • High ownership, sound judgment under time pressure, and a track record of delivering against commitments without hiding material trade-offs
  • Comfortable working in a small, autonomous group where priorities can change quickly as new evidence emerges

Technical

  • Very comfortable with React Native, plus native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development
  • Familiar with the full mobile release process for both iOS and Android, including store submission and review
  • Solid integrating against REST / backend APIs and handling auth, tokens, and SSO on device
  • Comfortable collaborating across mobile, web, and backend boundaries to create one coherent product experience
  • You adopt the existing patterns and conventions of the mobile codebase rather than introducing your own
  • You know how to code and understand good software design. You are not strictly a "vibe coder": you can reason about architecture and trade-offs, not just prompt your way to output

AI-Native Mindset

  • You've adopted modern AI development workflows and use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot as part of how you ship
  • You understand AI skills, agents, and code-spec workflows, and how to use them without losing engineering rigour
  • You lean on AI to move faster on prototypes and to hold quality up during hardening

Bonus (nice to have)

  • Ability to flex onto the Portal stack (TypeScript / Next.js / NestJS / PostgreSQL) when a bet calls for it

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)

jobs.excerpt: What’s in it for you?  Ready to make a serious impact?
jobs.description:
What’s in it for you?

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the team & opportunity

Millions of people use Calendly to book meetings, and most of that happens on public booking pages where anyone with a link can schedule time. That openness is what makes Calendly easy to use, and it’s also what makes it a target. The Trust & Safety team keeps Calendly safe without slowing anyone down.

We protect everyone who interacts with Calendly: the hosts who share their links, the invitees who book with them, and the email and SMS providers and partners who rely on us to send responsibly. Our work covers three areas: preventing and responding to abuse, protecting the deliverability and compliance of the messages Calendly sends, and keeping messaging costs predictable as the platform grows.

Most of our problems are adversarial. We often can’t rely on knowing who someone is, so we judge behavior, patterns, and content instead. Attackers change tactics all the time, so we build signals that last from one attack to the next. And we take false positives seriously, because blocking a real customer costs more than letting a spammer through. Engineers work closely with our Trust & Safety Operations team, who see abuse first and shape what we build.

In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager for the Trust & Safety team.

A day in the life of a Full Stack Engineer at Calendly

On a typical day, you will be working on:

  • Building and improving the systems that detect and stop abuse across sign-up, booking, and messaging, such as spam, phishing, bots, and fraudulent SMS traffic.
  • Improving the reliability, deliverability, and compliance of the email and SMS notifications Calendly sends.
  • Shipping new detection carefully: measuring how it performs on real traffic before it acts on accounts, and weighing false positives against false negatives.
  • Responding to active abuse, including during on-call, by stopping the damage fast, then replacing quick fixes with durable ones.
  • Building tools that help our Trust & Safety Operations team review accounts faster and understand why the system took each action.
  • Partnering with Product, Operations, and Data to define requirements and measure the impact of what we ship.
  • Working with other product teams to add protections to the flows they own.
  • Reviewing implementation plans and pull requests, and sharing what you learn with the team.

What do we need from you?

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience at a SaaS or technology company, including building and running production systems.
  • Strong backend skills: building services, APIs, and data-heavy workflows in a service-oriented architecture.
  • Experience with Rails, Node/TypeScript, Go, or a comparable language or framework, and a willingness to work across more than one.
  • Comfort with relational databases and SQL, and with using data to check whether a change actually worked.
  • An analytical, curious mindset: you think about how a system could be misused, not only how it’s supposed to be used.
  • Good judgment about trade-offs, such as stopping bad actors without adding friction for real customers.
  • A commitment to clean, reliable, maintainable code, thoughtful testing, and shipping in small increments.
  • Clear communication with engineers and non-engineers alike, including Operations and Support partners.
  • Comfort and skill with AI tools in your engineering work, including reviewing their output critically.
  • Availability to take part in an on-call rotation for critical services.
  • Authorized to work lawfully in the United States of America as Calendly does not engage in immigration sponsorship at this time.

Nice to have

  • Experience in trust and safety, fraud, spam, or abuse prevention.
  • Experience with email or SMS delivery, such as deliverability, sender reputation, or messaging compliance.
  • Experience with bot protection, rate limiting, or third-party risk and verification services.
  • Experience building rules engines, risk scoring, or ML-backed decisions in production.
  • Experience using LLMs to classify or moderate user-generated content.
  • Experience with GCP, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, or Redis.

Caspar Health connects digital rehabilitation with personal therapeutic care. We help people receive care during and after their clinic stay, wherever they are.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Integration Squad. You will develop, roll out, operate and maintain healthcare integrations across Health Level Seven version 2 (HL7 v2), REST application programming interfaces (APIs), Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR) and CSV imports. You will strengthen our backend engineering capacity and help clinic IT teams and software partners connect reliably to Caspar Health.

The role covers both existing interfaces and new integrations, from implementation and partner onboarding through production support and ongoing improvement. Hands-on experience implementing and operating FHIR integrations in production is a required qualification.

We would like to hear about the production FHIR integrations you have delivered, the systems you connected, the decisions you owned and how you kept the integrations reliable after launch.

This role is located in Germany and requires full physical presence within the country. Due to our existing payroll and social security framework, permanent remote employment from abroad is not supported. Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany and resident from their first day. Please be advised that we cannot offer visa sponsorship or relocation assistance at this time.

Deine Herausforderungen

  • Develop, roll out, operate and maintain integrations across our interface landscape
  • Take integrations through requirements clarification, data mapping, implementation, partner testing, go-live and ongoing support
  • Maintain and improve existing interfaces, resolve production issues and support changes in clinic and partner systems
  • Build reliable data flows for patient information and therapy schedules
  • Design and maintain backend services and versioned APIs in our Ruby on Rails and TypeScript environment
  • Handle duplicate messages, delayed or out-of-order updates, cancellations and partial failures with clear retry and reconciliation behaviour
  • Extend our developer portal with runnable quickstarts, accurate API references, synthetic examples and troubleshooting guidance
  • Work with clinic IT teams and software partners on tested interface contracts and repeatable onboarding
  • Improve automated contract and end-to-end tests, monitoring and operational runbooks
  • Share maintenance, support and knowledge through pairing, design discussions and code reviews
  • Apply secure authentication, authorisation, tenant isolation and data-handling practices with our infrastructure and privacy specialists

Dein Profil

  • Substantial hands-on experience delivering FHIR integrations used in production, including personal responsibility for implementation and troubleshooting after launch
  • Practical knowledge of FHIR resources, profiles, implementation guides, identifiers, terminology bindings, extensions and validation
  • Hands-on production experience with Ruby on Rails, including maintaining and troubleshooting backend APIs and asynchronous integrations.
  • You have practical experience working with AWS infrastructure, including the ability to integrate and manage cloud-based services
  • Experience with healthcare data models, patient and encounter lifecycles, identity matching and appointment changes
  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modelling, migrations and performance-conscious queries
  • Experience designing secure REST APIs and asynchronous or event-driven integrations
  • Clear documentation and communication with engineers, product colleagues and integration partners
  • A collaborative, pragmatic approach and strong written and spoken English

Warum Caspar Health?

  • Remote-first with flexible working hours – office optional in Berlin-Mitte or up to 90 days a year outside of Germany
  • To match this, we support you with a monthly home office allowance and an additional meal subsidy
  • Plenty of time to recharge – with 30 vacation days per year
  • Budget for learning & development, conferences, and coaching – tailored to your potential and growth opportunities
  • High level of ownership and decision-making freedom – no micromanagement. We hire experts who know what they’re doing. #MakeAnImpact!
  • Genuine collaboration – no silos, no egos. After all, we’re all working toward the same vision. #ValueFocus!
  • Access to all Caspar offerings for mental and physical well-being #HealthyTogether!
  • And yes – all the snacks your heart desires, group sports sessions, a never-empty drinks fridge, and a healthy dose of humor are included too

What defines us as a team

  • We live diversity – it's not a marketing slogan, it's part of our everyday reality
  • Feedback isn’t a tool – it’s part of our culture
  • We believe that technology only makes sense when it truly helps people
  • Our drive is purpose – but our standard is professionalism

Job Description:

Job Title: Team Lead, Engineering

Location: Remote | Canada

Reports to: Director, Engineering – Professional Services

Employment Type: Full-time

This is a new vacancy

About the Role:


The Engineering Team Lead is responsible for technical project execution and owning team delivery outcomes, as well as day-to-day operational leadership of a multidisciplinary software development team. This role works closely with Business Unit stakeholders as an individual contributor while ensuring the efficient allocation, utilization, and effectiveness of Engineering staff. The Software Development Team Lead also works in close collaboration with the Software Development Manager to define, implement, and continuously improve best practices across all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle.

You will directly influence delivery reliability, team productivity, and software quality by guiding day-to-day execution, removing blockers, and driving adherence to engineering standards and best practices.

In this role, you will:

  • Foster and maintain a positive, accountable, and collaborative work

environment to motivate Engineering staff

  • Own team delivery outcomes, ensuring commitments are met with

expected quality, velocity, and reliability

  • Contribute to the definition, adoption, and enforcement of best practices

for all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle

  • Identify, track, and report on key engineering performance indicators

(quality, velocity, productivity, delivery reliability)

  • Leading and support the team, hands on, in using and adopting AI tooling

(coding assistants, agents, review and test automation) to improve quality,

velocity, and delivery reliability ensuring humans are accountable for what

ships

  • Collaborate with Business Unit stakeholders to align priorities

and allocate resources based on business objectives

  • Provide day-to-day functional oversight and leadership for Engineering

staff

  • Identify and remove obstacles that prevent the team from meeting delivery

commitments

  • Provide continuous performance feedback through regular one-on-one

meetings

  • Conduct formal performance reviews for staff as per the schedule defined

by Human Resources

  • Develop training plans to address business needs and support ongoing

growth of staff

  • Actively participate in the recruitment process to grow the Engineering

organization

  • Manage onboarding of new software developers and interns to accelerate

contribution

  • Maintain visibility into team health, skills, and knowledge depth,

addressing gaps where needed

  • Design and develop software applications from business and technical

specifications

  • Develop and execute unit, component, and integration level tests to verify

requirements are met

  • Ensure adherence to coding standards and test coverage targets

to maintain product quality

  • Investigate and resolve technical issues and delivery risks for assigned

projects

  • Collaborate with architects and stakeholders on solution design and

technical direction

  • Contribute to the creation of technical and end user product

documentation

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience and Bachelor's degree in

Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field is required.

  • Proven technical team leadership abilities including on and offshore

multidisciplinary teams

  • Experience working with a variety of software development languages

including Java and Typescript

  • Experience with service-oriented architecture and design principles
  • Experience with relational and non-relational database design
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively at

all levels of an organization

  • Exceptionally self-motivated, accountable, and detail-oriented
  • Superior analytical and problem-solving skills

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $110,000 - $130,000 CAD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.


Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

  • We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.
  • We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.
  • We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.
  • We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.
  • We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact for accommodation request.


Data Privacy

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here.

Applications

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
About Pave Bank

Pave Bank is the world’s first programmable business bank. Built by the founders behind Monzo and BigPay, we’re redefining global business banking by combining programmable financial infrastructure with world-class client experiences.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Junior Security Engineer who is independent, curious, and has an adversary first mindset - someone who thinks like an attacker to keep our platform secure.

You'll be a critical guardian of Pave Bank: identifying weaknesses, closing loopholes, and empowering our Product and Engineering teams to ship quickly without compromising security.

You'll get hands-on exposure across the full security lifecycle - from code review to penetration testing - with mentorship from experienced engineers.

What You'll Do

  • Review platform and product code to identify security issues and guide engineers toward secure solutions

  • Build internal tools, libraries, and automation to improve security testing and enforcement

  • Continuously test internal and external applications for vulnerabilities

  • Support third-party application security reviews and penetration tests

  • Help educate engineering and product teams on secure coding and design practices

  • Stay current on emerging threats and attack techniques, and assess how they apply to our systems

What We're Looking For

Must have

  • An adversary-first mindset - you instinctively ask "how would I break this?"

  • Familiarity with common attacker tools and techniques, and how insecure development practices get exploited (e.g. OWASP Top 10)

  • Programming experience in at least one modern language (Go, Python, or TypeScript).

  • Clear communication skills - you can explain security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Self-motivation and a genuine drive to keep learning

Nice to have:

  • Exposure to blockchain technologies and cryptocurrency systems, and their security implications

  • Experience with security tooling, CTFs, bug bounties, or open-source security contributions

  • Prior internship or work experience in a fast-moving startup environment

Why Join Us

  • We recently raised a $39M Series A led by Accel, positioning us for major growth — a rare chance to join while things are still moving fast

  • We're building a fully-licensed programmable bank, rearchitecting how money moves between businesses, across borders, and between traditional and digital finance

  • We ship fast, think deeply, and expect high ownership — your work will hit production quickly across several parts of the business

  • You'll work alongside engineers from Monzo, Atom Bank, Blockdaemon, GXS, and Grab

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Operations
jobs.excerpt: Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back.
jobs.description:
Alternative Payments is building the financial operating system for SMBs, consolidating the disconnected tech stack that holds service-based businesses back. Starting with MSPs, we've spent five years perfecting accounts receivable, and we're now expanding into accounts payable, AI-powered analytics, and beyond. We're at an inflection point: closing the loop on money movement and laying the foundation for a platform that will reshape how service businesses operate financially.

We're growing fast, thinking big, and building a global team that wants to be part of something that lasts. We believe the best solutions come from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and a shared obsession with customer impact. If you're energized by real problems, real customers, and real impact, we want to hear from you!

Why should you apply for this role?

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who can take a real business problem, understand why it matters, and build the system that solves it. You'll own initiatives end to end, partner closely with operations, data, and product, and explore net-new product POCs and build internal tooling, automations and AI agents / agentic workflows that help the whole company move faster.

This is an internal-facing role. Your customers are our own Ops, Product, Customer Success and Sales teams. Think of it as playing forward-deployed engineer for Alternative Payments itself: embedded with the teams that need you, understanding their real problems, and building the systems that solve them. Examples of what’s you’ll own:

  • Internal AI data infrastructure that consolidates what we know about our business and makes it usable across teams. Put AI at the center of how you work. We're an AI-forward team and expect you to build with it by default, leveraging it in your daily workflows as well as for team enablement, not just basic usage.

  • Building products we'd otherwise buy. We're replicating internal versions of Sales, CS, Marketing tools, built to fit exactly how we operate instead of bending our workflows to someone else's SaaS.

  • The dashboards that run the business. Our Ops dashboard, Finance dashboard, and the Super Admin dashboard, plus the automations behind them. This means understanding why something matters to the business, not just what needs to be built.

  • Own the work that starts as a prototype and has to become a real system: internal applications and automations, product integrations, features for new verticals, and agentic workflows hardened into deterministic ones.

  • Net-new product POCs. Working directly with the Product Engineering team on early-stage ideas before they become full initiatives, bringing business context and translating it into technical decisions.

  • Guardrails on AI-assisted development. Our BizOps team ships production code with AI assistance. You'll review that work (architecture, infrastructure decisions, PRs) to make sure it's safe, reliable, and doesn't quietly generate tech debt we have to unwind later.

  • Build for reliability, not just speed. Design and build systems with real attention to reliability, performance, and maintainability. This is software that moves real money, so the bar is production-grade from day one.

  • Plug into the engineering team through code review, architecture feedback, and shared standards, so what you ship is production-grade and you get sharper with every initiative.

You'll sit within Engineering but work alongside our Business Operations and Product Engineering teams. You will support our non-technical subject matter experts in deploying product to our production codebase, building systems from scratch and refining our coding harnesses to make them more use-friendly for non-technical users.

We run parallel initiatives in small, high-autonomy teams, and we expect the people who join us to step up, make decisions, and take accountability for outcomes, technical and otherwise.

What you'll bring

  • Deep architectural knowledge. You can look at a system and tell whether it's built right, not just whether it works.

  • Platform/infrastructure fluency. You understand what's underneath the application layer (Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, data pipelines) even if you're not deploying it every day.

  • Strong software engineering ability within a full-stack range. You ship production code independently and have owned real systems end to end. You move comfortably between frontend and backend.

  • An AI-native operating bias. AI is your default way of working: multiple models, custom agents, and specialized contexts integrated into how you plan, build, and ship, not just Copilot autocomplete.

  • Proficiency in, or the ability to quickly ramp on, our stack: TypeScript, Next.js, and Python for internal tooling, and Go or Rust, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and AWS on the core platform.

  • Experience designing and evolving scalable systems, with a clear point of view on the tradeoffs involved for all stakeholders and end-users.

  • A demonstrated ability to take a project from end-to-end: technical execution, stakeholder communication, and delivery accountability.

  • Cross-functional instincts. You're comfortable moving between Operations, Product, and Data and switching context across very different stakeholders without losing the thread.

  • A bias toward business impact. You want to solve real operational problems and understand how the business actually runs and makes money.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, with the judgment to work autonomously, make decisions, and take accountability for outcomes.

  • Pragmatism and speed. You know when to build something fast and scrappy and when to make it bulletproof, and you can flex across domains without spreading yourself thin.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at a fintech or payments company, or somewhere you worked close to how money moves.

  • Experience contributing to billing, payments, or quote-to-cash systems.

  • Experience building internal tools, admin panels, or business-facing dashboards.

  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures (RabbitMQ or similar).

  • Background at a fast-scaling startup, or anywhere you owned systems end-to-end close to the business.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary tailored to your experience, skills, and expertise.

  • The base compensation range for this role is $200,000 - 250,000, plus equity. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the approximate total target compensation for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including relevant skills, experience, education/training.

  • Equity opportunities so you can share in our growth and success.

  • Unlimited PTO and flexibility when you need it the most.

  • Yearly learning & development stipend to help you grow and do your best work.

Why choose Alternative Payments?

At Alternative Payments, you'll do work that truly matters.

  • Own your impact: Build the internal systems the whole company runs on, and see your work used across the business every single day.

  • Collaborate: Work with a diverse, innovative team where every voice is heard and great ideas come from anywhere.

  • Grow with us: Your career journey is top of mind. We prioritize internal growth and give you the space to shape your path based on your goals, whether that's deepening your expertise in your domain or exploring something new.

  • Thrive in a supportive culture: As a scaling start-up, there's a lot to be done and initiative is key. We believe in shared learning, open communication, and building each other up. When one of us grows, we all do.

Want to see what we're actually building?

We made a short video so you don't have to take our word for it. Get a glimpse of our product, our people, and the problems we're solving, then decide if it sounds like your kind of place.

Our values

  • Transparency & Honesty: We communicate openly and truthfully with partners, investors, and each other so everyone understands where we stand and where we're headed.

  • Resourcefulness & AI: We stay scrappy, find creative solutions, and make progress even when the path isn't obvious. We have a bias for action and seek out the information and resources necessary to make decisions and move quickly.

  • Partnership: We win and lose together. We collaborate with our partners, investors, and teammates to tackle big challenges and reach shared goals.

  • Revolutionary & Boldness: We challenge conventions, take calculated risks, and build better, stronger solutions that move our business and the industry forward.

  • Accountability: We take ownership of our decisions and results. We follow through on our commitments knowing our work directly impacts our partners, our team and our business.

Applying to Alternative Payments

We're looking for candidates who are ready to step in and make an impact from day one. We know that sometimes people hold back unless they meet every requirement, but if you're excited about the role, bring relevant experience, and are ready to contribute, we want to hear from you!

All resumes are reviewed by our small but mighty talent team. While we may use AI tools to help prioritize applications, real people are behind every resume review and hiring decision. We're also committed to an inclusive and accessible process. If you require reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know upon being selected to interview.

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are looking for candidates in the UK, Ireland, Spain, Germany or Sweden.

Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. We are a 100% remote company. We believe in high-velocity but sustainable expectations and timeframes, giving people the room to do great work.

The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Bonus Points For:

  • Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
  • Experience working with OSS communities
  • Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
  • Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds

In Ireland, the base compensation range for this role is €104,000 - €124,800. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.

jobs.description:
CloudLinux is a global remote-first company. We are driven by our principles: do the right thing, employees first, we are remote first, and we deliver high-volume, low-cost Linux infrastructure and security products that help companies to increase the efficiency of their operations. Every person on our team supports each other and does what we can to ensure we all are successful.

Check out our website for more information

Imunify360 Security Suite is a product of CloudLinux Inc., the maker of the #1 OS in security and stability for hosting providers. Imunify is an innovative security solution designed specifically for shared and VPS/Dedicated servers. The automated, easy-to-use solution with the six-layer approach to security delivers comprehensive and complete attack prevention.

The mission

We protect web hosting providers and the sites running on their infrastructure through a defense-in-depth stack: web-server-layer WAF, runtime application self-protection for PHP, deep application integrations (WordPress plugins and similar), a malware scanner with cleanup capability, and network-layer firewalls and IP reputation. The pieces talk to each other, and the threat intelligence they generate at scale powers detection across the stack.

Node.js is the segment of the hosting market growing fastest, and the next layer we want to build for it is runtime protection inside the Node.js process itself. Most Node.js workloads on managed hosting today are AI-generated web apps deployed by non-technical owners who can't, won't, and shouldn't be expected to patch their own code or audit their own dependencies. We're going to defend those apps anyway — at runtime, without their cooperation, without breaking them.

You'll build that runtime protection layer end-to-end.

What you'll own

  • The product. A brand-new product line, yours to define — what we intercept, what we don't, what the customer-visible surface looks like.
  • The technical approach. Instrumentation strategy, deployment shape, programming language — all open. You'll consult with our architects but the direction is yours.
  • Implementation, end to end. You'll have the full tooling stack we provide — LLM subscriptions, modern dev infrastructure, the works. Use what makes you fast.
  • Methodology. How you build conviction in your detection logic — your call.
  • Cross-layer signal. Our existing stack produces threat intelligence at unmatched scale: tens of millions of monitored sites, petabyte-scale malware sample storage, real-time domain and URL reputation, IP-level attack feeds. These are available for you to plug into. Use what helps.

How we'll measure success

The product is held to four numbers: runtime overhead, false positives, false negatives, and customer-escalation volume. They reflect what hosting providers and their customers care about. Hit them well and the product runs inside a meaningful slice of the modern Node.js web.

What we're looking for

An experienced researcher or engineer who can build and iterate on a brand-new product, driving both the research and the development. The hard part of this work is knowing what's malicious, what's vulnerable, and what's just an unusual but legitimate pattern — and being right about it across the long tail of frameworks, libraries, and customer code we'll encounter in production.

Requirements

Must have:

  • Proven experience building and shipping a new product, security solution, major feature, or technical system from scratch.
  • Strong evidence of end-to-end technical ownership, from initial investigation and architecture through implementation, release, and production iteration.
  • Strong web application security knowledge and current knowledge of practical exploitation.
  • A working sense of how detection rules behave at scale — what catches attackers without flagging the long tail of legitimate code.
  • Ability to start as the PM, architect, lead engineer, and QA for this product. You ask for resources or help when you need them; you don't wait to be told what to do.
  • Comfort directing AI coding agents to high-quality output.

Nice to have:

  • Prior work on runtime-protection products, application firewalls, or instrumentation tooling.
  • Background in malware analysis or incident response.
  • Familiarity with managed-hosting environments.
  • Public security research, vulnerability disclosures, or detection rulesets you've authored.
  • Familiarity with the Node.js runtime and the JavaScript ecosystem.

What it's not

  • Not a scope-and-handoff role — you drive the work and own the outcome.
  • Not a "platform team will productize this later" role — you ship to real customer fleets and watch the telemetry quickly.
  • Not a spec-and-review role — you are hands-on every day.

Why this matters

  • Most managed-hosting customers are not developers. They cannot patch their apps. They cannot audit their dependencies. They will keep deploying vulnerable code from AI assistants because that's how modern web apps get built now. The textbook advice — "secure your code, audit your dependencies" — does not apply to them.
  • If we don't intercept exploits at runtime, nobody will. The numbers you hit on detection, performance, and false positives will materially affect how much of the modern web stays online when the next exploit class drops.

Benefits

What's in it for you?

  • A focus on professional development.
  • Interesting and challenging projects.
  • Fully remote work with flexible working hours, that allows you to schedule your day and work from any location worldwide.
  • Paid 24 days of vacation per year, 10 days of national holidays, and unlimited sick leaves.
  • Compensation for private medical insurance.
  • Co-working and gym/sports reimbursement.
  • Budget for education.
  • The opportunity to receive a reward for the most innovative idea that the company can patent.

jobs.excerpt: Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk ModellingHybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement) We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad.
jobs.description:
Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement)

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad.

You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't.

The squad works across three areas:

  • Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model.

  • The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from.

  • New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches.

The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead.

The role

As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems.

You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows.

Live project examples:

  • Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use.

  • Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning.

  • Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers...

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision.

  • Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending.

  • Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance.

  • Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.excerpt: The Role:We’re looking for a senior data engineer to own our data platform from architecture through production, reliably turning high volumes of data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping into trusted records for our products.
jobs.description:
The Role:

We’re looking for a senior data engineer to own our data platform from architecture through production, reliably turning high volumes of data from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping into trusted records for our products.

Today, our enrichment and extraction workflows largely run serially inside a container. You’ll lead the move to a platform that supports concurrent processing, event-driven intake, and orchestrated batch workflows.

Responsibilities:

  • Multi-source intake: Build concurrent ingestion for provider APIs, webhooks, files, and scraping, with rate limits and failure handling.

  • Batch and event-driven execution: Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect. Build event-driven intake with Pub/Sub or Cloud Tasks, including retries, dead-letter queues, and controlled replay of failed work.

  • Raw-to-curated data: Preserve original payloads, including provider JSON, in Google Cloud Storage (GCS) before transforming them with dbt. Establish medallion layers for raw, standardized, and curated data.

  • Correctness through recovery: Implement idempotent upserts and safe retries, replay, and historical backfills that avoid duplicate records or data corruption. Make data traceable to its source and safe to reprocess.

  • Data quality and delivery: Define data contracts, build automated validation and pipeline tests, and monitor freshness and failures. Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and loading patterns so downstream products receive dependable data.

  • Extraction and enrichment: Integrate provider enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction from text into the platform.

Requirements:

  • Experience building multi-source production data platforms from zero to one, from initial architecture and pipeline implementation through deployment and ongoing operation.

  • Production experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or Temporal, including dependencies, retries, and failure recovery. Airflow experience is preferred.

  • Hands-on production experience with dbt and GCP.

  • Experience building event-driven systems with messaging or task queues, including asynchronous processing and failure recovery.

  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and reliable incremental loading. Experience with data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, and automated quality checks.

  • Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with tools such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

  • Hands-on web scraping experience with tools such as Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, or Beautiful Soup, including concurrent scraping, rate limits, and failure handling.

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience working in startups or small engineering teams, with broad ownership and changing priorities.

  • Entity resolution experience is especially valuable: matching company and people records across sources and reconciling duplicates into consistent entities.

  • LLM-based structured extraction or company and people data enrichment.

  • Familiarity with BigQuery and Dataform.

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI
